			monster_load_async = function(this)
				if this.container == nil then
					this.container = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(this.specs)
				end
			end,
			dispose = function(this)
				if this.container ~= nil then
					load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(this.container)
					this.container = nil
				end
			end,
		}

	--region 터널 어둡게 틴트 작업
	self.fx_background = nil
	self.camera_grid_name = 'tunnel_grid'
	self.property_name = '_Color'

	self.target_alpha = nil
	self.current_alpha = 0

function local_class:request_change_tint_field(is_turn_on)
	local new_state = is_turn_on and "dark" or "off"
	local new_target = is_turn_on and self.tine_valve or 0

	-- 이미 같은 상태면 무시
	if self.last_state == new_state then
		return
	end

	-- 새로운 목표값 설정
	self.last_state = new_state
	self.target_alpha = new_target

	-- 전환이 진행중이 아니면 시작
	if not self.is_transitioning then
		self.is_transitioning = true
		start_coroutine(self.transition_alpha, self)
	end
end

function local_class:transition_alpha()
	while self.is_transitioning do
		local start_alpha = self.current_alpha
		local time_passed = 0

		-- 현재 알파에서 목표 알파까지의 거리
		local alpha_diff = math.abs(self.target_alpha - self.current_alpha)

		-- 목표에 거의 도달했으면 종료
		if alpha_diff < 0.01 then
			self.current_alpha = self.target_alpha
			self.is_transitioning = false
			break
		end

		while true do
			local progress = time_passed / self.transition_duration

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			-- 목표가 바뀌었으면 새로운 전환 시작
			if self.target_alpha ~= self.target_alpha then
				break
			end

			self.current_alpha = start_alpha + (self.target_alpha - start_alpha) * progress

			self.material:SetColor(self.property_name, unity_color(
					{ 0, 0, 0, self.current_alpha }))

			if progress >= 1.0 then
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:start_field_tint()
	local duration = 0.5
	local time_passed = 0
	local max_alpha = 0.3

	self.fx_background = self.fx.background():Instantiate(stage_camera.transform.position,
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, stage_camera.transform)

	self.fx_background.transform.localScale = vector(6, 1, 3)

	self.material = self                    .fx_background.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
			typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer)).material

	self.material:SetColor(self.property_name, unity_color(
			{ 1, 1, 1, alpha }))

	while (time_passed < duration and self.field_tint_request ~= nil) do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local alpha = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, max_alpha, progress)

		self.material:SetColor(self.property_name, unity_color(
				{ 1, 1, 1, alpha }))

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.field_tint_start_request = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.loaded and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.character.lancer_girl) then
		self.current_state = self.states.interact_lancer_girl

		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_lancer_girl, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.interact_lancer_girl and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.character.lancer_girl) then

		sp_util.start_scene(self.re_interact_lancer_girl, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	local count = 4

	for index = 1, count do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.get_lava_switch(index), e.SwitchObject) then

			if self.minigame.switch_onoff_data[self.minigame_switch_key_name .. index] ~= nil then
				self.minigame.switch_onoff_data[self.minigame_switch_key_name .. index] = e.IsTurningOn
			end

			self:update_lava_switch()
			self.minigame.clear_flag = self:is_minigame_clear()
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

	--라피스 : 일곱 시 방향에3번 탕이야.
	do
		local pos = self.get_minigame_pos(3)

		camera_util.move_async(pos, 1)
	end

	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(lancer_girl,
			'fw_sub_hs_s3_42', true, { viewport_pos = vector(0.75, 0.25) })

	--카메라 포커스 아래 위치로 1초간 이동 / 끝날때까지 대기
	--화면에 대사창 출력
	--x (0.75) / y (0.25)
	--라피스 : 다섯 시 방향에 4번 탕.
	do
		local pos = self.get_minigame_pos(4)

		camera_util.move_async(pos, 1)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'left',

	--라피스 (left, idle, idle) : 그래도 모르겠으면 각 위치마다 표지판이 있으니 확인하면 돼.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s3_45')

	--라피스 (left, tired, idle) : 문제는 수로를 돌리는 건데….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'left',
			nil, 'tired', 'fw_sub_hs_s3_46')

	--라피스 (left, tired, idle) : 아직 손님이 몰리기 전까지는 시간이 좀 있으니, 한 번 둘러보고 위치를 파악해볼래?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'left',
			nil, 'tired', 'fw_sub_hs_s3_47')

	--선택지
	--(intellect) 둘러보고 올게요.
	--(forced) 바로 실전으로 들어가죠.
	do
		local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'fw_sub_hs_s3_48', 'intellect' },
			{ 'fw_sub_hs_s3_49', 'forced' },
		})

		if result == 1 then
			--기사 (right, attack, idle) jump 2회
			--0.5초 대기
			wait_all_lua(
					function()
						character_util.normal_double_jump(knight, '01_small_jump_01')
					end,
					function()
						scene_util.play_wait_action(knight, self, 'right',
								nil, 'attack', 0.5)
					end
			)

			--라피스 (left, idle, idle) : 그래. 손님들 불만은 내가 막고 있을테니까 충분히 둘러보고 와.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'left',
					nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s3_50')

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

			--플레이어 컨트롤 해제
			--이후 재인터랙트시 재인터랙트 연출로 진행.
		else
			--기사 (right, doyagao, cross_arm)

			--라피스 (left, smile, idle) : 자신감이 대단하네! 그럼 바로 시작하자!
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'left',
					nil, 'smile', 'fw_sub_hs_s3_51')

			--이후 수로 액티비티 진행으로 이동.
			--화면 페이드 아웃되며 bgm 뮤트 / 믹스 디폴트
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0)

			screen_util.fade_out_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			self:minigame_start()

	end
end

function local_class:minigame_start()
	self.current_state = self.states.minigame_before

	self.minigame_constants = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Main/FireWorld/HotSpring/Constants')

	self.minigame:dynamic_npc_load_async()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.character.lancer_girl, self.controller)

	self.controller:remove_quest_marker()

	do
		local npc_count = 19
		local rock_count = 4
		local customer = self.dynamic_npc:get_customer()

		character_util.set_position(customer, self.nowhere)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(customer, active_state_type.disabled)

		for index = 1, npc_count do
			local npc = self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(index)

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, 0, 0)
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			npc.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)
		end

		for index = 1, rock_count do
			local rock = self.get_minigame_rocks(index)

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick
			damage_info.sender = rock
			damage_info.target = rock
			damage_info.damage = 1

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end

	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_on_off_event')

	local return_party = false

	while true do
		local is_all_clear = self:minigame_routine()

		do
			self.deactive_ui_and_controller()

			self.character.lancer_girl.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
		end

		if is_all_clear then
			self:minigame_clear_scene()

			break
		else
			return_party = self:fail_scene()

			if return_party then
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:minigame_routine()
	local lancer_girl = self.character.lancer_girl
	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local timer_duration = self.minigame_constants.timer_duration
	local quest_table = self.minigame_constants.quest_switch

	local function reset_minigame()
		local count = 4

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(get_party_leader(), { 'LavaFlowHandlerReset' }))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(get_party_leader(), { 'LavaFlowHandlerSwitchReset' }))

		do
			local group_1_2_count = self.minigame.group_1_2_count

			for index = 1, group_1_2_count do
				local npc = self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(index)

				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, 0, 0)
			end
		end

		do
			local group_3_4_count = self.minigame.group_3_4_count

			for index = 9, group_3_4_count do
				local npc = self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(index)

				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, 0, 0)
			end
		end

		self:minigame_npc_pos_setting()

		self:set_active_minigame_wall(active_state_type.enabled)

		self.minigame.quest_type_index = 1

		self.minigame.time_over_flag = false
		self.minigame.clear_flag = false

		self.minigame.switch_onoff_data = {
			[self.minigame_switch_key_name .. 1] = self.minigame_constants.switch_onoff_data[self.minigame_switch_key_name .. 1],
			[self.minigame_switch_key_name .. 2] = self.minigame_constants.switch_onoff_data[self.minigame_switch_key_name .. 2],
			[self.minigame_switch_key_name .. 3] = self.minigame_constants.switch_onoff_data[self.minigame_switch_key_name .. 3],
			[self.minigame_switch_key_name .. 4] = self.minigame_constants.switch_onoff_data[self.minigame_switch_key_name .. 4],
		}

		lancer_girl.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end

	local function set_quest(custom_objects, table_count)
		self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table = nil
		local quest_count = table_util.get_size(quest_table[self.minigame.type_key_name .. self.minigame.quest_type_index])

		if custom_objects ~= nil then
			self.minigame.random_quest_index = random_util.get_random_int(
					1, table_count)

			self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table = custom_objects[self.minigame.random_quest_index]

		else
			self.minigame.random_quest_index = random_util.get_random_int(
					1, quest_count)

			self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table = quest_table[self.minigame.type_key_name .. self.minigame.quest_type_index][self.minigame.random_quest_index]
		end

		self.minigame.clear_objects = {}

		if self.minigame.quest_type_index == 1 then
			self.minigame.clear_objects[self.minigame_switch_key_name .. self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table] = false
		else
			for index = 1, table_util.get_size(self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table) do
				self.minigame.clear_objects[self.minigame_switch_key_name .. self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table[index]] = false
			end
		end

		self:update_lava_switch()

		local is_clear = self:is_minigame_clear()

		if is_clear then
			self.minigame.clear_objects = {}
			self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table = nil

			local not_clear_switch_table = self:get_current_not_clear_switch(custom_objects)

			if self.minigame.quest_type_index == 1 then

				self.minigame.random_quest_index = not_clear_switch_table
				self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table = not_clear_switch_table

				self.minigame.clear_objects[self.minigame_switch_key_name .. self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table] = false
			else
				self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table = {}

				self.minigame.clear_objects[self.minigame_switch_key_name .. not_clear_switch_table[1]] = false
				self.minigame.clear_objects[self.minigame_switch_key_name .. not_clear_switch_table[2]] = false

				self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table[1] = not_clear_switch_table[1]
				self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table[2] = not_clear_switch_table[2]

				self:update_lava_switch()
			end
		end

		if self.minigame.quest_type_index == 1 then
			self:reaction_negative_npc_setting(self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table)
			self:show_emoticon_minigame_npc_group(self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table, true)
		else
			for index = 1, table_util.get_size(self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table) do
				self:reaction_negative_npc_setting(self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table[index])
				self:show_emoticon_minigame_npc_group(self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table[index], true)
			end
		end
	end

	local function start_sequence(action, custom_quest_arg)
		if custom_quest_arg ~= nil then
			set_quest(custom_quest_arg.table, custom_quest_arg.count)
		else
			set_quest()
		end

		self:active_ui_and_conroller()

		action(self)

		while self.minigame.clear_flag == false and self.minigame.time_over_flag == false do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	local function end_sequence(is_progress, is_npc_fade_out)
		self.deactive_ui_and_controller()

		--라피스, 그 자리에서 멈추고 (기사 방향, smile, cast2) 전환
		character_util.stop(lancer_girl)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lancer_girl)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(lancer_girl)

		character_util.look_at(lancer_girl, knight)
		scene_util.set_emotion(lancer_girl, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(lancer_girl, self, 'cast2')

		do
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_effect_lava_01')

			if self.minigame.quest_type_index == 1 then
				self:reaction_positive_npc_setting(self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table, is_npc_fade_out)
				self:show_emoticon_minigame_npc_group(self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table, false)
			else
				for index = 1, table_util.get_size(self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table) do
					self:reaction_positive_npc_setting(self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table[index], is_npc_fade_out)
					self:show_emoticon_minigame_npc_group(self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table[index], false)
				end
			end

			wait_for_sec(2)
		end

		if is_progress then
			self.minigame.quest_type_index = self.minigame.quest_type_index + 1
		end

		--화면에 말풍선 출력
		--x(0.5) y(0.75) / 말풍선 크기 3
		--라피스 : [shout] 잘했어 신참!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
		scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(lancer_girl, 'fw_sub_hs_s3_minigame_30_1', false, {
			viewport_pos = vector(0.75, 0.75), scale = 3
		})

		--생성되어 있던 NPC 0.5초간 알파 페이드 아웃으로 제거
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lancer_girl)

		self.minigame.clear_flag = false
	end

	do
		local pivot = self.get_minigame_switch(2).Position

		character_util.set_position(lancer_girl, pivot + vector(1, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_position(knight, pivot + vector(2, 0, 0))

		scene_util.set_direction(lancer_girl, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
	end

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(8, 0)

	reset_minigame()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_lava_01')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	do
		local viewport_vector = vector(0.75, 0.75)
		local bubble_scale = 2

		--라피스 (right, idle, release 2회) : 내가 돌아다니면서 공급이 필요한 탕이 몇 번인지 말 해줄게.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, nil,
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, {
					key = 'fw_sub_hs_s3_minigame_32', skip = true, viewport_pos = viewport_vector, scale = bubble_scale })

		--라피스 (right, idle, idle) : 동시에 여러 곳에 공급이 필요할 수 있으니까 내 말을 자세히 들어줘.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, nil,
				nil, nil, {
					key = 'fw_sub_hs_s3_minigame_33', skip = true, viewport_pos = viewport_vector, scale = bubble_scale })

		--라피스 (right, idle, idle) : 수로를 막고 있던 용암 찌꺼기들은 내가 다 빼놨으니까 걱정마!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, nil,
				'idle', 'idle', {
					key = 'fw_sub_hs_s3_minigame_34', skip = true, viewport_pos = viewport_vector, scale = bubble_scale })
	end

	--기사 (left, idle, nod 2회)
	scene_util.play_custom_action(knight, self, nil,
			nil, nil, function()
				scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
			end)

	--0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--3번 액티비티 시작으로 이동
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = 'bgm_shaolin_intro', volume = 0.8})
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.8)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
	timer_util.start_timer({
		duration = timer_duration,
		handler = self,
		callback = 'time_over'
	})

	do
		start_sequence(self.first_quest_action, { table = { 1, 2, 3 }, count = 3 })

		if self.minigame.time_over_flag then
			return false
		end

		end_sequence(false)
	end

	do
		start_sequence(self.first_quest_action)

		if self.minigame.time_over_flag then
			return false
		end

		end_sequence(true)
	end

	do
		start_sequence(self.table_quest_action)

		character_util.stop(lancer_girl)

		while self.minigame.lancer_girl_move_end_flag == false do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		if self.minigame.time_over_flag then
			return false
		end

		end_sequence(false)
	end

	do
		start_sequence(self.table_quest_action)

		character_util.stop(lancer_girl)

		while self.minigame.lancer_girl_move_end_flag == false do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		if self.minigame.time_over_flag then
			return false
		end

		end_sequence(false)
	end

	do
		start_sequence(self.table_quest_action, { table = {
			{ 1, 2 }, { 1, 3 }, { 1, 4 }
		}, count = 3 })

		character_util.stop(lancer_girl)

		while self.minigame.lancer_girl_move_end_flag == false do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		if self.minigame.time_over_flag then
			return false
		end

		timer_util.end_timer(self, true)

		wait_all_lua(
				function()
					end_sequence(false, false)
				end,
				function()
					wait_for_sec(2)

					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_activity_clear_01')
					--	--클리어 처리와 동시에 bgm 뮤트 / 믹스 1.5초
					music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0, 1.5)
				end
		)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:is_minigame_clear()
	local is_clear = true

	for _, boolean in pairs(self.minigame.clear_objects) do
		if boolean == false then
			is_clear = false
		end
	end

	if is_clear then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:minigame_clear_scene()
	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local lancer_girl = self.character.lancer_girl
	local staff = self.character.staff
	local witch = self.character.witch
	local dynamic_monster = self.controller.dynamic_monster

	--라피스가 팔로워로 붙음
	character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(lancer_girl, user_party, true)

	--컨트롤 복귀와 함께 bgm 볼륨 1로 원복 / 믹스 디폴트
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 1})

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	field_ui_util.show_default_single_ui()

	self.controller:progress_section()
end

function local_class:fail_scene()
	local lancer_girl = self.character.lancer_girl
	local knight = get_party_leader()

	do
		self:fail_npc_setting()

		wait_for_sec(2)
	end

	--실패 조건 및 연출
	--30초 이내에 5회차를 모두 완료하지 않았을 시 실패 처리.
	--타이머 UI 제거
	--플레이어 컨트롤 제한
	--동시 시작
	--화면 shake (0.1, 0.3)
	--실패 시 카메라 shake에 bgm 뮤트
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	--화면에 말풍선 출력
	--기사, 라피스 (down, attack, idle) jump 1회
	do
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'down')
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')

		scene_util.set_direction(lancer_girl, 'down')
		scene_util.set_emotion(lancer_girl, self, 'attack')
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(lancer_girl)

		character_util.normal_jump(lancer_girl, '01_small_jump_01')
		character_util.normal_jump(knight, '01_small_jump_01')
	end

	--화면 1초간 페이드 아웃
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--화면 1초간 페이드 인 되며 아래 세팅으로 전환 / 카메라값 4, 포커스 기사.
	camera_util.resize_to_default_async(0)

	self:set_active_minigame_wall(active_state_type.disabled)

	--라피스 (right, tired, cast)
	--기사 (left, tired, bomb_idle)
	--4번 (right, attack, cross_arm)
	--3번 (right, mad, idle)
	--12번 (right, attack, idle)
	--15번 (up, idle, idle)
	--16번 (left, tired,bomb_ idle)
	--8번 (left, mad, cross_arm)
	--7번 (left, attack, idle)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	do
		local pivot = self.get_marker_lancer_girl() + vector(-2, 0, -1)

		local function npc_setting(npc, pos, dir, emo, anim)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)

			character_util.set_position(npc, pos)
			character_util.set_direction(npc, dir)
			character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = anim })
			character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = emo })

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, 1, 0)
			npc.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)
		end

		character_util.set_position(knight, pivot + vector(0.5, 0, 1))
		character_util.set_direction(knight, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(knight, { name = 'bomb_dile' }, { name = 'tired' })

		character_util.set_position(lancer_girl, pivot + vector(-0.5, 0, 1))
		character_util.set_direction(lancer_girl, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(lancer_girl, { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'tired' })

		npc_setting(self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(4), pivot + vector(-1.5, 0, 2), 'right', 'attack', 'cross_arm')
		npc_setting(self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(3), pivot + vector(-1.5, 0, 1), 'right', 'mad', 'idle')
		npc_setting(self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(12), pivot + vector(-1, 0, 0), 'right', 'attack', 'idle')
		npc_setting(self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(15), pivot + vector(0.5, 0, -0.5), 'up', 'idle', 'idle')
		npc_setting(self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(16), pivot + vector(1, 0, 0), 'left', 'tired', 'bomb_idle')
		npc_setting(self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(8), pivot + vector(1.5, 0, 1), 'left', 'mad', 'cross_arm')
		npc_setting(self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(7), pivot + vector(1.5, 0, 2), 'left', 'attack', 'idle')
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	--동시 시작 / 모든 동작 끝날때까지 대기
	--라피스, 기사 (down, tired, cast) 캐릭터 shake (0.03,1)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'cast')
	scene_util.shake(knight, 0.03, 1)

	scene_util.set_direction(lancer_girl, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion(lancer_girl, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(lancer_girl, self, 'cast')
	scene_util.shake(lancer_girl, 0.03, 1)

	--카메라 줌 인 (2.5, 1.5)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(2.5, 1.5)

	--4번 (right, attack, cross_arm) : 언제까지 기다리게 하는거야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(4), self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s3_minigame_36')

	--16번 (left, tired,bomb_ idle) : 온천에 와서 온천도 못하면 무슨 소용이야?!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(16), self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s3_minigame_37')

	--3번 (right, mad, release 2회) : 이거 환불받아야겠어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(3), self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s3_minigame_38')

	--이후 NPC 순차적으로 아래 경로로 이동, 프레임 밖으로 사라지면 탕에 있는 NPC까지 모든 NPC 제거 (각자 정렬된 표정 유지된 상태로 이동합니다.)
	--4,3번 이동
	local function remove_npc(npc)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.disabled)
		character_util.set_position(npc, self.nowhere)
	end

	local move_key = 'npc_move_end'

	do
		local npc_4 = self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(4)
		local npc_3 = self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(3)

		local npc_4_end_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', npc_4.Position, -4)
		local npc_3_end_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', npc_3.Position, -4)

		character_util.remove_anim(npc_4)
		character_util.remove_anim(npc_3)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc_4, npc_4_end_pos, 4, nil, self, move_key, { end_callback = function()
			remove_npc(npc_4)
		end })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc_3, npc_3_end_pos, 4, nil, self, move_key, { end_callback = function()
			remove_npc(npc_3)
		end })
	end

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--15번 이동
	do
		local npc_15 = self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(15)

		local npc_end_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', npc_15.Position, -4)

		character_util.remove_anim(npc_15)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc_15, npc_end_pos, 4, nil, self, move_key, { end_callback = function()
			remove_npc(npc_15)
		end })
	end

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--12번 이동
	do
		local npc_12 = self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(12)

		local npc_end_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', npc_12.Position, -4)

		character_util.remove_anim(npc_12)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc_12, npc_end_pos, 4, nil, self, move_key, { end_callback = function()
			remove_npc(npc_12)
		end })
	end

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--7,16번 이동
	do
		local npc_7 = self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(7)
		local npc_16 = self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(16)

		local npc_7_end_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', npc_7.Position, -4)

		local npc_16_end_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', npc_16.Position, -4)

		character_util.remove_anim(npc_7)
		character_util.remove_anim(npc_16)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc_7, npc_7_end_pos, 4, nil, self, move_key, { end_callback = function()
			remove_npc(npc_7)
		end })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc_16, npc_16_end_pos, 4, nil, self, move_key, { end_callback = function()
			remove_npc(npc_16)
		end })
	end

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--8번 이동
	do
		local npc_8 = self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(8)

		local npc_8_end_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', npc_8.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5), -4)
		local npc_8_waypoints = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(npc_8, npc_8_end_pos, false)

		character_util.remove_anim(npc_8)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc_8, npc_8_waypoints, 4, nil, self, move_key, { end_callback = function()
			remove_npc(npc_8)
		end })
	end

	--모든 NPC 제거 후 다음 연출 진행
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lancer_girl)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	--라피스 (right, tired, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(lancer_girl, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(lancer_girl, self, 'tired')

	--기사 (left, tried, cast) sweat 이모티콘
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(knight, self, 'left',
			'cast', { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'sweat')

	--라피스 (right, tired, idle) : 괜찮아. 처음부터 잘하는 법은 없지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s3_minigame_39')

	--라피스 (right, tired, idle) : 바로 다음 손님을 받을 수 있겠어?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s3_minigame_40')

	--선택지
	--(mercy) 네
	--(brutal) 난 이제 지쳤어요.
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'fw_sub_hs_s3_minigame_41', 'mercy' },
		{ 'fw_sub_hs_s3_minigame_42', 'brutal' },
	})

	if result == 1 then
		--기사 (left, attack, idle) jump 1회
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
		character_util.normal_jump_async(knight)

		--라피스 (right, smile, idle) rowdy 이모티콘
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(lancer_girl, self, 'right',
				nil, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'rowdy')

		--1.5초간 서클로 페이드 아웃
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

		--1번 초기값 세팅으로 전환하며 액티비티 재시작
		return false
	else
		self.current_state = self.states.interact_lancer_girl

		--기사 (left, tired, cast)
		scene_util.play_wait_action(knight, self, 'left',
				'cast', 'tired', 1)

		--라피스 (right, tired, nod 2회) : 그래, 조금만 쉬었다 하자.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'fw_sub_hs_s3_minigame_43')

		--1.5초간 페이드 아웃.
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		--양 옆에 설치된 나가기 방지용 오브젝트 제거
		--1번 초기값 세팅으로 전환한 뒤 플레이어 컨트롤 해제.
		--npc들도 초기값으로 세팅 필요.
		--라피스에게 서브퀘스트 마커 표시 후 재인터랙트시 재인터랙트부터 시작
		do
			local pos = self.get_minigame_switch(2).Position + vector(1, 0, 0)

			character_util.set_position(lancer_girl, pos)
			character_util.set_direction(lancer_girl, 'left')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lancer_girl)

			--퀘스트 마커는 라피스에게
			field_object_util.set_active_state(lancer_girl, active_state_type.enabled)
			character_util.add_listener(lancer_girl, self.controller)

			self.controller:active_quest_marker(lancer_girl)
		end

		--재인터랙트 연출
		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

		camera_util.resize_to_default_async(0)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		--1.5초간 페이드 아웃.
		--페이드 인 / 컨트롤 복귀와 함께 bgm 볼륨 1로 원복 / 믹스 디폴트
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 1})

		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		return true
	end
end

		character_util.set_emotion(npc, emo)

		if custom_func ~= nil then
			custom_func()
		end

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, 1, 0.5)
	end

	--group1
	if group_index == 1 then
		--스위치 1번 그룹 / 전체 NPC jump 반복
		--1번 염룡 남자 (down, mad, cast2) angry 이모티콘

				'down', { name = 'mad' }, { name = 'cast2' })
		npc_setting(self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(2),
				'down', { name = 'mad' }, { name = 'idle' })
		npc_setting(self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(3),
				'down', { name = 'mad' }, { name = 'cross_arm' })
		npc_setting(self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(4),
				'down', { name = 'tired' }, { name = 'cast2' })

		--group2
	elseif group_index == 2 then
		--스위치 2번 그룹 / 전체 NPC jump 반복
		--5번 염룡 여자 (down, mad, cast2) angry 이모티콘
		--6번 염룡 여자 (down, mad, bomb_idle) angry 이모티콘
		--7번 하피 남자 (down, mad, cross_arm) angry 이모티콘
		--8번 염룡 남자 (down, mad, release 반복) angry 이모티콘

		npc_setting(self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(5),
				'down', { name = 'mad' }, { name = 'cast2' })
		npc_setting(self.minigame:get_dynamic_npc(6),
				'down', { name = 'mad' }, { name = 'bomb_idle' })

			character_util.set_anim(lancer_girl, { name = 'cast' })

function local_class:table_quest_action()
	local lancer_girl = self.character.lancer_girl
	local quest_index = self.minigame.random_quest_index
	local key_table = {
		'fw_sub_hs_s3_minigame_22',
		'fw_sub_hs_s3_minigame_23',
		'fw_sub_hs_s3_minigame_24',
		'fw_sub_hs_s3_minigame_25',
		'fw_sub_hs_s3_minigame_26',
		'fw_sub_hs_s3_minigame_27',
	}

	for index = 1, table_util.get_size(self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table) do
		self:group_jump(self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table[index])
	end

	--2, 3회차
	--라피스 (기사 방향, attack, release 2회) : [shout] 신참 <b>1번, 2번</b>이야!
	--라피스 (기사 방향, attack, release 2회) : [shout] 신참 <b>1번, 3번</b>이야!
	--라피스 (기사 방향, attack, release 2회) : [shout] 신참 <b>1번, 4번</b>이야!
	--라피스 (기사 방향, attack, release 2회) : [shout] 신참 <b>2번, 3번</b>이야!
	--라피스 (기사 방향, attack, release 2회) : [shout] 신참 <b>2번, 4번</b>이야!
	--라피스 (기사 방향, attack, release 2회) : [shout] 신참 <b>3번, 4번</b>이야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(lancer_girl,
			{
				key = key_table[quest_index],
				skip = false,
				bubble_type = 'shout',
				portraitname = self.lancer_girl_portraitname,
				viewport_pos = vector(0.75, 0.75),
				scale = 2,
				keep_display = true
			})

	start_coroutine(function()
		local pos_table_index = 1

		self.minigame.lancer_girl_move_end_flag = false

		while self.minigame.clear_flag == false and self.minigame.time_over_flag == false do
			local move_pos = self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table[pos_table_index]
			local pos = self.get_minigame_lancer_girl_pos(move_pos)
			local waypoints = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(lancer_girl, pos, false)

			wp_util.move_async(lancer_girl, waypoints, 7, nil, { run = true })

			if self.minigame.clear_flag == true or self.minigame.time_over_flag == true then
				break
			end

			if move_pos == 1 or move_pos == 2 then
				scene_util.set_direction(lancer_girl, 'up')
				character_util.set_anim(lancer_girl, { name = 'cast' })
			else
				scene_util.set_direction(lancer_girl, 'down')
				character_util.set_anim(lancer_girl, { name = 'cast' })
				character_util.set_emotion(lancer_girl, { name = 'tired' })
			end

			self:wait_for_sec(1.5)

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lancer_girl)

			if pos_table_index < table_util.get_size(self.minigame.clear_switch_index_table) then
				pos_table_index = pos_table_index + 1
			else
				pos_table_index = 1
			end
		end

		self.minigame.lancer_girl_move_end_flag = true
	end)
end

function local_class:update_lava_switch()
	local clear_objects_count = 4

	for index = 1, clear_objects_count do
		if self.minigame.clear_objects[self.minigame_switch_key_name .. index] ~= nil and
				self.minigame.clear_objects[self.minigame_switch_key_name .. index] ~= self.minigame.switch_onoff_data[self.minigame_switch_key_name .. index] then
			self.minigame.clear_objects[self.minigame_switch_key_name .. index] = self.minigame.switch_onoff_data[self.minigame_switch_key_name .. index]
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_current_not_clear_switch(custom_objects)
	local quest_table = self.minigame_constants.quest_switch[self.minigame.type_key_name .. self.minigame.quest_type_index]

	if custom_objects ~= nil then
		for index = 1, table_util.get_size(custom_objects) do
			if self.minigame.quest_type_index == 1 then
				if self.minigame.switch_onoff_data[self.minigame_switch_key_name .. custom_objects[index]] == false then

					self.minigame.random_quest_index = index

					return custom_objects[index]
				end
			else
				local quest_switch = custom_objects[index]

				for switch_number = 1, table_util.get_size(quest_switch) do
					if self.minigame.switch_onoff_data[self.minigame_switch_key_name .. quest_switch[switch_number]] == false then
						self.minigame.random_quest_index = index

						return quest_switch
					end
				end
			end
		end
	else
		for index = 1, table_util.get_size(quest_table) do
			if self.minigame.quest_type_index == 1 then
				if self.minigame.switch_onoff_data[self.minigame_switch_key_name .. quest_table[index]] == false then
					self.minigame.random_quest_index = index
					return quest_table[index]
				end
			else
				local quest_switch = quest_table[index]

				for switch_number = 1, table_util.get_size(quest_switch) do
					if self.minigame.switch_onoff_data[self.minigame_switch_key_name .. quest_switch[switch_number]] == false then
						self.minigame.random_quest_index = index
						return quest_switch
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:wait_for_sec(time)
	local s = unity_class.time.time

	while unity_class.time.time - s < time and (self.minigame.clear_flag == false and self.minigame.time_over_flag == false) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

return local_class

			if this.container == nil then
				this.container = {}
			end

			this.container = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_with_prefix_async(this.group_name, this.specs)

			return this.container
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			if this.container == nil then
				return
			end

			load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(this.container)

			this.container = nil
		end,
	}

	self.dynamic_npcs = metatable_helper.inherit({
		pull_monster = metatable_helper.inherit({
			group_name = 's4_pull_monster_',
			specs = {
				staff_1 = 'fw_hotspring_staff',
				staff_2 = 'fw_hotspring_staff',
				staff_3 = 'fw_hotspring_staff',
				staff_4 = 'fw_hotspring_staff',
				volcanic_ash_monster = 'fw_hotspring_monster',
				wyvern_1 = 'fw_wyvern_red',
				wyvern_2 = 'fw_wyvern_red',
				wyvern_3 = 'fw_wyvern_red',
				wyvern_4 = 'fw_wyvern_red',
				wyvern_5 = 'fw_wyvern_red',
				wyvern_6 = 'fw_wyvern_red',
				wyvern_7 = 'fw_wyvern_red',
				wyvern_8 = 'fw_wyvern_red',
				wyvern_9 = 'fw_wyvern_red',
				wyvern_10 = 'fw_wyvern_red',
			},
		}, dynamic_npc_helper),
	}, {
		dispose = function(this)
			for key, value in pairs(this) do
				value:dispose()
			end
		end,
	})

	local item_helper = {
		spawn = function(this, position, spr_scale, show_on_character)
			this.obj = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
				item_id = this.id,
				pos = position,
				unique_id = this.key,
				loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
				show_on_character = show_on_character,
				spr_scale = spr_scale,
				skip_text = true,
			})
		end,

		move_async = function(this, pos, duration)
			quest_drop_item_util.move_async(this.obj, pos, { duration = duration })
		end,

		drop_async = function(this, start_pos, end_pos, spr_scale)
			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
				item_id = this.id,
				pos = start_pos,
				spr_scale = spr_scale,
				unique_id = this.key,
				loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
				skip_text = false,
			})

			quest_drop_item_util.rotate(item, 1080, 0.75)

			quest_drop_item_util.move_async(item, end_pos, {
				duration = 0.75,
				y_move = function(progress)
					return math.sin(math.pi * progress) * 2.3
				end
			})

			this.obj = item
		end,

		consume_async = function(this, target)
			if this.obj == nil then
				return
			end

			quest_drop_item_util.consumed(this.obj, target)

			while this.obj.ConsumeTarget do
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			this.obj = nil
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			if this.obj == nil then
				return
			end

			quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(this.obj)

			this.obj = nil
		end
	}

	self.item = metatable_helper.inherit({
		gem_field = metatable_helper.inherit({
			id = 21651,
			key = 'fw_gem_field',
			obj = nil
		}, item_helper),

		rope = metatable_helper.inherit({
			id = 21652,
			key = 'fw_rope',
			obj = nil
		}, item_helper)
	}, {
		dispose = function(this)
			for key, value in pairs(this) do
				value:dispose()
			end
		end,
	})

	--괴물 연기 fx
	self.monster_fx_black_smoke = nil
	self.monster_tint_key = 'monster_tint_key'

	--훅샷 오브젝트
	self.hook_shot_obj = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load(e)
	self.fx:create_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self.current_state = self.states.before_pull_monster

	start_coroutine(function()
		self.dynamic_npcs.pull_monster:load_async()

		self:enter_setting()
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.current_state = self.states.done

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.item:dispose()
	self.dynamic_npcs:dispose()

	if self.monster_fx_black_smoke ~= nil then
		self.monster_fx_black_smoke:Dispose()
		self.monster_fx_black_smoke = nil
	end

	if self.hook_shot_obj ~= nil then
		self.hook_shot_obj:Dispose()
		self.hook_shot_obj = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_pull_monster and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.character.knight(), 's4_pull_monster') then
		self.current_state = self.states.in_pull_monster

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			self.pooled_obj:load_async()
			screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()

			self:pull_monster_scene()

			self.controller:remove_quest_marker()

			character_util.convert_to_npc(self.character.uptown_lancer_girl())

			self.controller:progress_section()
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:enter_setting()
	local witch = self.character.witch()
	local pivot = self.marker.pull_monster_pivot()
	local monster = self.dynamic_npcs.pull_monster:get('volcanic_ash_monster')

	--직원 1,2,3,4 (right, tired, cast)
	do
		local key_prefix = 'staff_'
		local offsets = {
			vector(-0.5, 0, 1.5),
			vector(0.5, 0, 2.5),
			vector(-0.5, 0, -1.5),
			vector(0.5, 0, -2.5),
		}

		for i = 1, #offsets do
			local staff = self.dynamic_npcs.pull_monster:get(key_prefix .. i)

			field_object_util.set_active_state(staff, active_state_type.enabled)

			character_util.set_position(staff, pivot + offsets[i])
			scene_util.set_direction(staff, 'right', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(staff, self, 'tired')
			scene_util.set_anim(staff, self, 'cast')
		end
	end

	--마녀 (right, attack, idle)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(witch, active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.set_position(witch, pivot)
	scene_util.set_direction(witch, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(witch, self, 'attack')

	--괴물 (left, idle, idle)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(monster, active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.set_position(monster, pivot + vector(5, -1, 0))
	scene_util.set_direction(monster, 'left', false)

	--맨 아래줄 와이번들 기준으로 y값 -1 된 상태

	--괴물 위로 fx_black_smoke 지속적으로 출력중.
	self.monster_fx_black_smoke = self.fx.fw_hs_smog():Instantiate(monster.Position + vector(0,1,-1), unity_class.quaternion.identity, monster.Transform)

	--검은 틴트 100% 상태
	character_util.add_color(monster, self.dark_tint_key, unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)

	--서브 퀘스트 마커는 마녀에게
	self.controller:active_quest_marker(witch)
end

function local_class:pull_monster_scene()
	local knight = self.character.knight()
	local uptown_lancer_girl = self.character.uptown_lancer_girl()
	local witch = self.character.witch()

	local monster = self.dynamic_npcs.pull_monster:get('volcanic_ash_monster')
	local staff_1 = self.dynamic_npcs.pull_monster:get('staff_1')
	local staff_2 = self.dynamic_npcs.pull_monster:get('staff_2')
	local staff_3 = self.dynamic_npcs.pull_monster:get('staff_3')
	local staff_4 = self.dynamic_npcs.pull_monster:get('staff_4')

	local wyvern_1 = self.dynamic_npcs.pull_monster:get('wyvern_1')
	local wyvern_2 = self.dynamic_npcs.pull_monster:get('wyvern_2')
	local wyvern_3 = self.dynamic_npcs.pull_monster:get('wyvern_3')
	local wyvern_4 = self.dynamic_npcs.pull_monster:get('wyvern_4')
	local wyvern_5 = self.dynamic_npcs.pull_monster:get('wyvern_5')
	local wyvern_6 = self.dynamic_npcs.pull_monster:get('wyvern_6')
	local wyvern_7 = self.dynamic_npcs.pull_monster:get('wyvern_7')
	local wyvern_8 = self.dynamic_npcs.pull_monster:get('wyvern_8')
	local wyvern_9 = self.dynamic_npcs.pull_monster:get('wyvern_9')
	local wyvern_10 = self.dynamic_npcs.pull_monster:get('wyvern_10')

	local pivot = self.marker.pull_monster_pivot()
	local wyvern_count = 10

	local wyvern_table = {
		wyvern_1,
		wyvern_2,
		wyvern_3,
		wyvern_4,
		wyvern_5,
		wyvern_6,
		wyvern_7,
		wyvern_8,
		wyvern_9,
		wyvern_10,
	}

	local function wyvern_func(func)
		for index = 1, wyvern_count do
			local npc = wyvern_table[index]

			func(npc, index)
		end
	end

	--마녀 인터랙트 시 bgm 0.6으로 재생
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	local amb_loop_earthquake = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_09', loop = true, volume = 0.5})

	--대본
	--동시 시작 / 모든 동작 끝날때까지 대기
	do
		--카메라 포커스 1초간 마녀에게로.
		camera_util.move_to_target(witch, 1)

		--존에 진입시 기사, 라피스 1.5초간 아래와 같이 정렬
		--기사, 라피스 (right, idle, idle)
		do
			local fos = { knight, uptown_lancer_girl }
			local offsets = { vector(-2, 0, 0.5), vector(-2, 0, -0.5) }

			for i = 1, #fos do
				local fo = fos[i]

				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fo, pivot + offsets[i], nil,
						1.5, self, nil,
						{ locked_dir = direction_constants.right })
			end

			wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
		end
	end

	--마녀 (right, attack, release 2회) : 이러다가 우리 온천 용암이 다 화산재로 뒤덮이겠어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(witch, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'fw_sub_hs_s4_1')

	--동시 시작
	do
		--마녀 캐릭터 shake (0.01, 1)
		field_object_util.shake(witch, 0.01, 1)

		--마녀 (right, attack, idle) : 으으….
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(witch, self, 'right',
				nil, 'attack', 'fw_sub_hs_s4_2')
	end

	--동시 시작
	do
		--직원 1,2 (down, tired, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(staff_1, 'down', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(staff_1, self, 'tired')

		scene_util.set_direction(staff_2, 'down', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(staff_2, self, 'tired')

		--마녀 (up, idle, release 2회) : 뭐라도 좀 해 봐!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(witch, self, 'up',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s4_3')
	end

	--직원 1,2 0.5 속도로 0.5타일 위쪽 뒷걸음질로 이동. / 끝날때까지 대기
	do
		local fos = { staff_1, staff_2 }

		for i = 1, #fos do
			local fo = fos[i]

			character_util.remove_anim(fo)
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fo, fo.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.5, 0.5,
					nil, self, nil,
					{ locked_dir = direction_constants.down })
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	end

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--동시 시작
	do
		--직원 3,4 (up, idle, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(staff_3, 'up', false)
		scene_util.set_direction(staff_4, 'up', false)

		--마녀 (down, attack, release 2회) : 이 무능한 것들아!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(witch, self, 'down',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'fw_sub_hs_s4_4')
	end

	--직원 3,4  0.5 속도로 0.5타일 아래쪽 뒷걸음질로 이동 / 끝날때까지 대기
	do
		local fos = { staff_3, staff_4 }

		for i = 1, #fos do
			local fo = fos[i]

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fo, fo.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.5, 0.5,
					nil, self, nil,
					{ locked_dir = direction_constants.up })
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	end

	--마녀 (right, tired, cross_arm) : 쓸모 없는 것들….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(witch, self, 'right',
			'cross_arm', 'tired', 'fw_sub_hs_s4_5')

	--카메라 포커스 기사, 라피스 사이로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(pivot + unity_class.vector3.left * 2, 1)

	--기사 (down, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'down', false)

	--라피스 (up, idle, idle) : 지금이 잘 보일 기회야! 이번 일을 우리가 해결하면 계약을 풀어줄 수도 있어!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(uptown_lancer_girl, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s4_6')

	--기사 (down, tired, question 1회, 마지막 프레임 대기)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'question', loop = false, keep_anim = true })

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--기사 (right, tired, release 2회)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--기사 (down, tired, bomb_idle) :
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'down')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'bomb_idle')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--기사 (down, tired, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	--라피스 (up, idle, idle) : 음… 그렇지… 어떻게 해야할 지 대책은 없지….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(uptown_lancer_girl, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s4_7')

	--라피스 (right, idle, question 1회, 마지막 프레임 1.5초 대기
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_wait_action(uptown_lancer_girl, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'question', loop = false }, nil, 1.5)

	--라피스 (right, attack, idle) notice 이모티콘
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(uptown_lancer_girl, self, 'right',
			nil, 'attack', 'notice')

	--라피스 (up, idle, idle) : 나한테 좋은 방법이 생각났어!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(uptown_lancer_girl, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s4_8')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--라피스 7의 속도로 왼쪽 프레임 밖으로 나감.
	do
		local wp = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', uptown_lancer_girl.Position)

		wp_util.move_async(uptown_lancer_girl, wp, 7, nil,{run = true, play_sfx = '01_dash_01'})
	end

	--기사 0.5 속도로 0.5타일 아래로 이동
	wp_util.move_async(knight, knight.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.5, 0.5)

	--기사 (left, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	--1.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--라피스 다시 아래 위치로 7의 속도로 이동 후 아래와 같이 정렬
	character_util.set_position(uptown_lancer_girl, screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', knight.Position))
	wp_util.move_async(uptown_lancer_girl,
			knight.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 1.5, 7, nil, {run = true, play_sfx = '01_dash_01'})

	--라피스 (right, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(uptown_lancer_girl, 'right', false)

	--라피스 (right, idle, throw) 자세로 기사에게 밧줄 아이템을 던짐
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(uptown_lancer_girl, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(uptown_lancer_girl, self, { name = 'throw', count = 1 })

	wait_for_sec(spine_util.get_animation_duration(uptown_lancer_girl, 'throw') / 2)

	do
		--아이템 스프라이트 이름 : rope
		--아이템 생성 위치 : 라피스 현재 위치
		--생성 후 도착 위치 : 기사 현재 위치의 0.3타일 좌측
		--크기 1
		self.item.rope:drop_async(uptown_lancer_girl.Position, knight.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 0.3, 1)

		--기사에게 아이템 흡수되며 아이템 획득 연출
		--아이템명 : 밧줄
		self.item.rope:consume_async(knight)
	end

	--기사 (left, idle, idle) question 이모티콘
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(knight, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'question')

	--라피스 (right, idle, idle) : 밧줄을 던져서 화산재가 뭉쳐있는 곳을 빼내자.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(uptown_lancer_girl, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s4_9')

	--라피스 (right, tired, idle) : 나는 조금 자신이 없는데… 신참, 할 수 있겠어?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(uptown_lancer_girl, self, 'right',
			nil, 'tired', 'fw_sub_hs_s4_10')

	--기사 (left, attack, nod 2회)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	--동시 시작
	do
		--기사 (right, idle, idle)
		character_util.remove_emotion(knight)
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right', false)

		--마녀 (left, attack, idle) : 너흰 뭐야! 지금 머리아파 죽겠는데 거기서 농땡이나 피우고 말이야!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(witch, self, 'left',
				nil, 'attack', 'fw_sub_hs_s4_11')
	end

	--기사 (right, tired, bomb_idle) annoyed 이모티콘
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'bomb_idle')

	--라피스 0.5속도로 0.5타일 우측 이동하며 대사
	do
		local is_move_end = false

		wp_util.move(uptown_lancer_girl, uptown_lancer_girl.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 0.5, 0.5,
				nil,
				{
					end_callback = function()
						is_move_end = true
					end
				})

		--라피스 (right, idle, idle) : 농땡이 피우던 게 아니에요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(uptown_lancer_girl, self, 'right',
				nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s4_12')

		while is_move_end == false do
			coroutine.yield()

		local jump_move = function(fo, end_pos, duration, height)
			local time_passed = 0
			local cur_y = 0
			local start_pos = fo.Position

			while duration > time_passed do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

				cur_y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height

				if cur_y <= 0 then
					cur_y = 0
				end

				fo.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress) + cur_y * unity_class.vector3.up

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end

--시작 지점부터 끝 지점까지 로프 늘리기 및 발사
function local_class:throw_rope(duration, start, des)
	self.hook_shot_obj = self.pooled_obj.hook_shot():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	local hook_shot = self.hook_shot_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.HookShot))
	hook_shot.Head.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local to_pos = start

	local diff = (des - start)
	local direction = diff.normalized

	do
		local time_passed = 0

		while duration > time_passed do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			to_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start, des + direction, time_passed / duration)

			hook_shot:SetFromTo(start, to_pos)

			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end
end

--끝 지점부터 시작 지점으로 로프 회수
function local_class:pull_rope(duration, start, des)
	local hook_shot = self.hook_shot_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.HookShot))

	if hook_shot == nil then
		return
	end

	hook_shot.Head.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local to_pos = start

	local diff = (des - start)
	local direction = diff.normalized

	do
		local time_passed = 0

		while duration > time_passed do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			to_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(des + direction, start, time_passed / duration)

			hook_shot:SetFromTo(start, to_pos)

			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end
end

--특정 시간 동안 로프의 양 끝점을 양 쪽 타겟에 고정시킴
function local_class:fix_rope(duration, left_target, right_target)
	local hook_shot = self.hook_shot_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.HookShot))

	if hook_shot == nil then
		return
	end

	hook_shot.Head.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local time_passed = 0
	local direction = (right_target.Bounds.center - left_target.Bounds.center).normalized

	while duration > time_passed do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		hook_shot:SetFromTo(left_target.Bounds.center, right_target.Bounds.center + direction)

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('FireWorldHotSpringSection5')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FireWorldHotSpring @
		Comment = 분출구 튜토리얼 @
		Index = 4 @
		NextSections = 5 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type FireWorldHotSpringController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'substage_22_2'

	self.character = self.controller.character

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		across_the_lava = 2,
		done = 5,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.get_bucket = function()
		return get_field_object('bucket_1')
	end

	self.get_bucket_switch = function()
		return get_field_object('s5_area_reset_switch')
	end

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		water_splash_out = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_common_water_splash_out_shear')
		end,
	})

	self.get_marker = setmetatable({
		spec = {
			lapice = 's5_lapice_pos',
			party_pivot = 's5_party_pivot',
		}
	}, {
		__index = function(this, key)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos(this.spec[key])
		end
	})

	self.field_object = {
		boat = function(index)
			return get_field_object('boat_' .. index)
		end,

		boat_interaction_trigger = function()
			return get_field_object('boat_interaction_trigger')
		end,
	}

	self.quest_marker = {
		key = 'hotspring_quest',
		add = function(this, data)
			quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(this.key, data)
		end,
		remove = function(this)
			quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(this.key)
		end
	}
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 초기 NPC 셋팅
	self:set_pre_npc()
	self:set_current_scene_npc()

	self.quest_marker:add({
		{
			zone = 'main_field',
			target = self.get_bucket()
		},
	})

	character_util.add_listener(self.character.lancer_girl, self.controller)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent), 'on_hold_up_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent), 'on_reset_switch_turned_on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrownEndEvent), 'on_throw_end_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	local boat_interaction_trigger = self.field_object.boat_interaction_trigger()
	field_object_util.set_active_state(boat_interaction_trigger, active_state_type.enabled)
	boat_interaction_trigger.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(2, 1, 2))

	--3섹션에 사용된 용암발판 리셋
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(get_character('s4_staff_npc_4'), { 'LavaRockReset' }))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrownEndEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.character.lancer_girl) then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_with_lancer_girl_without_event, self)

			return true
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.across_the_lava then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.field_object.boat_interaction_trigger()) then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_boat_event, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's5_lapice_zone') then
			local current_state = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
			if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
				local hold_target = current_state.HoldTarget
				if hold_target ~= nil and string.find(hold_target.Name, 'bucket') then
					self.current_state = self.states.across_the_lava

					start_coroutine(self.wet_lancer_girl_event, self, hold_target)
					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_hold_up_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_bucket()) then
		self.quest_marker:remove()
	end
end

function local_class:on_reset_switch_turned_on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, self.get_bucket_switch()) then
		self.quest_marker:remove()

		self.quest_marker:add({
			{
				zone = 'main_field',
				target = self.get_bucket()
			},
		})
	end
end

function local_class:on_throw_end_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_bucket()) and
			field:IsInSameCameraGrid(user_party.Leader.Position, e.Target.Position) then
		self.quest_marker:add({
			{
				zone = 'main_field',
				target = self.get_bucket()
			},
		})
	end
end

function local_class:set_pre_npc()
	-- npc 초기 셋팅 데이터 테이블
	self.pre_npc_data = {
		[self.states.none] = {
			[1] = {
				--라피스 (right, tired, idle)
				pos = self.get_marker.lapice,
				name = 'lancer_girl',
				dir = 'right',
				emo = 'tired',
				anim = 'idle',
			},
		},
	}
end

function local_class:set_current_scene_npc()
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[self.current_state]

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	linq(pre_npc_data):foreach(function(_, npc_data)
		local npc = get_character(npc_data.name)

		if npc == nil then
			if npc_data.name == 'leader' then
				npc = user_party.Leader
			else
				return
			end
		end

		if npc_data.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_data.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		npc_data.active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_data.active_state)

		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_data.anim, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.keep_shake ~= nil and npc_data.keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if npc_data.tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc_data.tint_color_key, npc_data.tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if npc_data.interaction then
			npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
		end

		if npc_data.string ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.string) then
			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_data.string
		end

		if npc_data.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_data.talk_sfx
		end

		if npc_data.weapon_1_id then
			character_util.set_equipment(npc, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1,
					npc_data.weapon_1_id, true)
		end

		if npc_data.weapon_2_id then
			character_util.set_equipment(npc, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2,
					npc_data.weapon_2_id, true)
		end

		if npc_data.show_weapon then
			scene_util.show_weapon(npc)
		end

		if npc_data.hitbox ~= nil then
			npc.Hitbox = npc_data.hitbox
		end
	end)
end
--endregion

function local_class:interact_with_lancer_girl_without_event()
	local lancer_girl = self.character.lancer_girl
	local knight = user_party.Leader

	--라피스 인터랙트 시  bgm 보륨 0.6 재생 / 믹스 디폴트
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--라피스에게 인터랙트시 아래와 같이 1.5초간 정렬
	do
		local wp_key = 'party_align'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, lancer_girl.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
				nil, 1.5, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--기사 (right, attack, release 2회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--라피스 (right, tired, idle) : 저리 가….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'idle' },
			{ name = 'tired' },
			{ key = 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_1', skip = true })

	--라피스 (right, tired, idle) : 이대로 그냥 말라 비틀어질때까지 내버려 둬….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'idle' },
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
			{ key = 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_1_1', skip = true })

	--표정, 자세 풀지 않고 유지

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	--플레이어 컨트롤 해제
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
end

function local_class:wet_lancer_girl_event(bucket)
	local lancer_girl = self.character.lancer_girl
	local knight = user_party.Leader

	sp_util.enter_scene({ release_hold = false })

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	self.quest_marker:remove()

	do
		local wp_key = 'party_align'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, lancer_girl.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
				nil, 1.5, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	if bucket ~= nil then
		message_system:SendSync(knight, CS.Oak.ReleaseHoldingObjectEvent.Create(knight))
	end

	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'throw', count = 1 })

	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(knight, 'throw')

	wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.2)

	local move_end_pos = lancer_girl.Position + unity_class.vector3.up * 0.7
	self:object_move_curve(bucket, move_end_pos, 0.5, nil, 0.5)

	character_util.release_hold_object(knight, bucket)

	bucket.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_water_01')
	self.fx.water_splash_out():Instantiate(move_end_pos)

	--라피스 (right, surprise, cast2)
	scene_util.set_direction(lancer_girl, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(lancer_girl, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim(lancer_girl, self, 'cast2')

	--화면 shake (0.1, 0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--라피스 (left, mad, embarrassed) : 이게 무슨 짓이야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'embarrassed', keep = true },
			{ name = 'mad', keep = true },
			{ key = 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_2', skip = true })

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--라피스 (left, mad, cross_arm)
	scene_util.set_anim(lancer_girl, self, { name = 'cross_arm' })

	--기사 (right, attack, release 2회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

	--기사 (left, damaged, cast2) annoyed 이모티콘
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(knight, self,
			nil,
			'cast2',
			'damaged',
			'annoyed')

	--라피스 (left, tired, cast)
	scene_util.set_emotion(lancer_girl, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(lancer_girl, self, { name = 'cast' })

	--기사 (down, tired, bomb_idle) - 1초
	scene_util.play_wait_action(knight, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			'bomb_idle',
			'tired',
			1)

	--기사 (right, idle, cross_arm)
	--기사 (right, attack, release 2회)
	scene_util.play_custom_action(knight, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			'attack',
			function()
				scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
			end)

	--라피스 (left, tried, cast) : 이렇게 쉽게 포기하지 말라고…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'left',
			'cast', { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_3')

	--라피스 (left, tried, cast) : 그래, 내가 먼저 같이 나가자고 해놓고 너무 무책임하긴 했지….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'left',
			'cast', nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_4')

	--라피스 (down, tried, idle) : 하지만 나도 너무 지치는 걸.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_5')

	--라피스 (down, tried, idle) : 여기 처음 왔을땐 오히려 새로운 경험을 할 기회라고 생각해서 좋기도 했지만….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_6')

	--라피스 (down, tried, idle) : 시간이 지날수록 점점 나 자신을 잃어가는 기분이야….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_7')

	--기사 (right, tired, cross_arm)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'cross_arm')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--선택지
	--(brutal) 그냥 잃어버린채로 살아요!
	--(mercy) 저는 언제나 48호 선배를 기억할게요.
	--(intellect) 불사조 눈물탕에서 새로 태어나는 건 어때요?
	choose_util.play_choose_sampling_without_replacement({
		{
			key = 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_8',
			tendency = 'brutal',
			keep = false,
			cb_func = function()
				--기사 (right, tired, bomb_idle) - 1초
				scene_util.play_wait_action(knight, self,
						nil,
						{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
						nil,
						1)

				--라피스 (left, tired, idle) : 뭐어…? 싫어.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'left',
						nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_8_1')

				--라피스 (left, tired, idle) : 결국 너도 다른 사람들과 똑같구나.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'left',
						nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_8_2')

			end,
		},
		{
			key = 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_9',
			tendency = 'mercy',
			choose_end = true,
			cb_func = function()
				--기사 (right, smile, victory_get 1회)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
				character_util.set_emotion(knight, { name = 'smile' })
				character_util.set_anim(knight, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })

				wait_for_sec(1.5)

				character_util.remove_anim(knight)

				--라피스 (left, attack, idle) notice 이모티콘
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
				scene_util.play_emoticon_action(lancer_girl, self,
						{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
						nil,
						{ name = 'attack' },
						'notice')
			end,
		},
		{
			key = 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_10',
			tendency = 'intellect',
			keep = false,
			cb_func = function()
				--기사 (right, smile, release 2회) hot 이모티콘
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_effect_lava_01')
				scene_util.play_custom_action(knight, self,
						nil,
						{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
						{ name = 'smile' },
						function()
							character_util.show_emoticon_async(
									knight,
									nil,
									'custom',
									'emoticon_bubble_fw_hotspring.png'
							)
						end)

				--라피스 (left, tired, idle) : 싫어… 난 조류 공포증이 있단 말이야.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'left',
						nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_10_1')

				--기사 (right, tired, bomb_idle)
				scene_util.play_wait_action(knight, self,
						{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
						'bomb_idle',
						'tired',
						1)
			end,
		},
	})

	--라피스 (left, smile, cast) : 처음에 한 약속을 잊지 않았구나….
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'left',
			'cast', 'smile', 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_11')

	--라피스 (left, awesome, cast) : 내 말을 제대로 기억해 준 사람은 네가 처음이야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'left',
			'cast', 'awesome', 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_12')

	--라피스 (left, awesome, cast) : 이렇게 까지 기분이 좋을 줄이야….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'left',
			'cast', 'awesome', 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_13')

	--라피스 (left, awesome, cast) heart 이모티콘
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(lancer_girl, self, 'left',
			'cast', 'awesome', 'heart')

	--라피스 (left, smile, nod 2회) : 그래. 나도 너와의 약속을 어길 순 없지! 다시 심기일전해보자!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, 'smile', 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_14')

	--기사 (right, smile, nod 2회)
	scene_util.play_custom_action(knight, self, 'right',
			nil, 'smile', function()
				scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
			end)

	--라피스 (left, idle, idle) silence 이모티콘
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(lancer_girl, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'silence')

	--라피스 (down, idle, idle) : 하지만, 포기하지 않는다고 해도 뭘 더 어떻게 해야 할 지 모르겠는데.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_15')

	--선택지
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--(forced) 마녀 담글까요?

		--(intellect) 온천을 메워야….
		{ 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_17', 'intellect' },
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		--기사 (right, dealwithit, cross_arm) - 1초
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
		scene_util.play_wait_action(knight, self,
				{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'cross_arm', keep = true },
				'dealwithit',
				1)

		--라피스 (left, tired, cast) sweat 이모티콘
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(lancer_girl, self,
				{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'cast', keep = true },
				{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
				'sweat')

		--라피스 (left, tired, cast) : 그렇게 잔인한 짓을 어떻게 해.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, nil,
				nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_16_1')

		--기사 (right, tired, bomb_idle) annoyed 이모티콘
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(knight, self,
				nil,
				{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
				{ name = 'tired' },
				'annoyed')

		--라피스 (left, tired, cast) : 착한척을 한다니….
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, nil,
				nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_16_2')

		--라피스 (left, tired, cast) : 그냥 더 평화로운 방법을 생각해보자.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, nil,
				nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_16_3')

	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		--기사 (right, attack, release 2회)
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

		--라피스 (left, idle, idle) jump 1회
		scene_util.set_direction(lancer_girl, 'left', false)
		character_util.normal_jump_async(lancer_girl, true)

		--0.5초 대기
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--라피스 (left, idle, question 1회, 마지막 프레임 유지) : 나쁘지 않은데? 장사를 못하면 결국 직원도 필요 없어질테니까.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, nil,
				{ name = 'question', loop = false }, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_17_1')

		--라피스 (left, tired, idle) : 하지만 어떻게 온천을 메워야 하지?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, nil,
				nil, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_17_2')

		--라피스 (left, tired, idle) : 아까 화산재 괴물을 그대로 뒀어야 했는데….
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, nil,
				nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s5_1_17_3')
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lancer_girl)

	--동시 시작
	--라피스 (left, idle, question 1회, 마지막 프레임 유지) silence 이모티콘
	--기사 (right, idle, question 1회, 마지막 프레임 유지)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	scene_util.set_anim(lancer_girl, self, { name = 'question', loop = false })

	--1.5초 유지
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--라피스 (left, idle, idle) notice 이모티콘
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lancer_girl)
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(lancer_girl, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'notice')

	--기사 (right, idle, idle)

function local_class:object_move_curve(fo, target_pos, height, speed, duration, move_end_action)
	local start_pos = fo.Position
	local distance = vector_util.distance(start_pos, target_pos)
	local to_duration = 0

	if type_util.is_number(speed) then
		to_duration = distance / speed
	elseif type_util.is_number(duration) then
		to_duration = duration
	end

	coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(to_duration, start_pos, target_pos, function(progress, cur_value)
		local h = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
		local lerp_pos = cur_value + vector(0, h, 0)

		fo.Position = lerp_pos
	end)

	if type_util.is_function(move_end_action) then
		move_end_action()
	end
end

		--현재 위치에서 A지점까지 0.5초간 (left, damaged, damaged) 자세로 최대 높이 1.5까지 올라가며 포물선으로 이동.

		--이후 바로 B지점까지 0.3초간 (right, damaged, damaged2) 자세로 최대 높이 1.5까지 올라가며 포물선 이동

		character_util.reset_locked_dir(witch)
		character_util.set_locked_dir(witch, 'right')
		scene_util.set_anim(witch, self, 'damaged2')

		--B 지점에서 y값 0이 되면 화면 shake (0.05, 0.3)
		camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.3)

		--이후 바로 C지점까지 0.3초간 (right, damaged, damaged2) 자세로 최대 높이 1.5까지 올라가며 포물선 이동
		local jump_pos_3 = pivot + vector(7, 0, 0)
		character_util.jump_move(witch, jump_pos_3, 10, 1.5, true)

		--C 지점에서 y값 0이 되면 화면 shake (0.05, 0.3) + 마녀 (right, scared, cliff) 자세로 전환
		camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.3)

		character_util.reset_locked_dir(witch)
		scene_util.set_emotion(witch, self, 'scared')
		scene_util.set_anim(witch, self, 'cliff')
	end

	--라피스 attack 표정, 8의 속도로 5.5타일 오른쪽 이동 / 카메라 라피스 따라감.
	scene_util.set_emotion(lancer_girl, self, 'attack')
	character_util.remove_anim(lancer_girl)

		local pos = witch.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)

		wp_util.move_async(lancer_girl, pos, 8, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = '01_dash_01' })
	end

	--라피스 (right, attack, push)
	scene_util.set_direction(lancer_girl, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(lancer_girl, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(lancer_girl, self, 'push')

	character_util.set_locked_dir(witch, 'right')

		character_util.jump_move(lancer_girl, lancer_girl.Position + move_offset, 4, 1, false)
		character_util.jump_move(witch, witch.Position + move_offset, 4, 1, true)
	end

	self.fx.hit():Instantiate(witch.Position + vector(0, -0.25, 0))

	character_util.reset_locked_dir(witch)

	--라피스 (right, damaged, hurt)
	scene_util.set_direction(lancer_girl, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(lancer_girl, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(lancer_girl, self, 'hurt')

	scene_util.set_direction(witch, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(witch, self, 'confused')
	scene_util.set_anim(witch, self, 'prostrate')

	--기사 tired 표정, 4의 속도로 오른쪽 4.5타일 이동
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'tired')

	do
		local pos = knight.Position + vector(4.5, 0, 0)

		wp_util.move_async(knight, pos, 4)
	end

	--라피스 (right, damaged, hurt) 캐릭터 shake (0.03,1) / 끝날때까지 대기
	do
		local duration = 1

		scene_util.set_direction(lancer_girl, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(lancer_girl, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(lancer_girl, self, 'hurt')
		scene_util.shake(lancer_girl, 0.03, duration)

		wait_for_sec(duration)
	end

	--라피스 mario jump로 right 방향으로 기상
	character_util.shake_and_wakeup(lancer_girl, 'right', nil, nil, '01_player_popup_01')

	--라피스 (right, damaged, idle) : 으으… 엉덩이 아파.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'right',
			'idle', 'damaged', 'fw_sub_hs_s6_13')

	--라피스 1의 속도로 1타일 왼쪽 이동
	do
		local pos = lancer_girl.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)

		wp_util.move_async(lancer_girl, pos, 1)
	end

	--라피스 (left, attack, idle) : 신참! 너무 걱정 말고 분출구를 막아줘 부탁할게!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'left',
			nil, 'attack', 'fw_sub_hs_s6_14')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--컨트롤 복귀와 동시에 볼륨 1로 원복 / 믹스 디폴트
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)

	do
		local bucket = self.get_bucket()

		bucket.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	character_util.convert_to_npc(lancer_girl)
end
