	--카메라 1초간 카메라값 4로 줌 아웃/ 끝날때까지 대기
	camera_util.resize_to_default_async(1)

	--퀘스트 완료와 보상 획득 연출 진행
	--퀘스트 완료 UI와 함께 bgm 볼륨 1 원복 / 믹스 디폴트
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 0.6 })
	self.controller:complete_quest({
		run_complete_ui = true,
		run_fame_alignment = false,
		return_control = false,
	})

	--기사, 라피스 1.5초간 아래와 같이 정렬
	do
		local pivot = self.get_lava_pos(3)
		local duration = 1.5

		camera_util.move(pivot + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), duration)

		wp_util.move(knight, pivot, nil, duration, {
			last_direction = 'left'
		})
		wp_util.move_async(lancer_girl, pivot + vector(-1, 0, 0), nil, duration, {
			last_direction = 'right'
		})
	end

	--라피스 (right, smile, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(lancer_girl, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(lancer_girl, self, 'smile')

	--기사 (left, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)

	--라피스 (right, smile, idle) : 고마워. 이건 다 네 덕분이야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s6_68')

	--라피스 (right, smile, idle) : 널 만난 게 어쩌면… 내 최고의 행운이 아닐까?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s6_69')

	--기사 (left, smile, idle) happy 이모티콘
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(knight, self, 'left',
			nil, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'happy')

	--라피스 (right, smile, idle) : 여길 나가서도 널 만날 수 있으면 정말 좋겠다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s6_70')

	--라피스 (right, smile, idle) : 그때도 꼭 내 이름 기억해서 불러줘!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lancer_girl, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'fw_sub_hs_s6_71')

	--기사 (left, smile, nod 2회)
	scene_util.play_custom_action(knight, self, 'left',
			nil, 'smile', function()
				scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
			end)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'down')

	--라피스 4의 속도로 아래로 이동하며 프레임 밖으로 나가면 삭제.
	do
		local pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', lancer_girl.Position, -4)

		wp_util.move_async(lancer_girl, pos, 4, nil, { end_callback = function()
			character_util.set_position(lancer_girl, self.nowhere)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lancer_girl)
		end })
	end

	--카메라 포커스 1초간 기사에게
	do
		local pos = knight.Position

		camera_util.move_async(pos, 1)
	end

	--기사 아래로 4의 속도로 이동 시작 (카메라 안 따라감)
	do
		local pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', knight.Position, -4)
		local move_key = 'knight_move'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, pos, 4, nil, self, move_key)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		--이동 시작 1초 뒤 1.5초간 서클로 페이드 아웃 되며 스테이지 클리어 처리.
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0)
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

		CS.Oak.Game.Instance:StageToLobby(true)
	end
end

function local_class:setting()
	local bucket = self.get_bucket()

	bucket.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	--서브 퀘스트 마커 물통 오브젝트에 배치

	self.controller:active_quest_marker(bucket)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('FireWorldLavaRaceSection1')
local game = newclass('FireWorldLavaRaceGame')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FireWorldLavaRace @
		Comment = 15섹션 용암 레이스@
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type FireWorldLavaRaceController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'fireworld_4'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		before_loaded = 1,
		before_introduce = 2,
		in_introduce = 3,
		before_game = 4,
		in_game = 6,
		done = 99,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_loaded

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version + 1

	self.character = {
		knight = function()
			return get_party_leader()
		end,
		princess = function()
			return get_character('princess')
		end,
		dragon_boy = function()
			return get_character('dragon_boy')
		end,
		fire_bishop = function()
			return get_character('fire_bishop')
		end,
		staff = function(idx)
			return get_character('lava_race_staff_' .. idx)
		end,
		player = function(idx)
			return get_character('lava_race_player_' .. idx)
		end,
	}

	self.marker = {
		staff_pivot = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('lava_race_staff_pivot')
		end,
		players_pivot = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('lava_race_players_pivot')
		end,
	}

	self.quest_marker = {
		marker_key = 'lava_race',

		add_marker = function(this)
			quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(this.marker_key,
					self.cs_controller.QuestId, true, self.character.staff(1))
		end,

		remove_marker = function(this)
			quest_marker_util.remove(this.marker_key)
		end
	}

	self.game_name = 'FireWorldLavaRace'
	self.game = game()

	self.started_players_oneline = false
	self.started_introduce_oneline = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self:start_setting()

	self.current_state = self.states.before_introduce
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.current_state = self.states.done

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.game:dispose()

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_introduce then
		local valid_checker = function()
			return self.current_state == self.states.before_introduce
		end

		if self.started_introduce_oneline == false and
				type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.character.knight(), 'lava_race_introduce_oneline') then
			self.started_introduce_oneline = true

			start_coroutine(self.staff_oneline, self, valid_checker)

			return true
		elseif self.started_players_oneline == false and
				type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.character.knight(), 'lava_race_players_oneline') then
			self.started_players_oneline = true

			start_coroutine(self.players_oneline, self, valid_checker)

			return true
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.before_game and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.character.knight(), 'lava_race_start') then
		self.current_state = self.states.in_game

		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene({ stop_party = false })

			self.game:load(self.game_name)
			self.game:start_scene()

			sp_util.exit_scene(nil, self.character.knight())
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_introduce and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.character.staff(1)) then
		self.current_state = self.states.in_introduce

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			self:stop_all_oneline_events()

			self:introduce_scene()
			self.quest_marker:remove_marker()

			self.current_state = self.states.before_game
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.in_game and
			e.Name == self.mini_game_name and
			e.Success == false then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_game
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.in_game and
			e.Name == self.mini_game_name and
			e.Success == true then
		start_coroutine(function()
			self.controller:complete_hidden_quest_default()

			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'clear_stage_4_event_3' }))
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 's15_sub_quest_clear' }))
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if e.QuestId == self.controller.main_quest_id and e.CurrentProgress == 14 then
		self:start_setting()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:start_setting()
	local main_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.controller.main_quest_id)

	if main_quest_progress == nil or main_quest_progress.InnerProgress < 14 then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')
		return
	end

	local staff_pivot = self.marker.staff_pivot()
	local players_pivot = self.marker.players_pivot()

	local staff_1 = self.character.staff(1)
	local staff_2 = self.character.staff(2)
	local staff_3 = self.character.staff(3)

	local player_1 = self.character.player(1)
	local player_2 = self.character.player(2)
	local player_3 = self.character.player(3)
	local player_4 = self.character.player(4)

	do
		--NPC 1 : fw_nm_fh_moderator
		--NPC 2 : fw_nm_db_human (right, idle, idle)
		--NPC 3 : fw_nm_db_human (right, idle, idle)

		--NPC 8 : fw_nm_fd_player_male
		--NPC 9 : fw_nm_fd_player_female
		--NPC 10 : fw_nm_fd_hulk
		--NPC 11 : fw_nm_fd_player_male

		--점프대를 막고 있는 원라인 NPC들
		--NPC 2 ~ 3 (right, idle, idle) : 아직 출입이 허가되지 않았습니다.

		local npc_infos = {
			{
				npc = staff_1,
				pos = staff_pivot,
				dir = direction_constants.right,
			},
			{
				npc = staff_2,
				pos = staff_pivot + vector(-2, 0, 0.5),
				dir = direction_constants.right,
				oneline = 'fw_main_lava_race_s1_6',
			},
			{
				npc = staff_3,
				pos = staff_pivot + vector(-2, 0, -0.5),
				dir = direction_constants.right,
				oneline = 'fw_main_lava_race_s1_6',
			},
			{
				npc = player_1,
				pos = players_pivot + unity_class.vector3.left * 3,
				dir = direction_constants.right,
				emotion = 'smile',
				anim = 'shoot',
			},
			{
				npc = player_2,
				pos = players_pivot + unity_class.vector3.left,
				dir = direction_constants.left,
				emotion = 'smile',
				anim = 'shoot',
			},
			{
				npc = player_3,
				pos = players_pivot + unity_class.vector3.back,
				dir = direction_constants.right,
			},
			{
				npc = player_4,
				pos = players_pivot + vector(2, 0, -1),
				emotion = 'tired',
				dir = direction_constants.left,
			},
		}

		self.controller:set_npcs(npc_infos)
	end

	self.quest_marker:add_marker()

	character_util.add_listener(staff_1, self)
end

function local_class:remove_speech(npc)
	local bubble = speech_bubble.instance:Get(npc)

	if bubble ~= nil then
		bubble:ResetBubble()
	end
end

function local_class:stop_all_oneline_events()
	local staff_1 = self.character.staff(1)
	local staff_2 = self.character.staff(1)
	local staff_3 = self.character.staff(1)

	local player_1 = self.character.player(1)
	local player_2 = self.character.player(2)
	local player_3 = self.character.player(3)
	local player_4 = self.character.player(4)

	local fos = {
		staff_1,
		staff_2,
		staff_3,
		player_1,
		player_2,
		player_3,
		player_4,
	}

	for _, fo in pairs(fos) do
		self:remove_speech(fo)
		character_util.stop(fo)
	end
end

function local_class:players_oneline(valid_checker)
	local player_1 = self.character.player(1)
	local player_2 = self.character.player(2)
	local player_3 = self.character.player(3)
	local player_4 = self.character.player(4)

	---중단 시 바로 원라인 NPC로 변경
	local stop_routine = function()
		player_1.Interactable.Talk = 'fw_main_lava_race_s1_1'
		player_2.Interactable.Talk = 'fw_main_lava_race_s1_2'
		player_3.Interactable.Talk = 'fw_main_lava_race_s1_3'
		player_4.Interactable.Talk = 'fw_main_lava_race_s1_4'
	end

	--[트리거 존 1 진입 시 진행]
	--존 진입 시 아래의 대사 순서대로 실행.
	--NPC 8 (right, smile, shoot) : 좋아, 꽁지 빠지게 달릴 준비 됐지?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(player_1, self, 'right',
			nil, nil,
			{ key = 'fw_main_lava_race_s1_1', skip = false })

	if valid_checker() == false then
		stop_routine()
		return
	end

	--이전 대사 실행 완료까지 대기.
	--NPC 9 (left, smile, shoot) : 너야말로! 올해는 빠지지 않도록 조심해!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(player_2, self, 'left',
			nil, nil,
			{ key = 'fw_main_lava_race_s1_2', skip = false })

	if valid_checker() == false then
		stop_routine()
		return
	end

	--이전 대사 실행 완료까지 대기.
	--NPC 10 (right, idle, idle) : 후우… 감량도 했으니 이번엔 안빠지겠지…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(player_3, self, 'right',
			nil, nil,
			{ key = 'fw_main_lava_race_s1_3', skip = false })

	if valid_checker() == false then
		stop_routine()
		return
	end

	--이전 대사 실행 완료까지 대기.
	--NPC 11 (left, tired, idle) : 음… 글쎄 좀 불안한데…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(player_4, self, 'left',
			nil, nil,
			{ key = 'fw_main_lava_race_s1_4', skip = false })

	--이전 대사 실행 완료까지 대기.
	--완료되면 전체 원라인으로 전환.
	stop_routine()
end

function local_class:staff_oneline(valid_checker)
	local staff_1 = self.character.staff(1)

	--[트리거 존 2 진입 시 진행]
	--존 진입 시 NPC 1 아래의 대사 실행 + 해당 NPC는 상시 인터렉트 가능 상태.
	--NPC 1 (right, smile, cast2) : 어서오세요! 새로운 도전자는 언제나 환영합니다!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_1, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'cast2', keep = true },
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			{ key = 'fw_main_lava_race_s1_5', skip = false })
end

function local_class:introduce_scene()
	local knight = self.character.knight()
	local princess = self.character.princess()
	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy()
	local fire_bishop = self.character.fire_bishop()

	local staff_1 = self.character.staff(1)
	local staff_2 = self.character.staff(2)
	local staff_3 = self.character.staff(3)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	local jump_fo = get_field_object('lava_racing_jump_1')

	local pivot = self.marker.staff_pivot()

	--[NPC 1 인터렉트 시 진행]
	--플레이어 일행 (left, idle, walk) 를 1초에 걸쳐 지정된 위치로 이동 후 (idle) 전환.
	do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, pivot + vector(1, 0, -0.5), nil,
				1, self, nil,
				{ locked_dir = direction_constants.left })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, pivot + vector(2, 0, -0.5), nil,
				1, self, nil,
				{ locked_dir = direction_constants.left })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dragon_boy, pivot + vector(1, 0, 0.5), nil,
				1, self, nil,
				{ locked_dir = direction_constants.left })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fire_bishop, pivot + vector(2, 0, 0.5), nil,
				1, self, nil,
				{ locked_dir = direction_constants.left })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	end

	--NPC 1 (right, smile, idle) : 또 다른 도전자인가요?!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_1, self, 'right',
			nil, 'smile', 'fw_main_lava_race_s1_7')

	--NPC 1 (right, sleep_deep, cast) : 환영합니다! 용염축제의 뜨거운 열기를 온 몸으로 느낄 수 있는…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_1, self, 'right',

function game:try_init_cur_plate_group(time_passed_diff)
	if #self.const.plate_group_infos < self.group_idx then
		return false
	end

	--다음 그룹으로 넘어갈 때, time_passed가 limit보다 넘어갔다면 그만큼 미리 더해놓기(시간 밀림 방지)
	time_passed_diff = lua_helper.get_or_default(time_passed_diff, 0)

	local cur_plate_group_info = self.const.plate_group_infos[self.group_idx]

	self.cur_plate_group.time_limit = cur_plate_group_info.time_limit
	self.cur_plate_group.time_passed = time_passed_diff

	return true
end

function game:load(game_name)
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor(self.fx):load_async()

	update_util.add_update(self, CS.Oak.UpdatePriorities.StageEvent, 'update')

	self.const = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Main/FireWorld/LavaRace/Constants')

	self:set_player()

	--1번째 발판 그룹 정보 가져오기
	self.group_idx = 1
	self:try_init_cur_plate_group()

	self.game_name = game_name

	self.is_all_destroyed = false

	self.player_fo = get_party_leader()

	self.plate_bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(unity_class.vector3.zero, vector(2, 1, 2))

	self.bound_list = {}
	self.bound_check_dt = 0.2
	self.cur_bound_check_dt = 0

	--분수 초기화
	do
		--분수 초기화
		self.fountain.update_data_table = create_lua_hashset()

		self.fountain.unentered_zone_table = {}

		for zone_idx = 1, self.fountain.max_zone_trigger_loop do
			--폭발 트리거 존이 없으면 브레이크
			local trigger_zone_name = self.const.zone_plate_prefix .. zone_idx
			local trigger_zone = field_util.get_zone(trigger_zone_name)

			if trigger_zone == nil then
				break
			end

			--트리거 존에 연결된 그룹 존들 전부 찾아서 넣기
			local group_zones = {}

			for i = 1, self.fountain.max_zone_group_loop do
				local group_zone_name = trigger_zone_name .. '_' .. i
				local group_zone = field_util.get_zone(group_zone_name)

				if group_zone == nil then
					break
				end

				group_zones[#group_zones + 1] = group_zone
			end

			if #group_zones > 0 then
				self.fountain.unentered_zone_table[trigger_zone_name] = group_zones
			end
		end
	end
end

function game:set_player()
	self.current_party = {}

	camera_util.move(stage_camera.LookAtPosition, 0)
	self.cashed_leader = self.character.knight()

	for i = user_party.Count - 1, 0, -1 do
		local character = user_party[i]
		character_util.convert_to_npc(character)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(character, active_state_type.enabled)

		table.insert(self.current_party, character)
	end

	local player = self.character.dragon_boy()
	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	field_object_util.set_active_state(player, active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(player, param)
end

function game:reset_party()
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.character.dragon_boy())

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.current_party[#self.current_party], active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(self.current_party[#self.current_party], param, true)
	character_util.set_immortal(self.current_party[#self.current_party], false)

	for i = #self.current_party - 1, 1, -1 do
		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.current_party[i], active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(self.current_party[i], user_party, true)
	end

	coroutine.yield()

	self.current_party = nil
	self.cashed_leader = nil
end

function game:start_scene()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy()
	local jump_fo = get_field_object('lava_racing_jump_1')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0, 2)
	--플레이어 점프대에 접근 시 정지 후 이벤트 진입.
	--카메라 0.5초에 걸쳐 기르가스 중심으로 이동.
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(dragon_boy, 0.5, { end_target = dragon_boy })
	--기르가스 (left, smile, cast2, jump 1회) : 이까짓 거 단숨에 끝내버릴게!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'left',
			'cast2', 'smile', 'fw_main_lava_race_s1_32_1')

	--기르가스 (left, attack, run) 상태로 0.5초에 걸쳐 점프대 중심으로 이동.
	scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'attack')
	wp_util.move_async(dragon_boy, jump_fo.Position + vector(0.5, 0, -0.5), nil,
			0.5, { run = true, play_sfx = true })

	--기르가스  left, attack, get, 상태로 지정된 붉은 지점까지 점프대 탑승 후 이동.
	--점프대 세팅 (이동거리 9 / 점프 스피드 15 / 수평 높이 5.145)
	local jump_tile_data = jump_fo.FieldObjectBehaviour
	local jump_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(jump_fo.Direction)
	local jump_speed = 15

	message_system:SendSync(jump_tile_data, CS.Oak.JumpTileSpringEvent.Create(dragon_boy, jump_fo, jump_dir, jump_speed))

	wait_for_sec(2)

	--반드시 점프대 탑승을 활용할 필요 없이, 연출 영역으로 구현하여도 문제 없음.
	--도착 시 컨트롤 빼앗고 연출 진입.
	--마지막 파티원 착지까지 대기
	local last_party_member = user_party[user_party.Count - 1]
	local fo_bhv = last_party_member.FieldObjectBehaviour

	while lua_helper.type_compare(fo_bhv.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterJumpState) or
			(lua_helper.type_compare(fo_bhv.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState) and fo_bhv.CurrentState.IsFlying == true) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	--0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--플레이어 일행 일제히 (down, idle, idle) 실행.
	party_util.foreach_member(function(idx, member)
		character_util.set_direction(member, direction_constants.down)
	end)

	--아래의 항목 동시에 실행.
	do
		--보라색 박스에 위치한 용암에 분수 실행하여, 배치된 용암판 모두 제거.
		self:destroy_plates(self:get_and_progress_time_plate_zone(), true)

		--플레이어 일행 전체 (down, surprise, jump 1회) 를 실행하여 2타일 상단으로 0.3초에 걸쳐 이동.
		party_util.foreach_member(function(idx, member)
			scene_util.set_emotion(member, self, 'surprise')
			character_util.normal_jump(member, '01_player_jump_01')
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member, member.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 2,
					nil, 0.3, self,
					nil, { locked_dir = direction_constants.down })
		end)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

		party_util.foreach_member(function(idx, member)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(member)
		end)
	end

	--0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--플레이어 일행 (down, tired, walk) 상태로 1타일 상단으로 1초에 걸쳐 이동.
	do
		party_util.foreach_member(function(idx, member)
			scene_util.set_emotion(member, self, 'tired')
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member, member.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 1,
					nil, 1, self,
					nil, { locked_dir = direction_constants.down })
		end)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	end

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--플레이어 일행 (down, tired, walk) 상태로 1타일 상단으로 1초에 걸쳐 이동.
	do
		party_util.foreach_member(function(idx, member)
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member, member.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 1,
					nil, 1, self,
					nil, { locked_dir = direction_constants.down })
		end)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	end

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--컨트롤 해제되면서 용염레이스 파트 진입.
	party_util.foreach_member(function(idx, member)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(member)
	end)

	local wall = self.wall.start_wall()

	wall.Position = self.marker.lava_race_start_wall_pos()
	wall.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(3, 1, 1))

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_run', state = 'event', volume = 1, mix = 1 })

	self.current_state = self.states.playing
end

function game:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	--도착 지점 도달하면 끝
	if self.current_state == self.states.playing and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.player_fo, 'lava_race_end') then
		self.current_state = self.states.clear

		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene({ stop_party = false })

			self:clear_scene()

			self:game_end(true)
		end)

		return true
	end

	--처음 들어가는 분수 트리거 존 입장시
	if self.current_state == self.states.playing and
			self.fountain.unentered_zone_table[e.Zone.Name] ~= nil and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.player_fo, e.Zone.Name) then
		local zones = self.fountain.unentered_zone_table[e.Zone.Name]

		--연결된 존에 걸친 발판들 전부 폭파
		for i = 1, #zones do
			self:destroy_plates(zones[i], false)
		end

		--입장 처리를 통해 중복 수행되지 않도록
		self.fountain.unentered_zone_table[e.Zone.Name] = nil

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.playing and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.player_fo, 'lava_race_finish_check') then
		local wall = self.wall.finish_wall()

		wall.Position = self.marker.lava_race_finish_wall_pos()
		wall.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(10, 1, 1))

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function game:aabb_by_point(bounds, point)
	return bounds.min.x <= point.x and bounds.max.x >= point.x
			and bounds.min.z <= point.z and bounds.max.z >= point.z
end

function game:update(dt)
	--용암 분수 루틴
	self:update_fountains(dt)

	if self.current_state ~= self.states.playing then
		return
	end

	local game_fail_scene = function()
		self.current_state = self.states.fail

		local start_wall = self.wall.start_wall()

		start_wall.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

		local finish_wall = self.wall.finish_wall()

		finish_wall.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			self:fail_scene()

			--용암 이펙트가 다 끝나고 파괴되어야 하기에 나중에 수행
			self:game_end(false)
		end)
	end

	self.cur_plate_group.time_passed = self.cur_plate_group.time_passed + dt

	--발판 파괴 루틴
	if self.is_all_destroyed == false and self.cur_plate_group.time_limit < self.cur_plate_group.time_passed then
		local time_passed_diff = self.cur_plate_group.time_passed - self.cur_plate_group.time_limit

		--발판 파괴 후 플레이어가 죽은 경우 실패 처리
		self:destroy_plates(self:get_and_progress_time_plate_zone(), false)

		if self:check_bound() then
			game_fail_scene()
			return
		end

		--다음 발판 초기화 시도, 초기화 실패하면 전부 파괴된 것이므로 체크
		if self:try_init_cur_plate_group(time_passed_diff) == false then
			self.is_all_destroyed = true
		end
	end

	self.cur_bound_check_dt = self.cur_bound_check_dt + dt

	if self.cur_bound_check_dt >= self.bound_check_dt then
		self.cur_bound_check_dt = 0

		if self:check_bound() then
			game_fail_scene()
			return
		end
	end

	return
end

function game:check_bound()
	for i = 1, #self.bound_list do
		if self:aabb_by_point(self.bound_list[i], self.player_fo.Position) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function game:update_fountains(dt)
	local start_scale = 1
	local end_scale = 0.2
	local start_delay = 0.25
	local up_wait_duration = 2
	local down_wait_duration = 0.8
	local end_delay = 1.5

	--실행 중 분수 데이터 가져와서 각각 흐른 시간에 따라 이펙트 진행
	for key, _ in pairs(self.fountain.update_data_table) do
		local data = key

		data.time_passed = data.time_passed + dt

		local reset_time = function(prev_limit)
			data.time_passed = data.time_passed - prev_limit
		end

		if data.current_state == self.fountain.states.before_start then
			if data.time_passed > start_delay then
				data.lava_piller_fx = self.fx.lava_piller():Instantiate(data.pos)

				data.current_state = self.fountain.states.up
				reset_time(data.time_passed, start_delay)
			end
		elseif data.current_state == self.fountain.states.up then
			if data.time_passed > up_wait_duration then
				data.current_state = self.fountain.states.down
				reset_time(data.time_passed, up_wait_duration)
			end
		elseif data.current_state == self.fountain.states.down then
			local progress = data.time_passed / down_wait_duration
			local y_scale = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_scale, end_scale, progress)

			data.lava_piller_fx.transform.localScale = vector_util.get_x0z(unity_class.vector3.one, y_scale)

			if data.time_passed > down_wait_duration then
				data.lava_piller_fx:Dispose()
				data.lava_piller_end_fx = self.fx.lava_piller_end():Instantiate(data.pos)

				data.current_state = self.fountain.states.close
				reset_time(data.time_passed, up_wait_duration)
			end
		elseif data.current_state == self.fountain.states.close then
			if data.time_passed > end_delay then
				data.lava_piller_end_fx:Dispose()

				--종료되면 현재 활성화 중인 애들에서 제거
				self.fountain.update_data_table:remove(key)
			end
		end
	end
end

function game:get_and_progress_time_plate_zone()
	local prev_group_idx = self.group_idx
	self.group_idx = self.group_idx + 1
	return field_util.get_zone(self.const.time_plate_prefix .. prev_group_idx)
end

--인자로 받은 존과 겹치는 파괴하고, 플레이어가 죽었는지 여부 리턴. 연출 내에서는 죽었는지 체크 하지 않음.
function game:destroy_plates(zone, only_effect)
	local is_fail = false

	local col_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(zone.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ name = '02_gimmick_lava_eruption_01', play_pos = zone.Bounds.center })

	for i = 0, col_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = col_list[i]
		local fo_bhv = fo.FieldObjectBehaviour

		--파괴될 발판 오브젝트인지 체크
		if lua_helper.type_compare(fo_bhv, CS.Oak.LavaRockFieldObjectBehaviour) then
			--그룹에 속한 모든 발판들 대미지 이벤트로 파괴
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()

			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick
			damage_info.sender = self.player_fo
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.damage = 1

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

			--발판 위치에 용암 분수 분출
			local fountain_data = self:create_fountain(fo.Position, true)
			self:start_erupt_fountain(fountain_data)

			----현재 발판 Bounds와 플레이어가 겹치면 탈락 처리
			if only_effect == false then
				table.insert(self.bound_list, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(fo.Bounds.center, self.plate_bounds.size))
			end
		end
	end

	col_list:Dispose()

	return is_fail
end

function game:game_end(is_success)
	self:dispose()

	if is_success then
		self.current_state = self.states.done
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, true))
	else
		self.current_state = self.states.before_play
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, false))
	end
end

function game:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	update_util.remove_update(self, CS.Oak.UpdatePriorities.StageEvent, 'update')

	self.const = nil
	self.group_idx = nil
	self.cur_plate_group.count = nil
	self.cur_plate_group.time_limit = nil
	self.cur_plate_group.time_passed = nil
	self.game_name = nil
	self.player_fo = nil
	self.is_all_destroyed = nil
	self.plate_bounds = nil
	self.bound_list = nil

	self.fountain.unentered_zone_table = nil

	if self.fountain.update_data_table ~= nil then
		for key, _ in pairs(self.fountain.update_data_table) do
			if key.lava_bubble_fx ~= nil then
				key.lava_bubble_fx:Dispose()
			end

			if key.lava_piller_fx ~= nil then
				key.lava_piller_fx:Dispose()
			end

			if key.lava_piller_end_fx ~= nil then
				key.lava_piller_fx:Dispose()
			end
		end

		self.fountain.unentered_zone_table = nil
		self.fountain.update_data_table = nil
	end
end

--분수 데이터 생성
function game:create_fountain(pos, only_erupt)
	local bubble_fx

	--분출만 시킬 경우에는 보글보글 이펙트 소환 안함.
	if only_erupt == false then
		bubble_fx = self.fx.lava_bubble():Instantiate(pos + self.fountain.bubble_fx_offset)
	end

	local fountain_data = {
		time_passed = 0,
		pos = pos,
		lava_bubble_fx = bubble_fx,
		lava_piller_fx = nil,
		lava_piller_end_fx = nil,
		current_state = self.fountain.states.before_start,
		only_erupt = only_erupt,
	}

	return fountain_data
end

--분수를 분출 중 업데이트 테이블에 추가
function game:start_erupt_fountain(data)
	--이미 실행중이면 아무것도 안함
	if data.current_state ~= self.fountain.states.before_start then
		return
	end

	self.fountain.update_data_table:add(data)
end

function game:fail_scene()
	local pivot = self.marker.staff_pivot()
	local knight = self.cashed_leader
	local princess = self.character.princess()
	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy()
	local fire_bishop = self.character.fire_bishop()

	local staff_1 = self.character.staff(1)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fire_06')
	local fall_down_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fall_down_01', volume = 0.8, loop = true })
	--파티원 캐릭터 모두 damaged 표정, embarrassed 애니메이션 전환
	--1초 동안 캐릭터들 크기 0으로 축소.
	--캐릭터들 1초 동안 3번 회전.
	party_util.foreach_member(function(idx, member)
		scene_util.set_emotion(member, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(member, self, { name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = false })

		member.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false

		local duration = 1

		character_util.spine_scale(member, unity_class.vector3.zero, duration)
		character_util.spine_rotate(member, 1080, duration)
	end)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--동시 실행 이벤트 완료 이후 0.6초 동안 서큘러 페이드 아웃.
	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(fall_down_sfx, 0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.6, 'linear')

	self:reset_party()

	--페이드 아웃 시점에 아래의 리스트들 세팅
	do
		--상단 타일맵의 위치로 조정한 후, 플레이어 일행 (left, confused, prostrate) 상태로 세팅.
		character_util.set_position(knight, pivot + vector(1, 0, -0.5))
		character_util.set_position(princess, pivot + vector(2, 0, -0.5))
		character_util.set_position(dragon_boy, pivot + vector(1, 0, 0.5))
		character_util.set_position(fire_bishop, pivot + vector(2, 0, 0.5))

		party_util.foreach_member(function(idx, member)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(member)
			character_util.set_direction(member, direction_constants.left)
			member.SpineController.IsShadowActive = true
			character_util.spine_scale(member, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
			character_util.spine_rotate(member, 0, 0)
		end)

		scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'confused')
		scene_util.set_anim(dragon_boy, self, 'prostrate')
	end

	--상단 타일맵의 위치로 조정한 후, 플레이어 일행 (left, confused, prostrate) 상태로 세팅.
	--용암 레이스에서 파괴된 용암판 전체 리셋.
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character.knight(), { 'LavaRockReset' }));

	---prostrate 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--서큘러 페이드 인 0.6초에 걸쳐 실행.
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.6, 'linear')

	--플레이어 일행 0.03 / 0.3 shake 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	field_object_util.shake(dragon_boy, 0.03, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--플레이어 일행 0.03 / 0.3 shake 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	field_object_util.shake(dragon_boy, 0.03, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--플레이어 일행 (left, idle, get, jump 1회) 실행하여 기상.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dragon_boy)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(dragon_boy, self, 'get')
	character_util.normal_jump(dragon_boy)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	party_util.foreach_member(function(idx, member)
		character_util.cancel_jump(member)
		character_util.remove_anim(member)
	end)

	--0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--NPC 1 (right, smile, cast2) : 하하! 그대로 용암과 한몸이 되는 순간! 주최측이 아슬아슬하게 구해냈습니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_1, self, 'right',
			'cast2', 'smile', 'fw_main_lava_race_s1_33')

	--NPC 1 (right, smile, sing) : 용기는 가상합니다만… 죽지 않게 조심하세요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_1, self, 'right',
			'sing', 'smile', 'fw_main_lava_race_s1_34')

	--플레이어 일행 (left, tired, idle) 상태로 annoyed 이모티콘 출력.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	party_util.foreach_member(function(idx, member)
		scene_util.set_emotion(member, self, 'tired')

		if idx == user_party.Count - 1 then
			character_util.show_emoticon_async(member, nil, 'annoyed')
		else
			character_util.show_emoticon(member, nil, 'annoyed')
		end
	end)

	party_util.foreach_member(function(idx, member)
		character_util.remove_emotion(member)
	end)

	--완료되면 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀.
	--이후 용염레이스 재진입 가능.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 1, volume = 1 })
end

function game:clear_scene()
	local pivot = self.marker.staff_pivot()
	local knight = self.cashed_leader
	local princess = self.character.princess()
	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy()
	local fire_bishop = self.character.fire_bishop()

	local staff_1 = self.character.staff(1)
	local staff_2 = self.character.staff(2)
	local staff_3 = self.character.staff(3)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 3 })

	--날아가는 중에
	--NPC 1, 2 (지정 방향, idle, walk) 를 1타일 씩 2초에 걸쳐 실행하여 길을 막은 상태로 (right, idle, idle) 실행.
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(staff_2, staff_2.Position + unity_class.vector3.back, nil,
			2, self, nil,
			{ last_direction = direction_constants.right })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(staff_3, staff_3.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward, nil,
			2, self, nil,
			{ last_direction = direction_constants.right })

	--마지막 파티원 착지까지 대기
	local last_party_member = user_party[user_party.Count - 1]
	local fo_bhv = last_party_member.FieldObjectBehaviour

	while lua_helper.type_compare(fo_bhv.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterJumpState) or
			(lua_helper.type_compare(fo_bhv.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState) and fo_bhv.CurrentState.IsFlying == true) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--[종료 연출 진행]
	--아래의 항목 동시에 실행.
	do
		--마지막 지점 점프대 탑승 시 2초에 걸쳐 지정된 위치에 도착한 후 (left, idle, idle) 정렬.
		--세밀한 연출 X. 점프 탑승까지는 기믹 처리 후, 도착한 뒤 정렬도 문제 없음.
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, pivot + vector(1, 0, -0.5), nil,
				1, self, nil,
				{ locked_dir = direction_constants.left })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, pivot + vector(2, 0, -0.5), nil,
				1, self, nil,
				{ locked_dir = direction_constants.left })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dragon_boy, pivot + vector(1, 0, 0.5), nil,
				1, self, nil,

local controller_base = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Base/QuestControllerBase')

---@class FireWorldLaytonController : QuestControllerBase
local local_class = newclass('FireWorldLaytonController', controller_base)

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.super:init(cs_controller)

	-- 사용할 섹션 스크립트 정보. 주석 해제하고 사용
	self.script_config = {
		HasPreSection = true,
		NormalSectionCount = 1,
		HasPostSection = false
	}

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version + 1

	-- npc
	self.character = setmetatable({
		spec = {
			-- 공주
			princess = 'princess',
			-- 기르가스
			dragon_boy = 'dragon_boy',
			-- 비슈바크
			fire_bishop = 'fire_bishop',
		}
	}, {
		__index = function(this, key)
			return get_character(this.spec[key])
		end
	})

	self.lava_boat = {
		trail = nil,
		board_scene_data = {
			move_dur = 0.5,
			camera_dur = 0.3,
			character_fade_dur = 0.6,
			jump_height = 1
		},

		--배 내부 위치 오프셋
		boat_offset = {
			vector(-0.2, 0, 0.2),
			vector(0.2, 0, 0.2),
			vector(-0.2, 0, -0.2),
			vector(0.2, 0, -0.2),
		},

		wp = {
			left = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_layton_boat_pos_1'),
			right = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_layton_boat_pos_2'),
			left_landing = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_layton_boat_end_pos_1'),
			right_landing = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_layton_boat_end_pos_2')
		},

		get = function()
			return get_field_object('layton_boat')
		end,

		-- 보트에 탈때 연출
		board_scene = function(this)
			local boat = this.get()
			local data = this.board_scene_data
			local leader = user_party.Leader

			--이동 방향
			local move_dir = vector_util.to_direction(boat.Position - leader.Position)

			--카메라 0.3초 동안 배 오브젝트의 중앙으로 패닝.
			local camera_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(boat.Bounds.center)
			camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, data.camera_dur, { end_target = boat })

			local current_party = get_user_party()

			-- 파티원이 4명이 이상일 경우는 fireworld_3 엔 없어서 처리하지 않음
			for i = 0, current_party.Count - 1 do
				local member = current_party[i]
				local end_pos = boat.Position + this.boat_offset[i + 1]

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
				scene_util.set_anim(member, self, { name = 'get' })
				character_util.jump(member, data.jump_height, data.move_dur)

				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member,
						end_pos, nil, data.move_dur, self, nil,
						{ run = false, locked_dir = move_dir, end_callback = function()
							character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(member)
						end })
			end

			wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
		end,

		-- 보트에 타서 이동 연출
		move_async = function(this, end_callback)
			local boat = this.get()

			local move_fos = {}
			local current_party = get_user_party()

			for i = 0, current_party.Count - 1 do
				local member = current_party[i]
				table.insert(move_fos, member)
			end

			table.insert(move_fos, boat)

			local trail = self.fx.lava_boat_trail():Instantiate(
					boat.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, boat.Transform)

			local start_pos = boat.Position
			local end_pos = this.wp.right
			local dir = direction_constants.right
			local center_pos_x = (this.wp.left.x + this.wp.right.x) / 2

			if boat.Position.x > center_pos_x then
				end_pos = this.wp.left
				dir = direction_constants.left
			end

			local speed = 6
			local dist = 10
			local move_dur = dist / speed

			local boat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gimmick_lava_move_01_loop', loop = true })

			coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(move_dur, start_pos, end_pos, function(_, cur_value)
				for idx, member in pairs(move_fos) do
					local move_pos = cur_value

					if not lua_helper.reference_equals(member, boat) then
						move_pos = cur_value + this.boat_offset[idx]
						scene_util.set_direction(member, dir, false)
					end

					member.Position = move_pos
				end
			end)

			music_player_util.stop_sfx(boat_sfx)

			trail:Dispose()

			if end_callback ~= nil then
				end_callback()
			end
		end,

		-- 보트에서 내릴때 연출
		board_exit_scene = function(this)
			local data = this.board_scene_data
			local boat = this.get()
			local leader = user_party.Leader

			local camera_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(leader.Bounds.center)
			camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, this.board_scene_data.camera_dur, { end_target = leader })

			local pivot_end_pos = this.wp.right_landing
			local center_pos_x = (this.wp.left.x + this.wp.right.x) / 2

			if boat.Position.x > center_pos_x then
				pivot_end_pos = this.wp.left_landing
			end

			local end_pos_table = {
				pivot_end_pos,
				pivot_end_pos + vector(1, 0, 0),
				pivot_end_pos + vector(0, 0, -1),
				pivot_end_pos + vector(1, 0, -1),
			}

			local current_party = get_user_party()

			-- 파티원이 4명이 이상일 경우는 fireworld_3 엔 없어서 처리하지 않음
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
			for i = 0, current_party.Count - 1 do
				local member = current_party[i]
				local end_pos = end_pos_table[i + 1]

				scene_util.set_anim(member, self, { name = 'get' })
				character_util.jump(member, data.jump_height, data.move_dur)

				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member,
						end_pos, nil, 0.6, self, nil,
						{ run = false, locked_dir = 'down', end_callback = function()
							character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(member)
						end })
			end

			wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
		end,

		-- 보트가 강의 어느편에 있는지
		get_boat_side = function(this)
			local boat = this.get()
			local center_pos_x = (this.wp.left.x + this.wp.right.x) / 2
			local dir = 'left'
			if boat.Position.x > center_pos_x then
				dir = 'right'
			end

			return dir
		end
	}

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		lava_boat_trail = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fw_lava_boat_trail')
		end,
	})

	-- 레이튼은 재접속 시 모든 npc 가 삭제되어야 해서 다이나믹으로
	self.dynamic_npcs = {
		prefix = 'fw_sub_layton_',
		spec_name = {
			layton = 'fw_steampunk_citizen_male',
			luke = 'fw_steampunk_citizen_boy',
			boatman = 'fw_nm_fh_male',
			wolf = 'fw_pet_wolf_red',
			slime = 'fw_pet_slime_lava',
			hedgehog = 'fw_pet_hedgehog_fire',
		},

		container = nil,

		get = function(this, name)
			if this.container == nil then
				return
			end

			return this.container[name]
		end,

		load_async = function(this)
			if this.container ~= nil then
				return
			end

			this.container = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_with_prefix_async(this.prefix, this.spec_name)
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			if this.container == nil then
				return
			end

			load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(this.container)

			this.container = nil
		end,
	}

	-- 위치 기준 값
	self.pivot_pos = {
		boat_pos = function(idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_layton_boat_pos_' .. idx)
		end,
		boat_end_pos = function(idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_layton_boat_end_pos_' .. idx)
		end,
		layton_pos = function(idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_layton_pivot_pos_' .. idx)
		end,
		wolf_pos = function(idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_layton_wolf_pos_' .. idx)
		end,
		slime_pos = function(idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_layton_slime_pos_' .. idx)
		end,
		hedgehog_pos = function(idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_layton_hedgehog_pos_' .. idx)
		end,
	}

	self.is_interacted = false
	self.is_dynamic_loaded = false
end

function local_class:load_resource()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress ~= nil and self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.IsComplete then
		local boat = self.lava_boat.get()

		if not self.is_interacted and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, boat) then
			self.is_interacted = true

			sp_util.start_scene(function()
				self.lava_boat:board_scene()
				self.lava_boat:move_async()
				self.lava_boat:board_exit_scene()
			end)

			self.is_interacted = false
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	self.fx:create_all()

	start_coroutine(function()
		self.dynamic_npcs:load_async()
		self.is_dynamic_loaded = true
	end)
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	if self.dynamic_npcs ~= nil then
		self.dynamic_npcs:dispose()
	end

	self.dynamic_npcs = nil
end

function local_class:set_npc_with_data(data)
	for i = 1, #data do
		local npc_preset = data[i]

		local npc
		if npc_preset.type == 'static' then
			if npc_preset.name == 'leader' then
				npc = get_party_leader()
			else
				npc = get_character(npc_preset.name)
			end
		else
			npc = self.dynamic_npcs:get(npc_preset.name)
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)

		if data[i].pos ~= nil then
			character_util.set_position(npc, data[i].pos)
		end

		if data[i].dir ~= nil then
			character_util.set_direction(npc, data[i].dir)
		end

		if data[i].emo ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, data[i].emo)
		end

		if data[i].anim ~= nil then
			if type_util.is_table(data[i].anim) then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, data[i].anim)
			else
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = data[i].anim, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_preset.name ~= 'leader' then
			npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end

		if data[i].oneline ~= nil then
			npc.Interactable.Talk = data[i].oneline
		end

		if data[i].sfx ~= nil then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = data[i].sfx
		end

		if data[i].active ~= nil then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, data[i].active)
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)
		end
	end
end

return local_class

						scene_util.set_emotion(fo, self, 'attack')

						--불꽃 고슴도치 (right, smile, attack) 상태로, 0.7타일 우측으로 0.1초에 걸쳐 이동
						scene_util.set_emotion(fo, self, 'smile')

						local slime = self.over_the_river:get_creature('slime')

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')

			character_util.convert_to_following_npc(fo, user_party)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)

		set_side_data = function(this)
			this.side.right = {}
			this.side.left = {}

			for creature_name, data in pairs(this.creatures) do
				if this:get_creature_side(creature_name) == 'right' then
					table.insert(this.side.right, creature_name)
				else
					table.insert(this.side.left, creature_name)
				end
			end

			if this:get_leader_side() == 'right' then
				table.insert(this.side.right, 'leader')
			else
				table.insert(this.side.left, 'leader')
			end
		end,

		-- 화산 생명체 전체 위치 리셋
		set_creatures = function()
			self.controller:set_npc_with_data(self.npc_presets[self.states.creatures_setting])
		end,

		set_quest_marker = function(this)
			if this.is_creature_in_party then
				return
			end

			for creature_name, data in pairs(this.creatures) do
				local fo = this:get_creature(creature_name)
				quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(fo.Name, self.controller.quest_id, false, fo)
			end
		end,

		remove_quest_marker = function(this)
			for creature_name, data in pairs(this.creatures) do
				local fo = this:get_creature(creature_name)
				quest_marker_util.remove(fo.Name)
			end
		end,

		set_listener = function(this)
			for creature_name, data in pairs(this.creatures) do
				local fo = this:get_creature(creature_name)
				character_util.add_lua_listener(fo, self)
			end
		end,

		remove_listener = function(this)
			for creature_name, data in pairs(this.creatures) do
				local fo = this:get_creature(creature_name)
				character_util.remove_lua_listener(fo, self)
			end
		end,

		check_for_eating = function(this)
			--강 을 기준으로 양쪽에 화산 생명체 + 리더 정보를 세팅 함
			this:set_side_data()

			-- 우측에 3마리 다 있는 경우와, 플레이어 포함 3마리가 있는 경우엔 먹지 않는다.
			-- 좌측에 3마리가 있을 경우는 클리어.
			if #this.side.right >= 3 or #this.side.left >= 3 then
				this:set_listener()
				this:set_quest_marker()

				return false
			end

			--강 오른쪽 먼저 검사
			for _, creature_name in pairs(this.side.right) do
				-- 리더 유무도 체크 해야 함 (리더가 같은 구역에 있으면 먹지 않기 때문)
				if creature_name == 'leader' then
					break
				end

				for _, prey in pairs(this.side.right) do
					if this.creatures[creature_name].prey == prey then
						-- 서로 천적 관계 이면 먹는 연출 재생
						this:eat_scene(creature_name, 'right', prey)

						return true
					end
				end
			end

			--강 왼쪽 검사
			for _, creature_name in pairs(this.side.left) do
				if creature_name == 'leader' then
					break
				end

				for _, prey in pairs(this.side.left) do
					if this.creatures[creature_name].prey == prey then
						this:eat_scene(creature_name, 'left', prey)

						return true
					end
				end
			end

			this:set_listener()
			this:set_quest_marker()

			return false
		end,

		-- 먹는 연출
		eat_scene = function(this, creature_name, side, prey_name)
			local fo = this:get_creature(creature_name)
			local wp = this.creatures[creature_name].wp.eat[side]

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

			character_util.remove_anim(fo)
			scene_util.set_emotion(fo, self, this.creatures[creature_name].eat_emo)

			screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			local pivot_pos_index = 1

			if side == 'right' then
				pivot_pos_index = 2
			end

			local camera_pos = self.controller.pivot_pos[prey_name .. '_pos'](pivot_pos_index)
			camera_util.set_position(camera_pos, true)

			screen_util.fade_in_async(0.2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			local last_dir = direction_util.get_opposite_ver2(character_util.get_direction(self.controller.lava_boat:get_boat_side()))

			local speed = 5

			if creature_name == 'hedgehog' then
				speed = 3.3
			end

			scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, { name = 'run' })

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(this.creatures[creature_name].eat_sfx.move)
			wp_util.move_async(fo, wp, speed, nil,
					{ run = true, play_sfx = false, last_direction = last_dir })

			character_util.remove_anim(fo)

			--슬로우 모션 / 0.5초를 0.25배로 실행하여 2초 진행하는 것을 의도
			local slow_key = 'slow_key'
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(this.creatures[creature_name].eat_sfx.slow)
			time_util.mod(slow_key, 0.25)

			this.creatures[creature_name].end_callback:eat(fo, last_dir)

			--즉시 붉은색으로 페이드 아웃 연출 출력
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(this.creatures[creature_name].eat_sfx.red)
			screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.red, 'linear')

			self.background_fade_controller:set_background_color(0, 0, 0)
			self.background_fade_controller:set_background_active(true)
			self.background_fade_controller:set_background_sorting_order('Top Effects', 100)
			self.background_fade_controller:set_background_alpha(1)

			self.controller:set_npc_with_data(self.npc_presets[self.states.creatures_setting])

			--초기화
			self.over_the_river:reset_puzzle_setting()

			time_util.unmod(slow_key)

			--검은색 배경 상태로 미리 전환 후, 1초에 걸쳐 붉은색 페이드인 (붉은색 흐릿해지면서 검은색이 됨)
			screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.red, 'linear')

			--이후 다시 1초에 걸쳐 검은색 페이드인 되어 컨트롤 돌려줌
			coroutine_util.while_each_frame(1, function(progress)
				self.background_fade_controller:set_background_alpha(1 - progress)
			end)

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
		end,

		-- 보트에 내려서 화산 생명체가 집으로 돌아가는 연출
		move_home_scene = function(this, creature_name, side)
			local fo = this:get_creature(creature_name)
			local wp = this.creatures[creature_name].wp.home[side]
			character_util.remove_anim(fo)

			local last_dir = direction_util.get_opposite_ver2(character_util.get_direction(self.controller.lava_boat:get_boat_side()))
			wp_util.move_async(fo, wp, 4, nil,
					{ run = true, play_sfx = false, last_direction = last_dir })

			this.creatures[creature_name].end_callback:home(fo)

			character_util.remove_emotion(fo)
		end,

		-- 파티로 추가한 화산 생명체를 다시 집에 돌려놓는 연출
		return_home_scene = function(this, creature_name, creature_return_home_fo)
			local creature_fo = this:get_creature(creature_name)
			local wp = {
				vector(creature_fo.Position.x, 0, creature_return_home_fo.Position.z),
				creature_return_home_fo.Position
			}

			character_util.convert_to_npc(creature_fo)
			self.over_the_river.is_creature_in_party = false

			local last_dir = direction_util.get_opposite_ver2(character_util.get_direction(self.controller.lava_boat:get_boat_side()))
			wp_util.move_async(creature_fo, wp, 4, nil,
					{ run = true, play_sfx = false, last_direction = last_dir })

			this.creatures[creature_name].end_callback:home(creature_fo)

			character_util.remove_emotion(creature_fo)

			--인터렉트용 기믹은 멀리 보내 놓음
			creature_return_home_fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		end,

		--미니게임 중 이탈 방지 용 연출
		exit_block_scene = function(this, dir)
			local leader = user_party.Leader
			local luke = self.controller.dynamic_npcs:get('luke')

			local leader_dir = direction_util.get_opposite_ver2(direction_constants[dir])
			scene_util.set_direction(leader, leader_dir, false)

			--카메라 위치로 0.5초에 걸쳐 이동
			local camera_pos = self.controller.pivot_pos.layton_pos(1)
			camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0.5)

			--루트 (left, surprise, release 2회 후 idle) : 어, 어디 가세요 선생님!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(luke, self, dir,
					{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
					{ name = 'surprise' },
					{ key = 'fw_sub_layton_s1_block_1', skip = true })

			--동시 실행 : 루트 모션 및 카메라 위치 복귀
			--루트 (right, tired, question 1회 후 정지) 상태로 전환
			scene_util.set_direction(luke, direction_constants.right, false)
			scene_util.set_anim(luke, self, { name = 'question', loop = false })
			scene_util.set_emotion(luke, self, 'tired')

			--카메라 플레이어 위치로 0.5초에 걸쳐 복귀
			camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

			--플레이어 파티 전체 (up, idle, walk) 상태로 1타일 상단으로 0.5초간 이동.

			--컨트롤을 돌려준다.
		end,

		-- 퍼즐 세팅을 리셋
		reset_puzzle_setting = function(this)
			local leader = user_party.Leader

			scene_util.set_direction(leader, direction_constants.up, false)
			leader.Position = self.controller.pivot_pos.layton_pos(1) + vector(-1, 0, -1)
			camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

			local boat = self.controller.lava_boat.get()
			boat.Position = self.controller.pivot_pos.boat_pos(2)

			self.over_the_river.is_creature_in_party = false

			this:set_listener()
			this:set_quest_marker()
		end,

		-- 화산 생명체들의 위치를 blink 이펙트와 함께 리셋함
		creature_position_reset = function(this)
			this:remove_quest_marker()
			this:remove_listener()

			if self.over_the_river.is_creature_in_party then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_button_party_add_01')
				local current_party_creature = self.over_the_river:get_creature(self.over_the_river.current_party_creature)
				self.fx.blink():Instantiate(current_party_creature.Position)
				character_util.convert_to_npc(current_party_creature)
				self.over_the_river.is_creature_in_party = false
			end

			self.controller:set_npc_with_data(self.npc_presets[self.states.creatures_setting])

			for creature_name, data in pairs(this.creatures) do
				local fo = this:get_creature(creature_name)
				self.fx.blink():Instantiate(fo.Position)
			end

			-- 화산 생명체를 파티에서 내려놓기 위한 인터렉트 오브젝트 위치 초기화
			this.get_return_fo().Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		end,

		creature_interact_data = function(this, creature_name)
			this.is_creature_in_party = true
			this:remove_quest_marker()
			this:remove_listener()

			this:add_party(creature_name)
			this.current_party_creature = creature_name
		end,

		-- 플레이어가 강의 왼쪽, 오른쪽 중에 어디에 있는지
		get_leader_side = function(this)
			local leader = user_party.Leader
			-- 임의의 기준점을 설정 하여 강의 왼, 오 판단
			local pivot_pos = self.controller.pivot_pos.layton_pos(1)

			if leader.Position.x > pivot_pos.x then
				return 'right'
			end

			return 'left'
		end,

		-- 화산 생명체가 강의 왼쪽, 오른쪽 중에 어디에 있는지
		get_creature_side = function(this, creature_name)
			local creature = this:get_creature(creature_name)
			-- 임의의 기준점을 설정 하여 강의 왼, 오 판단
			local pivot_pos = self.controller.pivot_pos.layton_pos(1)

			if creature.Position.x > pivot_pos.x then
				return 'right'
			end

			return 'left'
		end,

		clear_check = function(this)
			this:set_side_data()

			-- 좌측에 3마리가 있을 경우는 클리어. (플레이어 포함 4마리가 있는 경우)
			if #this.side.left == 4 then
				local luke = self.controller.dynamic_npcs:get('luke')

				self.quest_marker:add({
					{
						zone = 'main_field',
						target = luke
					}
				})

				this:remove_quest_marker()
				this:remove_listener()

				character_util.add_lua_listener(luke, self)

				self.current_state = self.states.puzzle_clear

				self:puzzle_clear_scene()
			end
		end
	}

	self.typing_text = {
		ui = nil,
		load_async = function(this)
			self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

			yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
					self.res_holder, 'ui/prologue', 'typing_text', function(prefab)
						local typing_text_go = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
						this.ui = typing_text_go:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UITypingText))
					end)
		end,
		set = function(this)
			this.ui.Widget.topAnchor.relative = 0
			--기본값은 y 100 이지만 해당 연출에선 50으로 세팅
			this.ui.Widget:SetAnchor(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, 1, 30, 1, 0)
			this.ui.Label.fontSize = 64
			this.ui.Label.alignment = CS.NGUIText.Alignment.Center
			this.ui.Widget:UpdateAnchors()

			--첫 typing_text alpha 값 초기화
			this.ui.Label.alpha = 0
		end,

		play_narration = function(this, text)
			local text_fade_in_duration = 0.5
			local text_fade_out_duration = 0.5
			local text_maintain_duration = 1.5
			local text_exposure_duration = text_fade_in_duration + text_maintain_duration + text_fade_out_duration
			local text_width = 2000
			local text_speed = 0

			--아래 text_out이 들어가고 중간에 text가 사라지게 되어서 start_coroutine_enumerator로 변경 후 대기시간동안 기다려준다.
			wait_all({
				--typing_text setting
				this.ui:SetTypedText(
						text,
						text_width,
						text_speed,
						text_exposure_duration
				),
				util.cs_generator(function()
					--fade in 대기
					this.fade_typing_text_in(this, this.ui, text_fade_in_duration)

					--노출 시간 대기
					wait_for_sec(text_maintain_duration)

					-- 피드백 사항으로 text 의 페이드 연출은 제외 됨. 필요시 사용
					--fade out 대기
					--this.fade_typing_text_out(this, this.ui, text_fade_out_duration)
				end)
			})
		end,
		fade_typing_text_in = function(this, typing_text, duration)
			this:fade_typing_text(typing_text, 1, duration)
		end,
		fade_typing_text_out = function(this, typing_text, duration)
			this:fade_typing_text(typing_text, 0, duration)
		end,
		fade_typing_text = function(his, typing_text, target_alpha, duration)
			local start_alpha = typing_text.Label.alpha
			local end_alpha = target_alpha

			coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(duration, start_alpha, end_alpha, function(_, cur_value)
				typing_text.Label.alpha = cur_value
			end)
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			if this.ui ~= nil then
				CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(this.ui.gameObject)
				this.ui = nil
			end
		end
	}

	self.puzzle_party_align_scene = function()

		local fire_bishop = self.controller.character.fire_bishop
		local dragon_boy = self.controller.character.dragon_boy

		--파티원들 (up, idle, run) 상태로, 표기된 위치로 1초에 걸쳐 이동

					scene_util.set_direction(princess, direction_constants.right, false)
					scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'smile')
					scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, { name = 'success', sfx_name = false })
				end
			},
			[fire_bishop] = {
				wp = wp_pivot_pos + vector(-3, 0, 0),
				end_callback = function()
					--비슈바크 (right, smile, idle) 상태로 대기
					scene_util.set_direction(fire_bishop, direction_constants.right, false)
					scene_util.set_emotion(fire_bishop, self, 'smile')
				end
			},
			[dragon_boy] = {
				wp = wp_pivot_pos + vector(-2, 0, 0),

					scene_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, direction_constants.left, false)
					scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'tired')

	--중간 연출에 필요한 npc 세팅용 state 인덱스 값
	self.puzzle_clear_scene_setting = {
		500,
		501,
		502,
		503,
		504,
	}

	self.is_in_zone = false
	self.is_interacted = false

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(function()
		self.fx:create_all()

		while not self.controller.is_dynamic_loaded do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		local luke = self.controller.dynamic_npcs:get('luke')

		self:set_npc_presets_for_state()
		self.controller:set_npc_with_data(self.npc_presets[self.states.npc_setting])
		self.controller:set_npc_with_data(self.npc_presets[self.states.creatures_setting])

		character_util.add_lua_listener(luke, self)

		self.current_state = self.states.before_puzzle

		--루트 (down, tired, question 정지) 상태로 퀘스트 마커 출력
		self.quest_marker:add({
			{
				zone = 'main_field',
				target = luke
			}
		})

		local is_get
		is_get, self.background_fade_controller = global_table_util.try_create_background_fade_controller()

		self.typing_text:load_async()
		self.typing_text:set()

		--asset_path, asset_name 디폴트 값 사용
		self.background_fade_controller:load_async()
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.quest_marker:remove()

	if self.background_fade_controller ~= nil then
		self.background_fade_controller:dispose_loaded()
	end

	self.background_fade_controller = nil

	if self.typing_text ~= nil then
		self.typing_text:dispose()
	end

	self.typing_text = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local boat = self.controller.lava_boat.get()
	local luke = self.controller.dynamic_npcs:get('luke')
	local creature_return_home_fo = self.over_the_river.get_return_fo()

	if not self.is_interacted and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, boat) then
		self.is_interacted = true

		-- 퍼즐을 시작한 후 상황에 따른 보트 이동
		if self.current_state == self.states.puzzle_start then
			local current_party = get_user_party()

			--if self.over_the_river:get_leader_side() == 'right' then
			--	if current_party.Count == 1 then
			--		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			--			self.controller.lava_boat:board_scene()
			--			self.over_the_river:exit_block_scene('right')
			--			self.controller.lava_boat:board_exit_scene()
			--		end)
			--
			--		self.is_interacted = false
			--
			--		return true
			--	end
			--end

			-- 파티원이 4명이 이상일 경우는 fireworld_3 엔 없어서 처리하지 않음
			sp_util.start_scene(function()
				self.controller.lava_boat:board_scene()
				self.controller.lava_boat:move_async()
				self.controller.lava_boat:board_exit_scene()

				if current_party.Count ~= 1 then
					self.over_the_river:leave_party(self.over_the_river.current_party_creature)

					local boat_side = self.controller.lava_boat:get_boat_side()

					--플레이어 하차 후 release 모션을 취합니다
					local leader = user_party.Leader
					scene_util.set_direction(leader, boat_side, false)
					scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'release' })

					self.over_the_river:move_home_scene(self.over_the_river.current_party_creature, boat_side)

					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

					self.over_the_river.is_creature_in_party = false
				end

				-- 천적이 잡아먹을 수 있는지
				self.over_the_river:check_for_eating()

				-- 클리어 했는지 체크
				self.over_the_river:clear_check()
			end)
		else
			-- 퍼즐을 시작 하기 전에 기본적인 보트 이동
			sp_util.start_scene(function()
				self.controller.lava_boat:board_scene()
				self.controller.lava_boat:move_async()
				self.controller.lava_boat:board_exit_scene()
			end)
		end

		self.is_interacted = false

		return true

	elseif not self.is_interacted and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, luke) then
		self.is_interacted = true

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			self:puzzle_start_scene()

			-- 선택지 결과에 따라서 변경
			if self.current_state == self.states.puzzle_start then
				self.over_the_river:set_quest_marker()
				self.over_the_river:set_listener()
			end
		end)

		self.is_interacted = false

		return true

	elseif not self.is_interacted and self.current_state == self.states.puzzle_clear and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, luke) then
		self.is_interacted = true
		self.current_state = self.states.done

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			self.quest_marker:remove()
			self:puzzle_clear_scene()
		end)

		self.is_interacted = false

		return true

	elseif not self.is_interacted and self.current_state == self.states.puzzle_start and
			not self.over_the_river.is_creature_in_party then
		self.is_interacted = true

		local wolf = self.over_the_river:get_creature('wolf')
		local slime = self.over_the_river:get_creature('slime')
		local hedgehog = self.over_the_river:get_creature('hedgehog')

		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, wolf) then
			creature_return_home_fo.Position = wolf.Position
			self.over_the_river:creature_interact_data('wolf')
		elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, slime) then
			creature_return_home_fo.Position = slime.Position
			self.over_the_river:creature_interact_data('slime')
		elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, hedgehog) then
			creature_return_home_fo.Position = hedgehog.Position
			self.over_the_river:creature_interact_data('hedgehog')
		end

		self.is_interacted = false

		return true
	elseif not self.is_interacted and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, creature_return_home_fo) then
		self.is_interacted = true

		-- 화산 생명체를 파티원에서 빼고 되돌려 놓는 연출
		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			self.over_the_river:return_home_scene(self.over_the_river.current_party_creature, creature_return_home_fo)
		end)

		self.over_the_river:set_quest_marker()
		self.over_the_river:set_listener()

		self.is_interacted = false
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	if self.current_state == self.states.puzzle_start or self.current_state == self.states.puzzle_clear then
		if not self.is_in_zone and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'sub_layton_block_zone') then
			self.is_in_zone = true

			sp_util.start_scene(function()
				music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

				self.over_the_river:exit_block_scene('left')

				local wp = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter('sub_layton_block_zone', leader, 'up', 0.5)
				wp_util.move_async(leader, wp, nil, 0.5)

				music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
			end)

			self.is_in_zone = false
		end
	end
end

function local_class:puzzle_start_scene()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local princess = self.controller.character.princess
	local fire_bishop = self.controller.character.fire_bishop
	local dragon_boy = self.controller.character.dragon_boy

	local luke = self.controller.dynamic_npcs:get('luke')

	local pivot_pos = self.controller.pivot_pos.layton_pos(1)

	--퀘스트 마커가 출력된 루트와 어떤 방향에서 인터랙트하든, 플레이어 컨트롤 빼앗고 아래 연출을 진행한다.

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--동시 실행 : 파티원 정렬
	local move_dur = 1

	if self.current_state ~= self.states.puzzle_start then
		local party_wp = {
			[leader] = {
				pivot_pos + vector(-1, 0, -1),
			},
			[princess] = {
				pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, -1),
			},
			[fire_bishop] = {
				pivot_pos + vector(-1, 0, -2),
			},
			[dragon_boy] = {
				pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, -2),
			},
		}

		--플레이어 및 파티원들 (right, idle, walk) 상태로, 표기된 위치로 1초에 걸쳐 이동
		--(up, idle, idle) 상태로 전환
		for fo, wp in pairs(party_wp) do
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fo, wp, nil, move_dur, self, nil,
					{ run = false, last_direction = 'up' })
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	else
		local wp = pivot_pos + vector(-1, 0, -1)
		wp_util.move_async(leader, wp, nil, move_dur, { run = false, last_direction = 'up' })
	end

	--선택지 출력 (*미니게임 진행 여부 on /off 역할)
	choose_util.play_async({
		{
			--(mercy) 우선 내가 해볼게.
			'fw_sub_layton_choose_s1_1_1',
			'mercy',
			function()
				self.quest_marker:remove()

				--루트 (down, tired, idle) : 부, 부탁드릴게요….
				character_util.remove_anim(luke)
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(luke, self, 'down',
						nil, 'tired', 'fw_sub_layton_s1_1')

				--루트 (right, tired, question 1회 후 정지) : 저는 당장 떠나기 어려울 거 같아요….
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(luke, self, 'right',
						{ name = 'question', loop = false, keep = true }, { name = 'tired', keep = true },
						'fw_sub_layton_s1_2')

				if self.current_state ~= self.states.puzzle_start then
					self.puzzle_party_align_scene(self)
				end

				self.current_state = self.states.puzzle_start
			end
		},
		--(brutal) 잠시 다른 곳을 다녀올게.
		{
			'fw_sub_layton_choose_s1_1_2',
			'brutal',
			function()
				--루트 (down, tired, idle) : 윽… 알겠습니다.
				character_util.remove_anim(luke)
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(luke, self, 'down',
						nil, 'tired', 'fw_sub_layton_s1_3')

				--루트 (right, tired, question 1회 후 정지) : 조금만 더 생각하면 될 거 같은데….
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(luke, self, 'right',
						{ name = 'question', loop = false, keep = true }, { name = 'tired', keep = true },
						'fw_sub_layton_s1_4')

				if self.current_state == self.states.puzzle_start then
					self.over_the_river:creature_position_reset()

					local party = {
						princess,
						fire_bishop,
						dragon_boy
					}

					--(down, idle, walk) 상태로 이동
					for i = 1, #party do
						local member = party[i]
						character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(member)
						character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(member, user_party)
					end

					self.quest_marker:add({
						{
							zone = 'main_field',
							target = luke
						}
					})
				end

				self.current_state = self.states.before_puzzle
			end
		},
	})

	--컨트롤을 돌려준다.

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:puzzle_clear_scene()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local princess = self.controller.character.princess
	local fire_bishop = self.controller.character.fire_bishop
	local dragon_boy = self.controller.character.dragon_boy

	local layton = self.controller.dynamic_npcs:get('layton')
	local luke = self.controller.dynamic_npcs:get('luke')
	local boatman = self.controller.dynamic_npcs:get('boatman')

	local creature_return_home_fo = self.over_the_river.get_return_fo()

	local pivot_pos = self.controller.pivot_pos.layton_pos(1)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--플레이어 컨트롤 뺏고 아래 연출이 진행된다
	--동시 실행
	--플레이어 (right, smile, success) 상태로 전환 후 페이드아웃 전까지 대기
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'success', sfx_name = false, one_shot_sfx = false })
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, direction_constants.right, false)

	--카메라, 플레이어 위치에서 루트위치로 2초에 걸쳐 이동
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(luke, 2)

	--카메라 이동 완료 후
	--루트 (left, surprise, cast) : [shout]어엇…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(luke, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'cast' },
			{ name = 'surprise' },
			{ key = 'fw_sub_layton_s1_5', skip = true })

	--동시 실행
	--뱃사공 (right, surprise, seat) 상태로 전환 (표정만 전환)
	scene_util.set_emotion(boatman, self, 'surprise')

	--루트 (left, surprise, release) : [shout]저 선생님께서 동물들을 전부 옮기셨어요…!
	--이후 루트 (left, surprise, idle) 상태로 전환 후 페이드아웃 전까지 대기
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(luke, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release' },
			{ name = 'surprise', keep = true },
			{ key = 'fw_sub_layton_s1_6', skip = true })

	--뱃사공 (left, surprise, idle) : 지, 진짜잖아…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(boatman)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(boatman, self, 'left',
			nil,
			{ name = 'surprise', keep = true },
			{ key = 'fw_sub_layton_s1_6_1', skip = true })

	--2초에 걸쳐 페이드아웃
	screen_util.fade_out_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--페이드인 전, 아래와 같이 세팅된다
	--뱃사공, (down, smile, cast) 상태
	--루트, (down, smile, idle) 상태
	--레이큰 교수, (left, smile, nod 반복) 상태
	self.controller:set_npc_with_data(self.npc_presets[self.puzzle_clear_scene_setting[5]])
	character_util.set_anim(layton, { name = 'nod', loop = true })

	--플레이어, 루트 바로 아래 1타일 위치에 (up, idle, idle) 상태
	--카메라, 플레이어 중심으로 이동
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	--커스텀용암배, 용암 우측 가장자리로 이동 (*타고 건너온 거처럼)
	local boat = self.controller.lava_boat.get()
	boat.Position = self.controller.lava_boat.wp.right

	--2초에 걸쳐 페이드인
	screen_util.fade_in_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--페이드인 완전히 종료 후 2초 대기한 뒤
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--루트 (down, smile, idle) : 감사드려요, 선생님!
	--(이후 붉은색으로 삭제한 연출 제외, 이전에 세팅해두신 연출과 동일합니다)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(luke, self, 'down',
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'fw_sub_layton_s1_6_2', skip = true })

	--동시 실행 : 이동하는 레이큰 교수, 반응하는 NPC들
	--레이큰 교수 (right, idle, walk) 상태로, 4타일 우측으로 1초에 걸쳐 이동
	character_util.remove_anim(layton)
	local wp = layton.Position + vector(4, 0, 0)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(layton,
			wp, nil, 1, self, nil, { run = false, last_direction = 'left',
									 end_callback = function()
										 --(left, sleep_deep, question 1회 후 정지) 상태로 대기
										 scene_util.set_emotion(layton, self, 'sleep_deep')
										 scene_util.set_anim(layton, self, { name = 'question', loop = false })
									 end })

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--뱃사공 (down, smile, cast) : 정말 고마워요, 덕분에 동물들을 무사히…
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(boatman, self, 'down',
						'cast', 'smile', 'fw_sub_layton_s1_7')

				--(right, tired, idle) 상태로 전환 후 대기
				scene_util.set_direction(boatman, 'right', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(boatman, self, 'tired')
			end,
			function()
				self.controller:set_npc_with_data(self.npc_presets[self.puzzle_clear_scene_setting[1]])

				--1초 대기 후
				wait_for_sec(1)

				self.controller:set_npc_with_data(self.npc_presets[self.puzzle_clear_scene_setting[2]])
			end
	)

	--1초 대기 후
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--카메라, 레이큰 교수 중심으로 1초에 걸쳐 이동하면서 교수를 제외하고 페이드 아웃
	local move_dur = 1

	do
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
		camera_util.move_to_target(layton, move_dur)
	end

	--asset_path, asset_name 디폴트 값 사용
	self.background_fade_controller:load_async()
	self.background_fade_controller:set_background_color(0, 0, 0)
	self.background_fade_controller:set_background_active(true)
	self.background_fade_controller:set_background_sorting_order('Default', -1)

	local sorting_layer_party = {
		leader,
		princess,
		fire_bishop,
		dragon_boy,
		luke,
		boatman
	}

	--레이튼의 human_emotion 때문에 나머지의 레이어를 낮춰 줌
	for i = 1, #sorting_layer_party do
		local member = sorting_layer_party[i]
		character_util.set_sorting_layer(member, 'Under Effects', -2)
	end

	coroutine_util.while_each_frame(move_dur, function(progress)
		self.background_fade_controller:set_background_alpha(progress)
	end)

	--레이튼 교수 시리즈 ‘문제 해결!’ 처럼 연출 출력 (*총 연출 시간 3.4초를 상정함)

	--레이큰 교수 (left, sleep_deep, question 정지) 상태로 0.4초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	--(*교수까지 가려지도록) 0.2초에 걸쳐 페이드 아웃
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--레이큰 교수 (down, sleep_deep, question 정지) 상태로 전환
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_get_star_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(layton, 'down', false)

	--카메라 3 값으로 줌인
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, 0)

	--(*교수만 드러나도록) 0.2초에 걸쳐 페이드 인

	end
	--endregion

	--region 스테이지6 일루니
	self.stage_6_character = {
		eternal_flame = function()
			return get_character('eternal_flame')
		end,
	}

	self.stage_end_flag = false

	--region 스테이지 NPC 배치
	self.stage_npc_setting_controller = metatable_helper.inherit({
		npc_controllers = nil,
		data_storage = nil,
		event_list = {
			fireworld_4 = {
				{
					path = 'Quest/Main/FireWorld/Main/Stage4NpcEvent1.lua',
					save_value = 1,
					target_quest_id = 478,
					clear_progress = 12,
					custom_state_key = 'stage_4_npc_setting',
					stage_event_key = 'clear_stage_4_event_1',
				},
				{
					path = 'Quest/Main/FireWorld/Main/Stage4NpcEvent2.lua',
					save_value = 2,
					target_quest_id = 478,
					clear_progress = 13,
					custom_state_key = 'stage_4_npc_setting',
					stage_event_key = 'clear_stage_4_event_2'
				},
				{
					path = 'Quest/Main/FireWorld/Main/Stage4NpcEvent3.lua',
					save_value = 4,
					target_quest_id = 486,
					clear_progress = nil,
					custom_state_key = 'stage_4_npc_setting',
					stage_event_key = 'clear_stage_4_event_3'
				},
				{
					path = 'Quest/Main/FireWorld/Main/Stage4NpcEvent4.lua',
					save_value = 8,
					target_quest_id = 485,
					clear_progress = nil,
					custom_state_key = 'stage_4_npc_setting',
					stage_event_key = 'clear_stage_4_event_4'
				}
			}
		}
	}, {
		init_controllers = function(this, quest_id)
			if this.event_list[stage.Name] == nil then
				return
			end

			if this.npc_controllers == nil then
				this.npc_controllers = {}
			end

			local storage_create = require('utils/QuestDataStorage')
			this.data_storage = storage_create.create(quest_id)

			for num, info in ipairs(this.event_list[stage.Name]) do
				local is_create, npc_controller = global_table_util.try_create(info.path)
				local custom_state = this:get_custom_state(info.custom_state_key)

				npc_controller:init_controller(self, info)

				local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(info.target_quest_id)
				local check_quest_progress = (quest_progress ~= nil and quest_progress.IsComplete) or
						(quest_progress ~= nil and info.clear_progress ~= nil and
								quest_progress.InnerProgress >= info.clear_progress)

				if is_create then
					if check_quest_progress or (custom_state & info.save_value) ~= 0 then
						--클리어 시 배치 세팅
						npc_controller:clear_setting()
					else
						--미 클리어 시 기본 배치 세팅
						npc_controller:default_setting()
					end
				end

				table.insert(this.npc_controllers, npc_controller)
			end
		end,

		get_custom_state = function(this, key)
			local custom_state = this.data_storage:get_data(key)

			return custom_state < 0 and 0 or custom_state
		end,

		check_custom_stage_event = function(this, e)
			if this.npc_controllers == nil then
				return
			end

			for i = 1, #this.npc_controllers do
				local npc_controller = this.npc_controllers[i]
				local info = npc_controller.save_info

				if info ~= nil and e:GetParamAt(0) == info.stage_event_key then
					this:clear_event(info)

					if npc_controller.clear_setting ~= nil then
						npc_controller:clear_setting()
					end

					break
				end
			end
		end,

		clear_event = function(this, info)
			local custom_state = this:get_custom_state(info.custom_state_key)

			end)
