		end,
		light_end = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_guiding_light_end')
		end,
		glitch_kid = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_glitch_kid')
		end,
		companion_trail = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_companion_trail')
		end,
	})

	-- 시온 대화 이벤트 봤는지 state 저장용 value
	self.sion_event_state_value = 8

	-- 스테이지를 종료했는지
	self.is_section_exit = false

	-- 섹션 이벤트
	self.section_event = setmetatable({
		event_controllers = nil,
		data_storage = nil,
		custom_state_key = 's10_save_state',
		custom_stage_event_key = 'stage_3_npc_setting',
		event_list = {
			{ path = 'Quest/Main/FireWorld/Main/SaveHuman.lua', clear_value = 1,
			  marker_key = 'main_quest', fo = self.characters.survivor(7) },
			{ path = 'Quest/Main/FireWorld/Main/SaveHarpy.lua', clear_value = 2,
			  marker_key = 'main_quest_2', fo = self.characters.harpy_kid_girl(2) },
			{ path = 'Quest/Main/FireWorld/Main/SaveFamily.lua', clear_value = 4,
			  marker_key = 'main_quest_3', fo = self.characters.family(1) },
		},
	}, {
		__index = {
			init_event = function(this, quest_id)
				if this.event_controllers == nil then
					this.event_controllers = {}
				end

				local storage_create = require('utils/QuestDataStorage')
				this.data_storage = storage_create.create(quest_id)

				local custom_state = this:get_custom_state()

				for num, info in ipairs(this.event_list) do
					--클리어 체크
					if (custom_state & info.clear_value) == 0 then
						local is_create, event_controller = global_table_util.try_create(info.path)

						if is_create then
							event_controller:init_controller(self, info.clear_value)
							table.insert(this.event_controllers, event_controller)
						end
					end
				end
			end,

			get_custom_state = function(this)
				local custom_state = this.data_storage:get_data(this.custom_state_key)

				return custom_state < 0 and 0 or custom_state
			end,

			clear_event = function(this, value)
				local custom_state = this:get_custom_state()

				custom_state = custom_state | value
				this.data_storage:set_data_async(this.custom_state_key, custom_state)

				-- 스테이지 컨트롤러에 이벤트 발송
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(get_party_leader(), { this.custom_stage_event_key }))

				if this:check_section_clear() then
					self:clear_section()
				end
			end,

			check_section_clear = function(this)
				if this.data_storage == nil then
					return
				end

				local custom_state = this:get_custom_state()

				for i = 1, #this.event_list do
					if (custom_state & this.event_list[i].clear_value) == 0 then
						return false
					end
				end

				return true
			end,

			active_marker = function(this)
				if this.data_storage == nil then
					return
				end

				local custom_state = this:get_custom_state()

				for i = 1, #this.event_list do
					if (custom_state & this.event_list[i].clear_value) == 0 then
						quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(this.event_list[i].marker_key, {
							{ zone = 'main_field', target = this.event_list[i].fo }
						})
					end
				end
			end,

			deactive_marker = function(this)
				for i = 1, #this.event_list do
					quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(this.event_list[i].marker_key)
				end
			end,

			dispose_event = function(this)
				for i = 1, #this.event_controllers do
					this.event_controllers[i] = nil
				end

				this.data_storage = nil
				this.event_controllers = nil
			end
		}
	})

end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:load_async()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	self:set_npc()
	self.section_event:init_event(self.cs_controller.QuestId)

	if (self.sion_event_state_value & self.section_event:get_custom_state()) ~= 0 then
		self.current_state = self.states.sion_talk
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self.section_event:active_marker()

	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			if self.section_event:check_section_clear() then
				local leader = get_party_leader()
				local princess = self.characters.princess()
				local dragon_boy = self.characters.dragon_boy()
				local fire_bishop = self.characters.fire_bishop()

				character_util.set_position(leader,
						field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_field_lava_reset_1') + vector(0, 0, -1))
				character_util.set_position(princess, leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 1))
				character_util.set_position(dragon_boy, leader.Position + vector(-1, 0, 1))
				character_util.set_position(fire_bishop, leader.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0))

				character_util.set_group_direction({ leader, princess }, 'left')
				character_util.set_group_direction({ dragon_boy, fire_bishop }, 'right')

				screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black)
				screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.6)

				self:clear_section()
			else
				local leader = get_party_leader()

				screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black)
				screen_util.fade_in_circular(1)

				character_util.set_position(leader, field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_field_lava_reset_1'))
				character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')

				stage_launch_util.directional_stage_entry(leader.Position, leader.Direction,
						game_string:GetString(stage.Name), false, false, true)

				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
			end
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.is_section_exit = true
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.characters.second_bishop())
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.characters.companion_boy())
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.characters.second_bishop(), self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.characters.companion_boy(), self.controller)

	self.section_event:deactive_marker()
	self.section_event:dispose_event()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end


function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'sion_talk_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.sion_talk
		sp_util.start_scene(self.sion_talk_scene, self)

		return true
	end
end

function local_class:set_npc()
	local second_bishop = self.characters.second_bishop()

	character_util.set_position(second_bishop, field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_s10_second_bishop_pos'))
	character_util.set_direction(second_bishop, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(second_bishop, self, 'sleep_deep')
	character_util.set_anim(second_bishop, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	field_object_util.set_active_state(second_bishop, active_state_type.enabled)

	second_bishop.Interactable.Talk = 'fw_main_s10_46'
end

function local_class:sion_talk_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.characters.princess()
	local dragon_boy = self.characters.dragon_boy()
	local fire_bishop = self.characters.fire_bishop()
	local companion_boy = self.characters.companion_boy()
	local camera_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sion_talk_camera_pos')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--카메라 연두 지점 중심으로 1초에 걸쳐 이동.
	camera_util.move(camera_pos, 1)
	--플레이어 일행 (up, idle, walk) 상태로 1초에 걸쳐 지정된 지점까지 이동.
	do
		local wp_key = 'leader_wp'
		local pivot = field_util.get_marker_pos('sion_talk_leader_pos')

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, pivot, nil,
				1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, pivot + vector(-1, 0, 0), nil,
				1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dragon_boy, pivot + vector(-1, 0, -1), nil,
				1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fire_bishop, pivot + vector(0, 0, -1), nil,
				1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	scene_util.set_direction(companion_boy, 'left', false)
	character_util.set_position(companion_boy, leader.Position + vector(7, 10, 0))
	scene_util.set_emotion(companion_boy, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(companion_boy, self, { name = 'jingak', loop = false })
	field_object_util.set_active_state(companion_boy, active_state_type.enabled)

	--아래 항목 동시에 실행.
	--플레이어 일행 (right, idle, idle) 실행
	--지정된 지점에 (fx_dv_guiding_light + fx_dv_guiding_light_contrail) 이 실행됨.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_light_turn_off_01')
	local blizzard_loop = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_04', loop = true, volume = 0.4 })
	local fx_light = self.fx.light():Instantiate(
			field_util.get_marker_pos('sion_talk_light_pos') + vector(0, 3, -1.5))
	local fx_light_contrail = self.fx.light_contrail():Instantiate(
			field_util.get_marker_pos('sion_talk_light_pos') + vector(0, 3, -1.5))
	local fx_companion_trail = self.fx.companion_trail():Instantiate(companion_boy.Position,
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, companion_boy.Transform)

	--꼬마공주 (right, idle, idle) : 응? 저건 뭐지?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s10_1')

	--플레이어 (right, idle, idle) 상태로 question 이모티콘 버블 출력.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'question')

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--아래 항목 0.5초에 걸쳐 동시에 실행.
	local fx_move = function(move_vec, duration)
		wait_all_lua(
				{
					pooled_object_util.move_async, fx_light, fx_light.transform.localPosition + move_vec, duration
				},
				{
					pooled_object_util.move_async, fx_light_contrail, fx_light_contrail.transform.localPosition + move_vec, duration
				},
				function()
					camera_pos = camera_pos + move_vec * 0.5

					camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, duration)
				end
		)
	end
	--빛 이펙트 0.5초에 걸쳐 1타일 좌측으로 이동.
	--카메라 0.5초에 걸쳐 0.5타일 좌측으로 이동.
	--플레이어 일행 (right, tired, idle) 실행 후 유지.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_cast_light_02')
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'tired' })
	fx_move(vector(-1, 0, 0), 0.5)

	--빛 이펙트 0.5초에 걸쳐 2타일 좌측으로 이동.
	--카메라 0.5초에 걸쳐 1타일 좌측으로 이동.
	--플레이어 일행 (right, attack, idle) 실행 후 유지.
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'attack' })
	fx_move(vector(-2, 0, 0), 0.5)

	--아래 항목 0.5초에 걸쳐 동시에 실행.
	--빛 이펙트 0.5초에 걸쳐 3타일 좌측으로 이동.
	--카메라 0.5초에 걸쳐 1.5타일 좌측으로 이동.
	--플레이어 일행 (right, scared, embarrassed) 실행 후 유지.
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'scared' })
	party_util.set_anim({ name = 'embarrassed' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	fx_move(vector(-3, 0, 0), 0.5)

	--아래 항목 0.5초에 걸쳐 동시에 실행.
	--빛 이펙트 0.5초에 걸쳐 2타일 좌측으로 이동.
	--카메라 0.5초에 걸쳐 1타일 좌측으로 이동.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_prologue_wind_01')
	character_util.move_to(companion_boy, leader.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 0.5)
	fx_move(vector(-2, 0, 0), 0.5)

	--빛 이펙트 마지막 위치에서 빛 이펙트에게 fx_dv_guiding_light_end 실행하여 제거 + 부착된 트레일 전부 제거.
	self.fx.light_end():Instantiate(fx_light.transform.localPosition)
	fx_companion_trail:Dispose()
	fx_light:Dispose()
	fx_light_contrail:Dispose()
	--시온 중심으로 Fx_lasthit 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_light_01')
	blizzard_loop:FadeOut()
	blizzard_loop = nil
	self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(companion_boy.Position)

	--환경음 루프 종료 동시에 BGM 볼륨 0.6 으로 재생
	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async(
			{ name = 'ondemand/v3_21_waterworld/audio:bgm_waterworld_blackhood', state = 'field' })
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0, 0)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--화면 0.3 / 0.3 shake 실행.
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
	--0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(companion_boy)
	--플레이어 일행 (right, tired, idle) 실행 후 유지.
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'tired' })
	party_util.remove_animation()
	--꼬마공주 (right, tired, idle) : 까, 깜짝이야… 갑자기 뭐야?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s10_2')

	--플레이어 선택지 출력
	do
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			--(mercy) 저 빛! 모토리산에서 봤어요!
			{ 'fw_main_s10_2_1', 'mercy' },
			--(forced) 와아! 조명 안시켰는데!
			{ 'fw_main_s10_3_1', 'forced' },
		})

		if choose_result == 1 then
			--플레이어 (left, attack, release 2회) 실행.
			scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
			scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
			--꼬마공주 (right, tired, idle) : 그래…? 난 기억이 안나는데…?
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'right',
					nil, 'tired', 'fw_main_s10_3')
		else
			--플레이어 (left, smile, cast2) 1초간 실행. 실행.
			scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cast2')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')

			wait_for_sec(1)

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
			--꼬마공주 (right, attack, idle) : 어어…? 그런 게 아닐 텐데…?
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'right',
					nil, 'attack', 'fw_main_s10_4')

	--꼬마공주(right, tired, idle) : 잠깐, 그게 중요한 게 아니잖아! 또 무슨 일이야 시온!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'right',
			nil, 'tired', 'fw_main_s10_5')

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()
	--시온 (left, attack, idle) : 너희는 이딴 거 신경쓸 필요 없어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(companion_boy, self, 'left',

	--꼬마공주 (left, tired, idle) : 네 말대로라면 여기 사람들 모두 용암에 덮쳐질 거야…

			nil, 'attack', 'fw_main_s10_11')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(companion_boy, self, 'left',
			nil, 'attack', 'fw_main_s10_12')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(companion_boy, self, 'left',
			nil, 'attack', 'fw_main_s10_13')

	--아래의 항목 동시에 실행.
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--시온 위치에 fx_dv_glitch_kid 이펙트가 실행되고, 가려지는 타이밍에 시온 제거.
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_05')

				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				character_util.set_position(companion_boy, vector(999, 0, 999))

				start_coroutine(self.fade_out_bgm, self, 2)
			end,
			function()
				character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)
				--꼬마공주 (left, attack, walk) : 너어! 또 알 수 없는 말로…!
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'right',
						nil, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'fw_main_s10_14')
			end
	)

	--꼬마공주 (left, tired, idle) : 사라졌어… 자기 멋대로…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'right',
			nil, 'tired', 'fw_main_s10_15')

	--꼬마 공주 silence 이모티콘 버블 출력 완료까지 대기.
	blizzard_loop = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_04', loop = true, volume = 0.4 })
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(princess, self, 'right',
			nil, 'tired', 'silence')

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	--꼬마공주 (right, tired, idle) : $name…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'right',

local local_class = newclass('FireWorldMainSection11')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @

		Comment = 라크리마와의 대화 후 화신의 표식을 새김 @
		Index = 10 @
		NextSections = 11 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type FireWorldMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'fireworld_3'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		npc_setting = 1,
		before_interact = 2,
		second_bishop_interact_scene = 3,
		companion_boy_scene = 4,
		companion_boy_interact_scene = 5,
		exit_scene = 6,
		done = 999
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.npc_setting

	-- 위치 기준 값
	self.pivot_pos = {
		s11_pivot_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s11_second_bishop_pos_1')
		end,
		exit = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s11_exit_event_pivot_pos')
		end,

		spec = {

			dragon_boy = 'dragon_boy',

			fire_bishop = 'fire_bishop',

			second_bishop = 'second_bishop',
			--시온
			companion_boy = 'companion_boy',
		}
	}, {
		__index = function(this, key)
			return get_character(this.spec[key])
		end
	})

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		second_bishop_emblem = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fw_second_bishop_emblem')
		end,
		glitch_kid = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_glitch_kid')
		end,
	})

	self.quest_marker = {
		key = 'main_quest',
		add = function(this, data)
			quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(this.key, data)
		end,
		remove = function(this)
			quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(this.key)
		end
	}
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(function()
		self.fx:create_all()
		self:set_npc_presets_for_state()
		self:set_npc_with_data(self.npc_presets[self.current_state])
		self.current_state = self.states.before_interact

		self.quest_marker:add({
			{
				zone = 'main_field',
				target = self.character.second_bishop
			}
		})
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local companion_boy = self.character.companion_boy
	local second_bishop = self.character.second_bishop

	if self.current_state == self.states.before_interact then
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, second_bishop) then
			self.current_state = self.states.second_bishop_interact_scene

			start_coroutine(function()
				sp_util.enter_scene()

				self.quest_marker:remove()

				self:second_bishop_interact_scene()

				self:companion_boy_scene()

				self.current_state = self.states.companion_boy_scene

				self:companion_boy_interact_scene()

				self.current_state = self.states.exit_scene

				self.quest_marker:add({
					{
						zone = 'main_field',
						target = self.pivot_pos.exit()
					}
				})

				sp_util.exit_scene(nil, user_party.Leader)

			end)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	if self.current_state == self.states.exit_scene and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's11_stage_exit_event_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.done

		sp_util.start_scene(self.stage_exit_scene, self)
	end
end

	self.npc_presets = {

			},
		},

function local_class:set_npc_with_data(data)
	for i = 1, #data do
		local npc_preset = data[i]

		local npc
		if npc_preset.type == 'static' then
			if npc_preset.name == 'leader' then
				npc = user_party.Leader
			else
				npc = get_character(npc_preset.name)
			end
		else
			npc = self.controller.dynamic_npcs:get(npc_preset.name)
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)

		if data[i].pos ~= nil then
			character_util.set_position(npc, data[i].pos)
		end

		if data[i].dir ~= nil then
			character_util.set_direction(npc, data[i].dir)
		end

		if data[i].emo ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, data[i].emo)
		end

		if data[i].anim ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = data[i].anim, one_shot_sfx = false })
		end

		if data[i].talk ~= nil then
			npc.Interactable.Talk = data[i].talk
		end

		if data[i].active ~= nil then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, data[i].active)
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)
		end

		if data[i].alpha ~= nil then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, data[i].alpha)
		end

		if data[i].add_listener ~= nil then
			character_util.add_lua_listener(npc, self)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:stage_exit_scene()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local princess = self.character.princess
	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy
	local fire_bishop = self.character.fire_bishop

	local pivot_pos = self.pivot_pos.exit()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--통로 직전 트리거 존 진입 시 이벤트 시작,
	local party_wp = {
		[leader] = {
			pivot_pos,
		},
		[princess] = {
			pivot_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0),
		},
		[dragon_boy] = {
			pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, -1),
		},
		[fire_bishop] = {
			pivot_pos + vector(-1, 0, -1),
		}
	}

	--플레이어 일행 (right, idle, walk) 상태로 지정된 위치에 1초에 걸쳐 이동 후 idle 전환.
	for fo, wp in pairs(party_wp) do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fo, wp, nil, 1, self, nil,
				{ run = false, last_direction = 'right' })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

	--비슈바크 (right, smile, idle) : 좋아. 이제 다음은 칼로르겠네.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'right',
			nil, 'smile', 'fw_main_s11_114')

	--기르가스 (right, damaged, idle) : 으으… 그 변태 이모도 만나야 하구나…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'right',
			nil, 'damaged', 'fw_main_s11_115')

	--비슈바크 (right, tired, idle) : 뭐, 그 녀석. 그렇게 보여도 첫번째 화신이니까.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'right',
			nil, 'tired', 'fw_main_s11_116')

	--기르가스 (right, smile, cast2) : 상관없어! 난 용염 축제만 참가하면 되니까!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'right',
			'cast2', 'smile', 'fw_main_s11_117')

	--기르가스 (right, attack, jump 1회) : 얼른 가자고! 빨리!!
	character_util.normal_jump(dragon_boy, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'right',
			nil, 'attack', 'fw_main_s11_118')

	--이후 기르가스 (right, attack, run) 상태로 1초에 걸쳐 우측 엑시트를 통해 나가면서 제거.
	scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'attack')

	local exit_pivot_pos = pivot_pos + vector(3, 0, 0)
	local wp = {
		exit_pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, -1),
		exit_pivot_pos + vector(2, 0, -1)
	}

	wp_util.move_async(dragon_boy, wp, nil, 1,
			{ run = true, play_sfx = true, callback = function(wp_index)
				if wp_index == 0 then

					character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(dragon_boy, 0, 0.5)
				end
			end })

	--비슈바크 (right, attack, jump 1회) : 야! 아우 진짜! 같이 가 이놈아!!
	character_util.normal_jump(fire_bishop, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'right',
			nil, 'attack', 'fw_main_s11_119')

	--아래의 항목 동시에 실행.

	--남은 플레이어 일행 (right, attack, run) 상태로 1초에 걸쳐 우측 엑시트를 통해 나가면서 제거.
	local party_wp = {
		[leader] = {
			exit_pivot_pos,
			exit_pivot_pos + vector(2, 0, 0),
		},
		[princess] = {
			exit_pivot_pos,
			exit_pivot_pos + vector(2, 0, 0),
		},
		[fire_bishop] = {
			exit_pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, -1),
			exit_pivot_pos + vector(2, 0, -1),
		},
	}

	--플레이어 일행 (right, idle, walk) 상태로 지정된 위치에 1초에 걸쳐 이동 후 idle 전환.
	for fo, wp in pairs(party_wp) do
		scene_util.set_emotion(fo, self, 'attack')

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fo, wp, 5, nil, self, nil,
				{ run = true, play_sfx = true, callback = function(wp_index)
					if wp_index == 0 then

						character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(fo, 0, 0.5)
					end
				end })
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1 })

	--1초에 걸쳐 화면 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	self.controller:progress_section()

	--3스테이지 종료.
	CS.Oak.TeleportPartyStageLogic.Execute('exit_fireworld_3', 'fireworld_4', nil, true)
end

return local_class

function local_class:set_current_scene_npc()
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[self.current_state]

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	linq(pre_npc_data):foreach(function(_, npc_data)
		local npc = get_character(npc_data.name)

		if npc == nil then
			if npc_data.name == 'leader' then
				npc = user_party.Leader
			else
				return
			end
		end

		if npc_data.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_data.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		npc_data.active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_data.active_state)

		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_data.anim, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.keep_shake ~= nil and npc_data.keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if npc_data.tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc_data.tint_color_key, npc_data.tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if npc_data.interaction then
			npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
		end

		if npc_data.string ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.string) then
			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_data.string
		end

		if npc_data.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_data.talk_sfx
		end

		if npc_data.weapon_1_id then
			character_util.set_equipment(npc, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1,
					npc_data.weapon_1_id, true)
		end

		if npc_data.weapon_2_id then
			character_util.set_equipment(npc, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2,
					npc_data.weapon_2_id, true)
		end

		if npc_data.show_weapon then
			scene_util.show_weapon(npc)
		end

		if npc_data.hitbox ~= nil then
			npc.Hitbox = npc_data.hitbox
		end
	end)
end

function local_class:first_event()
	local knight = self.character.knight()
	local princess = self.character.princess()
	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy()
	local fire_bishop = self.character.fire_bishop()

	local believer_1 = self.character.believer(1)
	local believer_2 = self.character.believer(2)

	local party_align_pivot = self.marker.party_align_pivot(1, 1)

	self.quest_marker:remove()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--존 진입 시 플레이어 일행 (right, idle, walk) 상태로 지정된 위치에 1초에 걸쳐 이동 후 idle 정렬.
	do
		local wp_key = 'party_align'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, party_align_pivot + vector(0.5, 0, 0.5),
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, party_align_pivot + vector(-0.5, 0, 0.5),
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dragon_boy, party_align_pivot + vector(0.5, 0, -0.5),
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fire_bishop, party_align_pivot + vector(-0.5, 0, -0.5),
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--용신도 2 (left, idle, cast) : 기르가스. 염룡왕님의 아들이자. 자격을 갖추지 않은 채 화산을 벗어난 이탈자.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(believer_1, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'cast', keep = true }, nil, 'fw_main_s12_1_1_1')

	--용신도 1 (left, idle, cast) : 오늘은 염룡의 불꽃이 세상으로 퍼져나와…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(believer_1, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'cast', keep = true }, nil, 'fw_main_s12_1_1')

	--용신도 2 (left, idle, cast) : 볼베르 화산을 채우는 위대한 날.

			return this.container
		end,

		dispose = function(this)

		end,
	}

			group_name = 'first_villager',
			specs = {

				villager_4 = 'fw_nm_fd_player_male',
			},

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	--[그리드 진입 / 퇴장으로 스크린 이펙트 출력]
	--유황 연기 스크린 이펙트(fx_fw_brimstone_smoke_screen_start) 가 해당 그리드 진입 시 출력.
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 's13_introduce_village_grid') then
		self:start_smoke_screen()

		return true
	end

	return false

	--유황 연기 종료 이펙트 (fx_fw_brimstone_smoke_screen_end) 가 해당 그리드 이탈 시 출력.
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 's13_introduce_village_grid') then
		self:end_smoke_screen()

		return true
	end

	return false

	if self.current_state == self.states.before_introduce_village and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.character.knight(), 's13_introduce_village') then

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			self:introduce_village_scene()

			self.controller:progress_section()
		end)

		return true
	end

	local stats_behaviour = fo.CharacterStatsBehaviour

		local portrait_asset_name = stats_behaviour.CharacterSpec.PortraitAssetName.assetName
		if portrait_asset_name ~= nil and portrait_asset_name ~= '' then
			return portrait_asset_name
		end

	return nil
end

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

		--기르가스 (left, idle, idle) : 응? 너희 예전에는 어딜 다녀온 건데?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'left',

		--비슈바크 (left, sleep_deep, nod 2회) : 너희도 참 고생이 많네! 나도 이놈 찾으러…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',

	--기르가스 (left, attack, shoot) : 어이 부하들! 이제 움직일 수 있지? 나 용염축제 참가 신청해야 한다고!

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'right',

local local_class = newclass('FireWorldMainSection14')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FireWorldMain @
		Comment = 칼로르 조우 이벤트 @
		Index = 13 @
		NextSections = 14 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type FireWorldMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'fireworld_4'

	--섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		before_loaded = 1,
		before_meet_first_bishop = 2,
		in_meet_first_bishop = 3,
		done = 99,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_loaded

	self.character = {
		knight = function()
			return get_party_leader()
		end,
		princess = function()
			return get_character('princess')
		end,
		dragon_boy = function()
			return get_character('dragon_boy')
		end,
		fire_bishop = function()
			return get_character('fire_bishop')
		end,
		first_bishop = function()
			return get_character('first_bishop')
		end,
	}

	self.marker = {
		meet_first_bishop_pivot = function(idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s14_meet_first_bishop_pivot_' .. idx)
		end,
		first_bishop_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s14_first_bishop_pos')
		end,
		boat_cam_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s14_boat_cam_pos')
		end,
	}

	local dynamic_npc_helper = {
		container = nil,
		group_name = nil,
		specs = nil,

		get = function(this, name)
			return this.container[name]
		end,

		load_async = function(this)
			if this.container == nil then
				this.container = {}
			end

			this.container = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_with_prefix_async(this.group_name, this.specs)

			return this.container
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			if this.container == nil then
				return
			end

			load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(this.container)

			this.container = nil
		end,
	}

	self.dynamic_npcs = metatable_helper.inherit({
		player = metatable_helper.inherit({
			group_name = 'player',
			specs = {
				fd_1 = 'fw_nm_fd_player_male',
				fd_2 = 'fw_nm_fd_player_male',
				fd_3 = 'fw_nm_fd_player_female',
				fd_4 = 'fw_nm_fd_player_female',
			},
		}, dynamic_npc_helper),

		companion = metatable_helper.inherit({
			group_name = 'companion',
			specs = {
				boy = 'fw_companion_boy',
			},
		}, dynamic_npc_helper),

	}, {
		dispose = function(this)
			for key, value in pairs(this) do
				value:dispose()
			end
		end,
	})

	self.fx = {
		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,
		glitch_adult = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_ww_glitch_adult')
		end,
		glitch_kid = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_glitch_kid')
		end,
	}

	self.quest_marker_key = 'main_quest'
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self:start_setting()

	self.current_state = self.states.before_meet_first_bishop
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.current_state = self.states.done

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(self.quest_marker_key)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_meet_first_bishop and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.character.knight(), 's14_first_bishop') then
		self.current_state = self.states.in_meet_first_bishop

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			self:enter_fire_bishop_scene()
			self:first_bishop_scene()

			self.controller:progress_section()

			self.current_state = self.states.done
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:start_setting()
	local first_bishop = self.character.first_bishop()
	local first_bishop_pos = self.marker.first_bishop_pos()

	--칼로르 : fw_first_bishop (down, smile, sleep)
	character_util.set_position(first_bishop, first_bishop_pos)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(first_bishop, active_state_type.enabled)
	scene_util.set_direction(first_bishop, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(first_bishop, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(first_bishop, self, 'sleep')

	--14섹션 이벤트에서 사용되는 칼로르의 머리 위로 메인 퀘스트 마커 출력.
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(self.quest_marker_key, {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = first_bishop }
	})
end

function local_class:enter_fire_bishop_scene()
	self.dynamic_npcs.player:load_async()
	metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor(self.fx):load_async()

	do
		--NPC 1 : fw_nm_fd_player_male (left, attack, cast2)
		--NPC 2 : fw_nm_fd_player_male (left, attack, release)
		--NPC 3 : fw_nm_fd_player_female (right, attack, cast)
		--NPC 4 : fw_nm_fd_player_female (right, attack, jingak)

		local fd_player_1 = self.dynamic_npcs.player:get('fd_1')
		local fd_player_2 = self.dynamic_npcs.player:get('fd_2')
		local fd_player_3 = self.dynamic_npcs.player:get('fd_3')
		local fd_player_4 = self.dynamic_npcs.player:get('fd_4')

		local players_pivot = self.marker.meet_first_bishop_pivot(2)

		--NPC 1 : fw_nm_fd_player_male (left, attack, cast2)
		character_util.set_position(fd_player_1, players_pivot + vector(3.5, 0, 1.5))
		scene_util.set_direction(fd_player_1, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(fd_player_1, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(fd_player_1, self, 'cast2')

		--NPC 2 : fw_nm_fd_player_male (left, attack, release)
		character_util.set_position(fd_player_2, players_pivot + vector(3.5, 0, 0.5))
		scene_util.set_direction(fd_player_2, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(fd_player_2, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(fd_player_2, self, { name = 'release', sfx_name = false })

		--NPC 3 : fw_nm_fd_player_female (right, attack, cast)
		character_util.set_position(fd_player_3, players_pivot + vector(-3.5, 0, 1.5))
		scene_util.set_direction(fd_player_3, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(fd_player_3, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(fd_player_3, self, 'cast')

		--NPC 4 : fw_nm_fd_player_female (right, attack, jingak)
		character_util.set_position(fd_player_4, players_pivot + vector(-3.5, 0, 0.5))
		scene_util.set_direction(fd_player_4, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(fd_player_4, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(fd_player_4, self, { name = 'jingak', loop = true })

function local_class:first_bishop_scene()
	local knight = self.character.knight()
	local princess = self.character.princess()
	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy()
	local fire_bishop = self.character.fire_bishop()
	local first_bishop = self.character.first_bishop()

	local fd_player_1 = self.dynamic_npcs.player:get('fd_1')
	local fd_player_2 = self.dynamic_npcs.player:get('fd_2')
	local fd_player_3 = self.dynamic_npcs.player:get('fd_3')
	local fd_player_4 = self.dynamic_npcs.player:get('fd_4')

	local companion_boy

	local first_pivot = self.marker.meet_first_bishop_pivot(1)
	local players_pivot = self.marker.meet_first_bishop_pivot(2)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1 })

	--[트리거 존 진입 시 진행]
	do
		--존 진입 시 플레이어 일행 (up, idle, walk) 상태로 지정된 위치까지 1초에 걸쳐 이동 후 idle 정렬.
		local fos = {
			knight,
			princess,
			dragon_boy,
			fire_bishop

			first_pivot,
			first_pivot + unity_class.vector3.left,
			first_pivot + unity_class.vector3.forward,
			first_pivot + unity_class.vector3.right
		}

		for i = 1, #fos do
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fos[i], destinations[i], nil,
					1, self, nil,
					{ locked_dir = direction_constants.up })
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	end

	--화면 0.3 / 0.3 shake 실행.
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(dragon_boy, true)
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s14_1')

	self.custom_stage_key = 's15_sub_quest_clear'

	return self:check_section_quest()
end

	if e:GetParamAt(0) == self.custom_stage_key then
		start_coroutine(self.check_section_clear, self)
		return true
	end

	if not self:check_section_quest() then
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
		return
	end

	self.controller:progress_section()
end

function local_class:check_section_quest()
	for i, quest_id in ipairs(self.section_quest_list) do
		local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(quest_id)

		-- 미클리어한 퀘스트가 존재하면 컨트롤 풀어줌
		if (quest_progress == nil or not quest_progress.IsComplete) then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

return local_class

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false

end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's17_event_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.zone_enter
		start_coroutine(self.boss_battle_intro_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion event

function local_class:setting_npc()
	local first_bishop = self.characters.first_bishop()

	field_object_util.set_active_state(first_bishop, active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.set_position(first_bishop, self.markers.first_bishop_pos(1))
	character_util.set_direction(first_bishop, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion(first_bishop, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(first_bishop, self, { name = 'cast2', one_shot_sfx = false })
end

function local_class:boss_battle_intro_scene()
	sp_util.enter_scene()

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.characters.princess()
	local dragon_boy = self.characters.dragon_boy()
	local fire_bishop = self.characters.fire_bishop()
	local first_bishop = self.characters.first_bishop()
	local first_bishop_myth = self.characters.first_bishop_myth()

	for i = 0, 1 do
		local boat = get_field_object('s12_boat_' .. i)
		message_system:SendSync(boat.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--플레이어 일행 (up, idle, walk) 로 지정된 위치까지 이동 후 idle로 정렬.
	do
		local wp_key = 'leader_wp'
		local pivot = self.markers.leader_pos()

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, pivot, nil,
				1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'up' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, pivot + vector(-1, 0, 0), nil,
				1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'up' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dragon_boy, pivot + vector(0, 0, 1), nil,
				1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'up' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fire_bishop, pivot + vector(1, 0, 0), nil,
				1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'up' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--화면 0.3 / 0.3 shake 실행.
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

	--칼로르 : [shout] 드디어 왔구나! 조카!
	--위치 x 0.5 / y 0.8
	--크기 1.5배
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(first_bishop, 'fw_main_s17_1',
			true, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.8), scale = 1.5 })

	--0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--카메라 5의 크기로 1초에 걸쳐 줌 아웃.
	local fire_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fire_05', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2 })
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 1)
	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 칼로르 중심으로 이동.
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(first_bishop, 1)

	--칼로르 (left, smile, cast2) : 역시 내 조카야! 충분히 올 줄 알았다니까!

	--칼로르 (left, smile, idle) : 이 이모가 얼마나 기다리고 있었는지 알아?!

	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(first_bishop, 'fw_main_s17_3')

	--기르가스 : 으엑. 징그러워 이모!

			true, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })

	--칼로르 (down, smile, cast2) : 본론으로 들어가자!!

			'cast2', 'smile', 'fw_main_s17_7')

	--칼로르 (down, smile, idle) : 우선. 모든 순례길을 돌아 이 자리에 도착한 기르가스!

			nil, 'smile', 'fw_main_s17_8')

	--칼로르 (down, smile, idle) : 너는 자랑스러운 염룡왕의 후예로서, 한 마리의 염룡으로서 세상에 자유롭게 나갈 준비가 되었음을 확인하였다.

	--위치 x 0.5 / y 0.8
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(first_bishop, 'fw_main_s17_23', true,
			{ viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.8) })

	--기르가스 (up, idle, cast) : 이모! 난 지금 당장 엄마를 만나야겠어!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'up',

	--기르가스 (up, idle, cast) : 엄마를 만나서… 그 앞에서까지도 당당하게 가출해서…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'up',
			'cast', nil, 'fw_main_s17_25')

	-- 화면 0.3 / 0.3 shake 실행.
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

	--기르가스 (up, idle, shoot) : [shout] 난 누구의 방해도 받지 않고 살 거야!!!

	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'up',
			'shoot', nil, 'fw_main_s17_26')

	--2초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--비슈바크 (up, idle, idle) : 칼로르. 기르가스의 도전이다. 받아주겠지?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s17_27')

	--플레이어 선택지 출력
	do
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			--[mercy] 덤벼라 칼로르!
			{ 'fw_main_s17_28', 'mercy' },
			--[forced] 여긴 4명이라고! 덤벼!!
			{ 'fw_main_s17_30', 'forced' }
		})

		if choose_result == 1 then
			--플레이어 (up, idle, jingak 1회) 실행.
			scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up', false)
			scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'jingak', count = 1, sfx_name = '01_jingak_01' })

			--꼬마공주 (up, idle, jump 1회) : 더, 덤벼라!
			character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'up',
					nil, nil, 'fw_main_s17_29')
		else
			--플레이어 (up, idle, cast2) 를 1.5초간 실행.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
			scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self, 'up', 'cast2', nil, 1.5)

			--꼬마공주 (up, idle, jump 1회) : 마, 맞아! 우리가 더 유리해!!

	--칼로르 : [shout] 하하하하하하하하!!!

local local_class = newclass('FireWorldMainSection19')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @

		Comment = 문을 열고 들어감@
		Index = 18 @
		NextSections = 19 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)

	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection

	self.available_stage_names = 'fireworld_4'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		section_end = 2
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	-- 섹션 종료 체크용
	self.is_section_exit = false

	self.characters = {
		-- 꼬마공주

		end,

		end,

		end,

			return get_character('companion_girl')
		end
	}

		end
	}

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:load_async()
end

function local_class:enter()
	self:setting_npc()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point('main_quest', self.cs_controller.QuestId,
			true, self.markers.leader_pos() + vector(0.5, 0, 2))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	quest_marker_util.remove('main_quest')

	self.is_section_exit = true

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.characters.first_bishop())
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.characters.companion_boy())
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.characters.first_bishop(), self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.characters.companion_boy(), self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:setting_npc()
	local first_bishop = self.characters.first_bishop()

	field_object_util.set_active_state(first_bishop, active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.set_position(first_bishop, field_util.get_marker_pos('s18_first_bishop_pos_2'))
	character_util.set_direction(first_bishop, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(first_bishop, self, 'smile')
	character_util.remove_anim(first_bishop)
	first_bishop.Interactable.Talk = 'fw_main_s19_27'
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's19_event_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.section_end
		sp_util.start_scene(self.section_end_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion event

function local_class:section_end_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.characters.princess()
	local dragon_boy = self.characters.dragon_boy()
	local fire_bishop = self.characters.fire_bishop()
	local companion_boy = self.characters.companion_boy()
	local companion_girl = self.characters.companion_girl()
	local companion_boy_pos = self.markers.leader_pos() + vector(0.5, 0, 4.5)

	--플레이어 일행 지정된 위치를 향해 (up, idle, walk) 상태로 1초에 걸쳐 이동한 후, 플레이어 꼬공 right, 기르가스 비슈바크 left 바라보도록 설정.
	--아래의 항목 동시에 실행.
	do
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

		local camera_pos = self.markers.leader_pos() + vector(0.5, 0, 4)

		--카메라 연두 중심으로 1초에 걸쳐 패닝.
		camera_util.move(camera_pos, 1)

		--플레이어 일행 지정된 지점까지 1초에 걸쳐 (up, idle, walk) 로 이동한 후 idle 전환.
		local wp_key = 'party_wp'
		local pivot = self.markers.leader_pos() + vector(0, 0, 3)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, pivot, nil,
				1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, pivot + vector(-1, 0, 0), nil,
				1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dragon_boy, pivot + vector(1, 0, 0), nil,
				1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fire_bishop, pivot + vector(2, 0, 0), nil,
				1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--꼬마공주 (right. smile, idle) : 좋아! 이제 전부 다 끝난 거지?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, nil,
			nil, 'smile', 'fw_main_s19_28')

	--비슈바크 (left, smile, cast2) : 그렇지. 화신 둘의 인정을 받았으니까. 이제 내 인정만 받으면 돼!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
			'cast2', 'smile', 'fw_main_s19_29')

	--기르가스 (right, smile, cast2) : 그래! 그럼 얼른 날 인정해!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'right',
			'cast2', 'smile', 'fw_main_s19_30')

	--비슈바크 (left, smile, idle) : 기다려 봐 이녀석아. 순서라는 게 있잖아!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
			'idle', 'smile', 'fw_main_s19_31')

	--아래 항목 동시에 실행
	--기르가스 (right, attack, cast2) : 순서는 뭔…!
	scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(dragon_boy, self, 'cast2')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(dragon_boy, { key = 'fw_main_s19_32', force_sfx = true, portraitname = 'dragon_boy' })

	--기르가스 스파인 위로 fx_fw_fire_bishop_emblem 이펙트가 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_demongovernor_cast_01')
	self.fx.fire_bishop_emblem():Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(dragon_boy.Position, 0.1))
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	-- 인장 이펙트 완료까지 대기. 완료된 후 실행되던 대사 종료하고 곧바로 다음 이벤트로 진행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_dark_projectile_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.45)

	--기르가스 (right, damaged, embarrassed, jump 2회)실행
	scene_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(dragon_boy, self, 'embarrassed')
	character_util.normal_double_jump(dragon_boy, true)

	--기르가스 (right, mad, release 2회) : 또 이모까지! 뜨거워 죽겠네 진짜!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'mad', 'fw_main_s19_59')

	--비슈바크 (left, idle, cast2) : 뭘 그래! 이제 익숙해졌잖아!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
			'cast2', nil, 'fw_main_s19_60')

	--비슈바크 (up, idle, idle) : 이제 세 화신의 인정을 모두 받았으니…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s19_61')

	--아래의 항목 동시에 실행.
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--카메라 2초에 걸쳐 연두 지점 중심으로 이동.
				local camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(0, 0, 4)

				camera_util.move(camera_pos, 2)
			end,
			function()
				--플레이어 일행 (up, idle, walk) 상태로 지정 위치까지 2초에 걸쳐 이동.
				local wp_key = 'party_wp'
				local pivot = self.markers.leader_pos() + vector(0.5, 0, 4)

				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, pivot, nil,
						2, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'up', locked_dir = 'up' })
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, pivot + vector(-1, 0, 0), nil,
						2, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'up', locked_dir = 'up' })
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dragon_boy, pivot + vector(0, 0, 1), nil,
						2, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'up', locked_dir = 'up' })
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fire_bishop, pivot + vector(1, 0, 0), nil,
						2, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'up', locked_dir = 'up' })

				wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
			end
	)

	--비슈바크 (up, idle, idle) : 염룡왕님이 계신 장소까지 갈 수 있을 거야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s19_62')

	--플레이어, 꼬마공주 right / 기르가스 비슈바크 left 바라봄.
	character_util.set_group_direction({ leader, princess }, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'down')
	scene_util.set_direction(fire_bishop, 'left')
	--비슈바크 (left, idle, idle) : 다들… 마지막까지 함께할 거지?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s19_63')

	--꼬마공주 (right, idle, idle) : 물론이지!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s19_64')

	--플레이어 선택지 출력.
	do
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			--(mercy) 볼베르 화산의 폭발을 막기 위해!
			{ 'fw_main_s19_65', 'mercy' },
			--(forced) 기르가스 가출을 위해!
			{ 'fw_main_s19_68', 'forced' },
		})

		if choose_result == 1 then
			--플레이어 (right, smile, victory_get) 실행.
			scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self, 'right',
					'victory_get', 'smile', 1.5)

			--비슈바크 (left, smile, clap) : 좋아! 마음가짐이 아주 훌륭해!
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
					'clap', 'smile', 'fw_main_s19_66')

			--기르가스 (down, attack, shoot) : 거기에 내 가출까지! 잊지 마!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'down',
					'shoot', 'attack', 'fw_main_s19_67')
		else
			--플레이어 (right, doyagao, cross_arm) 1초간 실행.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
			scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self, 'right',
					{ name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false }, 'doyagao', 1)

			--기르가스 (down, smile, clap) : 하! 역시 내 부하답구나! 훌륭해!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'down',
					'clap', 'smile', 'fw_main_s19_69')

			--비슈바크 (left, tired, idle) : 후우… 그래도 뭐 같이 가는 건 맞으니까.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
					nil, 'tired', 'fw_main_s19_70')
		end
	end

	--플레이어 일행 전체 (up, idle, idle 전환)
	party_util.set_direction('up')

	--비슈바크 (up, idle, idle) : 좋아, 그럼……!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s19_71')

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--문양 1 ~ 3번 위치에 각각 아래의 이펙트가 출력.
	--1번 fx_fw_first_bishop_emblem
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_demongovernor_cast_01')
	self.fx.first_bishop_emblem():Instantiate(dragon_boy.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 2))
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_dark_projectile_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--2번 fx_fw_second_bishop_emblem
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_demongovernor_cast_01')
	self.fx.second_bishop_emblem():Instantiate(dragon_boy.Position + vector(0, 0, 2))
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_dark_projectile_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--3번 fx_fw_second_bishop_emblem
	--1초 대기.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_demongovernor_cast_01')
	self.fx.fire_bishop_emblem():Instantiate(dragon_boy.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 2))
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_dark_projectile_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	--상단의 wall_lava_temple 오브젝트의 wall_lava_temple_open 애니메이션을 실행.

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gate_open_02')

	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(6.4)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gate_open_01')

		wait_for_sec(1.1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_door_02')
	end)

	animator_util.play_async(self.fo.door(), 'open')

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--화면 0.3 / 0.3 shake 실행.

	--비슈바크 (up, idle, jump 1회) : [shout] 가자!!!
	--크기 1.5배
	--위치 x 0.5 / y 0.7
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(fire_bishop, true)
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'up',
			nil, nil,
			{ key = 'fw_main_s19_72', skip = true, scale = 1.5, viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.7) })

	--아래의 항목 동시에 실행.
	do
		--플레이어 일행 (up, idle, run) 상태로 2초에 걸쳐 신전 문 안쪽으로 이동.
		wp_util.move(leader, leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 9),
				nil, 3, { run = true, play_sfx = true })
		wp_util.move(princess, princess.Position + vector(0, 0, 9),
				nil, 3, { run = true })
		wp_util.move(dragon_boy, dragon_boy.Position + vector(0, 0, 9),
				nil, 3, { run = true })
		wp_util.move(fire_bishop, fire_bishop.Position + vector(0, 0, 9),
				nil, 3, { run = true })
	end

	--이탈 완료 후 4초간 대기.
	wait_for_sec(4)

	--아래 항목 동시에 실행.
	--카메라 시온 중심으로 1초에 걸쳐 이동.
	camera_util.move(companion_boy_pos, 1)

	--시온 지점에 fx_dv_glitch_kid 이펙트가 실행되고, 가려지는 시점에 시온이 (up, idle, idle) 로 생성.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_05')
	self.fx.glitch_kid():Instantiate(companion_boy_pos)

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(companion_boy, self, 'down',

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type FireWorldMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	self.available_stage_names = 'fireworld_1'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		npc_setting = 1,
		eco_speech_event = 2,
		steam_princess_zone_event = 3,
		done = 999
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.npc_setting

	-- 위치 기준 값
	self.pivot_pos = {
		s2_pivot_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_pivot_pos_1')
		end,
	}

	-- npc
	self.character = setmetatable({
		spec = {
			princess = 'princess',
			-- 기르가스
			dragon_boy = 'dragon_boy',
			-- 아이샤
			steam_princess = 'steam_princess',
			-- 샤피라
			steam_knight = 'steam_knight',
		}
	}, {
		__index = function(this, key)
			return get_character(this.spec[key])
		end
	})

	self.oneline_npc = {
		human_prefix = 'human_oneline_npc_',
		human_count = 4,

		harpy_prefix = 'harpy_oneline_npc_',
		harpy_count = 4,

		---@param this self
		get_human = function(this, index)
			return get_character(this.human_prefix .. index)
		end,

		---@param this self
		get_harpy = function(this, index)
			return get_character(this.harpy_prefix .. index)
		end,

		---@param this self
		---@param action "function(index, npc) end"
		foreach = function(this, action)
			this:foreach_human(action)
			this:foreach_harpy(action)
		end,
		---@param this self
		---@param action "function(index, npc) end"
		foreach_human = function(this, action)
			for i = 1, this.human_count do
				action(i, this:get_human(i))
			end
		end,

		foreach_harpy = function(this, action)
			for i = 1, this.spirit_count do
				action(i, this:get_harpy(i))
			end
		end,
	}
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	if self.current_state == self.states.eco_speech_event and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's2_eco_enter_event_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.steam_princess_zone_event

		start_coroutine(self.eco_speech_routine, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.steam_princess_zone_event and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's2_steam_princess_event_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.done

		quest_marker_util.remove('main_quest')

		sp_util.start_scene(self.steam_princess_zone_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_npc_with_data(data)
	for i = 1, #data do
		local npc_preset = data[i]

		local npc
		if npc_preset.type == 'static' then
			if npc_preset.name == 'leader' then
				npc = get_party_leader()
			else
				npc = get_character(npc_preset.name)
			end
		else
			npc = self.controller.dynamic_npcs:get(npc_preset.name)
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)

		if data[i].pos ~= nil then
			character_util.set_position(npc, data[i].pos)
		end

		if data[i].dir ~= nil then
			character_util.set_direction(npc, data[i].dir)
		end

		if data[i].emo ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, data[i].emo)
		end

		if data[i].anim ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = data[i].anim, one_shot_sfx = false, sfx_name = false })
		end

		if data[i].talk ~= nil then
			npc.Interactable.Talk = data[i].talk
		end

		if data[i].active ~= nil then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, data[i].active)
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)
		end

		if data[i].is_force_update ~= nil then
			character_util.force_update_spines(npc, 3)
		end

		if data[i].talk_sfx ~= nil then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = data[i].talk_sfx
		end
	end
end

function local_class:eco_speech_routine()
	local wait_sec = function(duration)
		local time_passed = 0

		while not self.controller.stage_end_flag and
				self.current_state == self.states.steam_princess_zone_event do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if time_passed > duration then
				return false
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		return true
	end


	--(화면비) x : 0.2 / y :  0.2
	--말풍선 스케일 1.2배
	--인간2 (남) : [shout] 우릴 막을 생각 말라고!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.oneline_npc:get_human(2), {
		key = 'fw_main_s2_eco_1',
		bubble_direction = 'none',
		bubble_type = 'shout',
		viewport_pos = vector(0.2, 0.2),
		scale = 1.2,
		skip = false,
	})

	if wait_sec(1.8) then
		return
	end

	--말풍선 출력
	--(화면비) x : 0.8 / y :  0.2z
	--말풍선 스케일 1.2배
	--정령1 (남) : [shout] 조약을 어디고 어딜 가려는거야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.oneline_npc:get_harpy(1), {
		key = 'fw_main_s2_eco_2',
		bubble_direction = 'none',
		bubble_type = 'shout',
		viewport_pos = vector(0.8, 0.2),
		scale = 1.2,
		skip = false,
	})
end

function local_class:steam_princess_zone_event()
	local princess = self.character.princess
	local steam_princess = self.character.steam_princess
	local steam_knight = self.character.steam_knight
	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	local pivot_pos = self.pivot_pos.s2_pivot_pos()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--플레이어 강제 트리거 존에 진입 시 하단의 이벤트 진행.
	--동시 실행

	--1.5초에 걸쳐 파티원들이 각각의 타일로 down 방향 walk 자세로 정렬
	local party_wp = {
		[leader] = {
			pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, 5.5),
		},
		[princess] = {
			pivot_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 6.5),
		},
		[dragon_boy] = {
			pivot_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 6.5),
		},
	}

	--비강제 대사 실행 중이면 제거
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.oneline_npc:get_harpy(1))
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.oneline_npc:get_human(2))

	for fo, wp in pairs(party_wp) do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fo, wp, nil, 1.5, self, nil,
				{ run = false, locked_dir = 'down' })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

	--1초동안 카메라 ●지점으로 패닝. ←현재보다 위쪽으로 1.5칸 이동.
	do
		local camera_pos = pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, 1.5)
		camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 1)
	end

	--아이샤 (down, idle, idle) : 다들 그만 싸우고 진정들을…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(steam_princess, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s2_1')

	--인간2 (right, attack, release 2회) : 저리 비키라고, 이 하피 자식아!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.oneline_npc:get_human(2), self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'fw_main_s2_2')

	--인간1 (right, attack, idle) : 떠나는 건 우리 자유인데, 대체 우릴 왜 막으려는거야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.oneline_npc:get_human(1), self, 'right',
			nil, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'fw_main_s2_3')

	--정령1 (left, attack, cross_arm) : 자유? 웃기는 소리!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.oneline_npc:get_harpy(1), self, 'left',
			'cross_arm', { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'fw_main_s2_4')

	--정령3 (left, attack, release 2회) : 오래전에 세 종족간에 맺은 조약을 잊은거야?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.oneline_npc:get_harpy(3), self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'fw_main_s2_5')

	--정령2 (left, attack, bomb_idle) : 너희 인간들은 이곳에서 염룡들을 감시할 의무가 있어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.oneline_npc:get_harpy(2), self, 'left',
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' }, { name = 'attack', keep = true },
			'fw_main_s2_6')

	--정령2 (left, attack, idle) : 조약을 어기고 이기적이게 도망치려는 건가?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.oneline_npc:get_harpy(2), self, 'left',
			nil, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'fw_main_s2_7')

	--인간3 (right, attack, cast2) : 그건 벌써 몇백년도 더 된 조약이라고! 그걸 지킬 의무 따윈 없어!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.oneline_npc:get_human(3), self, 'right',
			{ name = 'cast2', keep = true }, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'fw_main_s2_8')

	--인간4 (right, attack, idle) : 우리한텐 그깟 조약보다 목숨이 더 소중하단 말이야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.oneline_npc:get_human(4), self, 'right',
			nil, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'fw_main_s2_9')

	--정령4 (left, attack, release 2회) : 억지 부리지마, 인간!

local local_class = newclass('FireWorldMainSection20')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FireWorldMain @
		Comment = 20섹션 시작, 5스테이지 첫 진입 @
		Index = 19 @
		NextSections = 20 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type FireWorldMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'fireworld_5'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		stage_start = 2,
		main_zone_enter = 3,
		done = 99,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.enter_brazier = metatable_helper.inherit({
		brazier_prefix = 's20_brazier_',
		zone_prefix = 's20_enter_zone_',
		group = {
			{ fo_count = 2, is_enter = false },
			{ fo_count = 2, is_enter = false },
			{ fo_count = 2, is_enter = false },
			{ fo_count = 2, is_enter = false },
		}
	}, {
		enter_event = function(this, e)
			for group_count = 1, #this.group do
				local fo_count = this.group[group_count].fo_count

				if not this.group[group_count].is_enter and
						type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), this.zone_prefix .. group_count) then
					this.group[group_count].is_enter = true
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_catch_fire_01')

					for num = 1, fo_count do
						local brazier = get_field_object(this.brazier_prefix .. group_count .. '_' .. num)

						command_util.publish_burn(get_party_leader(), brazier, true)
					end

					return true
				end
			end

			return false
		end,

		extinguish_all = function(this)
			for group_count = 1, #this.group do
				local fo_count = this.group[group_count].fo_count

				for num = 1, fo_count do
					local brazier = get_field_object(this.brazier_prefix .. group_count .. '_' .. num)

					command_util.publish_extinguish(get_party_leader(), brazier)
				end
			end
		end
	})

	--npc
	self.character = metatable_helper.inherit({
		spec = {
			fire_bishop = 'fire_bishop',
			princess = 'princess',
			dragon_boy = 'dragon_boy',
		}
	}, function(this, key)
		return get_character(this.spec[key])
	end)

	self.fx = metatable_helper.inherit({
		feather_screen = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_boss_priscilla_black_feather_long_screen')
		end,
	}, {
		create_all = function(this)
			for _, func in pairs(this) do
				func()
			end
		end
	})

	self.simple_marker = metatable_helper.inherit({
		marker_key = 'main_quest',
	}, {
		add = function(this)
			local marker_pos = field_util.get_zone('s20_main_enter_zone').Bounds.center

			quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(this.marker_key, self.cs_controller.QuestId, true, marker_pos)
		end,

		remove = function(this)
			quest_marker_util.remove(this.marker_key)
		end,
	})
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self.enter_brazier:extinguish_all()
end

function local_class:start()
	self.current_state = self.states.stage_start

	start_coroutine(function()
		if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
			screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')

			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

			sp_util.enter_scene()
		end

		self:intro_scene()

		self.simple_marker:add()

		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.stage_start and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's20_main_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.main_zone_enter

		self.simple_marker:remove()
		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.enter_brazier:enter_event(e) then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

	--set
	do
		local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s20_camera_pos')

		camera_util.set_position(target_pos, true)

	--1.3초 동안 화면 일반 페이드 인.
	local fire_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fire_05', loop = true, fade_in_time = 1 })
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 5 })
	screen_util.fade_in(1.3, unity_class.color.black, interpolations_constants.linear)

	--4초 동안 카메라 아래쪽으로 7칸 이동.
	do
		local camera_duration = 4
		local wait_duration = 3
		local fade_duration = 1

		camera_util.move(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + unity_class.vector3.back * 7, camera_duration)
		wait_for_sec(wait_duration)

		--3초가 지났을 때 화면 1초동안 일반 페이드 아웃.
		music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(fire_loop_sfx, 2)
		screen_util.fade_out_async(fade_duration, unity_class.color.black, interpolations_constants.linear)
	end

	party_util.position_party(field_util.get_marker_pos('default_start'), 'right', 'linear')
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	--최초 START ● 지점에 플레이어 파티 캐릭터 배치.
	--0.5초 동안 화면 서큘러 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, interpolations_constants.linear)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, interpolations_constants.linear)

	--플레이어 (right, idle, victory_get) 자세로 스테이지 이름 출력.
	stage_launch_util.directional_stage_entry(get_party_leader().Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), CS.Oak.Direction.Right,
			game_string:GetString(stage.Name), false, true)

	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
end

function local_class:enter_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.character.princess
	local fire_bishop = self.character.fire_bishop
	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy

	--플레이어 (right, idle, idle) 전환.

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s20_1')

	--꼬마공주 (up, idle, idle) : 왜 그래, 비슈바크?

			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s20_2')

	--기르가스 (up, idle, idle) : 무슨 일 있어?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s20_3')

	--비슈바크 (left, tired, question 정지) : 본래라면 이곳에 봉인소로 향하는 포탈이 있어야 할텐데…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s20_4')

	--비슈바크 (left, tired, question 정지) : 전혀 보이질 않고 있어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s20_5')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--비슈바크 (left, attack, idle 자세로 jump 1회) 끝날 때까지 대기.
	scene_util.set_direction(fire_bishop, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(fire_bishop, self, 'attack')
	character_util.remove_anim(fire_bishop)

	character_util.normal_jump_async(fire_bishop, true)

	--비슈바크 (left, attack, idle) : 설마…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
			nil, 'attack', 'fw_main_s20_6')

	--플레이어 (up, idle, idle) 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up', false)

	--비슈바크 이동속도 값 4.5 run 자세로 up 방향 3칸 이동.
	wp_util.move_async(fire_bishop, fire_bishop.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 3,

	--0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--비슈바크 캐릭터 머리 위에 (notice) 이모티콘 표시.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(fire_bishop, nil, 'notice')

	--플레이어, 꼬마공주, 기르가스 이동속도 값 2 walk 자세로 up 방향 2칸 이동.
	do
		do
			local speed = 2
			local move_pos = unity_class.vector3.forward * 3
			local camera_duration = 2
			local group = { leader, princess, dragon_boy }

			for _, npc in ipairs(group) do
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, npc.Position + move_pos,

			end

			--2초 동안 카메라 ●지점으로 패닝.
			camera_util.move_async(center_pos, camera_duration)

			camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(5.5, camera_duration)

			wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
		end
	end

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--동시 실행

	do
		local camera_duration = 1

		--1초 동안 카메라 아래쪽으로 2칸 이동.
		camera_util.move(stage_camera.LookAtPosition, camera_duration)

		--1초 동안 Stage Camera 값 4로 원상복귀.
		camera_util.resize_to_default_async(camera_duration)
	end

	--비슈바크 (up, idle, idle) : …역시나.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s20_7')

	--꼬마공주 이동속도 값 3 walk 자세로 right 방향 1칸, up 방향 3칸 이동.
	wp_util.move_async(princess, {
		princess.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
		princess.Position + vector(1, 0, 3),
	}, 3)

	--0.8초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	--꼬마공주 이동속도 값 3 walk 자세로 left 방향 2칸 이동.
	wp_util.move_async(princess, {
		princess.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0),
	}, 3)

	--꼬마공주 (up, idle, idle) 자세 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'up')

	--0.8초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	--꼬마공주 (down, idle, idle 자세로 jump 1회) : 벽에 뭔가 그림이 그려져 있어!
	character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, { dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s20_8')

	--기르가스 이동속도 값 2 walk 자세로 left 방향 1칸, up 방향 2칸 이동.
	wp_util.move_async(dragon_boy, {
		dragon_boy.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
		dragon_boy.Position + vector(-1, 0, 2),
	}, 2)

	--0.8초대기
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	--기르가스 (up, idle, idle) : 처음 보는 그림들인데…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s20_9')

	--플레이어 (right, idle, idle) 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)

	--기르가스 (right, idle, bomb_idle) : 저 벽화는 뭐야, 이모?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'fw_main_s20_10')

	--비슈바크 (up, idle, idle) 상태에서 머리 위에 (silence) 이모티콘 표시.
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(fire_bishop, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'silence')

	--비슈바크 (up, idle, idle) : 염룡의 역사가 그려져 있는 벽화야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s20_11')

	--비슈바크 (up, idle, idle) : 태초에 용족이 탄생하게 된 내용이나, 마룡을 막아냈던 사건 등이 담겨 있어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s20_12')

	--비슈바크 (left, idle, idle) : 기르가스 너도 어렴풋 들어본 적 있을 거야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s20_13')

	--기르가스 (right, smile, idle 자세로 jump 1회) : 맞다! 예전에 엄마가 나한테 얘기 해줬던 것 같아.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'right',
			nil, 'smile', 'fw_main_s20_14')

	--기르가스 (right, tired, idle) : 대부분 까먹었지만…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'right',
			nil, 'tired', 'fw_main_s20_15')

	--기르가스 (up, idle, idle) 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'up')

	--0.7초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--기르가스 (up, idle, idle) : 근데 이상하다… 벽화 곳곳에 구멍이 뚫려 있네.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s20_16')

	--기르가스 (right, idle, idle) : 원래부터 이런 상태였던거야?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s20_17')

	--비슈바크 (left, tired, idle) : 아니, 원래 박혀있어야 할 벽화 조각들이 몇개 빠져 있어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
			nil, 'tired', 'fw_main_s20_18')

	--비슈바크 (left, tired, cross_arm) : 화산 활동으로 생긴 지진 때문인건가… 잘 모르겠지만.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
			'cross_arm', 'tired', 'fw_main_s20_19')

	--비슈바크 (left, tired, cross_arm) : 일이 쉽게 흘러가질 않네.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false }, 'tired', 'fw_main_s20_20')

	--기르가스 (right, idle, bomb_idle) : 왜? 벽화 조각 좀 빠져 있는게 뭐 어때서?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'fw_main_s20_21')

	--비슈바크 (left, idle, idle) : 봉인소로 향하는 포탈 마법이 저 벽화에 걸려 있거든.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s20_22')

	--비슈바크 (up, idle, idle) : 포탈을 열기 위해선 모든 벽화 조각이 박혀 있어야 해.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s20_23')

	--비슈바크 (left, idle, queston 자세) (끝날때까지 대기)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(fire_bishop, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim_async(fire_bishop, self, { name = 'question', loop = false, keep_anim = true })

	--비슈바크 (left, idle, queston 정지 자세) : 미세하지만… 아직 벽화의 마력이 미세하게나마 느껴지고 있어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s20_23_1')

	--비슈바크 (left, idle, idle) : 아마도 조각난 벽화들이 이곳 신전 어딘가에 흩뿌려져 있는 것 같아.
	character_util.remove_anim(fire_bishop)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s20_24')

	--꼬마공주 (down, idle, release 2회) : 그럼 신전을 조사하면서 조각들을 찾아보자!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'fw_main_s20_25')

	--선택지 출력
	do
		--(intellect) 다 같이 흩어져서 찾아보는 건 어때?
		--(brutal) 잘 다녀와. 난 한숨 자고 있을게.
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'fw_main_s20_choose_1', 'intellect' },
			{ 'fw_main_s20_choose_2', 'brutal' }
		})

		if choose_result == 1 then
			--플레이어 (right, idle, bomb_idle 1초) 끝날때 까지 대기.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self,
					{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
					{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
					nil,
					1)

			--비슈바크 (left, idle, idle) : 안돼. 여기 신전은 네 생각보다 훨씬 복잡하게 설계 되어 있어.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
					nil, nil, 'fw_main_s20_26')

			--비슈바크 (left, idle, idle) : 길을 잃지 않도록 다 같이 뭉쳐 다니는게 안전할거야.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
					nil, nil, 'fw_main_s20_27')

		elseif choose_result == 2 then
			--플레이어 (right, sleep, sleep 1초) 끝날때 까지 대기.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_sleep_02')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
			scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self,
					{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
					{ name = 'sleep', keep = true },
					{ name = 'sleep', keep = true },
					1)

			--동시 실행

			--꼬마공주 (down, tired, idle) 전환.
			scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'down', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'tired')

			--비슈바크 (left, tired, idle) 전환.
			scene_util.set_direction(fire_bishop, 'left', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(fire_bishop, self, 'tired')

			--기르가스 (right, attack, release) : 일어나! 어딜 혼자서 꿀 빠려고.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'right',
					'release', 'attack', 'fw_main_s20_28')

			--플레이어 (right, idle, idle) 전환.
			--꼬마공주 (down, idle, idle) 전환.
			--기르가스 (right, idle, idle) 전환.
			party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()

			--0.5초 대기
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		end
	end

	--비슈바크 (left, idle, release 2회) : 자 그럼, 더 늦기 전에 서두르자.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'fw_main_s20_29')

	--비슈바크 (left, idle, idle) : 빠진 벽화 조각들을 모아서 다시 이곳에 끼워넣자고.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s20_30')

	--플레이어 (right, idle, nod 2회) 끝날때까지 대기.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	--1초동안 카메라 플레이어한테로 원상복귀.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	self.controller.progress_section()
end

function local_class:pre_setting()

end

return local_class
