		consume_count = 0,
		items = nil,

		-- FO 객체를 인덱스에 매핑하는 테이블
		fo_to_idx = {},

		---조각 상호작용 용도 FO 가져오기
		---@param this FireWorldSection21MuralPiece
		get_fo = function(this, idx)
			return get_field_object(this.prefix .. 'fo_' .. idx)
		end,

		---조각 위치 가져오기
		---@param this FireWorldSection21MuralPiece
		get_pos = function(this, idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos(this.prefix .. idx)
		end,

		---조각 및 상호작용 FO 소환
		---@param this FireWorldSection21MuralPiece
		spawn = function(this, idx)
			local fo = this:get_fo(idx)
			local pos = this:get_pos(idx)

			field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.enabled)
			fo.Position = pos

			this.items[idx] = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
				pos = pos,
				item_id = 21683,
				unique_id = this.prefix .. 'item_' .. idx,
				drop_type = quest_drop_item_drop_type.spawn,
				loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter
			})

			this.fo_to_idx[fo] = idx
		end,

		---조각 획득(도중에 대기)
		---@param this FireWorldSection21MuralPiece
		consume_async = function(this, idx, target)
			local fo = this:get_fo(idx)

			field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.disabled)

			--먹는 중 대기
			quest_drop_item_util.consumed(this.items[idx], target)

			while this.items[idx].ConsumeTarget do
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			this.consume_count = this.consume_count + 1

			--데이터 처리
			this.items[idx] = nil
			this.fo_to_idx[fo] = nil

			--NOTE: 임시 딜레이
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		end,

		---FO로 인덱스 가져오기(없으면 mural_piece fo가 아님)
		---@param this FireWorldSection21MuralPiece
		get_idx_by_fo = function(this, target)
			return this.fo_to_idx[target]
		end,

		---@param this FireWorldSection21MuralPiece
		dispose = function(this)
			if this.items == nil then
				return
			end

			for idx = 1, this.count do
				if this.items[idx] ~= nil then
					local fo = this:get_fo(idx)

					field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.disabled)

					quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(this.items[idx])

					this.items[idx] = nil
				end
			end

			this.items = nil
		end
	}

	---@class FireWorldSection21MuralWall
	---@type FireWorldSection21MuralWall
	local mural_wall = {
		prefix = 'mural_',
		broken_mural_nums = { 2, 4, 6 },
		fos = {},

		-- FO 객체를 인덱스에 매핑하는 테이블
		fo_to_idx = {},

		---@param this FireWorldSection21MuralWall
		get_fo = function(this, idx)
			return get_field_object(this.prefix .. this.broken_mural_nums[idx])
		end,

		---FO로 인덱스 가져오기(없으면 mural_wall fo가 아님)
		---@param this FireWorldSection21MuralWall
		get_idx_by_fo = function(this, target)
			return this.fo_to_idx[target]
		end,
	}

	---@class FireWorldSection21Mural
	---@type FireWorldSection21Mural
	self.mural = {
		count = 3,

		piece = mural_piece,

		wall = mural_wall,

		---@type FireWorld5MuralBit
		bit = nil,

		complete_bit = 42,

		---@param this FireWorldSection21Mural
		---@param bit FireWorld5MuralBit
		init = function(this, bit)
			this.bit = bit

			local piece = this.piece
			piece.count = this.count
			piece.items = {}

			local wall = this.wall

			for idx = 1, this.count do
				--조각 세팅
				do
					--상태가 0이면 조각을 획득하지 않은 상황이므로 맵상에 배치
					if this:is_idle(idx) == true then
						piece:spawn(idx)
					else
						--0이 아니면 조각을 얻었다는 뜻이므로 획득 카운트를 올려줌
						piece.consume_count = piece.consume_count + 1
					end
				end

				do
					--벽 세팅
					local fo = get_field_object(wall.prefix .. wall.broken_mural_nums[idx])

					wall.fos[idx] = fo
					wall.fo_to_idx[fo] = idx

					if this:is_activated(idx) == false then
						--안 꽃아넣은 경우면 미완성 애니메이션 상태로
						animator_util.play(fo, '[gimmick]wall_mural_idle')
					else
						--이미 꽃아넣은 경우면 완성된 애니메이션 상태로(즉시 출력)
						local animator = fo.Transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

						animator:Play('[gimmick]wall_mural_sleb', 0, 1.0)
					end
				end

				do
					--마커 세팅
					this:set_quest_marker_by_state(idx)
				end
			end
		end,

		---@param this FireWorldSection21Mural
		dispose = function(this)
			this.piece:dispose()
		end,

		---특정 벽화가 조각도 안 먹은 상태인지
		---@param this FireWorldSection21Mural
		is_idle = function(this, idx)
			return this.bit:get_state(idx) == 0
		end,

		---특정 벽화가 조각만 먹은 상태인지
		---@param this FireWorldSection21Mural
		is_acquire_piece = function(this, idx)
			return this.bit:get_state(idx) == 1
		end,

		---특정 벽화가 조각 꽃아놓은 상태인지
		---@param this FireWorldSection21Mural
		is_activated = function(this, idx)
			return this.bit:get_state(idx) == 2
		end,

		---벽화 3개 전부 완료한 상태인지
		---@param this FireWorldSection21Mural
		is_completed = function(this)
			return this.bit.bitfield == this.complete_bit
		end,

		---특정 mural의 bit 상태에 따라 맞는 위치에 마커 배치
		---@param this FireWorldSection21Mural
		set_quest_marker_by_state = function(this, idx)
			local prefix = 'main_quest_mural_'

			if this:is_idle(idx) then
				--조각 안 얻은 상태면 조각에 배치
				quest_marker_util.remove(prefix .. idx)
				quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(prefix .. idx,
						self.cs_controller.QuestId, true, this.piece:get_fo(idx))
			elseif this:is_acquire_piece(idx) then
				--조각 얻은 상태면 벽화에 배치
				quest_marker_util.remove(prefix .. idx)
				quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(prefix .. idx,
						self.cs_controller.QuestId, true, this.wall.fos[idx])
			elseif this:is_activated(idx) then
				--벽화에 꽃은 상태면 제거
				quest_marker_util.remove(prefix .. idx)
			end
		end
	}
	--endregion

	self.data_storage = nil

	self.mural_state_key = 'mural_state_key'
end

function local_class:need_skip()
	--만약 커스텀 스테이트는 완료로 저장되었는데 섹션 종료가 정상적으로 저장되지 않은 경우에는 다시 접속 시 정상 진행이 불가능하게 됨.
	--커스텀 스테이트 완료 상태를 체크해서 넘기도록 함
	local state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, self.mural_state_key)

	return state == self.mural.complete_bit
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	--벽화 플래그 세팅
	do
		---@type FireWorld5Controller
		local stage_controller = get_stage_event_controller('FireWorld5Controller')

		local storage_create = require('utils/QuestDataStorage')
		self.data_storage = storage_create.create(self.cs_controller.QuestId)

		--저장을 한번이라도 했으면 유효한 값이 옴
		--저장을 안 한 경우에는 디폴트 값 0이 저장
		local mural_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, self.mural_state_key)
		--local mural_state = stage_progress_util.get_custom_data_int(self.mural_state_key)
		--local mural_state = self.data_storage:get_data(self.mural_state_key)

		if mural_state == -1 then
			mural_state = 0
		end

		stage_controller.mural_bit.bitfield = mural_state

		self.mural:init(stage_controller.mural_bit)
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	self.current_state = self.states.before_complete_mural
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.current_state = self.states.done

	self.mural:dispose()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return self:on_interact_event(e)
end

---@param e InteractEvent
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_complete_mural then
		--FIXME: 조각을 먼저 만들어서 나눠지긴 했는데 얘내 둘 클래스랑 인덱스를 합쳐도 될 거 같음. 조건 체크는 is_acquire_piece 등 사용하면 될듯
		local mural_piece_idx = self.mural.piece:get_idx_by_fo(e.Target)
		local mural_idx = self.mural.wall:get_idx_by_fo(e.Target)

		if mural_piece_idx ~= nil and self.mural:is_idle(mural_piece_idx) == true then
			--벽화 조각에 상호작용한 경우(줍지도 않은 상태)
			self.current_state = self.states.in_consume_piece

			sp_util.start_scene(function()
				self:consume_piece_scene(mural_piece_idx)

				--벽화 획득 데이터 저장
				self.mural.bit:acquire_mural(mural_piece_idx)
				self:apply_custom_state_immediately(self.cs_controller.QuestId, self.mural_state_key, self.mural.bit.bitfield)
				--self.data_storage:set_data_async(self.mural_state_key, self.mural.bit.bitfield)
				--stage_progress_util.set_custom_data_async(self.mural_state_key, self.mural.bit.bitfield)

				--이후 메인 퀘스트 마커는 [gimmick]wall_mural2 오브젝트를 가리킴.
				self.mural:set_quest_marker_by_state(mural_piece_idx)

				self.current_state = self.states.before_complete_mural
			end)

			return true
		elseif mural_idx ~= nil and self.mural:is_activated(mural_idx) == false then
			--벽화 본체에 상호작용한 경우 + 벽화 고쳐진 상태가 아닌 경우에 들어옴
			--활성화된 경우는 스테이지 컨트롤러에서 씬 재생
			self.current_state = self.states.in_insert_piece

			local target = e.Target

			sp_util.start_scene(function()
				--나레이션 박스 출력
				--벽화 조각이 빠져 있어 내용을 읽을 수 없다.
				field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'fw_main_s21_mural_1' })

				--벽화 조각 오브젝트를 얻었을 경우 하단의 이벤트를 이어서 진행 / 얻지 않았을 경우엔 바로 이벤트 종료.
				if self.mural:is_acquire_piece(mural_idx) == true then
					local insert_result = self:try_insert_piece_scene(target)

					--넣기를 선택했다면 벽화 꽂은 데이터 저장
					if insert_result == true then
						self.mural.bit:activate_mural(mural_idx)
						self:apply_custom_state_immediately(self.cs_controller.QuestId, self.mural_state_key, self.mural.bit.bitfield)
						--self.data_storage:set_data_async(self.mural_state_key, self.mural.bit.bitfield)
						--stage_progress_util.set_custom_data_async(self.mural_state_key, self.mural.bit.bitfield)

						--메인 퀘스트 마커 제거.
						self.mural:set_quest_marker_by_state(mural_idx)
					end
				end

				--3개 다 끼워넣었으면 넘어가기
				if self.mural:is_completed() then
					self.controller:progress_section()
				else
					self.current_state = self.states.before_complete_mural
				end
			end)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:consume_piece_scene(mural_idx)
	local knight = self.character.knight()
	local princess = self.character.princess()
	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy()
	local fire_bishop = self.character.fire_bishop()

	local mural_pos = self.mural.piece:get_pos(mural_idx)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	if mural_idx == 1 then
		--플레이어가 벽화 조각1 아이템을 인터렉트 시, 하단의 이벤트 진행.
		--동시 실행
		do
			local duration = 1

			--1초 동안 파티원들이 각각의 타일로 left 방향 walk 자세로 정렬
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, mural_pos + vector(1, 0, -0.5),
					nil, duration,  self,
					nil, { locked_dir = 'left' })

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, mural_pos + vector(2, 0, -0.5),
					nil, duration,  self,
					nil, { locked_dir = 'left' })

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dragon_boy, mural_pos + vector(2, 0, 0.5),
					nil, duration,  self,
					nil, { locked_dir = 'left' })

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fire_bishop, mural_pos + vector(1, 0, 0.5),
					nil, duration,  self,
					nil, { locked_dir = 'left' })

			wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
		end

		--플레이어 (left, idle, idle 자세로 jump 1회) 하며 머리 위에 (notice) 이모티콘 표시.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
		character_util.normal_jump(knight, true)
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(knight, self, 'left',
				nil, nil, 'notice')

		--플레이어 (left, idle, eat 1초) 끝날때까지 대기.
		local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'eat', remove_after = 1 })

		--eat 자세 진행한지 0.8초가 지났을 때, 벽화 아이템이 플레이어 캐릭터한테 흡수됨.
		wait_for_sec(0.8)

		self.mural.piece:consume_async(mural_idx, self.character.knight())

		music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_sfx)
		--나레이션 박스 출력
		--…에서부터 한 마리의 용이 탄생하였다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'fw_main_s21_1' })

		--용은 그곳의 마력을 빨아들이더니 곧…
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'fw_main_s21_2' })

		--이후 하단의 대사 출력.
	elseif mural_idx == 2 then
		--플레이어가 벽화 조각2 아이템을 인터렉트 시, 하단의 이벤트 진행.

		--동시 실행
		do
			local duration = 1

			--1초 동안 파티원들이 각각의 타일로 right  방향 walk 자세로 정렬
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, mural_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0),
					nil, duration,  self,
					nil, { locked_dir = 'right' })

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, mural_pos + vector(-2, 0, 0),
					nil, duration,  self,
					nil, { locked_dir = 'right' })

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dragon_boy, mural_pos + vector(-2, 0, 1),
					nil, duration,  self,
					nil, { locked_dir = 'right' })

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fire_bishop, mural_pos + vector(-1, 0, 1),
					nil, duration,  self,
					nil, { locked_dir = 'right' })

			wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
		end

		--플레이어 (right, idle, idle 자세로 jump 1회) 하며 머리 위에 (notice) 이모티콘 표시.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
		character_util.normal_jump(knight, true)
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(knight, self, 'right',
				nil, nil, 'notice')

		--플레이어 (right, idle, eat 1초) 끝날때까지 대기.
		local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'eat', remove_after = 1 })

		--eat 자세 진행한지 0.8초가 지났을 때, 벽화 아이템이 플레이어 캐릭터한테 흡수됨.
		wait_for_sec(0.8)

		self.mural.piece:consume_async(mural_idx, self.character.knight())

		music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_sfx)
		--나레이션 박스 출력
		--…가 서로 대립하였고, 거대한 두 마력이 충돌하자 천지가 흔들렸다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'fw_main_s21_3' })

		--두 존재는 머지않아 소멸되었고, 충돌한 마력은…
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'fw_main_s21_4' })
		--이후 하단의 대사 출력.
	elseif mural_idx == 3 then
		--플레이어가 벽화 조각3 아이템을 인터렉트 시, 하단의 이벤트 진행.

		--동시 실행
		do
			local duration = 1

			--1초 동안 파티원들이 각각의 타일로 down 방향 walk 자세로 정렬
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, mural_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 1),
					nil, duration,  self,
					nil, { locked_dir = 'down' })

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, mural_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 1),
					nil, duration,  self,
					nil, { locked_dir = 'down' })

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dragon_boy, mural_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 2),
					nil, duration,  self,
					nil, { locked_dir = 'down' })

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fire_bishop, mural_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 2),
					nil, duration,  self,
					nil, { locked_dir = 'down' })

			wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
		end

		--플레이어 (down, idle, idle 자세로 jump 1회) 하며 머리 위에 (notice) 이모티콘 표시.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
		character_util.normal_jump(knight, true)
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(knight, self, 'down',
				nil, nil, 'notice')

		--플레이어 (left, idle, eat 1초) 끝날때까지 대기.
		local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'eat', remove_after = 1 })

		--eat 자세 진행한지 0.8초가 지났을 때, 벽화 아이템이 플레이어 캐릭터한테 흡수됨.
		wait_for_sec(0.8)

		self.mural.piece:consume_async(mural_idx, self.character.knight())

		music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_sfx)
		--플레이어 (down, idle, idle) 로 전환.

function local_class:apply_custom_state_immediately(quest_id, key_name, val)
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(quest_id)
	local save_success = true
	local on_success = function(res)
		save_success = true
	end

	-- 먼저 custom state 를 set 한다.
	local fail_count = 0
	while true do
		local r = CS.Oak.IQuestEventControllerExtensions.SetCustomState(nil, quest_progress, key_name, val)
		coroutine.yield(r)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		-- on_error 콜백을 안받아서 CustomState 가 실제로 변경되었는지로 체크해야 한다..
		save_success = true

		if quest_progress:GetCustomState(key_name) ~= val then
			save_success = false
		end

		if not save_success then
			fail_count = fail_count + 1
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('DemonShireVendingMachine : SetCustomState Retry')
			wait_for_sec(5.0 + fail_count)
		else
			break
		end
	end

	local is_replaying = CS.Oak.QuestReplaySystem.IsReplaying

	if not is_replaying then
		fail_count = 0
		while true do
			save_success = false
			local r = CS.Oak.NetworkManager.ApiConnection:SendProgressQuest(stage.StageId, quest_progress.QuestId, quest_progress.InnerProgress, nil)
			r:Then(on_success)
			coroutine.yield(r:SuppressDefaultErrorHandler())
			coroutine.yield(nil)
			if not save_success then
				fail_count = fail_count + 1
				CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('DemonShireVendingMachine : SendProgressQuest Retry')
				wait_for_sec(5.0 + fail_count)
			else
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

	self.available_stage_names = 'fireworld_5'

	self.npc = setmetatable({
		spec = {
			-- 공주
			princess = 'princess',
			-- 기르가스
			dragon_boy = 'dragon_boy',

			second_bishop = 'second_bishop'
		}
	}, {
		__index = function(this, key)
			return get_character(this.spec[key])
		end
	})

	self.field_object = setmetatable({
		spec = {
			gate = 's23_gate_1',
		}
	}, {
		__index = function(this, key)
			return get_field_object(this.spec[key])
		end
	})

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		fx_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		fx_dv_moneyshot_chain_loop = function()

		end,
		fx_bishop_volcano_cast = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_bishop_volcano_cast')
		end,
		fx_bishop_screen_spark_fx = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_bishop_screen_spark_fx')
		end,
		fx_fire_bishop_teleport = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_fire_bishop_teleport')

		end,

			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_blink')
		end,

		end,

		end,

			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fw_second_bishop_emblem')
		end,
	})

	self.background_util = {
		controller = nil,

		load_resource = function(this)
			this.controller = global_table_util.get_or_create_background_fade_controller()

			local asset_path = 'ondemand/v2_22_lilithtower/theatres/ending'
			local asset_name = 'white_tint_background'
			this.controller:load_async(asset_path, asset_name)
		end,

		set_position = function(this, pos)
			this.controller:set_background_position(pos)
		end,

		set_color = function(this, rgb_vector3)
			this.controller:set_background_color(rgb_vector3.x, rgb_vector3.y, rgb_vector3.z)
		end,

		set_active = function(this, boolean)
			this.controller:set_background_active(boolean)
		end,

		fade_in_async = function(this, duration, fade_value)
			local time_passed = 0
			local value = lua_helper.get_or_default(fade_value, 1)

			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Min(time_passed / duration, value)

				this.controller:set_background_alpha(progress)

				coroutine.yield()

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			end

			this.controller:set_background_alpha(1)
		end,

		fade_out_async = function(this, duration)
			local time_passed = 0

			local value = this.controller.background_renderer.color.a

			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(value - time_passed)

				this.controller:set_background_alpha(progress)

				coroutine.yield()

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			end

			this.controller:set_background_alpha(0)
		end,
		dispose = function(this)
			if this.controller ~= nil then
				this.controller:dispose_loaded()
			end

			this.controller = nil
		end
	}

	self.quest_marker = {
		key = 'main_quest',
		add = function(this, data)
			quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(this.key, data)
		end,

			quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(this.key)
		end
	}

	self.states = {

	}

function local_class:enter()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	local gate = self.field_object.gate
	gate.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	self.quest_marker:add({
		{
			zone = 'sealing_post_field',
			target = vector(7.5, 0, 184)
		}
	})
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.background_util:dispose()
	self.background_util = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.field_object.gate) then
		self.current_state = self.states.door_open
		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_gate_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state < self.states.enter_event_zone and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's23_event_zone_1') then
		self.current_state = self.states.enter_event_zone
		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_meet_companion_boy_zone, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

		---@type fun(this:self,num:number):IFieldObject

		---@type fun(this:self)
		set_interact_all = function(this)

				local fo = this:get(i)

		---@type fun(this:self,num:number)
		remove_interact = function(this, num)
			local fo = this:get(num)

			fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self)
		stop_move = function(this)
			this.is_move = false
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self , boat:IFieldObject,position:Vector3)
		set_boat_and_passenger_pos = function(this, boat, position)
			-- 배 이동
			boat.Position = position

			--최대 4인 파티 상정하고 제작
			for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
				local move_pos = position + this.passenger_offset[i + 1]
				user_party[i].Position = move_pos
			end
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self,boat:IFieldObject)
		ride_async = function(this, boat)
			local data = this.scene_data
			local leader = user_party.Leader

			--이동 방향
			local move_dir = vector_util.to_direction(boat.Position - leader.Position)

			--카메라 0.3초 동안 배 오브젝트의 중앙으로 패닝.
			local camera_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(boat.Bounds.center)
			camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, data.camera_dur, { end_target = boat })

			local current_party = get_user_party()

			-- 파티원이 4명이 이상일 경우는 fireworld_6 엔 없어서 처리하지 않음
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')

			for i = 0, current_party.Count - 1 do
				local member = current_party[i]
				local end_pos = boat.Position + this.passenger_offset[i + 1]

				scene_util.set_anim(member, self, { name = 'get' })
				character_util.jump(member, data.jump_height, data.move_dur)

				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member,
						end_pos, nil, data.move_dur, self, nil,
						{ run = false, locked_dir = move_dir, end_callback = function()
							character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(member)
						end })
			end

			wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self, boat:IFieldObject, dir:string | Direction)
		get_out_async = function(this, boat, dir)
			local data = this.scene_data
			local leader = user_party.Leader

			local camera_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(leader.Bounds.center)
			camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, data.camera_dur, { end_target = leader })

			local dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(dir)
			local distance = 2
			local target_pos = boat.Position + dir_vector * distance

			local party_offset = {
				vector(-0.5, 0, 0.5),
				vector(0.5, 0, 0.5),
				vector(-0.5, 0, -0.5),
				vector(0.5, 0, -0.5),
			}

			local current_party = get_user_party()

			-- firworld_6는 파티원이 4명 초과를 상정하지 않음.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')

			for i = 0, current_party.Count - 1 do
				local member = current_party[i]
				local end_pos = target_pos + party_offset[i + 1]

				scene_util.set_anim(member, self, { name = 'get' })
				character_util.jump(member, data.jump_height, data.move_dur)

				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member,
						end_pos, nil, data.move_dur, self, nil,
						{ run = false, locked_dir = dir, end_callback = function()
							character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(member)
						end })
			end

			wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
		end,

		---구간 반복 이동.
		---마지막 wp 도착 시 첫 wp로 이동
		---@type fun(this:self, boat:IFieldObject, wp:Vector3 | Vector3[])
		repeat_waypoint_move_async = function(this, boat, wp)
			--이동 이펙트 생성
			local trail = self.fx.boat_trail_loop():Instantiate(
					boat.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, boat.Transform)
			local boat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '02_gimmick_lava_move_01_loop', loop = true, volume = 0.6 })

			local cur_wp = 2
			local start_pos = wp[cur_wp - 1]
			local target_pos = wp[cur_wp]

			local move_pos = target_pos - start_pos
			local distance = move_pos.magnitude
			local duration = distance / this.speed
			local party_dir = vector_util.to_direction(move_pos)
			party_util.set_direction(party_dir)

			local progress = 0
			local time_passed = 0

			this.is_move = true
			while this.is_move do
				--이동 연산
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				progress = time_passed / duration

				if time_passed < duration then
					local current_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)

					this:set_boat_and_passenger_pos(boat, current_pos)
				else
					if cur_wp < #wp then
						cur_wp = cur_wp + 1

						this:set_boat_and_passenger_pos(boat, target_pos)
					else
						cur_wp = 2

						this:set_boat_and_passenger_pos(boat, wp[cur_wp - 1])
					end

					start_pos = wp[cur_wp - 1]
					target_pos = wp[cur_wp]

					move_pos = target_pos - start_pos
					distance = move_pos.magnitude

					duration = distance / this.speed
					time_passed = 0
					local current_dir = vector_util.to_direction(move_pos)

					if party_dir ~= current_dir then
						party_dir = current_dir
						party_util.set_direction(party_dir)
					end
				end

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			trail:Dispose()
			trail = nil

			music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(boat_sfx, 0.5)
		end,

		---waypoint 이동
		---@type fun(this:self, boat:IFieldObject, wp:Vector3 | Vector3[])
		move_with_end_callback = function(this, boat, wp)
			--현재 이동 여부 체크 및 wp 체크
			if this.is_move or wp == nil then

			--이동 이펙트 생성
			local trail = self.fx.lava_boat_trail():Instantiate(

			local boat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gimmick_lava_move_01_loop', loop = true })

			--단일 position 값 대응
			if not type_util.is_table(wp) then
				wp = { wp }
			end

			start_coroutine(function()
				local cur_wp = 0
				local start_pos = boat.Position
				local target_pos = boat.Position

				local move_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero
				local distance = 0
				local progress = 0
				local time_passed = 0
				local duration = -1
				local party_dir = nil

				this.is_move = true
				while this.is_move do
					--이동 연산
					time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
					progress = time_passed / duration

					if time_passed < duration then
						local current_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
						this:set_boat_and_passenger_pos(boat, current_pos)
					else
						this:set_boat_and_passenger_pos(boat, target_pos)

						if cur_wp < #wp then
							cur_wp = cur_wp + 1

							start_pos = target_pos
							target_pos = wp[cur_wp]

							move_pos = target_pos - start_pos
							distance = move_pos.magnitude

							duration = distance / this.speed
							time_passed = 0

							party_dir = vector_util.to_direction(move_pos)
							party_util.set_direction(party_dir)
						else
							--도착
							this.is_move = false
							break
						end
					end

					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end

				trail:Dispose()
				trail = nil

				music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(boat_sfx, 0.5)
			end)
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self)
		wait_move_end = function(this)
			while this.is_move do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end,
	}

	--조건에 따른 action_scene 호출
	self.action_scene_manager = {
		data = {
			{
				zone_name = 's25_enter_zone_5',
				action_scene = self.third_action_scene,
				handler = self,
				param = nil,
				is_entered = false,
			},
		},

		---@type fun(this:self, e:ZoneEnterEvent):boolean
		on_zone_enter_event = function(this, e)
			local is_screen_playing = lua_helper.type_compare(
					user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState)

			if not is_screen_playing then
				return false, nil
			end

			for num, info in ipairs(this.data) do
				if not info.is_entered and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), info.zone_name) then
					this.data[num].is_entered = true
					start_coroutine(info.action_scene, info.handler, info.param)
					return true
				end
			end

			return false, nil
		end,
	}

	self.fx_data = {
		fx_pool = {},

		---@type fun(this:self,fx:UnityObjectPool)
		insert = function(this, fx)
			table.insert(this.fx_pool, fx)
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self)
		dispose = function(this)
			for num = 1, #this.fx_pool do
				this.fx_pool[num]:Dispose()
				this.fx_pool[num] = nil
			end
		end,
	}
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	--원래는 on_pre_load에서 하지만 fireworld preload 스트레스 분산을 위해 타이밍 변경
	self.fx:create_all()

	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:start()
	self.current_state = self.states.before_interact

	if not self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		return
	end

	-- bgm 변경 후 시작
	start_coroutine(self.set_bgm_and_start_routine, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self.fx_data:dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_interact and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.lava_boat:get(1)) then
		self.current_state = self.states.first_boat_scene
		sp_util.start_scene(self.first_boat_interact_scene, self):Then(function()
			quest_marker_util.remove(self.lava_boat:get(1).Name)
			self.lava_boat:remove_interact(1)
		end)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.first_boat_scene and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.lava_boat:get(2)) then
		self.current_state = self.states.second_boat_scene
		sp_util.start_scene(self.second_boat_interact_scene, self):Then(function()
			quest_marker_util.remove(self.lava_boat:get(2).Name)
			self.lava_boat:remove_interact(2)
		end)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.second_boat_scene and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.lava_boat:get(3)) then
		self.current_state = self.states.third_boat_scene
		sp_util.start_scene(self.third_boat_interact_scene, self):Then(function()
			quest_marker_util.remove(self.lava_boat:get(3).Name)
			self.lava_boat:remove_interact(3)
		end)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.third_boat_scene and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.lava_boat:get(4)) then
		self.current_state = self.states.fourth_boat_scene
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.lava_boat:get(4).Name)
		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene()
			self:fourth_boat_interact_scene()
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local is_entered = self.action_scene_manager:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if is_entered then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_bgm_and_start_routine()
	-- bgm 클립 변경
	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({
		name = 'ondemand/v3_31_fireworld/audio:bgm_fireworld_temple', state = 'field'
	})

	-- 스테이지 시작 연출
	do

		character_util.set_position(leader, marker.position)

		screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

function local_class:first_party_routine()
	local lock_dir = function(dir)
		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party[i], dir)
		end
	end

	local reset_dir = function()
		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			character_util.reset_locked_dir(user_party[i])
		end
	end

	lock_dir('left')
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'attack' })

	wait_for_sec(2)

	lock_dir('down')
	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	lock_dir('left')
	wait_for_sec(4.5)

	reset_dir()
	party_util.remove_emotion()
end

function local_class:first_boat_interact_scene()
	local boat = self.lava_boat:get(1)

	--보트 승차 ( 카메라 보트 타케팅 되어있는 상태 )
	self.lava_boat:ride_async(boat)

	start_coroutine(self.first_action_scene, self)

	--카메라 타게팅 분리 전 까지 이동
	do
		local wp = {}
		local count = 9
		for i = 1, count do
			local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s25_lava_move_pos_1_' .. i)

			table.insert(wp, pos)
		end

		self.lava_boat:move_with_end_callback(boat, wp)
		self.lava_boat:wait_move_end()
	end

	--보트 하차
	self.lava_boat:get_out_async(boat, 'down')
end

function local_class:second_companion_action_routine(data)
	local companion_boy = self.character.companion_boy
	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(data.marker_name)
	local is_right = data.is_right
	local pos_data = {}

	do
		local count = 5
		for i = 1, count do
			local pos

			if is_right then
				local offset = (i - 1) * 1.5
				pos = center_pos + vector(-3.5 + offset, 0, 0)
			else
				local offset = (i - 1) * -1.5
				pos = center_pos + vector(3.5 + offset, 0, 0)
			end

			table.insert(pos_data, pos)
		end
	end

	--0초 시점. 1번 지점에서부터 진행.
	do
		local npc_data = {
			companion_boy = {
				dir = 'left',
				anim = 'idle',
				emo = 'attack',
				marker_name = 'default_start',
				offset = vector(999, 0, 999),
			},
		}
		self:set_by_npc_data(npc_data)
		if is_right then
			scene_util.set_direction(companion_boy, 'right', false)
		else
			scene_util.set_direction(companion_boy, 'left', false)
		end
	end

	--시온 (left, attack, idle) 상태로 fx_blink 이펙트 출력과 함께 생성.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_xellos_warp_01')
	companion_boy.Position = center_pos + vector(0, 0, -1.5)
	self.fx.blink():Instantiate(companion_boy.Position)

	--0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--시온 (left, attack, jingak[2배])를 0.5초에 걸쳐 실행.
	scene_util.set_anim(companion_boy, self, { name = 'jingak', loop = false, scale = 2 })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if data.index == 1 or data.index == 2 then
		--1-사1 지점에 fx_dv_moneyshot_chain_loop 실행.
		--0.2초 대기.
		--5회

		if data.index == 1 then
			for i = 1, #pos_data do
				music_player_util.play_multiple_sfx_one_shot('02_companion_chain_01', '02_hit_earth_02')
				local chain = self.fx.chain_loop():Instantiate(pos_data[i])
				self.fx_data:insert(chain)

				--0.2초 대기.
				wait_for_sec(0.2)
			end
		else
			local chain_count = 3

			for i = 1, #pos_data do
				music_player_util.play_multiple_sfx_one_shot('02_companion_chain_01', '02_hit_earth_02')

				for j = 1, chain_count do
					local chain = self.fx.chain_loop():Instantiate(pos_data[i] + vector(0, 0, -2 + j))
					self.fx_data:insert(chain)
				end

				--0.2초 대기.
				wait_for_sec(0.2)
			end
		end

		--1-사1 ~ 5 일제히 fx_dv_moneyshot_chain_break 실행하며 파괴됨.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_03')
		for i = 1, #pos_data do
			self.fx.chain_break():Instantiate(pos_data[i])
		end

		self.fx_data:dispose()

		--0.3초 대기.
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
	end

	if data.index == 3 then
		--비슈바크 좌표에서 (x 0.5 / y 0.25) 지점에 도착할 것을 기준으로, (x 20 / y 5) 지점에 dv_kusarigama 생성됨.
		--dv_kusarigama 오브젝트가 목표로 하는 좌표에 0.3초에 걸쳐 이동.
		local duration = 0.3
		local angle_z = -60
		local offset = vector(-0.8, 1.5, 0)
		local chain_fx = self.fx.kusarigama():Instantiate(center_pos + offset + vector(20, 5, 0))

		chain_fx.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, angle_z)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_companion_chain_01')
		pooled_object_util.move_async(chain_fx, center_pos + offset, duration)

		--화면 0.3 / 0.3 shake 실행.
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
		--1초 대기.
		wait_for_sec(1)

		start_coroutine(function()
			wait_for_sec(4.5)

			chain_fx:Dispose()
		end)
	end

	--시온 Fx_blink 실행하여 제거.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_xellos_warp_01')
	self.fx.blink():Instantiate(companion_boy.Position)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(companion_boy, active_state_type.disabled)
end

function local_class:second_fire_bishop_action_routine(data)
	local fire_bishop = self.character.fire_bishop
	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(data.marker_name)
	local is_right = data.is_right

	if data.index == 1 or data.index == 3 then
		if data.index == 1 then
			--1.5초 시점까지 대기.
			wait_for_sec(1.5)
		else
			wait_for_sec(1.1)
		end

		--동시 실행
		do
			local npc_data = {
				fire_bishop = {
					dir = 'right',
					anim = 'boong_attack_ready_loop',
					emo = 'attack',
					marker_name = 'default_start',
					offset = vector(999, 0, 999),
				},
			}
			self:set_by_npc_data(npc_data)

			local offset = is_right and 3.5 or -3.5
			character_util.set_position(fire_bishop, center_pos + vector(offset, 0, 0))

			if is_right then
				scene_util.set_direction(fire_bishop, 'left', false)
			else
				scene_util.set_direction(fire_bishop, 'right', false)
			end
		end

		--비슈바크 (right, attack, boong_attack_ready_loop) 상태로 생성 후 유지.

		--fx_fire_bishop_teleport 실행과 함께 비슈바크 생성.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_character_warp_04')
		self.fx.fire_bishop_teleport():Instantiate(fire_bishop.Position)

		--0.2초 대기
		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		--동시 실행
		--비슈바크 (right, attack, boong_attack) 실행.
		scene_util.set_anim(fire_bishop, self, { name = 'boong_attack', loop = false })

		if data.index == 3 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_furniture_01')
			scene_util.set_emotion(fire_bishop, self, 'damaged')
			scene_util.shake(fire_bishop, 0.02, 5)
		end

		--화면 0.3 / 0.3 shake 실행.
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
		do
			local offset = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(fire_bishop.Direction)

			--비슈바크 앞쪽으로 FX_Gauntlet_Hit 이펙트 실행.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_kick_01')
			self.fx.gauntlet_hit():Instantiate(fire_bishop.Bounds.center + offset)
			--비슈바크 중심으로 Fx_lasthit 이펙트 실행.
			self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(fire_bishop.Position)
		end

		--2초 시점
		wait_for_sec(2)

		--0.3초 대기.
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
	end

	if data.index == 2 then
		--0.35초 대기.
		wait_for_sec(0.55)

		--비슈바크 현재 위치에서 (up, idle, twohand_attack_4) 을 실행하여 지정된 지점까지 1.15초에 걸쳐 날아감.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_clara_boss_jump_01')
		character_util.set_direction(fire_bishop, 'up')
		scene_util.set_anim(fire_bishop, self, { name = 'twohand_attack_4', loop = false })
		character_util.jump(fire_bishop, 10, 1.15)
		character_util.move_to_async(fire_bishop, center_pos, 1.15)

		--총 애니 시간 1.5초, 내려찍기 시작시간 1.15초로 하여, 내려찍는 타이밍에 지정 위치에 도착할 수 있도록.
		--비슈바크 날아가는 1.15초 대기.
		--아래 항목 동시에 실행.
		--비슈바크 도착한 위치에서 (up, idle, twohand_attack_4)
		--화면 0.3 / 0.3 shake 실행.
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
		--비슈바크 중심으로 fx_cwp_bishop_volcano_explosion, Fx_lasthit 이펙트 실행.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_01')
		self.fx.volcano_explosion():Instantiate(fire_bishop.Position)
		--비슈바크 중심으로 Fx_lasthit 이펙트 실행.
		self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(fire_bishop.Position)

		--1초 대기.
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--비슈바크 fx_fire_bishop_teleport 실행하여 제거.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_character_warp_04')
		self.fx.fire_bishop_teleport():Instantiate(fire_bishop.Position)
		character_util.set_position(fire_bishop, vector(999, 0, 999))
	end
end

function local_class:second_boat_interact_scene()
	local boat = self.lava_boat:get(2)

	--보트 승차 ( 카메라 보트 타케팅 되어있는 상태 )
	self.lava_boat:ride_async(boat)

	start_coroutine(self.second_action_scene, self)

	--카메라 타게팅 분리 전 까지 이동
	do
		local wp = {}
		local count = 5
		for i = 1, count do
			local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s25_lava_move_pos_2_' .. i)

			table.insert(wp, pos)
		end

		self.lava_boat:move_with_end_callback(boat, wp)
		self.lava_boat:wait_move_end()
	end

	--보트 지그재그 이동. 카메라 동선 분리.( 카메라와 보트는 같은 지점에 같은 시간에 도착해야한다. )
	do
		local wp = {}
		local count = 12
		for i = 5, count do
			local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s25_lava_move_pos_2_' .. i)

			table.insert(wp, pos)
		end

		local camera_duration = self:calculate_wp_duration_to_speed(wp, self.lava_boat.speed)
		local camera_pos = wp[#wp]

		self.lava_boat:move_with_end_callback(boat, wp)

		camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, camera_duration, { end_target = boat })

		self.lava_boat:wait_move_end()
	end

	--카메라 타게팅 다시 보트인 상태로 마지막 이동.
	do
		local wp = {}
		local count = 14
		for i = 12, count do
			local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s25_lava_move_pos_2_' .. i)

			table.insert(wp, pos)
		end

		self.lava_boat:move_with_end_callback(boat, wp)
		self.lava_boat:wait_move_end()
	end

	self.lava_boat:get_out_async(boat, 'left')
end

	--라크리마 베리어 폭발 이펙트fx_co_exp_season2_barrier_broken 실행.

	self.fx.barrier_broken():Instantiate(lava_boat.Bounds.center, unity_class.quaternion.identity, lava_boat.Transform)

	--사슬 1 ~ 3번 오브젝트 각자 진행과 반대 방향으로 0.05초에 걸쳐 이동.
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				local duration = 0.05
				local angle_z = -40
				local distance = 10
				local move_pos = self:get_vector_by_euler_angle(angle_z, distance)

				self:local_move_async(chain_data[1], lava_boat.Transform, move_pos, duration)

				chain_data[1]:Dispose()
				chain_data[1] = nil
			end,
			function()
				local duration = 0.5
				local angle_z = 0
				local distance = 10
				local move_pos = self:get_vector_by_euler_angle(angle_z, distance)

				self:local_move_async(chain_data[2], lava_boat.Transform, move_pos, duration)

				chain_data[2]:Dispose()
				chain_data[2] = nil
			end,
			function()
				local duration = 0.5
				local angle_z = 40
				local distance = 10
				local move_pos = self:get_vector_by_euler_angle(angle_z, distance)

				self:local_move_async(chain_data[3], lava_boat.Transform, move_pos, duration)

				chain_data[3]:Dispose()
				chain_data[3] = nil
			end
	)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	companion_handler.is_hovering = false
	second_bishop_handler.is_hovering = false

	companion_boy.Transform.parent = nil
	second_bishop.Transform.parent = nil

	companion_trail:Dispose()
	companion_trail = nil

	bishop_trail:Dispose()
	bishop_trail = nil

	--fx_fire_bishop_teleport 가 실행되며, 라크리마 제거.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_character_warp_01')
	self.fx.fire_bishop_teleport():Instantiate(second_bishop.Position)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(second_bishop, active_state_type.disabled)

	--시온 Fx_blink 실행하여 제거.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_xellos_warp_01')
	self.fx.blink():Instantiate(companion_boy.Position)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(companion_boy, active_state_type.disabled)

	party_util.set_direction('right')
	party_util.remove_emotion()
end

function local_class:third_boat_interact_scene()
	local boat = self.lava_boat:get(3)
	local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s25_lava_move_pos_3_1')

	self.lava_boat:ride_async(boat)

	self.lava_boat:move_with_end_callback(boat, pos)
	self.lava_boat:wait_move_end()

	self.lava_boat:get_out_async(boat, 'right')

	local marker_boat = self.lava_boat:get(4)
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(marker_boat.Name, self.cs_controller.QuestId, true, marker_boat)
end

function local_class:fourth_boat_interact_scene()
	local boat = self.lava_boat:get(4)
	local loop_start = field_util.get_marker_pos('s25_lava_move_pos_4_2')
	local wp = {
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s25_lava_move_pos_4_1'),
		loop_start,
	}
	local repeat_wp = {
		loop_start,
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s25_lava_move_pos_4_3'),
	}

	self.lava_boat:ride_async(boat)

	self.lava_boat:move_with_end_callback(boat, wp)
	self.lava_boat:wait_move_end()

	start_coroutine(function()
		self:fourth_action_scene()
		self.lava_boat:stop_move()
	end)

	self.lava_boat:repeat_waypoint_move_async(boat, repeat_wp)

	self:section_end_scene()

	self.controller.progress_section()
end

function local_class:fourth_action_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.character.princess
	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy
	local companion_boy = self.character.companion_boy
	local first_bishop = self.character.first_bishop
	local second_bishop = self.character.second_bishop
	local fire_bishop = self.character.fire_bishop
	local party_group = { leader, princess, dragon_boy }
	local lava_boat = self.lava_boat:get(4)
	local fx_offset = vector(0, -0.25, 0)

	local bishops = { first_bishop, second_bishop, fire_bishop }

	for i = 1, #bishops do
		local bishop = bishops[i]
		scene_util.hide_weapon(bishop)
		message_system:SendSync(bishop, CS.Oak.CharacterBehaviourResetEvent.Instance)
	end

	local chain_1_angle_z = -100
	local chain_2_angle_z = -53
	local chain_3_angle_z = -30
	local first_bishop_offset = vector(-2.5, 1.5, -1.5)
	local second_bishop_offset = vector(-2, 1.5, 0)
	local fire_bishop_offset = vector(0, 2.5, 0)
	local camera_come_and_follow_async = function(start_fo, target_fo, move_duration, handler)
		--stage camera는 Character 혹은 iFieldObject의 Position을 접근하여 팔로잉 한다.
		--Position은 transfom.localPosition이며 부모가 있는 오브젝트를 팔로잉하기에 적합하지 않아 별도로 구현.
		local time_passed = 0
		local progress = 0
		local current_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero

		handler.is_move = true
		while time_passed < move_duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			progress = time_passed / move_duration
			current_pos = vector_util.lerp(start_fo.transform.position, target_fo.transform.position, progress)
			camera_util.set_position(current_pos, true)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		handler.is_move = false

		handler.is_follow = true
		while handler.is_follow do
			camera_util.set_position(target_fo.transform.position, true)

			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	--기르가스 (right, attack, idle) : 거의 다 왔어…! 이제 조금이면…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'right',
			nil, 'attack', 'fw_main_s25_1')

	--화면 0.3 / 0.3 shake 실행.
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

	--시온 : [shout] 그마아아아안!!!
	--화면 0.3 / 0.3 shake 실행.
	--위치 x 0.2 / y 0.5
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(companion_boy, self,
			nil, nil, nil, {
				key = 'fw_main_s25_2',
				bubble_direction = 'none',
				skip = true,
				viewport_pos = vector(0.2, 0.5),
				scale = 1.3
			})

	party_util.set_direction('left')
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'attack' })

	--시온 해당 지점에서 Y 3 높은 상태로 배치.
	do
		local npc_data = {
			companion_boy = {
				dir = 'right',
				anim = 'idle',
				emo = 'attack',
				marker_name = 'default_start',
				offset = vector(999, 0, 999),
			},
		}
		self:set_by_npc_data(npc_data)

		companion_boy.Position = lava_boat.Position + vector(-5, 2, 0)
		companion_boy.Transform.parent = lava_boat.Transform
	end

	--시온에게 fx_dv_companion_trail 이펙트 붙여줌.
	local companion_trail = self.fx.companion_trail():Instantiate(companion_boy.transform.position + fx_offset,
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, companion_boy.Transform)

	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 시온 중심으로 이동.
	local simple_camera_handler = {}
	start_coroutine(function()
		camera_come_and_follow_async(lava_boat, companion_boy, 1, simple_camera_handler)
	end)

	--시온 생성 위치에 fx_dv_glitch_kid 생성.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_05')
	self.fx.glitch_kid():Instantiate(companion_boy.Bounds.center, unity_class.quaternion.identity, companion_boy.Transform)
	wait_for_sec(3)

	while simple_camera_handler.is_move do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--0.3초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--시온 (right, attack, idle) : 도대체 네놈들은 왜 그러는 거야……!
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_boss_intro', state = 'event', mix = 1, volume = 0.6 })
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(companion_boy, self, 'right',
			nil, 'attack', 'fw_main_s25_3')

	--시온 0.02 / 지속 shake 시작.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(companion_boy, 0.02, 9999)

	--시온 (right, attack, idle) :  몇번이고 몇번이고 몇번이고 설명해도……!
	--크기 1.2
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(companion_boy, self, 'right',
			nil, 'attack', { key = 'fw_main_s25_4', skip = true, scale = 1.2 })

	--시온 (right, attack, idle) :  왜 자꾸 날 방해하는 거야?!!
	--크기 1.2
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(companion_boy, self, 'right',
			nil, 'attack', { key = 'fw_main_s25_5', skip = true, scale = 1.2 })

	--시온 (right, attack, idle) : 제발……!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(companion_boy, self, 'right',
			nil, 'attack', 'fw_main_s25_6')

	--시온 0.02 / 지속 shake 종료.
	character_util.stop_shake(companion_boy)

	--화면 0.3 / 0.3 shake 실행.
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

	--시온 (right, attack, idle) : [shout] 그만 하란 말이야!!!
	--크기 1.5
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(companion_boy, self, 'right',
			nil, { name = 'attack', keep = true },
			{ key = 'fw_main_s25_7', skip = true, scale = 1.5 })

	--0.3초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--아래 항목 동시에 실행.

	--플레이어 일행 (left, attack, cast)
	scene_util.set_group_direction(party_group, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_group_emotion(party_group, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_group_anim(party_group, self, 'cast')

	--사슬(dv_kusarigama) 1 ~ 3번 화면 배 오브젝트 직전 지점까지 0.5초에 걸쳐 이동.
	local chain_1
	local chain_2
	local chain_3
	local boat_camera_handler = {}

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				local duration = 0.5
				local distance = 10.5
				local offset = self:get_vector_by_euler_angle(chain_1_angle_z, distance)

				chain_1 = self.fx.kusarigama():Instantiate(lava_boat.Position + offset + first_bishop_offset,
						unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, -chain_1_angle_z), lava_boat.Transform)

				local move_pos = self:get_vector_by_euler_angle(chain_1_angle_z, 3)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_companion_chain_01')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
				self:local_move_async(chain_1, lava_boat.Transform, move_pos + first_bishop_offset, duration)
			end,
			function()
				local duration = 0.5
				local distance = 10.5
				local offset = self:get_vector_by_euler_angle(chain_2_angle_z, distance)

				chain_2 = self.fx.kusarigama():Instantiate(lava_boat.Position + offset + second_bishop_offset,
						unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, -chain_2_angle_z), lava_boat.Transform)

				local move_pos = self:get_vector_by_euler_angle(chain_2_angle_z, 3)
				self:local_move_async(chain_2, lava_boat.Transform, move_pos + second_bishop_offset, duration)
			end,
			function()
				local duration = 0.5
				local distance = 10.5
				local offset = self:get_vector_by_euler_angle(chain_3_angle_z, distance)

				chain_3 = self.fx.kusarigama():Instantiate(lava_boat.Position + offset + fire_bishop_offset,
						unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, -chain_3_angle_z), lava_boat.Transform)

				local move_pos = self:get_vector_by_euler_angle(chain_3_angle_z, 3)
				self:local_move_async(chain_3, lava_boat.Transform, move_pos + fire_bishop_offset, duration)
			end,
			function()
				simple_camera_handler.is_follow = false

				--카메라 0.5초에 걸쳐 플레이어 중심으로 이동.
				start_coroutine(function()
					camera_come_and_follow_async(companion_boy, lava_boat, 0.5, boat_camera_handler)
				end)

				while boat_camera_handler.is_move do
					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end
			end,
			function()
				music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0, 2)

				--0.7초 대기.
				wait_for_sec(0.2)

				--타임스케일 1/10
				local time_key = 'action'
				time_util.mod(time_key, 0.1)

				--아래 항목 동시에 실행.

				--플레이어 일행 (left, damaged, cast) 실행 유지.
				scene_util.set_group_emotion(party_group, self, 'damaged')

				--리얼타임 1초 대기.
				wait_for_sec(0.1)

				--화면 0.1초에 걸쳐 화이트 페이드 아웃.
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_01')
				screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.white)

				time_util.unmod(time_key)
			end
	)

	--화이트 시점에 세팅
	--칼로르, 라크리마, 비슈바크 모두 (left, attack, boong_attack_ready_loop) 상태로 배치.
	do
		local npc_data = {
			first_bishop = {
				dir = 'left',
				anim = 'boong_attack_ready_loop',
				emo = 'attack',
				marker_name = 'default_start',
				offset = vector(999, 0, 999),
			},
			second_bishop = {
				dir = 'left',
				anim = 'boong_attack_ready_loop',
				emo = 'attack',
				marker_name = 'default_start',
				offset = vector(999, 0, 999),
			},
			fire_bishop = {
				dir = 'left',
				anim = 'boong_attack_ready_loop',
				emo = 'attack',
				marker_name = 'default_start',
				offset = vector(999, 0, 999),
			},
		}
		self:set_by_npc_data(npc_data)

		local bounds_offset = vector(0, -0.5, 0)
		first_bishop.Position = lava_boat.Position + first_bishop_offset + bounds_offset
		first_bishop.Transform.parent = lava_boat.Transform

		second_bishop.Position = lava_boat.Position + second_bishop_offset + bounds_offset
		second_bishop.Transform.parent = lava_boat.Transform

		fire_bishop.Position = lava_boat.Position + fire_bishop_offset + bounds_offset
		fire_bishop.Transform.parent = lava_boat.Transform
	end

	--플레이어 일행 (left, attack, cast)
	scene_util.set_group_direction(party_group, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_group_emotion(party_group, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_group_anim(party_group, self, 'cast')

	--시온 (right, attack, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(companion_boy, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(companion_boy, self, 'attack')
	character_util.remove_anim(companion_boy)

	--화신들과 사슬 사이에 fx_twosword_oppose_spark 실행.
	local fx_spark_1
	local fx_spark_2
	local fx_spark_3
	do
		local distance = 0.4
		local offset_1 = self:get_vector_by_euler_angle(chain_1_angle_z, distance)

		fx_spark_1 = self.fx.oppose_spark():Instantiate(lava_boat.Position + offset_1 + first_bishop_offset,
				unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -30, 0), lava_boat.Transform)

		local offset_2 = self:get_vector_by_euler_angle(chain_2_angle_z, distance)

		fx_spark_2 = self.fx.oppose_spark():Instantiate(lava_boat.Position + offset_2 + second_bishop_offset,
				unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 30, 0), lava_boat.Transform)

		local offset_3 = self:get_vector_by_euler_angle(chain_3_angle_z, distance)

		fx_spark_3 = self.fx.oppose_spark():Instantiate(lava_boat.Position + offset_3 + fire_bishop_offset,
				unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 45, 0), lava_boat.Transform)
	end

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--화면 0.05/ 지속 shake 시작.
	camera_util.shake(0.05, 9999)

	--0.1초에 걸쳐 화이트 페이드 인.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_run', state = 'event' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_villain_explosion_02')
	local light_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_light_loop_06', loop = true, volume = 0.4 })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.1, unity_class.color.black)

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--기르가스 (left, smile, idle) : [shout] 이… 이모들!!!
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'left',
			nil, 'smile', 'fw_main_s25_8')

	--칼로르 (left, attack, boong_attack_ready_loop) : [shout] 어이…! 아직…! 안 끝났다고…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(first_bishop, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s25_9')

	--라크리마 (left, attack, boong_attack_ready_loop) : [shout] 당신을 보낼 수는……!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(second_bishop, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s25_10')

	--비슈바크 (left, attack, boong_attack_ready_loop) : [shout] 죽어도…! 넌 못보내…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s25_11')

	--시온 (right, attack, idle) : [shout] 또… 또또또!!!
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(companion_boy, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s25_12')

	--시온 (right, attack, idle) : [shout] 제발 날 그만 좀 방해하라고!!!
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(companion_boy, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s25_13')

	--칼로르 (left, attack, boong_attack_ready_loop) : [shout] 어서 가 조카!!!
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(first_bishop, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s25_14')

	--기르가스 (left, attack, idle) : [shout] ……응! 고마워 이모들!!
	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(light_loop_sfx, 1)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s25_15')

	boat_camera_handler.is_follow = false
	camera_util.cancel_shake()

	--루프 공간에 그리드 영역 무시한 채 카메라 연두 지점까지 1초에 걸쳐 이동.
	do
		local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s25_lava_move_pos_4_5')

		camera_util.move_async(target_pos, 1, { ignorecameragrids = false })
	end

	chain_1:Dispose()
	chain_1 = nil

	chain_2:Dispose()
	chain_2 = nil

	chain_3:Dispose()
	chain_3 = nil

	fx_spark_1:Dispose()
	fx_spark_1 = nil

	fx_spark_2:Dispose()
	fx_spark_2 = nil

	fx_spark_3:Dispose()
	fx_spark_3 = nil

	companion_trail:Dispose()
	companion_trail = nil

	for i = 1, #bishops do
		local bishop = bishops[i]
		scene_util.show_weapon(bishop)
		message_system:SendSync(bishop, CS.Oak.CharacterBehaviourResetEvent.Instance)
	end

	companion_boy.Transform.parent = nil
	second_bishop.Transform.parent = nil
	fire_bishop.Transform.parent = nil

	field_object_util.set_active_state(first_bishop, active_state_type.disabled)
	first_bishop.transform.parent = nil

	field_object_util.set_active_state(second_bishop, active_state_type.disabled)
	second_bishop.transform.parent = nil

	field_object_util.set_active_state(fire_bishop, active_state_type.disabled)
	fire_bishop.transform.parent = nil

	field_object_util.set_active_state(companion_boy, active_state_type.disabled)
	companion_boy.transform.parent = nil
end

function local_class:section_end_scene()
	local boat = self.lava_boat:get(4)
	local start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s25_lava_move_pos_4_4')
	local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s25_lava_move_pos_4_6')

	--배 오브젝트 좌측 공간 위치에 정렬.
	self.lava_boat:set_boat_and_passenger_pos(boat, start_pos)

	--배 오브젝트가 기본 속도(5를) 우측에 배치된 통로 오브젝트를 통과하여 이동.
	self.lava_boat:move_with_end_callback(boat, target_pos)

	--대문 통과하는 시간
	wait_for_sec(2.8)

	--이후 아래의 항목 동시에 실행.
	local chain_data = {}

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				do
					local duration = 0.2
					local distance = 0.7
					local first_shot = true
					local start_offset = {
						vector(-20, 7, -10),
						vector(-30, 20, -10),
						vector(-20, 23, -10),
						vector(-20, 33, -10),
						vector(-40, 10, 00),
						vector(-30, 16, 00),
						vector(-20, 30, 00),
						vector(-40, 5, 10),
						vector(-30, 13, 10),
						vector(-20, 26, 10),
						vector(-10, 23, -10),
						vector(-10, 26, 10),
						vector(-30, 26, 00),
						vector(-33, 26, -10),
					}
					for i = 1, #start_offset do

--EaseOutQuint 이동 연출
---@param fo FieldObject 호버링할 오브젝트
---@param target_pos Vector3 도착 위치
---@param duration number 소요 시간
---@param is_fly boolean fly 여부
function local_class:ease_out_quint_move_async(fo, target_pos, duration, is_fly)
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = fo.Position

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = interpolations_constants.ease_out_quint(time_passed, 0, 1, duration)
		local position = vector_util.lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)

		character_util.set_position(fo, position, is_fly)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.set_position(fo, target_pos, is_fly)
end

---@param handler self 루틴 관리용
---@param fo FieldObject 호버링할 오브젝트
---@param speed number 속도
---@param hover_height number 호버링 높이
function local_class:hovering_routine(handler, fo, speed, hover_height)
	local time_passed = 0
	local default_y = fo.Position.y
	local current_y = 0

	handler.is_hovering = true
	while handler.is_hovering do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		current_y = math.sin(math.pi * 2 * time_passed * speed) * hover_height + default_y
		fo.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position, current_y)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

--부모(followingTarget)가 있는 PooledObject의 localposition 이동을 구현
--TODO : UnityObjectPool 내부에 지정된 parent는 접근이 불가능했다. 방법이 있다면 굳이 parent 매개 변수를 선언 안해도 된다.
--pooled_object_util에 구현 여부 확인 필요.
---@param fo FieldObject 이동 오브젝트
---@param parent Transform 부모로 삼을 트랜스폼 ( followingTarget )
---@param local_target_pos Vector3 부모 자식 간의 로컬 거리
---@param duration number 이동 시간
function local_class:local_move_async(fo, following_target, local_target_pos, duration)
	if following_target == nil then
		return
	end

	local start_offset = fo.transform.position - following_target.position
	local progress = 0
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local target_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local current_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		progress = time_passed / duration
		start_pos = following_target.position + start_offset
		target_pos = following_target.position + local_target_pos
		current_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
		fo.transform.localPosition = current_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

--Euler 기준 z축 회전에 따른 좌표값 가져오는 함수
---@param euler_angle number 각도
---@param distance number 거리
function local_class:get_vector_by_euler_angle(euler_angle, distance)
	local radians = math.rad(90 - euler_angle)
	local x = math.cos(radians)
	local y = math.sin(radians)
	return vector(x, y, 0) * distance
end

--waypoint를 특정 speed만큼 이동 시 소요되는 시간 계산
---@param wp Vector3[] 이동 동선
---@param speed number 이동 속도
function local_class:calculate_wp_duration_to_speed(wp, speed)
	--waypoint가 없다고 판단.
	if #wp < 2 then
		return 0
	end

	local max_distance = 0

	for i = 1, #wp - 1 do
		local distance = vector_util.distance(wp[i + 1], wp[i])
		max_distance = max_distance + distance
	end

	return max_distance / speed
end

--zone 안에 랜덤 vector3 좌표 반환.
--zone_util.get_random_pos는 zone의 y값을 사용하지 않아 제작.
---@param zone string | Zone 이동 동선
function local_class:get_zone_random_pos(zone)
	if type_util.is_string(zone) then
		zone = field_util.get_zone(zone)
	end

	-- zone.Bounds 데이터 캐싱
	local bounds = zone.Bounds

	--Zone 생성 시 Region.cs의 WorldSpaceBounds를 사용하여 y의 폭을 100만큼 증가 시킨다.
	--하여 타일맵에서 지정한 y폭 값을 우회 적으로 사용하기 위해 height를 자체적으로 구하고 center 기준으로 양분한다.
	local height = bounds.max.y + bounds.min.y

	-- min, max 값 설정
	local min = { x = bounds.min.x, y = bounds.center.y - height * 0.5, z = bounds.min.z }
	local max = { x = bounds.max.x, y = bounds.center.y + height * 0.5, z = bounds.max.z }

	local pos = unity_class.vector3.zero

	-- 계산된 min, max의 랜덤 값을 추출
	pos.x = unity_class.random.Range(min.x, max.x)
	pos.y = unity_class.random.Range(min.y, max.y)
	pos.z = unity_class.random.Range(min.z, max.z)

	return pos
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated')
end

function local_class:start()
	self.fx:create_all()
	screen_util.preload_boss_title()

	start_coroutine(function()
		self.dynamic_npcs:load_async()

		self:set_npc_presets_for_state()
		self:set_npc_with_data(self.npc_presets[self.states.npc_setting])

		if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
			screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')

			sp_util.enter_scene()

			camera_util.move_async(self.character.boss_volcano_mana.Position, 0)

			self.shake_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_03', volume = 0.6,
			                                              loop = true, fade_in_time = 1 })
			screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		end

		self:start_scene()

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, user_party.Leader)
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	if self.dynamic_npcs ~= nil then
		self.dynamic_npcs:dispose()
	end

	self.dynamic_npcs = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.boss_battle.group_names then
		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene()

			--보스 처치 후 1초에 걸쳐 페이드 아웃.
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			self:set_npc_with_data(self.npc_presets[self.states.npc_setting])

			self:battle_end_scene()
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_npc_with_data(data)
	for i = 1, #data do
		local npc_preset = data[i]

		local npc
		if npc_preset.type == 'static' then
			if npc_preset.name == 'leader' then
				npc = get_party_leader()
			else
				npc = get_character(npc_preset.name)
			end
		else
			npc = self.dynamic_npcs:get(npc_preset.name)
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		npc.CharacterStatsBehaviour:ResetAllAilments()

		if data[i].pos ~= nil then
			character_util.set_position(npc, data[i].pos)
		end

		if data[i].dir ~= nil then
			character_util.set_direction(npc, data[i].dir)
		end

		if data[i].emo ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, data[i].emo)
		end

		if data[i].anim ~= nil then
			if type_util.is_table(data[i].anim) then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, data[i].anim)
			else
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = data[i].anim, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if data[i].oneline ~= nil then
			npc.Interactable.Talk = data[i].oneline
		end

		if data[i].active ~= nil then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, data[i].active)
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)
		end
	end
end

	--기르가스 (up, idle, jingak 1회)를 0.7초간 실행 후, 발 구르는 타이밍에 화면 0.3 / 0.3 shake, Fx_lasthit 실행.

	scene_util.set_anim(dragon_boy, self, { name = 'jingak', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_slash_03')
	self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(dragon_boy.Position)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

	--카메라 화산의 마나 중심으로 0.5초에 걸쳐 패닝.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--기르가스 shake 종료.
	character_util.stop_shake(dragon_boy)
	--기르가스 (up, idle, jingak 1회[정지]) : [shout] 우리 엄마를 토해내!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s26_75')

	--0.3초 대기.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_event_fw_05')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--화산의 마나 본체 + 양 손 (down, angry, phase_cast) 실행 후 phase_cast_loop 로 전환.
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				scene_util.set_emotion(boss_volcano_mana, self, 'angry')
				scene_util.set_anim_async(boss_volcano_mana, self, { name = 'phase_cast', count = 1 })

				scene_util.set_anim(boss_volcano_mana, self, 'phase_cast_loop')
			end,
			function()
				scene_util.set_anim_async(left_hand, self, { name = 'phase_cast', count = 1 })

				scene_util.set_anim(left_hand, self, 'phase_cast_loop')
			end,
			function()
				scene_util.set_anim_async(right_hand, self, { name = 'phase_cast', count = 1 })

				scene_util.set_anim(right_hand, self, 'phase_cast_loop')
			end
	)

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--아래 연출 동시에 실행.
	--화산의 마나 본체 + 양 손 (down, angry, phase_action) 실행 후 마지막 자세 정지.
	--양 손이 도착하는 위치에 Fx_lasthit, fx_boss_volcano_mana_lavafist_attack 실행.

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				scene_util.set_emotion(boss_volcano_mana, self, 'angry')
				scene_util.set_anim(boss_volcano_mana, self, { name = 'phase_action', loop = false })
			end,
			function()
				scene_util.set_anim(left_hand, self, { name = 'phase_action', loop = false })
				wait_for_sec(0.6)

				self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(left_hand.Position + vector(0, 0, -3))
				self.fx.boss_volcanomana_lavafist_stomp():Instantiate(left_hand.Position + vector(0, 0, -3))
			end,
			function()
				scene_util.set_anim(right_hand, self, { name = 'phase_action', loop = false })
				wait_for_sec(0.6)

				camera_util.shake(0.5, 0.3)
				self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(right_hand.Position + vector(0, 0, -3))
				self.fx.boss_volcanomana_lavafist_stomp():Instantiate(right_hand.Position + vector(0, 0, -3))
			end
	)

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--아래 연출 동시에 실행.
	--화산의 마나 본체 + 양 손 (down, vomiting, phase_action[정지])
	scene_util.set_emotion(boss_volcano_mana, self, 'vomiting')
	--화면 0.3 / 2 shake 실행.
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 2)
	--화신의 마나 입 위치에 fx_pixy_roar 이펙트 실행.
	local roar = self.fx.pixy_roar():Instantiate(self.pivot_pos.s26(1) + vector(0, 2, 0))

	--이후 보스 텍스트 출력.
	local duration = 2

	--메인 텍스트 = 영원의 불꽃
	--서브 텍스트 = 볼베르 화산의 마나
	screen_util.show_boss_title('fw_main_s26_boss_title', 'fw_main_s26_boss_sub_title',
			duration, false)

	--카메라 보스 룸 줌으로 조정.
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(6, 1)

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	roar:Dispose()

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--카메라 플레이어 중심으로 0.5초에 걸쳐서 이동.
				camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
			end,
			function()
				--아래의 항목 동시에 실행.
				--화산의 마나 본체 + 양 손 (down, idle, up_idle) 실행 후 idle 유지.
				scene_util.set_group_anim({ boss_volcano_mana, left_hand, right_hand }, self,
						{ name = 'up_idle', next_anim = 'idle' })
				wait_for_sec(1.167)
			end
	)

	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()
	character_util.remove_emotion(boss_volcano_mana)
	character_util.remove_anim(boss_volcano_mana)
	character_util.remove_anim(left_hand)
	character_util.remove_anim(right_hand)
	--idle 전환되면서 손 아래 그림자 생성.

	if self.shake_sfx ~= nil then
		music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.shake_sfx, 1)
		self.shake_sfx = nil
	end

	music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'combat' })

	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({
			name = 'ondemand/v3_31_fireworld/audio:bgm_fireworld_boss_001', state = 'field', mix = 0 })
	else
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 0)

		if self.controller.shake_sfx ~= nil then
			music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.controller.shake_sfx, 1)
		end
	end

	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(boss_volcano_mana)

	-- 보스가 리더를 발각
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(boss_volcano_mana, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(left_hand, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(right_hand, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(left_hand, 'right')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(right_hand, 'left')

	-- 보스 hp 바가 공격하지 않아도 바로 보이도록
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.ShowBossHPEvent.Create(boss_volcano_mana))
end

function local_class:battle_end_scene()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy
	local princess = self.character.princess
	local fire_dragon_king = self.character.fire_dragon_king
	local first_bishop = self.character.first_bishop
	local second_bishop = self.character.second_bishop
	local fire_bishop = self.character.fire_bishop

	local boss_volcano_mana = self.character.boss_volcano_mana
	local boss_volcano_mana_phase_2 = self.character.boss_volcano_mana_phase_2
	local left_hand = self.character.boss_left_hand
	local right_hand = self.character.boss_right_hand
	local left_hand_phase_2 = self.character.boss_left_hand_phase_2
	local right_hand_phase_2 = self.character.boss_right_hand_phase_2

	local companion_boy = self.character.companion_boy
	local companion_blind = self.dynamic_npcs:get('companion_blind')
	local companion_girl = self.dynamic_npcs:get('companion_girl')

	local pivot_pos = self.pivot_pos.s26(1)

	character_util.convert_to_npc(boss_volcano_mana)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(left_hand)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(right_hand)

	--암전 시점에서 아래 세팅 진행.
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(fire_dragon_king, 0, 0)
	character_util.force_update_spines(fire_dragon_king, 0.5)

	--플레이어 일행 (up, idle, idle) 상태.
	--보스 (down, groggy, idle) 상태.
	--카메라 화산의 마나 보스 중심으로 설정.
	scene_util.set_emotion(boss_volcano_mana, self, 'grogy')
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(boss_volcano_mana, 0)
	camera_util.resize_to_default_async(0)

	local amb_void_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_amb_void_01', loop = true })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--기르가스 (up, idle, idle) : 허억… 허어억…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s27_1')

	--기르가스 (up, idle, idle) : 이제 좀 작작하고 뱉어내라고!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'fw_main_s27_2')

	--0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_event_fw_06')
	character_util.shake(boss_volcano_mana, 0.3, 0.3)
	--2초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--화산의 마나 + 양 손 (down, vomiting, vomiting) 실행 후 마지막 자세에서 정지.
	scene_util.set_emotion(boss_volcano_mana, self, 'vomiting')
	scene_util.set_anim(boss_volcano_mana, self, { name = 'vomiting', loop = false, next_anim = 'vomiting_loop' })
	scene_util.set_anim(left_hand, self, { name = 'vomiting', loop = false, next_anim = 'vomiting_loop' })
	scene_util.set_anim(right_hand, self, { name = 'vomiting', loop = false, next_anim = 'vomiting_loop' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--화산의 마나 0.3 / 0.3 shake 실행 + 지속 shake 제거.
	character_util.stop_shake(boss_volcano_mana)
	character_util.shake(boss_volcano_mana, 0.3, 0.3)

	--타임스케일 0.1 설정.
	local slow_key = 'slow_key'
	time_util.mod(slow_key, 0.1)

	--아래 항목 동시에 실행.

	--니드호그 화산의 마나 본체 중심에서 (left, damaged, prostrate) 상태로 생성되어, 지정된 위치까지 0.5초에 걸쳐 이동.
	scene_util.set_anim(fire_dragon_king, self, { name = 'prostrate' })

	--카메라 니드호그 도착 지점까지 0.5초에 걸쳐 이동 + 0.5초에 걸쳐 알파 1로 상승.
	fire_dragon_king.Position = self.pivot_pos.s26(1) + vector(0, 2.7, 0)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(fire_dragon_king, active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(fire_dragon_king, 1, 0.5)

	do
		local wp = pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, -1)
		local move_dur = 0.5

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fire_dragon_king, wp, nil, 0.5, self, nil)

		--위 항목 시작 후 리얼타임 1초 대기.
		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		--타임스케일 1 설정.
		time_util.unmod(slow_key)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_dark_03')

		camera_util.move(wp, move_dur)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

		--니드호그 도착하는 위치에 Fx_lasthit 실행.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
		self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(fire_dragon_king.Position)
	end

	--화산의 마나 + 마나의 손 (idle, idle) 실행.
	--character_util.remove_emotion(boss_volcano_mana)
	--character_util.remove_group_anim({ boss_volcano_mana, left_hand, right_hand })
	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--화산의 마나 + 마나의 손 (down, angry, crash_down) 을 실행하며 Y - 10 으로 이동한 뒤 제거.
	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(amb_void_sfx, 1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_event_fw_07')
	scene_util.set_emotion(boss_volcano_mana, self, 'angry')
	scene_util.set_anim(boss_volcano_mana, self, { name = 'crash_down', scale = 0.5 })
	scene_util.set_anim(left_hand, self, { name = 'crash_down', scale = 0.5 })
	scene_util.set_anim(right_hand, self, { name = 'crash_down', scale = 0.5 })
	wait_for_sec(3)

	local boss_wp = {
		[boss_volcano_mana] = {
			boss_volcano_mana.Position + vector(0, -10, 1),
		},
		[left_hand] = {
			left_hand.Position + vector(0, -20, 1),
		},
		[right_hand] = {
			right_hand.Position + vector(0, -20, 1),
		},
	}

	for fo, wp in pairs(boss_wp) do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fo, wp, nil, 1, self, nil,
				{ run = false, end_callback = function()
					field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.disabled)
				end })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

	--0.3초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--기르가스 (up, idle, jump 1회) : [shout] 어, 엄마!!!
	--크기 1.2
	--화면 0.3 / 0.3 shake 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fireworld_boss_lavasqueeze_explosion_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	local blizzard_loop = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_blizzard_04', loop = true, volume = 0.4, fade_in_time = 1 })
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
	character_util.normal_jump(dragon_boy, true)
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, { key = 'fw_main_s27_3', scale = 1.2, skip = true })

	--기르가스, 꼬마공주 (up, idle, run) 상태로 0.2초에 걸쳐 이동 후 니드호그 방향 idle로 바라봄.
	do
		local wp_key = 'princess_wp'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dragon_boy, fire_dragon_king.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
				nil, 0.2, self, wp_key, { run = true, play_sfx = true, last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, fire_dragon_king.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
				nil, 0.2, self, wp_key, { run = true, last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--기르가스 (right, tired, eat) : 괜찮아?! 살아있는 거지!!
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'right',
			'eat', 'tired', 'fw_main_s27_4')

	--1초 대기
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(eat_sfx)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--니드호그 0.02 / 0.2 shake 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(fire_dragon_king, 0.02, 0.2)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--니드호그 0.02 / 0.2 shake 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(fire_dragon_king, 0.02, 0.2)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--니드호그 (left, tired, seat) 실행 후 유지.

	scene_util.set_emotion(fire_dragon_king, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(fire_dragon_king, self, 'seat')

	--0.3초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--플레이어 일행 전체 (현재 방향, smile, jump 1회) 실행.

	character_util.normal_jump(leader, true)

	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'smile')
	character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)

	scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'smile')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(dragon_boy, true)

	--0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--기르가스 (right, cry, cast) : 엄마! 괜찮은 거지?! 나 정말 걱정…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_cry_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'cast', keep = true }, { name = 'cry', keep = true }, 'fw_main_s27_5')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--아래 항목 동시에 실행.

	--기르가스 (right, attack, jump 1회) 실행.
	scene_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'attack')
	character_util.remove_anim(dragon_boy)
	character_util.normal_jump(dragon_boy, true)

	--니드호그 (left, tired, seat)[유지] : ……우리 아들. 오랜만에 이 엄마 걱정해 준 거야?
	character_util.remove_anim(fire_dragon_king)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_dragon_king, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'seat', keep = true }, { name = 'tired', keep = true },
			'fw_main_s27_6')

	--기르가스 (right, attack, cast2) : …거, 걱정하는 게 당연하잖아! 아줌마!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'cast2', keep = true }, 'attack', 'fw_main_s27_7')

	--기르가스 (right, attack, cast2) : 참 나! 자기 멋대로 행동해 버리고선…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'right',
			'cast2', 'attack', 'fw_main_s27_8')

	--니드호그 (left, smile, seat) : 하하… 우리 아들 답네!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_dragon_king, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'seat', keep = true }, { name = 'tired', keep = true },
			'fw_main_s27_9')

	--니드호그 (left, tired, seat) : 오랜만에… 감동적인 부자 상봉을 하고 싶지만…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_dragon_king, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'seat', keep = true }, { name = 'tired', keep = true },
			'fw_main_s27_10')

	--아래 항목 동시에 실행.
	--니드호그 0.01 / 2 shake 실행.
	character_util.shake(fire_dragon_king, 0.01, 2)

	--니드호그 (left, tired, seat) 상태에서 (right, idle, idle) 자세로 2초간 이어져서 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(fire_dragon_king, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(fire_dragon_king, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(fire_dragon_king, self, { name = 'idle', mix_duration = 2, count = 1 })

	--기르가스 (right, attack, idle) : 엄마! 쓸데없이 움직이지 마! 아직…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'right',
			'idle', { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'fw_main_s27_11')

	--니드호그 (left, tired, idle) : 기르가스. 싸움은 아직 끝나지 않았어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_dragon_king, self, 'left',
			nil, 'tired', 'fw_main_s27_12')

	--니드호그 (left, tired, idle)[유지] : 날 뱉어냈을 뿐… 아직 영원의 불꽃은 힘이 남아있는 상태야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_dragon_king, self, 'left',

				do

					local time_passed = 0

						if index % 2 == 1 then
							self.fx.lava_drop():Instantiate(fx.transform.localPosition)

						index = index + 1

							fx.transform.localPosition = vector_util.lerp(wp.end_pos, wp.start_pos, progress)
