		if npc == nil then
			if npc_data.name == 'leader' then
				npc = user_party.Leader
			else
				return
			end
		end

		if npc_data.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_data.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		npc_data.active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_data.active_state)

		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_info ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim_info == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			elseif type_util.is_table(npc_data.anim_info) then
				npc_data.anim_info.one_shot_sfx = false

				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, npc_data.anim_info)
			elseif type_util.is_string(npc_data.anim_info) then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_data.anim_info, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.keep_shake ~= nil and npc_data.keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if npc_data.scale_factor ~= nil then
			character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, npc.Name, npc_data.scale_factor)
		end

		if npc_data.tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc_data.tint_color_key, npc_data.tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if npc_data.talk ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk) then
			if not lua_helper.type_compare(npc.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
				npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			end

			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_data.talk
		end

		if npc_data.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_data.talk_sfx
		end

		if npc_data.hitbox ~= nil then
			npc.Hitbox = npc_data.hitbox
		end
	end)

--- 슬로우 이펙트 생성
function local_class:instantiate_scalable_speed_effect(effect_pool, key, pos, speed_multiplier)
	local effect = effect_pool:Instantiate(pos)

	local effect_data = {
		effect = effect,
		instantiate_time = unity_class.time.time,
		speed_multiplier = speed_multiplier,
		--- 파티클 시스템 접근
		particle_systems = effect:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem))
	}

	self.scalable_speed_effects[key] = effect_data
end

--- 이펙트 속도 변경
function local_class:change_effect_speed(key, reset)
	local effect_data = self.scalable_speed_effects[key]

	if effect_data ~= nil and effect_data.particle_systems ~= nil then
		for i = 0, effect_data.particle_systems.Length - 1 do
			local effect_particle_system = effect_data.particle_systems[i]
			local main = effect_particle_system.main

			if not lua_helper.reference_equals(effect_data.effect, effect_particle_system) then
				effect_data.origin_speed = main.simulationSpeed
			end

			if reset then
				-- dispose 할 때 원복
				main.simulationSpeed = effect_data.origin_speed
			else
				main.simulationSpeed = main.simulationSpeed * effect_data.speed_multiplier
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 이펙트 제거
function local_class:dispose_scalable_speed_effect(key)
	self:change_effect_speed(key, true)

	if self.scalable_speed_effects ~= nil and self.scalable_speed_effects[key] ~= nil then
		self.scalable_speed_effects[key].effect:Dispose()
		self.scalable_speed_effects[key].effect = nil
		self.scalable_speed_effects[key].instantiate_time = nil
		self.scalable_speed_effects[key].speed_multiplier = nil
		self.scalable_speed_effects[key].particle_systems = nil
		self.scalable_speed_effects[key] = nil
	end
end

return local_class

	--생성될 용암 발판의 위치를 비교할 좌표값들 셋팅
	for i = 1, self.total_plates_to_generate do
		table.insert(self.check_lava_plate_pos_list, self.marker.plate('s1', i))
	end

	local rock = self.field_object.rock()

	--바위 오브젝트 활성화
	field_object_util.set_active_state(rock, active_state_type.enabled)
end

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.LavaRockChangedEvent), 'on_lava_rock_changed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent), 'on_reset_switch_turned_on_event')
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.LavaRockChangedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent))

	if self.loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.loop_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_lava_rock_changed_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none then
		for i = 1, #self.check_lava_plate_pos_list do
			local target_pos = e.Target.Position
			local compare_pos = self.check_lava_plate_pos_list[i]

			if target_pos.x == compare_pos.x and target_pos.z == compare_pos.z then
				self.created_lava_plate = self.created_lava_plate + 1

				if self.created_lava_plate == self.total_plates_to_generate then
					self.current_state = self.states.sting_event

					sp_util.start_scene(self.play_appear_sting_event, self)
				end

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_reset_switch_turned_on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, self.field_object.bucket_reset_switch()) then
		self.created_lava_plate = 0

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:play_appear_sting_event()
	local sting = self.character.sting()
	local chicken_a = self.character.chicken_a()
	local knight = user_party.Leader
	local princess = self.character.princess()
	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy()
	local fire_bishop = self.character.fire_bishop()

	local portal_center = self.marker.portal_center()
	local knight_cur_pos = user_party.Leader.Position
	local knight_end_pos = self.marker.knight('s1', 1, 1)
	local wp_list = {}

	local compare_pos_1 = self.marker.runaway_route('s1', 1)
	local compare_pos_2 = self.marker.runaway_route('s1', 2)
	local compare_pos_3 = self.marker.runaway_route('s1', 3)

	if knight_cur_pos.z > portal_center.z then
		if (knight_cur_pos.x > (compare_pos_1.x - 1) and knight_cur_pos.z < (compare_pos_1.z + 1)) and
				(knight_cur_pos.x < compare_pos_2.x and knight_cur_pos.z > (compare_pos_2.z - 1)) then
			table.insert(wp_list, vector(compare_pos_2.x, knight_cur_pos.y, knight_cur_pos.z))
			table.insert(wp_list, vector(compare_pos_2.x, knight_cur_pos.y, knight_end_pos.z))
		else
			if knight_cur_pos.x < portal_center.x then
				table.insert(wp_list, vector(knight_cur_pos.x, knight_cur_pos.y, compare_pos_1.z))
				table.insert(wp_list, compare_pos_2)
				table.insert(wp_list, vector(compare_pos_2.x, knight_cur_pos.y, knight_end_pos.z))
			else
				table.insert(wp_list, vector(knight_cur_pos.x, knight_cur_pos.y, knight_end_pos.z))
			end
		end
	else
		if (knight_cur_pos.x > (compare_pos_3.x - 1) and knight_cur_pos.z < (compare_pos_3.z + 0.5)) and
				(knight_cur_pos.x < (knight_end_pos.x - 1) and knight_cur_pos.z < (knight_end_pos.z - 1.5)) then
			table.insert(wp_list, vector(knight_end_pos.x - 1, knight_cur_pos.y, knight_cur_pos.z))
			table.insert(wp_list, vector(knight_end_pos.x - 1, knight_cur_pos.y, knight_end_pos.z))
		else
			if knight_cur_pos.x < portal_center.x then
				table.insert(wp_list, vector(knight_cur_pos.x, knight_cur_pos.y, compare_pos_3.z))
			else
				table.insert(wp_list, vector(knight_cur_pos.x, knight_cur_pos.y, knight_end_pos.z))
			end
		end
	end

	table.insert(wp_list, knight_end_pos)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--플레이어 물통 던지는 연출 잠시 기다림
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--카메라 shake 0.8초 출력 (0.05 세기)

	camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.8)

	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	--플레이어(right, surprise, idle) normal_jump 1회 출력

	knight.Direction = look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.None and knight.Direction or look_dir
	direction_util.to_side_dir(knight.Direction)

	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.remove_anim(knight)
	character_util.normal_jump_async(knight, true)

	local align_key = 'party_wp'

	--동시연출

			function()
				self.loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })



				--플레이어(right, surprise, run) 상태로 6의 속도로 아래 원 위치로 이동
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, wp_list, 6, nil,
						self, align_key, { run = true, last_direction = 'left' })

				wait_for_sec(0.15)

				--파티원(idle, run) 상태로 위의 원 위치로 6의 속도로 이동
				for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do

local local_class = newclass('FireWorldMineCraftSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FireWorldMineCraft @
		Comment = @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type FireWorldMineCraftController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = { 'fireworld_2' }

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		before_gimmick_event = 2,
		gimmick_event = 3,
		clear_gimmick_event = 4,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.character = metatable_helper.inherit({}, self.controller.character)

	self.field_object = metatable_helper.inherit({}, self.controller.field_object)

	self.marker = metatable_helper.inherit({}, self.controller.marker)

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		smoke = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Common_SmokeScreen')
		end,
	})

	--region Sprite
	self.sprite = {
		sprite_info = {
			chicken = 21658,
			map = 21659,
		},
		sprite_table = {},
		sprite_table_origin_parent = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter, target, drop_type, skip_text)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		consumed = function(this, name, target)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				quest_drop_item_util.consumed(this.sprite_table[name], target)
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}

	self.play_sting_sing_loop = false

	--이벤트 존 넘어가 마지막 이벤트 시작 딜레이 플래그
	self.delay_last_event = false

	self.is_in_grid = false

	self.ambi_sfx = nil
	self.loop_sfx = nil
end

end

end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'sub_mine_craft_s1_1_trigger_zone') then
		if self.current_state == self.states.none then
			self.current_state = self.states.before_gimmick_event

			sp_util.start_scene(self.play_before_gimmick_event, self)

			return true
		else
			if self.delay_last_event then
				self.delay_last_event = false
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'minecraft_grid') then
		self.is_in_grid = true

		if self.current_state == self.states.clear_gimmick_event then
			local bgm_volume = 1
			if self.delay_last_event then
				speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.character.sting())

				bgm_volume = 0.6

				sp_util.start_scene(self.clear_gimmick_event, self, true)
			end

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'event', name = 'ondemand/v3_31_fireworld/audio:bgm_fireworld_lava_chicken', volume = bgm_volume})
		elseif self.current_state == self.states.gimmick_event then
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'event', name = 'ondemand/v3_31_fireworld/audio:bgm_fireworld_lava_chicken'})
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'minecraft_grid') then
		self.is_in_grid = false

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field', name = 'ondemand/v3_31_fireworld/audio:bgm_fireworld_human'})

		if not self.delay_last_event then
			self.delay_last_event = true

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.gimmick_event then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, self.field_object.lava_switch()) then
			self.current_state = self.states.clear_gimmick_event

function local_class:sting_sing_routine()
	local sting = self.character.sting()

	scene_util.set_emotion(sting, self, 'sing')
	scene_util.set_anim(sting, self, 'cast')

	self.current_state = self.states.gimmick_event

	self.play_sting_sing_loop = true

	local check_escape_loop = function()
		if not self.play_sting_sing_loop then
			return false
		end

		return true
	end

	local sting_speech = function(string_key, callback_func)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sting, { key = string_key, skip = false, auto_layout = true, bubble_direction = 'lt' })

		if not callback_func() then
			return false
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.25)

		return true
	end

	while self.play_sting_sing_loop do
		if not sting_speech('fw_sub_mine_craft_s2_2_0', check_escape_loop) then
			break
		end

		if not sting_speech('fw_sub_mine_craft_s2_2_1', check_escape_loop) then
			break
		end

		if not sting_speech('fw_sub_mine_craft_s2_2_2', check_escape_loop) then
			break
		end

		if not sting_speech('fw_sub_mine_craft_s2_2_3', check_escape_loop) then
			break
		end

		if not sting_speech('fw_sub_mine_craft_s2_2_4', check_escape_loop) then
			break
		end

		if not sting_speech('fw_sub_mine_craft_s2_2_5', check_escape_loop) then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if self.is_in_grid and not self.delay_last_event then
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(sting)

		sp_util.start_scene(self.clear_gimmick_event, self)
	end
end

	self.sprite:dispose('map')

	--스팅(right, scared, embarrassed))[shout 2.0 크기]: X좌표 12,345, Y좌표 -2,399, Z좌표 999나 떨어진 곳이잖아!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(sting, self, 'right',
			'embarrassed', { name = 'scared' }, 'fw_sub_mine_craft_s2_3_16')

	--스팅 right, damaged, dead 마지막에 유지
	scene_util.set_emotion(sting, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(sting, self, { name = 'dead', loop = false })

	--액션 상태 퀘스트 종료까지 지속 출력
	--스팅(right, cry): 열심히 파밍했는데… 다 필요 없어졌어.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(sting, self, 'right',
			nil, { name = 'cry', keep = true }, 'fw_sub_mine_craft_s2_3_17')

	--스팅 현재 상태에서 스타피스 출력하여, 자신 아래 1타일 착지
	local star_piece = get_field_object('mine_craft_star_piece')
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, sting.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0), sting.Position + vector(0, 0, -1))

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.ambi_sfx, 1)
	self.loop_sfx = nil

	--퀘스트 완료와 보상 획득 연출 진행
	self.controller:complete_quest()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field', name = 'ondemand/v3_31_fireworld/audio:bgm_fireworld_human', volume = 1})

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('FireWorldOniGirlPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = pre @
		QuestName = FireWorldOniGirl @
		Comment = @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type FireWorldOniGirlController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'fireworld_4'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		before_loaded = 1,
		before_interact_oni_girl = 2,
		in_interact_oni_girl = 3,
		before_accept_quest = 4,
		in_mini_game_start = 5,
		done = 99,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_loaded

	self.character = metatable_helper.inherit({}, self.controller.character)

	self.field_object = metatable_helper.inherit({}, self.controller.field_object)

	self.marker = metatable_helper.inherit({}, self.controller.marker)
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	quest_icon_util.pre_load()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	-- 초기 NPC 셋팅
	self.controller:set_pre_npc()

	self.controller:set_current_scene_npc(self.controller.section_state.pre_section)

	local oni_girl = self.character.oni_girl()
	character_util.add_listener(oni_girl, self.controller)

	quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(oni_girl)
end

function local_class:start()
	self.current_state = self.states.before_interact_oni_girl
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.current_state = self.states.done
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return self:on_interact_event(e)
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if (self.current_state == self.states.before_interact_oni_girl or
			self.current_state == self.states.before_accept_quest) and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.character.oni_girl()) then
		local is_first_interact = self.current_state == self.states.before_interact_oni_girl
		self.current_state = self.states.in_interact_oni_girl

		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene()

			local accepted = self:interact_oni_girl_scene(is_first_interact)

			--퀘스트 수락 여부
			if accepted then
				self.controller:activate_quest(0)
			else
				sp_util.exit_scene(nil, self.character.knight())

				self.current_state = self.states.before_accept_quest
			end
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:interact_oni_girl_scene(is_first_interact)
	local oni_girl = self.character.oni_girl()
	local knight = user_party.Leader
	local princess = self.character.princess()
	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy()
	local fire_bishop = self.character.fire_bishop()

	quest_icon_util.remove(oni_girl)

	--라나 (left, smile, idle) 로 전환.
	character_util.remove_anim(oni_girl)

	--컨트롤 뻇길 때, BGM 볼륨 0.6으로 조절, 믹스 디폴트값
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	self.controller:party_align_after_interaction()

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if is_first_interact then
		--라나 (left, smile, jump 1회) : 친구! 또 만나네!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		character_util.normal_jump(oni_girl, true)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl, self, 'left',
				nil, 'smile', 'fw_oni_girl_pre_1_1')

		--라나 (left, smile, idle) : 여긴 상당히 뜨겁고 후덥지근한게, 고강도의 훈련을 하기 딱 좋은 곳인 것 같아!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl, self, 'left',
				nil, 'smile', 'fw_oni_girl_pre_1_2')

		--라나 (down, smile, idle) : 마침 곳곳에 도움이 될만한 물건들도 놓여 있더라고!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl, self, 'down',
				nil, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'fw_oni_girl_pre_1_3')

		--1초 동안 카메라 아래쪽으로 1.5칸 이동.
		camera_util.move_async(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(0, 0, -1.5), 1)

		--플레이어 (down, idle, idle) 전환
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'down', false)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

		--라나 (down, smile, release 2회) : 여기 이 광차를 타고 이동하면서 훈련을 하고 있던 중이었어.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl, self, 'down',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'smile', 'fw_oni_girl_pre_1_4')

		--라나 (down, smile, idle) : 처음에는 운전에 영 익숙치 않았지만, 이젠 완벽히히 통달했지!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl, self, 'down',
				nil, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'fw_oni_girl_pre_1_5')

		--0.5초 동안 카메라 플레이어한테 원상복귀.
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

		--플레이어 (right, idle, idle) 전환
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

		--라나 (left, attack, idle) : 하지만 나 혼자만 통달했다고 좋아하는 건 의미 없는 법!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl, self, 'left',
				nil, 'attack', 'fw_oni_girl_pre_1_6')

		--라나 (left, attack, shoot) : 다른 사람과 함께 달리면서 내 실력을 증명해야만 해!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_china_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl, self, 'left',
				'shoot', 'attack', 'fw_oni_girl_pre_1_7')

		--동시 실행
		--0.2초 동안 Stage Camera 값 3으로 줌인.
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0.2)

		--0.2초 동안 화면 0.1값으로 shake.
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.2)

		--라나 (left, smile, victory_get) : 보여주고 증명하는 것! 그것이 스피드 퀸의 자세니까!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'victory_get', loop = false }, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'fw_oni_girl_pre_1_8')

		--0.5초 동안 Stage Camera 값 4로 원상복구.
		camera_util.resize_to_default_async(0.5)

		--라나 (left, smile, idle) : 그런 의미에서, 광차를 타고 레이싱 한 번 어때?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl, self, 'left',
				nil, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'fw_oni_girl_pre_1_10')
	end

	--퀘스트 수락 창 출력
	--수락시
	--퀘스트 수락 연출 진행.
	--거절시
	local accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.cs_controller.QuestId, false)

	if accepted then
		--수락시
		--라나 (left, smile, shoot) : 좋아! 시작하자!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'shoot', keep = true }, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'fw_oni_girl_pre_2_1')

		--카메라 일반 페이드 아웃 시점부터 bgm 3초간 페이드 아웃
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0, 3)

		--1초동안 카메라 일반 페이드 아웃.
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

		--0.7초 대기, (반만 하고 나머지는 섹션1에서)
		wait_for_sec(0.35)

		character_util.remove_relate_event(oni_girl, self.controller)

		return true
	else
		--라나 (left, smile, nod 1회) : 마음이 바뀌거든 찾아와! 언제든 상대해줄테니까!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'nod', count = 1 }, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'fw_oni_girl_pre_2_2')

		--컨트롤 돌아오며 bgm 볼륨 1로 조정, 믹스 디폴트 값
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

		--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
		--라나 NPC에 퀘스트 말풍선 재출력.
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

		--대사 이후 라나 (left, smile, attack 자세 반복) 전환.
		character_util.set_anim(oni_girl, { name = 'attack', loop = true})

		quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(oni_girl)

		return false
	end
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('FireWorldRagerSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FireWorldRager @
		Comment = 용염 광전사 서브 퀘스트 1 섹션 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type FireWorldRagerController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'fireworld_3'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		before_interact = 2,
		activity_start = 3,
		section_end = 4,
		harpy_talk = 97,
		back_move = 98,
		done = 99,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	--npc
	self.character = self.controller.character

	--gimmick
	self.gimmick = self.controller.gimmick

	--fx
	self.fx = self.controller.fx

	self.harpy_party = {
		cashed_member = nil,
		npc_name = 'sub_rager_fire_harpy',

		---@type fun(this:self)
		convert = function(this)
			this.cashed_member = {}

			for i = user_party.Count - 1, 1, -1 do
				local party_member = user_party[i]

				table.insert(this.cashed_member, party_member)
				character_util.set_direction(party_member, 'down')
				character_util.convert_to_npc(party_member)
				field_object_util.set_active_state(party_member, active_state_type.disabled)
			end

			character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(get_character(this.npc_name), user_party, true)
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self)
		reset = function(this)
			if this.cashed_member == nil then
				return
			end

			character_util.convert_to_npc(get_character(this.npc_name))

			-- 파티원 복원
			for i = #this.cashed_member, 1, -1 do
				field_object_util.set_active_state(this.cashed_member[i], active_state_type.enabled)
				character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(this.cashed_member[i], user_party, true)
			end

			this.cached_party = nil
		end,
	}

	self.event_checker = {
		zone_name = 'sub_rager_finish_enter_zone',
		fo_name = 'sub_rager_protein',
		fo_enter = false,

		---@type fun(this:self):IFieldObject
		get_fo = function(this)
			return get_field_object(this.fo_name)
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self, e:ZoneEnterEvent):boolean
		on_zone_enter_event = function(this, e)
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, this:get_fo(), this.zone_name) then
				this.fo_enter = true
				return false
			end

			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), this.zone_name) then
				if this.fo_enter then
					return true
				else
					local current_state = e.FieldObject.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState

					--홀드업 상태 체크
					if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
						if lua_helper.reference_equals(current_state.HoldTarget, this:get_fo()) then
							return true
						end
					end

					sp_util.start_scene(function()
						self.current_state = self.states.back_move
						self:back_enter_scene(e.Zone)
						self.current_state = self.states.activity_start
					end)
				end
			end

			return false
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self, e:ZoneLeaveEvent):boolean
		on_zone_leave_event = function(this, e)
			if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, this:get_fo(), this.zone_name) then
				this.fo_enter = false
				return true
			end

			return false
		end,
	}

	--스나이퍼 정보 스테이터스 관리
	self.rager_controller = {
		states = {
			none = 1,
			idle = 2,
			wait = 3,
			zoom_start = 4,
			zoom = 5,
			shoot = 7,
		},

		rager_info = nil,

		---@type fun(this:self)
		create_info_async = function(this)
			local npc = this:get_character()
			this.rager_info = {
				current_state = this.states.none,
				next_state = this.states.none,
				shoot_helper = this:create_shooter_helper_async(npc),
				attack_range = this:create_range(),
				timer = 0,
				shoot_dir = unity_class.vector3.down
			}
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self,fo:IFieldObject)
		create_shooter_helper_async = function(this, fo)
			local proj_data = game_data_service.GetData('ProjectileData')
			local spec_clone = proj_data:GetSpec('projectile_fireworld_rager_punch'):Clone()
			local pattern_Info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo()
			pattern_Info.columns = 1
			pattern_Info.spreadDistance = 1
			pattern_Info.parallel = true

			local shooter = shoot_helper_util.create_projectile_shooter(self, fo)
			local shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(
					CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
					shooter,
					spec_clone,
					pattern_Info,
					CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot,
					this.data.shooter_offset,
					CS.Oak.WeaponType.Custom,
					CS.Oak.DamageType.None
			)

			while not this:is_shoot_helper_loaded(shoot_helper) do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			return shoot_helper
		end,

		is_shoot_helper_loaded = function(this, shoot_helper)
			return shoot_helper:IsLoaded()
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self):AttackRange
		create_range = function(this)
			local range = attack_range_util.create_rect(
					unity_class.vector3.zero,
					this.data.range_size,
					nil, nil,
					CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayOutward
			)

			attack_range_util.hide(range)

			return range
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self,dt:number)
		update = function(this, dt)
			local npc = this:get_character()
			local info = this:get_info()

			if info.current_state == this.states.idle then
				--3.0초간 (down, idle, twohand_walk) 상태를 유지한다.
				scene_util.set_direction(npc, 'down', false)
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'twohand_walk')

				info.current_state = this.states.wait
				info.next_state = this.states.zoom_start
				info.timer = 3

			elseif info.current_state == this.states.zoom_start then
				--용염 광전사 (down, mad, dash) 자세 유지
				scene_util.set_direction(npc, 'down', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'mad')
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'dash')
				character_util.shake(npc, 0.05, this.data.zoom_duration)

				local shoot_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(get_party_leader().Position - npc.Position).normalized
				attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(info.attack_range, npc.Position, shoot_dir)
				attack_range_util.show(info.attack_range, this.data.zoom_duration)

				info.current_state = this.states.zoom
				info.timer = this.data.zoom_duration

			elseif info.current_state == this.states.zoom then
				local shoot_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(get_party_leader().Position - npc.Position).normalized

				attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(info.attack_range, npc.Position, shoot_dir)

				info.timer = info.timer - dt

				if info.timer < 0 then
					info.current_state = this.states.wait
					info.next_state = this.states.shoot
					info.timer = 0.5
					info.shoot_dir = shoot_dir
				end

			elseif info.current_state == this.states.shoot then
				attack_range_util.hide(info.attack_range)

				--용염 광전사 (down, mad, attack1회 마지막 프레임 유지) : [shout] 용염 펀치!!
				scene_util.set_direction(npc, 'down', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'mad')
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = 'attack', loop = false })

				--화면 shake  (0.2, 0.3)
				camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)

				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(npc, {
					key = 'fw_sub_rager_s1_28',
					skip = false,
					bubble_type = 'shout',
					viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.8),
					bubble_direction = 'none',
				})

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_explosion_01')

				--총알 발사
				info.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(npc.Position, info.shoot_dir, 999,
						-1, nil, false, 0, vector(0, 0, 0), 0, false)
				info.current_state = this.states.wait
				info.next_state = this.states.idle
				info.timer = 0.3

			elseif info.current_state == this.states.wait then
				info.timer = info.timer - dt

				if info.timer < 0 then
					info.current_state = info.next_state
				end
			end

			this:update_info(info)
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self):table
		get_info = function(this)
			if this.rager_info == nil then
				return nil
			end

			return this.rager_info
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self, info:table)
		update_info = function(this, info)
			if this.rager_info == nil then
				return nil
			end

			this.rager_info.current_state = info.current_state
			this.rager_info.next_state = info.next_state
			this.rager_info.timer = info.timer
			this.rager_info.current_state = info.current_state
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self)
		start_setting = function(this)
			this.rager_info.current_state = this.states.zoom_start
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self)
		end_setting = function(this)
			local info = this:get_info()

			attack_range_util.hide(info.attack_range)
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self):Character
		get_character = function(this)
			return get_character(this.data.character_name)
		end,

		data = {
			--npc
			character_name = 'sub_rager_fire_rager',
			--range
			range_size = vector(40, 2),
			--shooter
			shooter_offset = 0.5,
			zoom_duration = 1.5,
		}
	}

	self.puzzle_area = {
		zone_name = 'sub_rager_puzzle_area',
		reset_gimmick_data = nil,
		convert_switch_toggle = false,

		---@type fun(this:self)
		reset = function(this)
			for i = 1, #this.reset_gimmick_data do
				local fo = this.reset_gimmick_data[i]
				message_system:Send(fo, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)

				local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()

				heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
				heal_info.isRevive = true
				heal_info.skipEffect = true
				heal_info.sender = fo
				heal_info.target = fo

				command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
			end

			if this.convert_switch_toggle then
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ConvertSwitchChangedEvent.Create())
			end
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self)
		cash_puzzle = function(this)
			this.reset_gimmick_data = {}
			local zone = field_util.get_zone(this.zone_name)
			local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(zone.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

			for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
				local fo = fo_list[i]

				if not type_util.is_string(fo.Name) then
					goto continue
				end

				if string_helper.start_with(fo.Name, '[breakable]') or
						string_helper.start_with(fo.Name, '[GIMMICK]rock') or
						string_helper.start_with(fo.Name, '[GIMMICK]small_rock') or
						string_helper.start_with(fo.Name, '[gimmick]bucket') then
					table.insert(this.reset_gimmick_data, fo)
				end

				:: continue ::
			end
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self, e:Event)
		on_convert_switch_changed_event = function(this, e)
			this.convert_switch_toggle = not this.convert_switch_toggle

			return false
		end,
	}

	self.is_throw = false
	self.damage = false
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.rager_controller:create_info_async()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent), 'on_throw_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrownEndEvent), 'on_throw_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ConvertSwitchChangedEvent), 'on_convert_switch_changed_event')

	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:start()
	self.current_state = self.states.before_interact

	if not self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		start_coroutine(function()
			self.current_state = self.states.activity_start
			self:activity_scene()

			sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrownEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ConvertSwitchChangedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_interact and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.character.fire_harpy) then
		self.current_state = self.states.harpy_talk

		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene()

			quest_icon_util.remove(self.character.fire_harpy)

			local acceptance = self:interact_scene()

			if acceptance then
				self.current_state = self.states.activity_start
				character_util.remove_relate_event(self.character.fire_harpy, self.controller)

				self:activity_scene()

				--아래 위치에 파란색 퀘스트 마커 생성
				local marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_rager_finish_center_pos')

				quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point('clear_flag', self.cs_controller.QuestId, false, marker_pos)
			else
				self.current_state = self.states.before_interact
				quest_icon_util.set_quest_accepted(self.character.fire_harpy)
			end

			sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.activity_start and
			self.event_checker:on_zone_enter_event(e) then
		self.current_state = self.states.section_end
		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene({ release_hold = false })

			self:finish_scene()

			sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.activity_start and
			self.event_checker:on_zone_leave_event(e) then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_throw_event(e)
	if not self.is_throw and
			self.current_state == self.states.activity_start and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.gimmick.protein) then
		self.is_throw = true
		start_coroutine(self.throw_routine, self, e.Target)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_throw_end_event(e)
	if self.is_throw and
			self.current_state == self.states.activity_start and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.gimmick.protein) then
		self.is_throw = false

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_convert_switch_changed_event(e)
	if self.puzzle_area:on_convert_switch_changed_event(e) then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.activity_start and
			not self.damage and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, self.gimmick.protein) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.gimmick.protein) and
			e.Info.type == CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee then
		self.damage = true
	end
end

--홀더블 오브젝트 던져지는 동안 HitFloor 마다 체크하는 루틴
--FieldObjectThrownState는 HitFloor시 damage 발생
function local_class:throw_routine(fo)
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

	while self.is_throw do
		if self.damage then
			--용암 충돌 처리
			if self:lava_check(fo) then
				self.is_throw = false
				message_system:SendSync(fo, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)

				sp_util.start_scene(function()
					self.current_state = self.states.before_interact
					self:protein_fail_scene()
				end)
			else
			end

			self.damage = false
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
end

--용암 기믹 (2x2) 충돌 체크
function local_class:lava_check(fo)
	local obj_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(fo.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	local lava_behaviour = nil

	--가까운 용암 기믹 서칭
	for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
		local obj = obj_list[i]
		local fo_bhv = obj.FieldObjectBehaviour

		if self:aabb_by_point(obj.Bounds, fo.Position) then
			--세부 충돌 확인

			if lua_helper.type_compare(fo_bhv, CS.Oak.LavaRockFieldObjectBehaviour) then
				--생성 블록 일 경우 탈출
				return false
			elseif lua_helper.type_compare(fo_bhv, CS.Oak.LavaFlowFieldObjectBehaviour) then
				--용암 기믹 일 경우 캐싱
				lava_behaviour = fo_bhv
			end
		end
	end

	--용암 기믹 없을 시 탈출
	if lava_behaviour == nil then
		return false
	end

	--철망 오브젝트 리스트
	local vfo_list = lava_behaviour:GetVfoList()

	--철망이 없으면 다 용암.
	if vfo_list.Count == 0 then
		return true
	end

	local cashed_vfo = nil

	--철망 오브젝트(1x1) 충돌 추론
	for i = 0, vfo_list.Count - 1 do
		local vfo = vfo_list[i]
		if self:aabb_by_point(vfo.Bounds, fo.Position) then
			cashed_vfo = vfo
			break
		end
	end

	--충돌 오브젝트가 철망이 아닐 경우 용암에 빠진 것.
	if cashed_vfo ~= nil and
			field:GetTileInfoAt(cashed_vfo.Position).types ~= CS.Tilemaps.TileTypes.Wire then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:interact_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local fire_harpy = self.character.fire_harpy

	self.controller:align_harpy_async(fire_harpy.Position + unity_class.vector3.right, 'left', 1)

	--신틸라 (right, smile, victory_get 1회, 마지막 프레임 유지) : 좋아! 가보자구~!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_harpy, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'victory_get', loop = false }, 'smile', 'fw_sub_rager_s1_26')

	do
		--(mercy) 출격~!
		--(brutal) 잠시만 시간을 줘!
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'fw_sub_rager_s1_choose_3', 'mercy' },
			{ 'fw_sub_rager_s1_choose_4', 'brutal' },
		})

		if choose_result == 2 then
			--플레이어 (left, tired, release 2회) async
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
			scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

			return false
		end
	end

	--플레이어 (left, smile, victory_get 1회) async
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false, keep_anim = true })

	--1초에 걸쳐 화면 검은색 페이드아웃
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	return true
end

function local_class:back_enter_scene(zone)

			nil, 'mad', 'fw_sub_rager_s1_27')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)

function local_class:zone_back_move_async(zone, dir)
	local offset = 0.5
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local npc = user_party[i]
		local adder = 1 + i * offset
		local return_pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter(zone, npc, dir, adder)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, return_pos, nil, 0.7, self)
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
end

function local_class:activity_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local fire_harpy = self.character.fire_harpy
	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_rager_center_pos')

	--기존 파티원들 파티 해제
	--기존 파티원들 맵에서 삭제
	--신틸라가 파티에 합류
	self.harpy_party:convert()
	self.event_checker.fo_enter = false

	camera_util.set_position(center_pos + vector(0, 0, -3.5), true)

	--1.5초에 걸쳐 검은색 화면 페이드인
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black)

	--플레이어, 신틸라 화면 바깥에서 0.5초간 Y축으로 해당 위치로 낙하한다 async
	--플레이어, 신틸라 (up, embarrassed) 상태
	do
		local duration = 0.5

		--플레이어, 신틸라 (up, embarrassed)
		character_util.set_position(leader, center_pos + vector(0.5, 10, -3.5))
		character_util.set_position(fire_harpy, center_pos + vector(-0.5, 10, -3.5))
		scene_util.set_group_direction({ leader, fire_harpy }, 'up', false)
		scene_util.set_group_anim({ leader, fire_harpy }, self, { name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = false })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, vector_util.get_x0z(leader.Position, 0),
				nil, duration, self, nil, { locked_dir = 'up' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fire_harpy, vector_util.get_x0z(fire_harpy.Position, 0),
				nil, duration, self, nil, { locked_dir = 'up' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

		party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()
	end

	self:rager_appear_scene()

	start_coroutine(self.activity_routine, self)
end

function local_class:activity_routine()
	self.rager_controller:start_setting()

	while self.current_state == self.states.activity_start or
			self.current_state == self.states.back_move do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if self.current_state == self.states.activity_start then
			self.rager_controller:update(dt)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.rager_controller:end_setting()

	stage.ProjectileManager:ClearProjectiles()
end

function local_class:rager_appear_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local fire_harpy = self.character.fire_harpy
	local fire_rager = self.character.fire_rager
	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_rager_center_pos')
	local rager_pos = center_pos + unity_class.vector3.forward * 2

	--플레이어 및 신틸라 현재방향, cast 상태로 shake (0.1) , 이후 추락 전까지 shake 유지
	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()
	character_util.shake(leader, 0.1, 9999)
	character_util.shake(fire_harpy, 0.1, 9999)

	--화면 shake (0.2 , 0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)

	--1초에 걸쳐 카메라 줌 인 3.5
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.5, 1)

	--1초에 걸쳐 카메라 포커스 용염 광전사 생성 예정 위치로 이동,
	camera_util.move_async(rager_pos, 1)

	--0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--플레이어 shake 멈춘다.
	character_util.stop_shake(leader)
	character_util.stop_shake(fire_harpy)

	--표시된 위치 y좌표 7 상단에 용염 광전사 생성한다.
	do
		local height = 7
		local duration = 0.3
		local start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(rager_pos, height)

		--0.3초간 용염 광전사 (down, attack, throw 마지막프레임) 자세로
		--y 높이 7에서 0으로 떨어진다.
		field_object_util.set_active_state(fire_rager, active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.set_position(fire_rager, start_pos)
		scene_util.set_direction(fire_rager, 'down', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(fire_rager, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(fire_rager, self, { name = 'throw', loop = false })

		wp_util.move_async(fire_rager, rager_pos, nil, duration, { locked_dir = 'down' })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fire_rager)
	end

	--원형 반경에 fx_boss_salamandra_fireball_explosion 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_02')
	self.fx.fire_ball():Instantiate(rager_pos)

	--화면 shake (0.3 , 0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

	--가디언 (현재방향, embarrassed, jump 1회)
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = false })
	character_util.normal_jump_async(leader, true)

	--용염광전사 (down, mad, attack 1회) : 또 한 번 내 영역에 발을 들이다니…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_rager, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'attack', count = 1, sfx_name = '02_wing_fire_02' }, 'mad', 'fw_sub_rager_s1_34')

	--화면 shake (0.3, 0.2)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)

	--용염광전사 (down, mad, cast2) : [shout] 프로틴은 넘겨줄 수 없다!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(fire_rager, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'cast2' }, 'mad', 'fw_sub_rager_s1_35')

	--1초에 걸쳐 플레이어 중심으로 카메라 포커스 복귀한다.
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()
	--컨트롤 돌려준다.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_shaolin_intro', state = 'event', volume = 1, mix = 1 })
end

function local_class:finish_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local fire_harpy = self.character.fire_harpy
	local fire_rager = self.character.fire_rager
	local protein = self.gimmick.protein
	local broken_protein = self.gimmick.broken_protein
	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_rager_finish_center_pos')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.6)

	quest_marker_util.remove('clear_flag')

	--화면 0.7초에 걸쳐 페이드아웃
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.7, unity_class.color.black)

	--플레이어 홀드 사양으로 프로틴 든다.
	local current_state = get_party_leader().FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		command_util.publish_holdup(leader, protein, leader.Position, nil, false)
	end

	scene_util.set_group_direction({ leader, fire_harpy }, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_group_emotion({ leader, fire_harpy }, self, 'attack')

	character_util.set_position(leader, center_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_position(fire_harpy, center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0))

	--카메라 줌 인 (3.0)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0)

	protein.Holdable.BounceSfxHandleName = nil

	--0.7초간 검은 색으로 페이드인
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.7, unity_class.color.black)

	--플레이어, 신틸라 (down, attack, run) 5의 속도로 위 동선을 따라 이동한다.
	do
		local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })

		local speed = 5
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -3),
				speed, nil, self, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = false })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fire_harpy, fire_harpy.Position + vector(0, 0, -3),
				speed, nil, self)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

		dash_sfx:FadeOut()
		dash_sfx = nil
	end

	--도착 동시에 아래 연출 1과 연출 2, 연출 3 동시에 진행
	do
		wait_all_lua(
				function()
					local duration = 0.5
					local height = 2
					local start_pos = protein.Position
					local target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(start_pos + vector(0, 0, -3.5), 0)

					command_util.publish_throw(leader, protein, unity_class.vector3.back, protein.Position, 1, false)

					coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(duration, start_pos, target_pos, function(progress, cur_value)
						local h = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
						local lerp_pos = cur_value + vector(0, h, 0)

						protein.Position = lerp_pos
					end)

					--도착지점 도달시 Fx_dead 이펙트 출력
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_break_wagon_01')
					self.fx.dead():Instantiate(target_pos)

					--이펙트 생성과 동시에 파괴된 프로틴 오브젝트 로 변경
					field_object_util.set_active_state(protein, active_state_type.disabled)
					broken_protein.Position = protein.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0)
					protein.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.HoldableObjectBehaviour()
					protein.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
					protein.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PortableCrashBehaviour()
				end,
				function()
					--신틸라 (down, surprised, cliff)
					scene_util.set_direction(fire_harpy, 'down', false)
					scene_util.set_emotion(fire_harpy, self, 'surprise')
					scene_util.set_anim(fire_harpy, self, { name = 'cliff', one_shot_sfx = false })

					--0.3초 대기
					wait_for_sec(0.3)

					--신틸라 jump 1회
					character_util.normal_jump(fire_harpy, '01_player_jump_01')

					--신틸라 (down, surprised, cast2) : 내 프로틴!!
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
					scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_harpy, self, 'down',
							'cast2', nil, 'fw_sub_rager_s1_1')
				end,
				function()
					--플레이어 현재 위치에 fx_hit 이펙트 출력
					self.fx.hit():Instantiate(leader.Position)

					--플레이어 (down, damaged, throw 1회, 마지막 프레임 유지) 하단으로  9의 속도로 0.5칸 이동
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
					scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'down', false)
					scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
					scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'throw', loop = false })

					wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.5, 9)

					--플레이어 (down, damaged, prostrate) 하단으로 9의 속도로 0.5칸 이동
					scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'prostrate')

					wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.5, 9)

					--0.5초 대기
					wait_for_sec(0.5)

					--플레이어 (down, damaged, prostrate) shake (0.05, 0.5)
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
					character_util.shake(leader, 0.05, 0.5)
					wait_for_sec(0.5)
				end
		)
	end

	--신틸라 (down, greed, cliff) : 저 귀한 걸!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_harpy, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'cliff', one_shot_sfx = false }, 'greed', 'fw_sub_rager_s1_2')

	--카메라 포커스 0.5초에 걸쳐 신틸라로 변경
	camera_util.move(leader.Position + vector(0.5, 0, -1), 0.5)

	--신틸라 (down, greed,  run) 상태로 9의 속도로 위와 같이 동선 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
	local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })

	scene_util.set_emotion(fire_harpy, self, 'greed')
	wp_util.move_async(fire_harpy, fire_harpy.Position + vector(0, 0, -3.5),
			9, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = false })

	dash_sfx:FadeOut()
	dash_sfx = nil

	--도착지점 에서 신틸라 (left, greed, eat)
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_eat_01', loop = true })
	scene_util.set_direction(fire_harpy, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(fire_harpy, self, 'eat')

	--터진 프로틴 오브젝트 shake (0.05, 9999)
	field_object_util.shake(broken_protein, 0.05, 9999)

	do
		local height = 7
		local duration = 0.3
		local start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(leader.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), height)

		--표시된 위치 y좌표 7 상단에 용염 광전사 생성한다.
		--그림자도 동시 생성
		field_object_util.set_active_state(fire_rager, active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.set_position(fire_rager, start_pos)
		scene_util.set_direction(fire_rager, 'down', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(fire_rager, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(fire_rager, self, { name = 'throw', loop = false, scale = 999 })

		--0.3초 대기

	scene_util.set_emotion(fire_harpy, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(fire_harpy, self, 'get')

	--신틸라 위치에서 스타피스 출력,
	--위 위치에 스타피스 도착한다.
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, fire_harpy.Position, fire_harpy.Position + vector(-1, 0, 1))
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--신틸라 (right, burning, run) 7의 속도로 위 동선대로 이동
	do
		local speed = 7

		dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })

		scene_util.set_direction(fire_harpy, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(fire_harpy, self, 'burning')
		character_util.remove_anim(fire_harpy)
		wp_util.move_async(fire_harpy, {
			fire_harpy.Position + vector(0, 0, -2.5),
			fire_harpy.Position + vector(9.5, 0, -2.5),
			fire_harpy.Position + vector(9.5, 0, 2.5),
		}, speed, nil, { run = true })

		dash_sfx:FadeOut()
		dash_sfx = nil
	end

	--신틸라 (right, burning, fire_harpy/attack2) : 하나 둘! 하나 둘!
	scene_util.set_direction(fire_harpy, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(fire_harpy, self, 'burning')
	scene_util.set_anim(fire_harpy, self, 'fire_harpy/attack2')
	fire_harpy.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	fire_harpy.Interactable.Talk = 'fw_sub_rager_s1_25'

	--클리어 시 퍼즐 환경 세팅
	self.puzzle_area:reset()
	self.controller:post_simple_setting()
	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.gimmick.jump, active_state_type.enabled)

	--상호작용할 시 나레이션 출력하는 용염 광전사 시체 NPC 로 변경
	--나레이션 : 막강한 공격력에 비해 저열한 생명력을 가졌던 적의 유해이다.
	local narration_interactable = CS.Oak.NarrationInteractable()
	narration_interactable.StringKeys = { 'fw_sub_rager_s1_9' }
	fire_rager.Interactable = narration_interactable

	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field'})

	--플레이어 컨트롤 돌려줍니다.
	self.controller:complete_quest({
		run_complete_ui = true,
		run_fame_alignment = false,
		return_control = false,
		run_chapter_end_ui = false,
	})
end

-- 프로젝타일 명중 처리
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.current_state == self.states.activity_start then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, get_party_leader()) then
			self.current_state = self.states.before_interact
			sp_util.start_scene(function()
				self:punch_fail_scene()
			end)
			return true
		elseif hit_info.target ~= nil and
				(lua_helper.type_compare(hit_info.target.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.RockDamagedBehaviour) or
				lua_helper.type_compare(hit_info.target.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.PotDamagedBehaviour)) then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick
			damage_info.sender = self.character.fire_rager
			damage_info.target = hit_info.target
			damage_info.damage = 100

			command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)

			return false
		end
	end

	return false
end

--- @param protein IFieldObject 프로틴
function local_class:protein_fail_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local fire_harpy = self.character.fire_harpy
	local protein = self.gimmick.protein

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.6)

	--던졌을 때 용암으로 빠지면 FX_dead fw_lava_drop 출력과 함께 사라지는 처리.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_lava_ship_02')
	self.fx.lava_drop():Instantiate(protein.Position)

	protein.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	--플레이어 컨트롤 빼앗고 0.5초에 걸쳐 카메라 신틸라 위치로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(fire_harpy.Position, 0.5)

	--신틸라 (프로틴이 빠진 방향, surprised, embarrassed) :  [shout] 안돼! 내 프로틴…!
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(fire_harpy, self, nil,
			'embarrassed', { name = 'surprise', keep = true }, 'fw_sub_rager_s1_31')

	--신틸라 중심으로 카메라 줌 인 (2.5, 0.5) 끝날 때까지 대기
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(2.5, 0.5)

	--플레이어 (신틸라 방향, scared, embarrassed)
	character_util.look_at(leader, fire_harpy)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = false })

	--신틸라 방향으로 용염 광전사의 공격 이펙트 생성되어 즉시 발사된다.
	--신틸라 (right, damaged, frustration 1회 실행, 마지막 프레임 유지) 다 틀렸어….
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				scene_util.set_anim_async(fire_harpy, self, { name = 'frustration', loop = false, keep_anim = true })
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
			end,
			function()
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_harpy, self, 'right',
						{ name = 'frustration', loop = false }, 'damaged', 'fw_sub_rager_s1_32')
			end
	)

	--하단에 별도 기입한 투사체 피격 연출 진행한다.

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	--플레이어 위치에 FX_Obj_Car_Explosion 이펙트 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_harpy_explosion_01')
	self.fx.explosion():Instantiate(leader.Bounds.center)

	--화면 shake (0.5, 0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.5, 0.3)

	--표정 (damaged, embarrassed)
	self.controller:party_screen_out_fly_away_async(leader.Position)

	--1초에 걸쳐 화면 붉게 페이드 아웃
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_horror_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.red)

	self:activity_reset_scene()
end

function local_class:punch_fail_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	camera_util.set_position(leader.Position)

	--플레이어 위치에 FX_Obj_Car_Explosion 이펙트 출력
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_harpy_explosion_01')
	self.fx.explosion():Instantiate(leader.Bounds.center)

	--화면 shake (0.5, 0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.5, 0.3)

	--표정 (damaged, embarrassed)
	self.controller:party_screen_out_fly_away_async(leader.Position)

	--화면 1.5초간 붉은 색으로 페이드아웃
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_horror_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.red)

	self:activity_reset_scene()
end

function local_class:activity_reset_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local fire_harpy = self.character.fire_harpy
	local fire_rager = self.character.fire_rager
	local protein = self.gimmick.protein

	quest_marker_util.remove('clear_flag')

	self.harpy_party:reset()
	self.puzzle_area:reset()

	message_system:Send(protein, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)

	do
		local harpy_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_harpy_center_pos')

		self.controller:align_harpy_async(harpy_pos + unity_class.vector3.right, 'left', 0)

		--신틸라 (left, damaged, prostrate)
		character_util.set_position(fire_harpy, harpy_pos)
		scene_util.set_direction(fire_harpy, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(fire_harpy, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(fire_harpy, self, 'prostrate')

		--플레이어 (left, damaged, prostrate)
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'prostrate')

		--카메라 포커스 가디언에게 복귀.
		camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

		--광전사 제거
		character_util.set_position(fire_rager, vector(999, 0, 999))
	end

	--1.5초간 붉은 색 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1.5, unity_class.color.red)

	--플레이어, 신틸라 shake 2회 실시 후 마리오 점프로 기상
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				character_util.shake_and_wakeup(fire_harpy, 'right', 2, nil, true)
			end,
			function()
				character_util.shake_and_wakeup(leader, 'left', 2)
			end
	)

	--나레이션 : 무시무시한 파괴력을 가진 용염 펀치에 맞았다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'fw_sub_rager_s1_30' })

	--플레이어 (right, scared) shake (0.05, 0.5)
	--신틸라 (left, scared) shake (0.05, 0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_group_emotion({ leader, fire_harpy }, self, 'scared')
	character_util.shake(leader, 0.05, 0.5)
	character_util.shake(fire_harpy, 0.05, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--신틸라 (right, attack, idle)
	scene_util.set_emotion(fire_harpy, self, 'attack')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	character_util.add_listener(fire_harpy, self.controller)
	quest_icon_util.set_quest_accepted(fire_harpy)
	--컨트롤 돌려준다.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 1, mix = 1 })
end

function local_class:pre_setting()
	local fire_harpy = self.character.fire_harpy
	local protein = self.gimmick.protein
	local harpy_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_harpy_center_pos')
	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_rager_center_pos')
	local jump = self.gimmick.jump

	--protein
	protein.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.HoldableObjectBehaviour()
	protein.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	protein.Holdable.BounceSfxHandleName = '01_bounce_head_01'
	protein.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PortableCrashBehaviour()
	protein.Position = center_pos

	local protein_bhv = protein.FieldObjectBehaviour

	cast(protein_bhv, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectBehaviour))
	protein_bhv.ResetOnWrongPosition = false

	--jump
	field_object_util.set_active_state(jump, active_state_type.disabled)

	--스테이지 재진입 세팅
	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		local protein_twinkle = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(protein.Bounds.center,
				unity_class.quaternion.identity, protein.transform)

		self.controller.fx_data:insert('twinkle', protein_twinkle)

		character_util.set_position(fire_harpy, harpy_pos)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(fire_harpy, active_state_type.enabled)
		scene_util.set_direction(fire_harpy, 'right', false)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fire_harpy)
		character_util.add_listener(fire_harpy, self.controller)

		quest_icon_util.set_quest_accepted(self.character.fire_harpy)
	end

	self.puzzle_area:cash_puzzle()
end

function local_class:aabb_by_point(bounds, point)
	return bounds.min.x <= point.x and bounds.max.x >= point.x
			and bounds.min.z <= point.z and bounds.max.z >= point.z
end

return local_class
