local local_class = newclass('FireWorldSpicyRaceSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FireWorldSpicyRace @
		Comment = @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type FireWorldSpicyRaceController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'fireworld_4'

	-- scene_util 버전. 버전 올라갈 때 + N 해서 사용
	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version + 1

	-- 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		first_zone_event = 2,
		second_zone_event = 3,
		request_talk = 4,
		second_request_talk = 5,
		start_mini_game = 6,
		clear_mini_game = 7
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	-- character
	self.characters = {
		-- 레이스 npc
		race_npc = function(number)
			return get_character('spicy_race_npc_' .. number)
		end,
		-- 꼬마 공주
		princess = function()
			return get_character('princess')
		end,
		-- 기르가스
		dragon_boy = function()
			return get_character('dragon_boy')
		end,
		-- 비슈바크
		fire_bishop = function()
			return get_character('fire_bishop')
		end,
	}

	-- marker
	self.markers = {
		leader_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('save_harpy_leader_pos_' .. number)
		end,
	}

	-- 퀘스트 마커(다른 지형으로 이동하지 않음)
	self.quest_marker = setmetatable({
		marker_key = 'spicy_race',
	}, {
		__index = {
			add_marker = function(this)
				quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(this.marker_key,
						self.cs_controller.QuestId, true, self.characters.race_npc(1))
			end,
			remove_marker = function(this)
				quest_marker_util.remove(this.marker_key)
			end
		}
	})

	self.mini_game_name = 'SpicyFoodRace'

	self.stage_exit = false
	self.is_active_quest = false
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	self:start_setting()
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.is_active_quest then
		self.quest_marker:add_marker()
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.characters.race_npc(1), self.controller)

	mini_game_util.game_dispose(self.mini_game_name)

	self.quest_marker:remove_marker()

	self.stage_exit = true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.characters.race_npc(1)) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.second_zone_event then
			self.current_state = self.states.request_talk
			start_coroutine(self.request_mini_game_scene, self, true)

			return true
		elseif self.current_state == self.states.second_request_talk then
			self.current_state = self.states.request_talk
			start_coroutine(self.request_mini_game_scene, self, false)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'spicy_race_event_zone_1') then
		self.current_state = self.states.first_zone_event
		start_coroutine(self.first_talk_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.first_zone_event and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'spicy_race_event_zone_2') then
		self.current_state = self.states.second_zone_event
		start_coroutine(self.second_talk_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.mini_game_name then
		if e.Success then
			self.current_state = self.states.clear_mini_game
			start_coroutine(self.game_clear_scene, self)
		else
			self.current_state = self.states.second_request_talk
			sp_util.start_scene(self.game_fail_scene, self)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if e.QuestId == self.controller.main_quest_id and e.CurrentProgress == 14 then
		self:start_setting()
		self.quest_marker:add_marker()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:start_setting()
	local main_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.controller.main_quest_id)

	if main_quest_progress == nil or main_quest_progress.InnerProgress < 14 then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')
		return
	end

	self.is_active_quest = true

	self:setting_npc()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')
end

function local_class:setting_npc()
	local npc_1 = self.characters.race_npc(1)

	character_util.set_direction(npc_1, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc_1, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(npc_1, self, 'cast2')

	local npc_2 = self.characters.race_npc(2)

	character_util.set_direction(npc_2, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc_2, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(npc_2, self, 'shoot')
	npc_2.Interactable.Talk = nil

	local npc_3 = self.characters.race_npc(3)

	character_util.set_direction(npc_3, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc_3, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(npc_3, self, 'shoot')
	npc_3.Interactable.Talk = nil

	local npc_4 = self.characters.race_npc(4)

	character_util.set_direction(npc_4, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc_4, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(npc_4, self, 'idle')
	npc_4.Interactable.Talk = nil

	local npc_5 = self.characters.race_npc(5)

	character_util.set_direction(npc_5, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc_5, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(npc_5, self, 'idle')
	npc_5.Interactable.Talk = nil
end

function local_class:first_talk_scene()
	local npc_2 = self.characters.race_npc(2)
	local npc_3 = self.characters.race_npc(3)
	local npc_4 = self.characters.race_npc(4)
	local npc_5 = self.characters.race_npc(5)

	--NPC 2 (right, attack, shoot) : 혓바닥 제대로 단련했지?!
	--이전 대사 실행 완료까지 대기.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc_2, 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_1')

	if self.stage_exit then
		return
	end

	--NPC 9 (left, attack, shoot) : 볼바네로 고추로 단련했지! 난 이제 무적이야!
	--이전 대사 실행 완료까지 대기.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc_3, 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_2')

	if self.stage_exit then
		return
	end

	--NPC 10 (right, scared, idle) : 맵겠지… 그치? 그치이…?
	--이전 대사 실행 완료까지 대기.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc_4, 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_3')

	if self.stage_exit then
		return
	end

	--NPC 11 (left, tired, idle) : 뭐… 잠깐만 참으면 괜찮지 않을까?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc_5, 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_4')

	if self.stage_exit then
		return
	end

	npc_2.Interactable.Talk = 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_1'
	npc_3.Interactable.Talk = 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_2'
	npc_4.Interactable.Talk = 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_3'
	npc_5.Interactable.Talk = 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_4'
end

function local_class:second_talk_scene()
	local npc_1 = self.characters.race_npc(1)

	--NPC 1 (right, smile, cast2) : 어서오세요! 새로운 도전자는 언제나 환영합니다!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc_1, 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_5')

	character_util.add_listener(npc_1, self.controller)
end

function local_class:request_mini_game_scene(is_first)
	sp_util.enter_scene()
	self.quest_marker:remove_marker()

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.characters.princess()
	local dragon_boy = self.characters.dragon_boy()
	local fire_bishop = self.characters.fire_bishop()
	local npc_1 = self.characters.race_npc(1)

	do
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

		--카메라 NPC 1을 중심으로 1초에 걸쳐 패닝.
		camera_util.move_to_target(npc_1, 1)

		--플레이어 일행 (left, idle, walk) 를 1초에 걸쳐 지정된 위치로 이동 후 (idle) 전환.
		local wp_key = 'leader_wp'
		local pivot = npc_1.Position

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, pivot + vector(1, 0, -1), nil,
				1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, pivot + vector(2, 0, -1), nil,
				1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dragon_boy, pivot + vector(1, 0, 0), nil,
				1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fire_bishop, pivot + vector(2, 0, 0), nil,
				1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	if is_first then
		--NPC 1 (right, attack, shoot) : 또 다른 도전자인가요?!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_1, self, 'right',
				'shoot', 'attack', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_6')

		--NPC 1 (right, smile, cast2) : 환영합니다! 용염축제의 화끈하게 매운 음식 속에서 살아남아야 하는……!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_china_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_1, self, 'right',
				'cast2', 'smile', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_7')

		--NPC 1 (right, awesome, victory_get) : 스파이시 레이스가 여러분들을 기다리고 있습니다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_1, self, 'right',
				'victory_get', 'awesome', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_8')

		--기르가스 (left, smile, cast2) : 좋아! 난 이제 매운 음식에는 자신 있다고!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'left',
				'cast2', 'smile', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_9')

		--기르가스 (left, damaged, cast) : 저번 라 제국에서 죽음으로 매운 음식을 먹어서…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'left',
				'cast', 'damaged', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_10')

		--비슈바크 (left, smile, idle) : 오 그래? 우리 조카 언제 또 그런 걸 먹어봤대?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
				nil, 'smile', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_11')

		--기르가스 (right, mad, cast2) : 으으… 시끄러! 자꾸 애취급 할래?!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'right',
				'cast2', 'mad', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_12')

		character_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'left')
		--NPC 1 (right, smile, cast2) : 하하하! 아주 화목한 분위기를 연출하시네요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_1, self, 'right',
				'cast2', 'smile', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_13')

		--NPC 1 (right, attack, cast) : 하지만… 이번 경기는 팀워크만으로는 이길 수 없을 겁니다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_1, self, 'right',
				'cast', 'attack', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_14')

		--아래 항목 동시에 실행.
		--카메라 3.5 크기로 줌 0.5초에 걸쳐 진행.
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.5, 0.5)
		--NPC 1 (right, burning, cast) : 목구멍을 타오르게 하는 열기!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_catch_fire_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_1, self, 'right',
				'cast', 'burning', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_15')

		--아래 항목 동시에 실행.
		--카메라 3 크기로 줌 0.5초에 걸쳐 진행.
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0.5)
		--NPC 1 (left, burning, jingak 1회) : 위장이 불타오르는 고통!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_1, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'jingak', count = 1, sfx_name = '01_jingak_01' },
				'burning', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_16')

		--아래 항목 동시에 실행.
		--카메라 2.5 크기로 줌 0.5초에 걸쳐 진행.
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.5, 0.5)
		--NPC 1 (right, burning, jingak 1회) : 흘러내리는 땀을 참아내는 끈기!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_1, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'jingak', count = 1, sfx_name = '01_jingak_01' },
				'burning', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_17')

		--아래 항목 동시에 실행.
		--NPC 1 0.03 / 지속 shake 실행.
		scene_util.shake(npc_1, 0.03, 999)
		--NPC 1 (right, attack, cast) : 이 세가지를 모두 참아내는 염룡이…!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_1, self, 'right',
				'cast', 'attack', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_18')

		--아래 항목 동시에 실행.
		--화면 0.3 / 0.3 shake 실행.
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
		--카메라 4 크기로 줌 0.5초에 걸쳐 진행.
		camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
		--NPC 1 shake 종료.
		character_util.stop_shake(npc_1)

		--NPC 1 (right, awesome, victory_get) : [shout] 이번 경기의 승리자가 되겠습니다!!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(npc_1, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'victory_get', keep = true }, { name = 'awesome', keep = true },
				'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_19')

		--1초 대기.
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--기르가스 (left, tired, idle) : 왜 그렇게…… 부담스럽게 굴어?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'left',
				nil, 'tired', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_20')

		--플레이어 선택지 출력.
		do
			local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
				--(mercy) 다들 직업 정신이 투철하네!
				{ 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_21', 'mercy' },
				--(forces) 이미 매운 음식을 먹은 건가?
				{ 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_24', 'forced' }
			})

			if choose_result == 1 then
				--플레이어 (left, smile, cast2) 상태를 2초간 유지.
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
				scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self, 'left',
						'cast2', 'smile', 2)

				--꼬마공주 (left, smile, idle) : 그러게! 엄청 열정적으로 일하신다!
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left',
						nil, 'smile', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_22')

				--비슈바크 (left, smile, idle) : 그게 용염축제니까! 일반인들에게 부담스럽긴 하지?
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
						nil, 'smile', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_23')
			else
				--플레이어 (left, tired, cast) 상태를 2초간 유지.
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
				scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self, 'left',
						'cast', 'tired', 2)

				--기르가스 (left, tired, idle) : 그런… 거야?
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'left',
						nil, 'tired', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_25')

				--NPC 1 (right, smile, cast2) : 하하! 천만에 말씀! 이 텐션은 무려 멀쩡한 상태에서 나오는 거랍니다!
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_1, self, 'right',
						'cast2', 'smile', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_26')
			end
		end

		party_util.set_direction('left')

		--NPC 1 (right, smile, idle) : 자 여러분! 그렇다면 각오는 되신 건가요?
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc_1)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_1, self, 'right',
				nil, 'smile', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_27')

		--NPC 1 (right, sleep_deep, cast) : 온 몸이 매콤함에 짜릿해지실 각오가 되셨다면…!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_1, self, 'right',
				'cast', 'sleep_deep', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_28')

		--화면 0.3 / 0.3 shake 실행.
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
		--NPC 1 (right, burning, shoot) : 경기장으로 들어와 자신의 진심을 던져보세요!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
		scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(npc_1, self, 'right',
				'shoot', 'burning',
				{ key = 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_29', skip = true, scale = 1.2 })
	else
		--[2회차 이상부터 NPC 1 에게 인터렉트 할 시]
		--NPC 1 (right, smile, cross_arm) : 후후, 도전할 각오가 되신 걸까요?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_1, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false },
				'smile', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_36')
	end

	--플레이어 선택지 출력
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--(mercy) 기르가스가 참가한다.
		{ 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_30', 'mercy' },
		--(normal) 그만둔다.
		{ 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_31', 'normal' }
	})

	--[선택지에서 ‘그만둔다’ 선택할 시]
	--이어서 이벤트 실행.
	if choose_result == 2 then
		--기르가스 (left, tired, idle) : 어… 으음……
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'left',
				nil, 'tired', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_32')

		--비슈바크 (left, tired, idle) : ……기르가스?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self, 'left',
				nil, 'tired', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_33')

		--기르가스 (right, attack, idle) : 잠깐! 이, 이몸은 아직 준비가 덜 된 것 같아!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'right',
				nil, 'attack', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_34')

		--NPC 1 (right, smile, cast2) : 좋습니다! 하지만 빨리 오셔야 해요!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_1, self, 'right',
				'cast2', 'smile', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_35')

		camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

		--이후 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀.
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
		self.quest_marker:add_marker()
		self.current_state = self.states.second_request_talk
		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)
		return
	end

	--[선택지에서 ‘기르가스가 참가한다’ 선택할 시]
	--기르가스 (left, burning, cast2) : 좋아! 까짓거 이몸이 전부 먹어주겠어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_catch_fire_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'left',
			'cast2', 'burning', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_37')

	--NPC 1 (right, sleep_deep, cast) : 좋습니다! 그럼 준비되어있는 선수…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_1, self, 'right',
			'cast', 'sleep_deep', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_38')

	--NPC 1 (right, burning, shoot) : 입장해주세요!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_coop_matched_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_1, self, 'right',
			'shoot', 'burning', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_39')

	self.current_state = self.states.start_mini_game

	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 페이드 아웃.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	mini_game_util.get_or_create(self.mini_game_name, self.cs_controller.QuestId)

	mini_game_util.load_resource_async(self.mini_game_name, 'normal')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--NPC 1 : [shout] 오래 기다리셨습니다!
	--위치 x 0.5 / y 0.8
	local loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_clap_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 1 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_arena_exclamation_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(npc_1, 'fw_main_spicy_race_mini_game_7',
			true, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.8), scale = 1.4 })

	--NPC 1 : [shout] 화끈한 염룡들이 한데 모여 진행하는 스파이시 레이스!
	--위치 x 0.5 / y 0.8
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(npc_1, 'fw_main_spicy_race_mini_game_8',
			true, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.8), scale = 1.4 })

	--NPC 1 : [shout] 이곳에서 가장 화끈한 염룡이 되기 위해…!
	--위치 x 0.5 / y 0.8
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(npc_1, 'fw_main_spicy_race_mini_game_9',
			true, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.8), scale = 1.4 })

	--NPC 1 : [shout] 모두! 지옥같이 매운 음식을 향해 달려주세요!!
	--위치 x 0.5 / y 0.8
	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(loop_sfx, 1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_arena_exclamation_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(npc_1, 'fw_main_spicy_race_mini_game_10',
			true, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.8), scale = 1.4 })

	--이후 3, 2, 1 액티비티 카운트 실행 후, 액티비티 진입.
	for i = 3, 1, -1 do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
		screen_util.show_stage_title('fw_main_spicy_race_mini_game_activity_' .. i, 2.1)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	mini_game_util.game_start(self.mini_game_name)
end

function local_class:game_fail_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.characters.princess()
	local dragon_boy = self.characters.dragon_boy()
	local fire_bishop = self.characters.fire_bishop()
	local npc_1 = self.characters.race_npc(1)

	camera_util.move_to_target(npc_1, 0)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

	--화면 암전 상태에 아래의 리셋 처리 실행.
	--플레이어 일행 지정된 위치에 (left, idle, idle) 실행중.
	--파티 세팅 원복 필요.
	do
		local pivot = npc_1.Position

		character_util.set_position(leader, pivot + vector(1, 0, -1))
		character_util.set_position(princess, pivot + vector(2, 0, -1))
		character_util.set_position(dragon_boy, pivot + vector(1, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_position(fire_bishop, pivot + vector(2, 0, 0))
		party_util.set_direction('left')
		party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	mini_game_util.game_dispose(self.mini_game_name)

	--기르가스, 그 외 경주 NPC에 적용된 사항 제거.(색 적용, 속도 등등…)
	--서큘러 페이드 인 1초에 걸쳐 실행.
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	--NPC 1 (right, smile, idle) : 저런… 아쉽게 되었군요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_1, self, 'right',
			'idle', 'smile', 'fw_main_spicy_race_s1_43')

	--NPC 1 (right, smile, idle) : 하지만 아직 포기하지 마세요!

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 's15_sub_quest_clear' }))

	}

	--region Sprite
	self.sprite = {
		sprite_info = {
			-- 음식 이벤트 내 아이템
			candy = 21665,
			apple = 21666,
			paprika = 21667,
			dish = 21680,

			--각 이벤트 앞 아이템
			beat_box = 21662,
			body_pillow = 21663,
			apple_basket = 21664,
			soap = 21668,

			candy_bottle = 21682,
		},
		sprite_table = {},
		sprite_table_origin_parent = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter, target, drop_type, skip_text)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,

		get = function(this, name)
			return this.sprite_table[name]
		end,

		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,

		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,

		consumed = function(this, name, target)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				quest_drop_item_util.consumed(this.sprite_table[name], target)
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			end
		end,

		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,

		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}
	--endregion

	self.quest_marker = {
		key = 'sub_tamagotchi',
		add = function(this, data)
			quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(this.key, data, nil, self.sub_quest_id, false)
		end,
		remove = function(this)
			quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(this.key)
		end
	}

	-- 알 요구사항 충족 점수
	self.cur_egg_point = 0

	--알 키우기 시작 체크
	self.egg_hatching_started = false

	--서브 퀘스트 영역에서 나간 상태인지
	self.is_exited_area = false

	--알을 들고 있는 상태
	self.is_holding_egg = false

	self.active_zone_leave_event = false

	self.leader_is_animal = false
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.sub_quest_id)

	--섹션1의 존 이탈 이벤트 활성화 체크
	if quest_progress ~= nil then
		if quest_progress.InnerProgress == 0 then
			self.active_zone_leave_event = true
		end
	else
		self.active_zone_leave_event = true
	end

	if self:is_animal_type_character() then
		self.leader_is_animal = true
	end

end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()

	self.dynamic_npcs:dispose()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
end

function local_class:set_current_scene_npc(section_state)
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[section_state]

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	linq(pre_npc_data):foreach(function(_, npc_data)
		local npc = get_character(npc_data.name)

		if npc == nil then
			if npc_data.name == 'leader' then
				npc = user_party.Leader
			else
				return
			end
		end

		if npc_data.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_data.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		npc_data.active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_data.active_state)

		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_info ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim_info == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			elseif type_util.is_table(npc_data.anim_info) then
				npc_data.anim_info.one_shot_sfx = false

				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, npc_data.anim_info)
			elseif type_util.is_string(npc_data.anim_info) then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_data.anim_info, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.keep_shake ~= nil and npc_data.keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if npc_data.scale_factor ~= nil then
			character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, npc.Name, npc_data.scale_factor)
		end

		if npc_data.tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc_data.tint_color_key, npc_data.tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if npc_data.talk ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk) then
			if not lua_helper.type_compare(npc.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
				npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			end

			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_data.talk
		end

		if npc_data.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_data.talk_sfx
		end

		if npc_data.hitbox ~= nil then
			npc.Hitbox = npc_data.hitbox
		end
	end)
end

function local_class:load_score(post_section)
	local shift_amount = 0
	local quest_progress = quest_util.get_started_quest(self.sub_quest_id)

	self.care_event_info.save_event_encode = quest_util.get_custom_state(quest_progress, self.custom_state_key_1)

	while self.care_event_info.save_event_encode >> shift_amount > 0 do
		table.insert(self.care_event_info.save_event_index_list, (self.care_event_info.save_event_encode >> shift_amount) & 0xFF)
		shift_amount = shift_amount + 8
	end

	for i = 1, #self.care_event_info.save_event_index_list do
		local num = self.care_event_info.save_event_index_list[i]

		if self.correct_event_order[i] == num then
			self.cur_egg_point = self.cur_egg_point + 1
		end

		self.care_event_info.cur_event_count = self.care_event_info.cur_event_count + 1
	end

	if post_section then
		self.npc_placement_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(quest_progress, self.custom_state_key_2)
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.active_zone_leave_event then
		if self.egg_hatching_started then
			if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), 'sub_tamagotchi_area') then
				if not self.is_exited_area then
					sp_util.start_scene(self.on_zone_exit, self)

					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_exit()
	local knight = user_party.Leader
	local princess = self.character.princess()
	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy()
	local mystery_egg = self.character.mystery_egg()
	local count_j = self.character.count_j()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--플레이어(up, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'up', false)

	--J백작 : 알은 밖으로 데리고 나갈 수 없습니다. 어떤 일이 생길지 예상할 수 없기에…
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(count_j, 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_area_out_1')

	--J백작 : 나가실 때는 제가 다시 맡아 두겠습니다.
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(count_j, 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_area_out_2')

	--선택지 출력
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_async({
		--(normal) 계속해서 알을 돌본다.
		{ 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_area_out_3', 'normal' },
		--(normal) 밖으로 나간다.
		{ 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_area_out_4', 'forced' },
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		--플레이어 일행 0.5초에 걸쳐 뒤로 이동하여 해당 위치로 정렬
		local align_key = 'party_wp'

		do
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, knight.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), nil, 1,
					self, align_key, { locked_dir = 'right' })

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, princess.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), nil, 1,
					self, align_key, { locked_dir = 'right' })

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dragon_boy, dragon_boy.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), nil, 1,
					self, align_key, { locked_dir = 'right' })

			wp_util.wait_move_end(self, align_key)
		end
	else
		wait_all_lua(
				function()

				end,

					--플레이어(up, idle, idle) 상태에서 throw 애니메이션 1회 출력되며, J백작에게 알을 던짐.
					--둥지에 미지의알 팝업되며 하늘색 마커 활성화

				end
		)

		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		character_util.set_position(mystery_egg, self.marker.mystery_egg('pre', 1, 1))
		scene_util.set_direction(mystery_egg, 'down', false)

		self:set_trigger_interaction_state(self.field_object.mystery_egg_trigger(), true)

		self.is_exited_area = true

		self.quest_marker:add({
			{
				zone = 'main_field',
				target = mystery_egg
			}
		})

		screen_util.fade_in_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	end

function local_class:on_egg_pickup(upper, set_parent)
	local knight = user_party.Leader
	local mystery_egg = self.character.mystery_egg()
	local height = 1.2
	if self.leader_is_animal then
		height = 0.8
	end

	upper = lua_helper.get_or_default(upper, false)
	set_parent = lua_helper.get_or_default(set_parent, true)

	local look_dir = vector_util.to_direction(mystery_egg.Position - knight.Position)
	knight.Direction = look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.None and knight.Direction or look_dir

	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'hold', one_shot_sfx = '01_holdup_01', upper = upper })

	scene_util.set_anim(mystery_egg, self, { name = 'idle_width' })

	local move_end_offset = vector(0.075, height, 0)

	if knight.Direction == direction_constants.up or
			knight.Direction == direction_constants.down then
		move_end_offset = vector(0.025, height, 0)
	end

	sp_util.sine_move(mystery_egg, { from = mystery_egg.Position, to = knight.Position + move_end_offset,
									 duration = 0.75, height = 1.0})

	character_util.remove_anim(knight, upper)

	self.is_holding_egg = true

	if set_parent then
		mystery_egg.Transform:SetParent(knight.Transform)
	else
		start_coroutine(self.egg_holding_routine, self)
	end


end

function local_class:egg_holding_routine()
	local knight = user_party.Leader
	local mystery_egg = self.character.mystery_egg()
	local height = 1.2
	if self.leader_is_animal then
		height = 0.8
	end
	local move_end_offset = vector(0.075, height, 0)

	while self.is_holding_egg do
		if knight.Direction == direction_constants.up or
				knight.Direction == direction_constants.down then
			move_end_offset = vector(0.025, height, 0)
		else
			move_end_offset = vector(0.095, height, 0)
		end

		mystery_egg.Position = knight.Position + move_end_offset

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:on_egg_put_down(egg_drop_pos, thrower_dir, throw_anim_scale)
	local knight = user_party.Leader
	local mystery_egg = self.character.mystery_egg()

	local anim_scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(throw_anim_scale, 0.5)

	self.is_holding_egg = false
	mystery_egg.Transform:SetParent(nil)

	coroutine.yield()

	if thrower_dir then
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, thrower_dir, false)
	else
		local look_dir = vector_util.to_direction(egg_drop_pos - knight.Position)
		knight.Direction = look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.None and knight.Direction or look_dir
	end

	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'throw', sfx_name = '01_throw_01', scale = anim_scale, count = 1 })

	sp_util.sine_move(mystery_egg, { from = mystery_egg.Position, to = egg_drop_pos,
									 duration = 0.75, height = 1.0})
end

function local_class:set_trigger_interaction_state(target, on)
	if on then
		target.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	else
		target.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end
end

function local_class:is_animal_type_character()
	if user_party.Leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.OriginId == CS.Oak.CharacterSpecId.Pet or
			user_party.Leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.OriginId == CS.Oak.CharacterSpecId.WhiteTigerBaby then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

return local_class

function local_class:apply_effect_alpha(main_module, duration)
	local color = main_module.startColor.color
	self.gradient = CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem.MinMaxGradient(unity_class.color.black)
	main_module.startColor = self.gradient

	local time_passed = 0
	local start_alpha = color.a
	local end_alpha = 1
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = (time_passed / duration)

		color.a = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_alpha, end_alpha, progress)
		self.gradient.color = unity_color({ color.r, color.g, color.b, color.a })
		main_module.startColor = self.gradient

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.fx:create_all()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self:set_npcs()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.controller.dynamic_npcs:dispose()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.character.count_j(), self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return self:on_interact_event(e)
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.count_grants_animal_adoption or self.current_state == self.states.decline_counts_offer then
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.character.count_j()) then
			if self.current_state == self.states.count_grants_animal_adoption then
				self.current_state = self.states.count_recommend
			end

			sp_util.start_scene(self.count_recommend_event, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'sub_tamagotchi_pre_trigger_zone_1') then
			self.current_state = self.states.count_grants_animal_adoption

			start_coroutine(self.count_talk_with_people, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_npcs()
	start_coroutine(function()
		self.controller.dynamic_npcs:load_async(self.controller.npc_placement_phases.pre_section)

		self.controller:set_pre_npc()

		self.controller:set_current_scene_npc(self.controller.section_state.pre_section)
	end)
end

function local_class:count_talk_with_people()
	local count_j = self.character.count_j()
	local animal_a = self.character.animal_a()
	local prospective_adopter_1 = self.controller.dynamic_npcs:get('sub_tamagotchi_dyn_prospective_adopter_1')
	local prospective_adopter_2 = self.controller.dynamic_npcs:get('sub_tamagotchi_dyn_prospective_adopter_2')

	--렉돌(left, idle, idle)
	character_util.set_direction(animal_a, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(animal_a)

	--입양자1(left, smile, idle) : 감사합니다! 예쁘게 잘 키울게요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prospective_adopter_1, self, 'left',
			nil, 'smile', { key = 'fw_tamagotchi_pre_1_1', skip = false })

	--랙돌(right, idle, idle) : 이모션 rowdy버블 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_guild_cat_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(animal_a, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'rowdy')

	--입양자1 속도 4로 [A]위치로 이동
	wp_util.move_async(prospective_adopter_1, vector(prospective_adopter_1.Position.x, 0, animal_a.Position.z), 4, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

	--입양자1(left, smile, nod 2회)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(prospective_adopter_1, self, 'smile')
	character_util.nod_twice(prospective_adopter_1)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(prospective_adopter_1, active_state_type.visible)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(animal_a, active_state_type.visible)

	--입양자1(up, idle, idle) 랙돌(up, idle, idle)과 함께 위쪽으로 이동 후, 카메라 밖으로 사라짐.
	local arrive_pos = self.marker.prospective_adopte_a('pre', 1, 2)

	local align_key = 'out_wp'
	local wp = {
		vector(arrive_pos.x, prospective_adopter_1.Position.y, prospective_adopter_1.Position.z),
		arrive_pos
	}
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(prospective_adopter_1, wp, 4, nil,
			self, align_key)

	wp = {
		vector(arrive_pos.x, animal_a.Position.y, animal_a.Position.z),
		arrive_pos + vector(0, 0, 1),
		arrive_pos + vector(1, 0, 1),
		arrive_pos + vector(1, 0, 0),
	}
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(animal_a, wp, 4, nil,
			self, align_key)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, align_key)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(prospective_adopter_1, active_state_type.enabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(animal_a, active_state_type.enabled)

	--입양자1(right, smile, idle)
	character_util.set_direction(prospective_adopter_1, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(prospective_adopter_1, self, 'smile')
	character_util.remove_anim(prospective_adopter_1)

	--랙돌(left, idle, idle)
	character_util.set_direction(animal_a, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(animal_a)

	--입양자2(left, idle, idle)가 속도4로  [B] 위치로 이동
	wp_util.move_async(prospective_adopter_2, vector(count_j.Position.x + 1, 0, prospective_adopter_2.Position.z), 4, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

	--백작(right, idle, staff_idle) : 당신과 어울리는 동물을 찾아 드립니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'right',
			'staff_idle', nil, { key = 'fw_tamagotchi_pre_1_2', skip = false })

	--백작(right, sleep_deep, staff_idle) : 당신이 마음속 깊이 바라고 있는 모습을 만나보시겠습니까?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'staff_idle', keep = true }, { name = 'sleep_deep', keep = true }, { key = 'fw_tamagotchi_pre_1_3', skip = false })

	--J백작(right, sleep_deep, staff_idle) 머리 위에 퀘스트 아이콘 출력
	character_util.add_listener(count_j, self.controller)

	quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(count_j)
end

function local_class:count_recommend_event()
	local count_j = self.character.count_j()
	local prospective_adopter_2 = self.controller.dynamic_npcs:get('sub_tamagotchi_dyn_prospective_adopter_2')
	local knight = user_party.Leader
	local princess = self.character.princess()
	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	quest_icon_util.remove(count_j)

	local party_align = function(party_align_pos)
		--플레이어 일행 입양자2 뒤(우측)에 정렬
		local align_key = 'party_wp'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, party_align_pos, 4, nil,
				self, align_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, party_align_pos + vector(1, 0, 0), 4, nil,
				self, align_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dragon_boy, party_align_pos + vector(2, 0, 0), 4, nil,
				self, align_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, align_key)
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.count_recommend then

		--J백작(right, idle, idle) : 먼저 오신 손님이 계십니다.
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(count_j)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'right',
				nil, nil, 'fw_tamagotchi_pre_2_1')

		--J백작(right, idle, staff_idle) : 잠시 기다려 주시겠습니까?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'right',
				'staff_idle', nil, 'fw_tamagotchi_pre_2_2')

		party_align(self.marker.party_align('pre', 1, 1))

		--입양자2(left, attack, release 2회 후 idle) : 저와 어울리는 동물을 분양받고 싶어요!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prospective_adopter_2, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'fw_tamagotchi_pre_2_3')

		--J백작(right, idle, idle)상태로 bird_egg를 듦.
		--bird_egg좌표  y좌표 1.0
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_costume_equip_01')
		local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
				{ pos = count_j.Position + vector(0, 1, 0), item_id = self.sprite.sprite_info.pet_egg, show_on_character = true,
				  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = 1 })

		quest_drop_item_util.rotate(item, 90, 0)

		--0.5초 대기
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--J백작이 right 방향으로 throw 애니메이션 1회 하며, 입양자2에게 bird_egg를 던져 준다.
		--이때, bird_egg는 y좌표 0.6에서 포물선을 그리며 y좌표 1.0까지 올라갔다가 입양자2 머리 위 y좌표 0.6으로 안착.
		--이때 bird_egg는  540도 회전하며 날아간다.
		scene_util.set_anim(count_j, self, { name = 'throw', sfx_name = '01_throw_01', count = 1 })

		quest_drop_item_util.rotate(item, 630, 0.75)

		sp_util.sine_move(item, { from = count_j.Position + vector(0, 1, 0), to = prospective_adopter_2.Position + vector(0, 1, 0),
								  duration = 0.75, height = 1.4})

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fat_gnome_03')

		self.fx.get():Instantiate(prospective_adopter_2.Bounds.center)
		floating_text_util.activate_for_text(prospective_adopter_2, game_string:GetString('fw_pet_egg'), 0,
				unity_color({0.4549, 0.5294, 0.549, 1}), unity_color({0, 0, 0, 0.6274}))

		--입양자2(left, surprise, idle)상태로 J백작이 던진 bird_egg 들고 있음. bird_egg y좌표 0.6
		character_util.set_direction(prospective_adopter_2, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(prospective_adopter_2, self, 'surprise')
		character_util.remove_anim(prospective_adopter_2)

		--J백작(right, idle, staff_idle) : 이 알을 부화시키면, 당신이 원하는 바를 충족시킬 수 있을 겁니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'staff_idle', keep = true }, nil, 'fw_tamagotchi_pre_2_4')

		--입양자2(right, smile, idle) : 정성껏 돌볼게요.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prospective_adopter_2, self, 'left',
				nil, 'smile', 'fw_tamagotchi_pre_2_5')

		--입양자2(up, idle, idle) 상태로 bird_egg를 든 채로 카메라 밖으로 이동
		local npc_move_end = false

		start_coroutine(function()
			while not npc_move_end do
				item.Position = prospective_adopter_2.Position + vector(0, 1, 0)

				coroutine.yield()
			end

			quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(item)
			item = nil
		end)

		local out_pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('up', prospective_adopter_2.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), 1)
		local wp = {
			vector(prospective_adopter_2.Position.x, prospective_adopter_2.Position.y, prospective_adopter_2.Position.z + 2),
			vector(out_pos.x, prospective_adopter_2.Position.y, prospective_adopter_2.Position.z + 2),
			out_pos,
		}

		wp_util.move_async(prospective_adopter_2, wp, 4, nil)

		npc_move_end = true

		character_util.set_position(prospective_adopter_2, vector(999, 0, 999))

		--플레이어 일행 속도4로 이동하여 정렬
		local align_key = 'party_wp'

		local party_align_pos = self.marker.knight('pre', 1, 1)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, party_align_pos, 4, nil,
				self, align_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		party_align_pos = self.marker.princess('pre', 1, 1)
		wp = {
			vector(princess.Position.x, princess.Position.y, party_align_pos.z),
			party_align_pos,
		}
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, wp, 4, nil,
				self, align_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		party_align_pos = self.marker.dragon_boy('pre', 1, 1)
		wp = {
			vector(dragon_boy.Position.x, dragon_boy.Position.y, party_align_pos.z),
			party_align_pos,
		}
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dragon_boy, wp, 4, nil,
				self, align_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, align_key)

		--J백작(right, sleep_deep, twohand_idle)  : 오호, 흥미로운 분이군요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'right',
				'twohand_idle', 'sleep_deep', 'fw_tamagotchi_pre_2_6')

		--J백작(right, attack, twoand_idle) : 당신이라면… 그 알을 맡겨도 될 거 같군요.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'twoand_idle', keep = true }, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'fw_tamagotchi_pre_2_7')

		--플레이어(left, surprise, idle)
		--꼬마공주(left, surprise, idle)
		--기르가스(left, surprise, idle)
		character_util.set_direction(knight, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'surprise')
		character_util.remove_anim(knight)
		character_util.set_direction(princess, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'surprise')
		character_util.remove_anim(princess)
		character_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'surprise')
		character_util.remove_anim(dragon_boy)

		--알이 있는 위치로 2초에 걸쳐 카메라 이동 후, 2초에 걸쳐 다시 돌아옴.
		local egg_pos = self.marker.mystery_egg('pre', 1, 1) + vector(0.075, 0, -0.15)
		local mystery_egg = self.character.mystery_egg()

		character_util.set_direction(mystery_egg, 'down')
		scene_util.set_anim(mystery_egg, self, 'idle_width')
		character_util.set_position(mystery_egg, egg_pos)
		camera_util.move_async(vector(egg_pos.x, 0, egg_pos.z), 2)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		camera_util.return_to_leader(2)

		--플레이어(left, idle, idle)
		--꼬마공주(left, idle, idle)
		--기르가스(left, idle, idle)
		party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()

		--J백작(right, sleep_deep, idle) : 저 알에서 어떤 생명체가 태어날지 알 수 없습니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'right',
				nil, 'sleep_deep', 'fw_tamagotchi_pre_2_8')

		--J백작(right, sleep_deep, idle) : 관심과 사랑으로 키울지, 무관심으로 키울지. 그건 당신의 선택입니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'right',
				nil, 'sleep_deep', 'fw_tamagotchi_pre_2_9')

		--J백작(right, idle, idle) : 또한 그 선택에 책임을 지는 것도 당신입니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'right',
				nil, nil, 'fw_tamagotchi_pre_2_10')

		--J백작(right, idle, staff_idle) : 새로운 생명을 꽃피워 보시겠습니까?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'right',
				'staff_idle', nil, 'fw_tamagotchi_pre_2_11')
	else
		party_align(self.marker.party_align('pre', 1, 1) + vector(-1, 0, 0))

		--J백작(right, sleep_deep, idle) : 당신의 사랑과 관심에 따라, 다른 생명이 탄생한다는 걸 기억해 주시길.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'right',
				nil, 'sleep_deep', 'fw_tamagotchi_pre_2_14')

		--J백작(right, idle, staff_idle) : 그럼 잘 부탁드립니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'staff_idle', keep = true }, nil, 'fw_tamagotchi_pre_2_15')


	end

	--퀘스트 수락 창 출력
	--수락시
	--퀘스트 수락 연출 진행.
	--거절시
	local accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.cs_controller.QuestId, false)

	if accepted then
		--수락시
		local door = self.field_object.door(1)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(door.Name, false))

		character_util.remove_relate_event(count_j, self.controller)

		self.controller.dynamic_npcs:dispose()

		local animal_a = self.character.animal_a()
		field_object_util.set_active_state(animal_a, active_state_type.disabled)

		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		--J백작(right, idle, staff_idle) : 그럼 이쪽으로 오시면 됩니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'right',
				'staff_idle', nil, 'fw_tamagotchi_pre_2_16')

		--J백작(이동 방향, idle, idle) 속도 4로 [F]위치로 이동
		local out_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', count_j.Position + vector(0, 0, -2), -1)
		local wp = {
			vector(count_j.Position.x, count_j.Position.y, out_pos.z),
			out_pos,
		}

		wp_util.move_async(count_j, wp, 4, nil)

		character_util.set_position(count_j, self.marker.count_j('s1', 1, 1))
		character_util.set_direction(count_j, 'down')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(count_j)

		party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()

		self.controller:activate_quest(0)
	else
		--J백작(right, sleep_deep, idle) : 마음이 바뀌면 언제든지 들러 주시길.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'right',
				nil, 'sleep_deep', 'fw_tamagotchi_pre_2_12')

		--J백작(right, sleep_deep, idle) : 당신이라면 분명 찬란한 생명을 품어낼 수 있을 테니.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'right',
				nil, 'sleep_deep', 'fw_tamagotchi_pre_2_13')

		party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()
		camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

		quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(count_j)

		self.current_state = self.states.decline_counts_offer
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('FireWorldTamagotchiSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FireWorldTamagotchi @
		Comment = 알을 들고 순서 맞춰 각 돌보기 이벤트 보기 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type FireWorldTamagotchiController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = { 'fireworld_1' }

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		egg_encounter = 1,
		egg_playtime_1 = 2,
		egg_playtime_2 = 3,
		egg_playtime_3 = 4,
		egg_playtime_4 = 5,
		done = 99,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.egg_encounter

	self.character = metatable_helper.inherit({}, self.controller.character)

	self.field_object = metatable_helper.inherit({}, self.controller.field_object)

	self.marker = metatable_helper.inherit({}, self.controller.marker)

	self.sprite = metatable_helper.inherit({}, self.controller.sprite)

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		twinkle = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle')
		end,

		water_splash = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_common_water_splash_in')
		end,

		bubble_loop = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_ww_bubble_loop')
		end,

		egg_ripple = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_egg_ripple')
		end,

		dead = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
		end,

	})

	self.cashed_fx_list = {
		cached_inst = {},

		cache = function(this, key, fx)
			if this.cached_inst == nil then
				this.cached_inst = {}
			end

			this.cached_inst[key] = fx
		end,

		dispose = function(this, key)
			this.cached_inst[key]:Dispose()
			this.cached_inst[key] = nil
		end,

		dispose_all = function(this, clear_inst)
			for _, cashed_fx in pairs(this.cached_inst) do
				cashed_fx:Dispose()
				cashed_fx = nil
			end

			if clear_inst then
				this.cached_inst = nil
			end
		end,
	}

	self.care_event_info = metatable_helper.inherit({}, self.controller.care_event_info)

	-- 알의 요구사항
	self.egg_requirements = {
		beat_box = 1,	-- 이모티콘 happy 일 때
		sleep = 2,		-- 이모티콘 sleep 일 때
		food = 3,		-- 이모티콘 food 일 때
		wash = 4,		-- 이모티콘 sweat 일 때
	}

	-- 현재 알의 요구사항
	self.cur_egg_requirements = self.egg_requirements.beat_box

	-- 서브 퀘스트 id
	self.sub_quest_id = 489

	self.count_j_event_executed_once = false
	self.count_j_speaks_end = false

	self.dance_music = nil
end

end

function local_class:enter()
	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
	self.fx:create_all()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	local mystery_egg = self.character.mystery_egg()

	self.controller.quest_marker:add({
		{
			zone = 'main_field',
			target = mystery_egg
		}
	})

	local door = self.field_object.door(1)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(door.Name, false))

	local trigger = self.field_object.mystery_egg_trigger()
	trigger.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	start_coroutine(function()
		self.controller:set_pre_npc()

		self.controller:set_current_scene_npc(self.controller.section_state.section_1)
	end)

	local shift_amount = 0
	local quest_progress = quest_util.get_started_quest(self.sub_quest_id)

	self.care_event_info.save_event_encode = quest_util.get_custom_state(quest_progress, self.controller.custom_state_key_1)

	while self.care_event_info.save_event_encode >> shift_amount > 0 do
		table.insert(self.care_event_info.save_event_index_list, (self.care_event_info.save_event_encode >> shift_amount) & 0xFF)
		shift_amount = shift_amount + 8
	end

	if #self.care_event_info.save_event_index_list > 0 then
		self.current_state = self.states.egg_playtime_1
	end

	for i = 1, #self.care_event_info.save_event_index_list do
		local num = self.care_event_info.save_event_index_list[i]

		if self.controller.correct_event_order[i] == num then
			self.controller.cur_egg_point = self.controller.cur_egg_point + 1
		end

		self.care_event_info.cur_event_count = self.care_event_info.cur_event_count + 1

		self.current_state = self.current_state + 1
	end

	if self.current_state > self.states.egg_encounter then
		self.controller.is_exited_area = true
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.cashed_fx_list:dispose_all(true)

	if self.dance_music then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.dance_music)
		self.dance_music = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil

	self.sprite:dispose_all()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state < self.states.done then
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.field_object.mystery_egg_trigger()) then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.start_mystery_egg_event, self)

			return true
		end

		if not self.controller.is_exited_area then
			if self.current_state >= self.states.egg_playtime_1 and self.current_state <= self.states.egg_playtime_4 then
				if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.field_object.beatbox_event_trigger()) then
					sp_util.start_scene(self.beat_dance_event, self)

					return true
				elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.field_object.pillow_event_trigger()) then
					sp_util.start_scene(self.sleep_event, self)

					return true
				elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.field_object.food_event_trigger()) then
					sp_util.start_scene(self.food_event, self)

					return true
				elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.field_object.washer_event_trigger()) then
					sp_util.start_scene(self.wash_event, self)

					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state < self.states.done then
		if not self.count_j_event_executed_once and
				type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'sub_tamagotchi_area') then
			self.count_j_event_executed_once = true

			start_coroutine(self.count_j_speaks, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:count_j_speaks()
	local count_j = self.character.count_j()

	scene_util.set_emotion(count_j, self, 'sleep_deep')

	--J백작(down, sleep_deep, idle) : 이거 하나만 기억해 주시길.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, { key = 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_1_1', skip = false })

	if self.count_j_speaks_end then
		count_j.Interactable.Talk = 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_oneline_5'

		character_util.remove_emotion(count_j)

		return
	end

	--J백작(down, sleep_deep, idle) : 당신의 관심과 사랑에 따라, 다른 생명이 탄생하게 된다는 걸요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, { key = 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_1_2', skip = false })

	count_j.Interactable.Talk = 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_oneline_5'

	character_util.remove_emotion(count_j)
end

function local_class:start_mystery_egg_event()
	local knight = user_party.Leader
	local princess = self.character.princess()
	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy()
	local mystery_egg = self.character.mystery_egg()

	local party_align_pos = self.marker.knight('s1', 1, 1)

	local animal_b = self.character.animal_b()
	local animal_c = self.character.animal_c()
	local animal_d = self.character.animal_d()

	field_object_util.set_active_state(animal_b, active_state_type.disabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(animal_c, active_state_type.disabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(animal_d, active_state_type.disabled)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)


	self.count_j_speaks_end = true
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.character.count_j())

	--플레이어 일행 (left, idle, idle) 둥지에 우측 정렬
	do
		local align_key = 'party_wp'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, party_align_pos, nil, 1,
				self, align_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		party_align_pos = self.marker.princess('s1', 1, 1)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, party_align_pos, nil, 1,
				self, align_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		party_align_pos = self.marker.dragon_boy('s1', 1, 1)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dragon_boy, party_align_pos, nil, 1,
				self, align_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, align_key)
	end

	--하늘색 퀘스트 마커 해제
	self.controller.quest_marker:remove()

	--현재 지역 팻말 주변의 beat_basket, 물통none, 음식none, 배게none 오브젝트에서 fx_object_twinke 활성화.
	local tringger = self.field_object.beatbox_event_trigger()
	local tringger_twinkle_pos = tringger.Position + vector(0, 1, 0)
	local fx_twinkle = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(tringger_twinkle_pos)
	self.cashed_fx_list:cache('beatbox', fx_twinkle)
	tringger.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	self.controller:set_trigger_interaction_state(tringger, true)

	tringger = self.field_object.pillow_event_trigger()
	tringger_twinkle_pos = tringger.Position + vector(0, 1, 0)
	fx_twinkle = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(tringger_twinkle_pos)
	self.cashed_fx_list:cache('pillow', fx_twinkle)
	self.controller:set_trigger_interaction_state(tringger, true)

	tringger = self.field_object.food_event_trigger()
	tringger_twinkle_pos = tringger.Position + vector(0, 1, 0)
	fx_twinkle = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(tringger_twinkle_pos)
	self.cashed_fx_list:cache('food', fx_twinkle)
	self.controller:set_trigger_interaction_state(tringger, true)

	tringger = self.field_object.washer_event_trigger()
	tringger_twinkle_pos = tringger.Position + vector(0, 1, 0)
	fx_twinkle = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(tringger_twinkle_pos)
	self.cashed_fx_list:cache('washer', fx_twinkle)
	self.controller:set_trigger_interaction_state(tringger, true)

	-- 첫 시작 처리
	if not self.controller.is_exited_area then
		--0.5초 대기
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--기르가스(left, idle, idle) : 이 알인가?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'left',
				nil, nil, 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_2_1')

		--꼬마공주(left, smile, idle) : 건강하게 태어날 수 있게 정성껏 돌봐줘야지!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left',
				nil, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_2_2')

		--미지의알 happy 이모티콘 출력.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(mystery_egg, self, nil,
				nil, nil, 'happy')

		--꼬마공주(left, smile, idle) : 알이 같이 춤추면서 놀고 싶나 봐!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left',
				nil, 'smile', 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_2_3')

		--플레이어(left, smile, nod 2회)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'smile')
		character_util.nod_twice(knight)

		--원라인 백작 : 춤은 모두를 즐겁게 만들죠.
		local count_j = self.character.count_j()
		count_j.Interactable.Talk = 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_oneline_6'
	end

	--플레이어(left, attack, hold 애니메이션 1회 후 ilde)상태로 미지의알을 1회 y좌표 1.0지점인 머리 위로 듦
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
	self.controller:on_egg_pickup()

	--이후 플레이어가 미지의 알을 머리로 드는 연출에서는 y좌표 1.0지점
	--플레이어 컨트롤 돌려줌
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	self.controller:set_trigger_interaction_state(self.field_object.mystery_egg_trigger(), false)

	if not self.controller.is_exited_area then
		self.current_state = self.states.egg_playtime_1
	end

	self.controller.egg_hatching_started = true

	self.controller.is_exited_area = false

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:beat_dance_event()
	local knight = user_party.Leader
	local princess = self.character.princess()
	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy()
	local mystery_egg = self.character.mystery_egg()

	local party_align_pos = self.marker.party_align('s1', 1, 1)

	if not self:check_egg_event_status({ pos = party_align_pos, dir = 'up' }) then
		return
	end

	--플레이어(이동 방향, idle, idle)  미지의알(idle_width)을 머리 위(y좌표1.0)를 유지한채로  [H]위치로 이동
	--꼬마공주(이동 방향, idle, idle), 기르가스(이동 방향, idle, idle) 함께 이동
	scene_util.set_anim(mystery_egg, self, { name = 'idle_width' })

	local align_key = 'party_wp'

	do
		party_align_pos = self.marker.knight('s1', 2, 1)
		local wp = {
			vector(party_align_pos.x, knight.Position.y, knight.Position.z),
			party_align_pos,
		}
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, wp, 4, nil,
				self, align_key, { last_direction = 'left', y_mode = 'floor' })

		party_align_pos = self.marker.princess('s1', 2, 1)
		wp = {
			vector(party_align_pos.x - 1, princess.Position.y, princess.Position.z),
			vector(party_align_pos.x - 1, princess.Position.y, party_align_pos.z - 2),
			vector(party_align_pos.x, princess.Position.y, party_align_pos.z - 2),
			party_align_pos,
		}
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, wp, 4, nil,
				self, align_key, { last_direction = 'left', y_mode = 'floor' })

		party_align_pos = self.marker.dragon_boy('s1', 2, 1)
		wp = {
			vector(party_align_pos.x - 2, dragon_boy.Position.y, dragon_boy.Position.z),
			vector(party_align_pos.x - 2, dragon_boy.Position.y, party_align_pos.z - 2),
			vector(party_align_pos.x - 1, dragon_boy.Position.y, party_align_pos.z - 2),
			party_align_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			party_align_pos,
		}
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dragon_boy, wp, 4, nil,
				self, align_key, { last_direction = 'left', y_mode = 'floor' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, align_key)
	end

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--꼬마공주(left, smile, ilde) : 예전에 켄터베리에서 엄청 신나는 춤 배운적 있는데…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left',
			'ilde', 'smile', 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_dance_1_1')

	--꼬마공주(left, smile, idle) : 이 춤을 다 같이 추면 신날 거 같아!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left',
			nil, 'smile', 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_dance_1_2')

	--기르가스(left, idle, idle) : 춤? 신나겠는데!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_dance_1_3')

	--꼬마공주(이동 방향, idle, idle) [J]위치로 이동
	local move_pos = self.marker.princess('s1', 2, 2)
	local wp = {
		vector(princess.Position.x, princess.Position.y, move_pos.z),
		move_pos,
	}
	wp_util.move_async(princess, wp, 4, nil)

	--기르가스(left, smile, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'smile')
	character_util.remove_anim(dragon_boy)

	--플레이어(left, smile, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'smile')
	character_util.remove_anim(knight)

	--꼬마공주(down, smile, idle) : 어떤 춤인지 보여줄게!
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'down',
			nil, 'smile', 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_dance_1_4')

	--플레이어(left, smile, walk) 1타일 이동
	wp_util.move_async(knight, knight.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 4, nil, { locked_dir = 'left' })

	--플레이어(left, smile, nod 2회 후 idle)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.nod_twice(knight)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--꼬마공주 솔로 연출(속도 2.5로 이동)
	local party_voodoo_dance = function(princess_only)
		wait_all_lua(
				function()
					--wall_speaker_R, wall_speaker_L 오브젝트 0.05강도 shake
					--0.5초간 출력
					--0.3초 대기
					--0.5초간 출력

					local fo = self.field_object.speaker('right')
					field_object_util.shake(fo, 0.05, 0.5)

					fo = self.field_object.speaker('left')
					field_object_util.shake(fo, 0.05, 0.5)

					wait_for_sec(0.5)

					wait_for_sec(0.3)

					fo = self.field_object.speaker('right')
					field_object_util.shake(fo, 0.05, 0.5)

					fo = self.field_object.speaker('left')
					field_object_util.shake(fo, 0.05, 0.5)

					wait_for_sec(0.5)
				end,
				function()
					if princess_only == nil or princess_only == false then
						--플레이어 (down, smile, dance_voodoo 1.5초)
						scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'smile')
						scene_util.play_wait_action(knight, self, 'down',
								'dance_voodoo', nil, 1.5)
					end
				end,
				function()
					--꼬마공주 (down, smile, dance_voodoo 1.5초)
					scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'smile')
					scene_util.play_wait_action(princess, self, 'down',
							'dance_voodoo', nil, 1.5)
				end,
				function()
					if princess_only == nil or princess_only == false then
						--기르가스 (down, smile, dance_voodoo 1.5초)
						scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'smile')
						scene_util.play_wait_action(dragon_boy, self, 'down',
								'dance_voodoo', nil, 1.5)
					end
				end
		)
	end

	self.dance_music = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_amb_cf_04', loop = true})

	--꼬마공주 (down, smile, dance_voodoo
	party_voodoo_dance(true)

	--꼬마공주 좌측으로 1타일 이동 후
	wp_util.move_async(princess, princess.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 2.5, nil)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')

	--꼬마공주(left, smile, dance) 1.5초
	scene_util.play_wait_action(princess, self, 'left',
			'dance', 'smile', 1.5)

	--꼬마공주(right, smile, dance) 1초
	scene_util.play_wait_action(princess, self, 'right',
			'dance', 'smile', 1.5)

	--꼬마공주 우측으로 1타일 이동 후
	wp_util.move_async(princess, princess.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 2.5, nil)

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--wall_speaker_R, wall_speaker_L 오브젝트 0.05강도 shake
				--0.5초간 출력
				--0.3초 대기

				local fo = self.field_object.speaker('right')
				field_object_util.shake(fo, 0.05, 0.5)

				fo = self.field_object.speaker('left')
				field_object_util.shake(fo, 0.05, 0.5)

				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				wait_for_sec(0.3)
			end,
			function()
				--꼬마공주(down, smile, dance_voodoo 1.5초)
				scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'smile')
				scene_util.play_wait_action(princess, self, 'down',
						'dance_voodoo', nil, 1.5)
			end

function local_class:sleep_event()
	local knight = user_party.Leader
	local princess = self.character.princess()
	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy()
	local mystery_egg = self.character.mystery_egg()

	local party_align_pos = self.marker.party_align('s1', 2, 1)

	if not self:check_egg_event_status({ pos = party_align_pos, dir = 'down' }) then
		return
	end

	--플레이어(이동 방향, idle, idle) 미지의알을 머리 위에 든 채로 [K]위치로 이동
	--이동 후 1초에 걸쳐 아래와 같이 정렬
	local align_key = 'party_wp'

	do
		party_align_pos = self.marker.knight('s1', 3, 1)
		local wp = {
			vector(party_align_pos.x + 1, knight.Position.y, knight.Position.z),
			vector(party_align_pos.x + 1, knight.Position.y, party_align_pos.z + 1.5),
			vector(party_align_pos.x, knight.Position.y, party_align_pos.z + 1.5),
			party_align_pos,
		}
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, wp, 4, nil,
				self, align_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

		party_align_pos = self.marker.princess('s1', 3, 1)
		wp = {
			vector(party_align_pos.x + 1, princess.Position.y, princess.Position.z),
			vector(party_align_pos.x + 1, princess.Position.y, party_align_pos.z + 2.5),
			vector(party_align_pos.x - 1, princess.Position.y, party_align_pos.z + 2.5),
			vector(party_align_pos.x - 1, princess.Position.y, party_align_pos.z),
			party_align_pos,
		}
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, wp, 4, nil,
				self, align_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

		party_align_pos = self.marker.dragon_boy('s1', 3, 1)
		wp = {
			vector(party_align_pos.x + 1, dragon_boy.Position.y, dragon_boy.Position.z),
			vector(party_align_pos.x + 1, dragon_boy.Position.y, party_align_pos.z + 0.5),
			vector(party_align_pos.x, dragon_boy.Position.y, party_align_pos.z + 0.5),
			party_align_pos,
		}
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dragon_boy, wp, 4, nil,
				self, align_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, align_key)
	end

	--플레이어(right, idle, idle)에서 throw 애니메이션 1회 후, 미지의알을 building_pasture_pet_bed 위에 내려놓음
	scene_util.set_anim(mystery_egg, self, { name = 'idle' })
	self.controller:on_egg_put_down(knight.Position + vector(1.5, 0.75, 0.2))

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--미지의알(jump 2회)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fat_gnome_03')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(mystery_egg, self, { name = 'jump', count = 2 })

	--미지의알(left, idle_width) jump 후 idle 상태에서 idle_width로 바뀔 때 애니메이션 0.5배
	scene_util.set_direction(mystery_egg, 'left', false)

	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(mystery_egg, 'idle_width') / 0.5

	wait_for_sec(anim_duration)

	--꼬마공주(right, smile, idle) : $name의 자장가 소리 들으면 좋은 꿈 꾸곤 했는데…

			nil, 'smile', { key = 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_sleep_1_1', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'rb' })

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0, 2)

	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'smile')
	character_util.nod_twice(knight)

	--미지의알(idle_width)상태에서 미지의알(idle)로 변경 후 building_pasture_pet_bed 위에서 jump 애니 2회
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fat_gnome_03')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(mystery_egg, self, { name = 'jump', count = 2 })

	character_util.remove_anim(mystery_egg)
	scene_util.set_direction(mystery_egg, 'down', false)

	--플레이어(right, idle,  hold 애니메이션 1회 후 ilde) 상태로 변경되며, 미지의알을 머리 위로 듦

	self.controller:on_egg_pickup()

	--꼬마공주, 기르가스 플레이어 우측에 정렬

	--알의 요구사항에 따라 출력되는 연출
	if self.cur_egg_requirements == self.egg_requirements.sleep then
		--알이 출력한 이모티콘이 happy였을 경우
		--1점 획득
		self.controller.cur_egg_point = self.controller.cur_egg_point + 1

		--미지의알(idle_width) 이모티콘 heart
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		self:play_mystery_egg_emoticon({ type = 'heart', offset = vector(0.15, 0, 1.5) })

		wait_for_sec(2.5)

		--플레이어(right, smile, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'smile')
		character_util.remove_anim(knight)

		scene_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'smile')
		character_util.remove_anim(dragon_boy)

		--꼬마공주(right, smile, sing) : 푹 잤어? 다음에도 자장가 불러줄게!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'right',
				'sing', 'smile', { key = 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_sleep_1_7', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'rb' })

		--알이 출력한 이모티콘이 happy가 아니었을 경우
		--점수 획득 없음
		--미지의알(idle_width) 이모티콘 annoyed
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
		self:play_mystery_egg_emoticon({ type = 'annoyed', offset = vector(0.15, 0, 1.5) })

		wait_for_sec(2.5)

		--플레이어(right,tired, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'tired')
		character_util.remove_anim(knight)

		--기르가스(right, tired, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'tired')
		character_util.remove_anim(dragon_boy)

		--꼬마공주(right, tired, idle) : 놀고 싶은 게 아니었나봐.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'right',
				nil, 'tired', { key = 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_sleep_1_8', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'rb' })

	end

	-- 다음 알과 놀아주기(혹은 클리어) 상태로 변경
	local clear = self:check_last_event_part()

	self:save_event_num(self.controller.events.sleep)

	-- 섹션1 클리어 상태
	--다음 섹션으로 진행
	if clear then
		self:last_event(self.controller.events.sleep)
	else
		party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:food_event()
	local knight = user_party.Leader
	local princess = self.character.princess()
	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy()
	local mystery_egg = self.character.mystery_egg()

	local party_align_pos = self.marker.party_align('s1', 3, 1)

	if not self:check_egg_event_status({ pos = party_align_pos, dir = 'down' }) then
		return
	end

	--플레이어(이동 방향, idle, idle)가 미지의 알을 들고, [L]위치로 이동.
	local align_key = 'party_wp'

	do
		party_align_pos = self.marker.knight('s1', 4, 1)
		local wp = {
			knight.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0),
			knight.Position + vector(-2, 0, -3),
			party_align_pos,
		}
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, wp, 4, nil,
				self, align_key, { last_direction = 'down' })

		party_align_pos = self.marker.princess('s1', 4, 1)
		wp = {
			princess.Position + vector(-3, 0, 0),
			princess.Position + vector(-3, 0, -3),
			party_align_pos,
		}
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, wp, 4, nil,
				self, align_key, { last_direction = 'down' })

		party_align_pos = self.marker.dragon_boy('s1', 4, 1)
		wp = {
			dragon_boy.Position + vector(-4, 0, 0),
			dragon_boy.Position + vector(-4, 0, -3),
			party_align_pos,
		}
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dragon_boy, wp, 4, nil,

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, align_key)
