				--green_paprika, empty_dish가 1.5초에 걸쳐 점점 작아지면서 사라짐.
				quest_drop_item_util.scale(paprika, 0, 1.5)
				scene_util.play_wait_action(mystery_egg, self, nil,
						'dance', nil, 1.5)

				self.sprite:dispose('paprika')
				music_player_util.stop_sfx(eat_sfx)
				eat_sfx = nil

				--꼬마공주(down, surprise, idle) : 피망을 먹었어. 대, 대단해…
				--플레이어(right, surprise, idle)
				--기르가스(right, surprise, idle)
				self:change_party_dir_n_anim_n_emo(nil, 'surprise', 'idle', nil)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, nil,
						nil, nil, 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_food_1_6_3')

				--기르가스(down, surprise, idle) : 이런 걸 먹다니 제법이야.
				--플레이어(right, surprise, idle)
				--꼬마공주(down, surprise, idle)
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'down',
						nil, nil, 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_food_1_6_4')

				wp = {
					vector(knight.Position.x, knight.Position.y, knight.Position.z + 1),
					vector(mystery_egg.Position.x, knight.Position.y, knight.Position.z + 1),
				}

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
				wp_util.move_async(knight, wp, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'down' })

				--0.5초 대기
				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				--플레이어(right, idle,  hold 애니메이션 1회 후 ilde) 상태로 알을 머리 위로 듦
				party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()
				self.controller:on_egg_pickup()
			end
		},
	})

	--알의 요구사항에 따라 출력되는 연출
	if self.cur_egg_requirements == self.egg_requirements.food then
		--알이 출력한 이모티콘이 food였을 경우
		--1점 획득
		self.controller.cur_egg_point = self.controller.cur_egg_point + 1

		--미지의알 이모티콘 heart
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		self:play_mystery_egg_emoticon({ type = 'heart', offset = vector(0.15, 0, 1.5) })

		wait_for_sec(2.5)

		--플레이어(left, smile, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'smile')
		character_util.remove_anim(knight)

		--기르가스(right, smile, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'smile')
		character_util.remove_anim(dragon_boy)

		--꼬마공주(right, smile, sing) : 배부른가 봐!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'right',
				'sing', 'smile', 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_food_1_7')

	else
		--알이 출력한 이모티콘이 food가 아니었을 경우
		--점수 획득 없음
		--미지의알 이모티콘 annoyed
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
		self:play_mystery_egg_emoticon({ type = 'annoyed', offset = vector(0.15, 0, 1.5) })

		wait_for_sec(2.5)

		--플레이어(left,tired, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'tired')
		character_util.remove_anim(knight)

		--기르가스(right, tired, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'tired')
		character_util.remove_anim(dragon_boy)

		--꼬마공주(right, tired, idle) : 배가 고픈 게 아니었던 걸까?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'right',
				nil, 'tired', 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_food_1_8')

	end

	-- 다음 알과 놀아주기(혹은 클리어) 상태로 변경
	local clear = self:check_last_event_part()

	self:save_event_num(self.controller.events.food)

	-- 섹션1 클리어 상태
	--다음 섹션으로 진행
	if clear then
		self:last_event(self.controller.events.food)
	else
		party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:wash_event()
	local knight = user_party.Leader
	local princess = self.character.princess()
	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy()
	local mystery_egg = self.character.mystery_egg()

	local party_align_pos = self.marker.party_align('s1', 4, 1)

	if not self:check_egg_event_status({ pos = party_align_pos, dir = 'down' }) then
		return
	end

	--플레이어(이동 방향, idle, idle)가 미지의알을 머리 위에 든 채로 [N]위치로 이동
	local wp

	--이동 후 1초에 걸쳐 아래와 같이 정렬
	local align_key = 'party_wp'

	do
		party_align_pos = self.marker.knight('s1', 5, 1)
		wp = {
			knight.Position + vector(-2.5, 0, 0),
			knight.Position + vector(-2.5, 0, -3),
			party_align_pos,
		}
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, wp, 4, nil,
				self, align_key, { last_direction = 'down' })

		party_align_pos = self.marker.princess('s1', 5, 1)
		wp = {
			princess.Position + vector(-3.5, 0, 0),
			princess.Position + vector(-3.5, 0, -3),
			party_align_pos,
		}
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, wp, 4, nil,
				self, align_key, { last_direction = 'down' })

		party_align_pos = self.marker.dragon_boy('s1', 5, 1)
		wp = {
			dragon_boy.Position + vector(-4.5, 0, 0),
			dragon_boy.Position + vector(-4.5, 0, -3),
			party_align_pos,
		}
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dragon_boy, wp, 4, nil,
				self, align_key, { last_direction = 'down' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, align_key)
	end

	--플레이어가(left, idle, idle)상태로 타임스케일 0.5배로 throw 애니메이션 1회 후, 미지의알을 [gimmick]fireworld_spa1 온천 안에 던져 넣음.
	character_util.remove_anim(mystery_egg)
	self.controller:on_egg_put_down(knight.Position + vector(-1.5, -0.55, -1.5), 'left')

	--미지의알 온천 던져질 때, fx_common_water_splash_in 이펙트 출력되며 온천 중앙에 위치
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_splash_02')
	self.fx.water_splash():Instantiate(mystery_egg.Position)

	self.cashed_fx_list:cache('egg_ripple', self.fx.egg_ripple():Instantiate(vector(mystery_egg.Position.x, 0, mystery_egg.Position.z - 0.1)))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--기르가스(down, idle, idle) : 꼬질꼬질해 보여. 씻기면 한결 나아지겠지!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_wash_1_1')

	--꼬마공주(down, smile, idle) : 뽀독뽀독 구석구석 씻겨주자!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'down',
			nil, 'smile', 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_wash_1_2')

	--꼬마공주(down, smile, idle) : 깨끗함이 건강의 첫걸음이야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'down',
			nil, 'smile', 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_wash_1_3')

	--플레이어(left, smile, nod 2회 후 idle)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'smile')
	character_util.nod_twice(knight)

	--QTE 진행(QTE 진행 중에는 전원 속도4로 이동, QTE 실패 없음)
	--우측 스와이프 1회
	--플레이어 일행 아래 위치로 이동하여 정렬

	--꼬마공주(left, idle, idle)
	--기르가스(left, idle, idle)

	align_key = 'party_wp'

	local knight_align_pos = self.marker.knight('s1', 5, 2)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, knight_align_pos, 4, nil,
			self, align_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

	local princess_align_pos = self.marker.princess('s1', 5, 2)
	wp = {
		vector(knight_align_pos.x, princess.Position.y, princess.Position.z),
		princess_align_pos,
	}
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, wp, 4, nil,
			self, align_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

	local dragon_boy_align_pos = self.marker.dragon_boy('s1', 5, 2)

		vector(knight_align_pos.x, dragon_boy.Position.y, dragon_boy.Position.z),

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, align_key)

	--화면 터치 5회
	--동시 연출
	--플레이어(left, smile, dance)
	--꼬마공주(left, smile, dance)
	--기르가스(left, smile, dance)

	--기르가스(left, smile, dacne)

		knight.Position + vector(-3, 0, -0.5),

		princess.Position + vector(-3, 0, -1.5),
		party_align_pos,
	}
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, wp, nil, 1,
			self, align_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

	party_align_pos = self.marker.dragon_boy('s1', 5, 3)

	}

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, align_key)

	--화면 터치 5회

	--QTE 진행 전(QTE 진행 가능 상태)

	--기르가스(left, smile, dacne)

	--[gimmick]firewrld_spa1(2*2)온천 좌측에서 fx_ww_bubble_loop 출력

			self.cashed_fx_list:cache('bubble_loop_2', self.fx.bubble_loop():Instantiate(mystery_egg.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)))

	end })

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(dash_sfx)
	dash_sfx = nil

	-- fx_ww_bubble_loop 거품 이펙트
	--플레이어(right, smile, idle)
	--꼬마공주(right, smile, idle)
	--기르가스(right, smile, idle)
	--1초 유지

	wait_for_sec(2)

	fx_twinkle:Dispose()
	fx_twinkle = nil

	--플레이어(right, smile, idle)
	--기르가스(right, idle, idle)
	--꼬마공주(right, smile, sing) : 티 하나 없이 깨끗해졌어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'right',
			'sing', nil, 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_wash_1_4')

	--플레이어(right, smile, idle)
	--꼬마공주(right, smile, idle)

	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()
	self.controller:on_egg_pickup()

		--미지의알 이모티콘 heart

		self:play_mystery_egg_emoticon({ type = 'heart', offset = vector(0.15, 0, 1.5) })

		wait_for_sec(2.5)

		--플레이어(right, smile, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'smile')
		character_util.remove_anim(knight)

		--기르가스(right, smile, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'smile')
		character_util.remove_anim(dragon_boy)

		--꼬마공주(right, smile, sing) : 아주 만족했나봐!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'right',
				'sing', 'smile', 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_wash_1_6')

	else
		--알이 출력한 이모티콘이 happy가 아니었을 경우
		--점수 획득 없음
		--미지의알 이모티콘 annoyed
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
		self:play_mystery_egg_emoticon({ type = 'annoyed', offset = vector(0.15, 0, 1.5) })

		wait_for_sec(2.5)

		--플레이어(right,tired, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'tired')
		character_util.remove_anim(knight)

		--기르가스(right, tired, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'tired')
		character_util.remove_anim(dragon_boy)

		--꼬마공주(right, tired, idle) : 아직 씻고 싶지 않았던 걸까?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'right',
				nil, 'tired', 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_wash_1_7')

	end

	-- 다음 알과 놀아주기(혹은 클리어) 상태로 변경
	local clear = self:check_last_event_part()

	self:save_event_num(self.controller.events.wash)

	-- 섹션1 클리어 상태
	--다음 섹션으로 진행
	if clear then
		self:last_event(self.controller.events.wash)
	else
		party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:check_last_event_part()
	local knight = user_party.Leader
	local princess = self.character.princess()
	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy()
	local mystery_egg = self.character.mystery_egg()

	if self.current_state == self.states.egg_playtime_1 then
		self.current_state = self.states.egg_playtime_2
		self.cur_egg_requirements = self.egg_requirements.sleep

		--미지의알 sleep 이모티콘 출력
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_sleep_02')
		self:play_mystery_egg_emoticon({ type = 'sleep', offset = vector(0.15, 0, 1.5) })

		wait_for_sec(2.5)

		--꼬마공주(이동 방향, idle, idle) : 알이 졸린가봐 !좋은 꿈 꿀 수 있게 자장가 불러주자!
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, nil,
				nil, nil, 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_common_event_2_1')

		--원라인 백작 : 충분한 수면은 반드시 필요합니다.
		local count_j = self.character.count_j()
		count_j.Interactable.Talk = 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_oneline_7'

		return false

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.egg_playtime_2 then
		self.current_state = self.states.egg_playtime_3
		self.cur_egg_requirements = self.egg_requirements.food

		--미지의알 food 이모티콘 출력
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_eat_02')
		self:play_mystery_egg_emoticon({ type = 'food', offset = vector(0.15, 0, 1.5) })

		wait_for_sec(2.5)

		--꼬마공주(이동 방향, idle, idle) : 배가 고픈 걸까? 어떤 걸 좋아하려나?
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, nil,
				nil, nil, 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_common_event_3_1')

		--원라인 백작 : 편식은 좋지 않습니다.
		local count_j = self.character.count_j()
		count_j.Interactable.Talk = 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_oneline_8'

		return false

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.egg_playtime_3 then
		self.current_state = self.states.egg_playtime_4
		self.cur_egg_requirements = self.egg_requirements.wash

		--미지의알 sweat 이모티콘 출력
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gell_fall_down_01')
		self:play_mystery_egg_emoticon({ type = 'sweat', offset = vector(0.15, 0, 1.5) })

		wait_for_sec(2.5)

		--꼬마공주(이동 방향, idle, idle) : 뽀독뽀독 깨끗이 씻으면 기분 좋아져!
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, nil,
				nil, nil, 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_common_event_4_1')

		--원라인 백작 : 청결은 건강의 시작입니다.
		local count_j = self.character.count_j()
		count_j.Interactable.Talk = 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_oneline_9'

		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:check_egg_event_status(party_align_info)
	local knight = user_party.Leader
	local princess = self.character.princess()
	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy()

	local align_key = 'party_wp'

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, party_align_info.pos, nil, 1,
				self, align_key, { last_direction = party_align_info.dir })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, party_align_info.pos + vector(1, 0, 0), nil, 1,
				self, align_key, { last_direction = party_align_info.dir })

	--공통 연출, 선택지 출력

		{ 'fw_tamagotchi_s1_common_event_1_2', 'forced' },

function local_class:save_event_num(event_num)
	local event_idx = event_num
	local shift_amount = 0

	while self.care_event_info.save_event_encode >> shift_amount > 0 do
		shift_amount = shift_amount + 8
	end

	if self.care_event_info.save_event_encode ~= -1 then
		self.care_event_info.save_event_encode = self.care_event_info.save_event_encode | (event_idx << shift_amount)
	else
		self.care_event_info.save_event_encode = event_idx
	end

	local quest_progress = quest_util.get_started_quest(self.sub_quest_id)

	quest_util.set_custom_state(quest_progress, self.controller.custom_state_key_1, self.care_event_info.save_event_encode)
end

function local_class:play_mystery_egg_emoticon(param)
	local type = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'type', nil)
	local custom_sprite = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'custom_sprite', nil)
	local base_scale = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'base_scale', vector(1, 1, 1))
	local scale = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'scale', 1.0)
	local active_duration = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'active_duration', 0.5)
	local wait_duration = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'wait_duration', 2)
	local remove_duration = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'remove_duration', 0.2)
	local no_time_limit = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'no_time_limit', false)
	local offset = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'offset', vector(0, 0, 1))
	local item_sprite_p2w = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'item_sprite_p2w', 0.02)
	local should_following = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'should_following', false)

	local emoticon_param = CS.Oak.EmoticonGenerateParam(user_party.Leader)

	type = character_util.get_emoticon_type(type)

	emoticon_param.EmoticonType = type
	emoticon_param.SpriteName = custom_sprite
	emoticon_param.BaseScale = base_scale
	emoticon_param.Scale = scale
	emoticon_param.ActiveDuration = active_duration
	emoticon_param.WaitDuration = wait_duration
	emoticon_param.ContentHideDuration = remove_duration
	emoticon_param.NoTimeLimit = no_time_limit
	emoticon_param.Offset = offset
	emoticon_param.ItemSpriteP2W = item_sprite_p2w
	emoticon_param.ShouldFollowing = should_following

	return stage.EmoticonManager:ShowOn(emoticon_param)
end

return local_class

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)

	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	--self.available_stage_names = {}

		none = 1,
		hatch_an_egg = 2,
	}

	self.marker = metatable_helper.inherit({}, self.controller.marker)

	self.sprite = metatable_helper.inherit({}, self.controller.sprite)

		explosion = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fw_pet_incubation_light')
		end,

		crack = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fw_pet_incubation_crarck_loop')
		end,

		fire = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_qc_flamethrower')
		end,

		lava_boat_drop = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fw_lava_boat_drop')
		end,

		lava_piller = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fw_lava_fountain_lava_piller')
		end,

		dead = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
		end,

		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,

		lava_bubble = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fw_lava_bubble')
		end,
	})

	self.cashed_fx_list = {
		cached_inst = {},

		cache = function(this, key, fx)
			if this.cached_inst == nil then
				this.cached_inst = {}
			end

			this.cached_inst[key] = fx
		end,

		get = function(this, key)
			if this.cached_inst ~= nil then
				return this.cached_inst[key]
			end

			return nil
		end,

		dispose = function(this, key)
			this.cached_inst[key]:Dispose()
			this.cached_inst[key] = nil
		end,

		dispose_all = function(this, clear_inst)
			for _, cashed_fx in pairs(this.cached_inst) do
				cashed_fx:Dispose()
				cashed_fx = nil
			end

			if clear_inst then
				this.cached_inst = nil
			end
		end,
	}

	self.care_event_info = metatable_helper.inherit({}, self.controller.care_event_info)

	-- 연출 중 알에서 나온 펫, 홀링 상태 플래그
	self.is_pet_loop_action = false

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.cashed_fx_list:dispose_all(true)

	self.is_pet_loop_action = false

	if self.loop_sfx then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.loop_sfx)
		self.loop_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none then
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.field_object.mystery_egg_trigger()) then
			self.current_state = self.states.hatch_an_egg

			sp_util.start_scene(self.hatch_an_egg_event, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:hatch_an_egg_event()
	local knight = user_party.Leader
	local princess = self.character.princess()
	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy()
	local mystery_egg = self.character.mystery_egg()
	local count_j = self.character.count_j()

	self.controller.quest_marker:remove()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	local align_key = 'party_wp'

	local party_align_pos = self.marker.knight('s2', 1, 1)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, party_align_pos, nil, 1,
			self, align_key, { last_direction = 'down' })

	party_align_pos = self.marker.princess('s2', 1, 1)

			self, align_key, { last_direction = 'down' })

	party_align_pos = self.marker.dragon_boy('s2', 1, 1)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dragon_boy, party_align_pos, nil, 1,
			self, align_key, { last_direction = 'down' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, align_key)

	--기르가스(left, smile, cast2) : 이, 위대한 염룡이 키웠으니, 당연히 훌륭하게 태어나겠지!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dragon_boy, self, 'left',
			'cast2', 'smile', 'fw_tamagotchi_s2_1_1')

	--플레이어(right, smile, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'smile')

	--기르가스(left, smile, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'smile')

	--꼬마공주(left, smile, sing) : 푹 쉬고, 건강하게 쑥쑥 자라줘!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left',
			'sing', { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'fw_tamagotchi_s2_1_2')

	--0~3점 공통연출
	if self.controller.cur_egg_point <= 3 then
		--미지의알 0.03 강도로 shake
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(mystery_egg, 0.03, 99999)

		--플레이어(right, surprise, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'surprise')

		--기르가스(left, surprise, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'surprise')

		--꼬마공주(left, surprise, idle) : 어? 어?! 저기 봐봐!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left',
				nil, { name = 'surprise', keep = true }, 'fw_tamagotchi_s2_1_3')

		--미지의알 crack 이펙트 크기 0.8배로 축소
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_morian_thorns_03', 0.3)
		character_util.stop_shake(mystery_egg)
		local fx_crack = self.fx.crack():Instantiate(mystery_egg.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.1),
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.down), mystery_egg.Transform)
		fx_crack.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.8
		self.cashed_fx_list:cache('crack', fx_crack)
		fx_crack.transform:SetParent(mystery_egg.Transform)

		--플레이어(right, surprise, idle)
		--기르가스(left, surprise, idle)

		--꼬마공주(left, surprise, idle) : 태어 나나봐!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left',
				nil, { name = 'surprise', keep = true }, 'fw_tamagotchi_s2_1_4')


		--fx_fw_pet_incubation_light 알 위에 출력
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magic_shield_01')
		self.fx.explosion():Instantiate(mystery_egg.Position)

		--wait_for_sec(1.4)
		-- 1.5초에 걸쳐서 화면 전체 화이트 아웃
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1.5, unity_class.color.white,'linear')

		if self.controller.cur_egg_point == 0 then
			self:spawn_magma()
		elseif self.controller.cur_egg_point == 1 or self.controller.cur_egg_point == 2 then
			self:spawn_slime()
		elseif self.controller.cur_egg_point == 3 then
			self:spawn_minotaur()
		end
	elseif self.controller.cur_egg_point >= 4 then
		--미지의알 0.03 강도로 shake
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(mystery_egg, 0.03, 99999)

		--플레이어(right, surprise, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'surprise')

		--기르가스(left, surprise, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'surprise')

		--꼬마공주(left, surprise, idle) : 어? 어?! 저기 봐봐!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left',
				nil, { name = 'surprise', keep = true }, 'fw_tamagotchi_s2_1_3')

		--미지의알 shake하며 crack 이펙트 이펙트 크기 0.8배로 축소
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_morian_thorns_03', 0.3)
		character_util.stop_shake(mystery_egg)
		local fx_crack = self.fx.crack():Instantiate(mystery_egg.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.1),
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.down), mystery_egg.Transform)
		fx_crack.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.8
		self.cashed_fx_list:cache('crack', fx_crack)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--플레이어(right, surprise, embarrassed)
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'surprise')
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'embarrassed')

		--꼬마공주(down, surprise, embarrassed)
		scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'down', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'surprise')
		scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, 'embarrassed')

		--기르가스(left, surprise, embarrassed)
		scene_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'surprise')
		scene_util.set_anim(dragon_boy, self, 'embarrassed')

		--J백작(이동 방향, idle, idle) 속도7로 [V] 위치로 이동
		--이때 카메라는 플레이어 고정. J백작은 카메라 밖에서 이동하여 화면 안으로 들어옴
		local star_piece = self.field_object.star_piece()
		local out_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right', star_piece.Position, 1.5)

		character_util.set_position(count_j, out_pos)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(count_j)

		local wp = {
			vector(mystery_egg.Position.x - 1.5, 0, count_j.Position.z),
			vector(mystery_egg.Position.x - 1.5, 0, mystery_egg.Position.z),
		}
		wp_util.move_async(count_j, wp, 7, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

		--J백작(right, attack, release) : 화산 지대 생명체는 높은 체온이 필수…!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'release' }, 'attack', { key = 'fw_tamagotchi_s2_5_0', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lt' })

		--J백작(right, attack, release) : 알의 체온이 빠르게 떨어지고 있어요!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'release' }, 'attack', { key = 'fw_tamagotchi_s2_5_1', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lt' })

		--J백작(right, attack, release 2회 후 idle) : 당장 체온을 빠르게 올릴 방법이 필요한데…!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'right',
				nil, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, { key = 'fw_tamagotchi_s2_5_3', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lt' })

		--꼬마공주(left, tired, cross_arm)
		scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, 'cross_arm')

		--기르가스(left, tired, cross_arm)
		scene_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim(dragon_boy, self, 'cross_arm')

		--플레이어(right, tired, cross_arm) 이모티콘 question 출력
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(knight, self, 'right',
				'cross_arm', 'tired', 'question')

		party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()

		--J백작(right, attack, release 2회 후 idle) : 알을 용암에 넣는다면… 필요한 온도를 얻을 수 있을 겁니다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, { key = 'fw_tamagotchi_s2_5_4', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lt' })


		--선택지 출력
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_async({
			--(mercy) 용암에 던진다.
			{ 'fw_tamagotchi_s2_5_5', 'mercy' },
			--(forced) 알을 용암에 던지면 삶은 계란 되는 거 아니야…?
			{ 'fw_tamagotchi_s2_5_6', 'forced' },
		})

		if choose_result == 1 then
			self:spawn_dragon()
		elseif choose_result == 2 then
			self:spawn_horse()
		end
	end

	local quest_progress = quest_util.get_started_quest(self.controller.sub_quest_id)
	quest_util.set_custom_state(quest_progress, self.controller.custom_state_key_2, self.controller.npc_placement_state)

	self.controller:set_trigger_interaction_state(self.field_object.mystery_egg_trigger(), false)

	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()

	local fx_crack = self.cashed_fx_list:get('crack')
	fx_crack.transform:SetParent(nil)
	self.cashed_fx_list:dispose('crack')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 0 })
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	-- 퀘스트 클리어
	self.controller:complete_quest()
end

function local_class:spawn_magma()
	local knight = user_party.Leader
	local princess = self.character.princess()
	local dragon_boy = self.character.dragon_boy()
	local mystery_egg = self.character.mystery_egg()
	local pet = self.character.magma()
	local count_j = self.character.count_j()

	--마그마(left, idle, idle) 등장
	field_object_util.set_active_state(mystery_egg, active_state_type.disabled)
	character_util.set_position(pet, mystery_egg.Position)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(pet, active_state_type.enabled)
	scene_util.set_direction(pet, 'left', false)

	--플레이어(right, surprise,idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'surprise')
	--꼬마공주(left, surprise, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'surprise')
	--기르가스(left, surprise, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'surprise')

	-- 1.5초에 걸쳐서 화면 전체 화이트 인
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1.5, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	--마그마(이동 방향, idle, idle)  [P]위치로 속도 4로 이동
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(pet, self, { name = 'get' })
	character_util.jump(pet, 1, 0.5)
	wp_util.move_async(pet, vector(pet.Position.x - 1, 0, pet.Position.z), nil, 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pet)

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	local wp = {
		pet.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),

	}
	wp_util.move_async(pet, wp, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

	--마그마(right, mad, attack 1회 후 마지막 프레임에서 정지)

	scene_util.set_anim(pet, self, { name = 'attack', sfx_name = false, loop = false })

	--플레이어 일행이 서 있는 방향으로  FX_Flamethrower_loop 3초간 지속

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, { dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			'release', 'attack', 'fw_tamagotchi_s2_2_1')

	--J백작(right, attack, release) : 자식이나 다름없는 아이를 공격하다니!

	scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

	scene_util.set_direction(pet, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(pet, self, 'mad')

function local_class:apply_effect_alpha(main_module, duration)
	local color = main_module.startColor.color
	main_module.startColor = self.gradient

	local time_passed = 0
	local start_alpha = color.a
	local end_alpha = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = (time_passed / duration)

		color.a = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_alpha, end_alpha, progress)
		self.gradient.color = unity_color({ color.r, color.g, color.b, color.a })
		main_module.startColor = self.gradient

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end
end

function local_class:spawn_dragon()

		vector(party_align_pos.x, 0, princess.Position.z),

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, align_key)

	--QTE 진행

	--동시 연출
	--플레이어(right, attack, idle) 상태에서 throw 애니메이션 1회

	--용암에 닿을 때 lava_boat_drop 이펙트

	--동시 연출

	character_util.move_to(mystery_egg, mystery_egg.Position + vector(0, -1, 0), 2.5)

	--꼬마공주(right, tired, embarrassed)

	scene_util.set_anim(dragon_boy, self, 'embarrassed')

	--플레이어(left, idle, embarrassed)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = false })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dragon_boy)

	local fx_lava_piller = nil
	local play_lava_piller = function(start_pos, end_pos, duration)

		fx_lava_piller = self.fx.lava_piller():Instantiate(start_pos)

		local time_passed = 0
		local progress = 0
		while time_passed < duration do
			progress = time_passed / duration
			fx_lava_piller.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	--fw_lava_fountain_lava_piller 이펙트 y좌표 -2.5에서 2.5초에 걸쳐 y좌표 -1로 이동 후 유지

	--동시 연출
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--미지의알[X] 지점에서 y좌표 -2에서 2.5초에 걸쳐서 y좌표 1로 이동 후 유지
				character_util.move_to(mystery_egg, mystery_egg.Position + vector(0, 3, 0), 2.5, nil, false, false)

				--fw_lava_fountain_lava_piller 이펙트 y좌표 -2.5에서 2.5초에 걸쳐 y좌표 -1로 이동 후 유지
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_lava_eruption_01')
				play_lava_piller(vector(mystery_egg.Position.x, -3.5, mystery_egg.Position.z),
						vector(mystery_egg.Position.x, -1.5, mystery_egg.Position.z), 2.5)
			end,
			function()
				--플레이어(left, surprise, idle)
				scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'surprise')
				character_util.remove_anim(knight)

				--꼬마공주(right, surprise, idle)
				scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'right', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'surprise')
				character_util.remove_anim(princess)

				--기르가스(right, surprise, idle)
				scene_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'right', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'surprise')
				character_util.remove_anim(dragon_boy)
			end,
			function()
				--J백작(이동 방향, idle, idle) 속도7로 [Z]위치로 이동
				party_align_pos = self.marker.knight('s2', 2, 1)
				local count_j_pos = self.marker.count_j('s2', 2, 1)
				wp = {
					vector(count_j.Position.x, 0, count_j.Position.z - 1),
					vector(party_align_pos.x + 1, 0, count_j.Position.z - 1),
					count_j_pos + vector(0, 0, -1),
				}
				wp_util.move_async(count_j, wp, 7, nil)
			end
	)

	--J백작(left, attack, release) : 당신이 정성스럽게 키워낸 이 아이!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			'release', 'attack', { key = 'fw_tamagotchi_s2_6_1', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lb' })

	--J백작(left, attack, release 2회 후 idle) : 분명 이 정도는 견뎌 낼 수 있을거라 생각했습니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, nil,
			nil, 'attack', { key = 'fw_tamagotchi_s2_6_2', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lb' })


	--플레이어(right, surprise, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.remove_anim(knight)

	--꼬마공주(right, surprise, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.remove_anim(princess)

	--기르가스(right, surprise, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.remove_anim(dragon_boy)

	--J백작(left, surprise, idle) : 게, 게다가 이 빛은!!!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'left',
			nil, { name = 'surprise', keep = true }, { key = 'fw_tamagotchi_s2_6_3', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lb' })

	--동시 연출
	--미지의알 0.03 강도로 crack 상태에서 1초간 shake
	character_util.shake(mystery_egg, 0.03, 1)
	scene_util.set_anim(mystery_egg, self, { name = 'sleep' })
	--
	--플레이어(left, surprise, embarrassed)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'embarrassed')

	--꼬마공주(right, surprise, embarrassed)
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, 'embarrassed')

	--기르가스(right, surprise, embarrassed)
	scene_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim(dragon_boy, self, 'embarrassed')

	-- 대기 시간
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--J백작(right, surprise, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(count_j, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(count_j, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.remove_anim(count_j)

	--플레이어(left, surprise, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.remove_anim(knight)

	--꼬마공주(right, surprise, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.remove_anim(princess)

	--기르가스(right, surprise, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.remove_anim(dragon_boy)

	--fx_fw_pet_incubation_light 알 위에 출력
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magic_shield_01')
	self.fx.explosion():Instantiate(mystery_egg.Position)

	--2초에 걸쳐 화이트 아웃
	screen_util.fade_out_async(2, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	--미지의알, fw_lava_fountain_lava_piller 제거
	if fx_lava_piller ~= nil then
		fx_lava_piller:Dispose()
		fx_lava_piller = nil
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.is_pet_loop_action = false

	local backup_pet_pos = vector(mystery_egg.Position.x, 0.5, mystery_egg.Position.z)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(mystery_egg, active_state_type.disabled)
	character_util.set_position(pet, backup_pet_pos, true)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(pet, active_state_type.enabled)

	--2초에 걸쳐서 화이트 인

	--동시 연출
	--플레이어(up, idle, idle)
	--꼬마공주(up, idle, idle)
	--기르가스(up, idle, idle)
	--플레이어(up, idle, idle)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	--꼬마공주(up, idle, idle)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)

	--기르가스(up, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'up', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dragon_boy)

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--J백작(up, idle, idle) : 아아, 태어났다…! 정말 훌륭한 용입니다.
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(count_j)
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'up',
						nil, nil, { key = 'fw_tamagotchi_s2_6_4', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lb' })
			end,
			function()
				--fw_dragon(left, idle, idle) [A]위치 (y= 0.5)에서 (y=1.4)로 1의 속도로 이동
				--fw_dragon 그림자는 (y=0)에서 고정 유지
				wp_util.move_async(pet, pet.Position + vector(0, 0.9, 0), 1, nil, { y_mode = 'flying' })
			end
	)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local out_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', pet.Position, -1)

	local change_party_dir = function(pivot, change_dir, is_x_greater_than_pivot, callback)
		while true do
			if is_x_greater_than_pivot then
				if pivot.x < pet.Position.x then
					party_util.set_direction(change_dir)

					if callback then
						callback()
					end

					return
				end
			else
				if pivot.x > pet.Position.x then
					party_util.set_direction(change_dir)

					if callback then
						callback()
					end

					return
				end
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
	--J백작(left, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(count_j, 'left', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(count_j)

	--fw_dragon(left, idle, idle) [A]위치에서 [B]위치로 속도4.5로 이동
	--플레이어 일행 0.2초 후에 (left, idle, idle)
	start_coroutine(function()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dragon_02')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wing_fire_02')

		wait_for_sec(1.2)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wing_fire_02')
	end)
	start_coroutine(change_party_dir, dragon_boy.Position, 'left', false)
	wp_util.move_async(pet, out_pos, 4.5, nil, { y_mode = 'flying' })

	local pivot_pos = knight.Position + vector(0, 0, -3)
	out_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', pivot_pos, -1)
	character_util.set_position(pet, vector(out_pos.x, pet.Position.y, out_pos.z), true)

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--fw_dragon(right, idle, idle) [B]위치 도착 시 [C]위치로 위치 변경
	--fw_dragon(right, idle, idle) [C]위치에서. [D]위치로 속도 8으로 이동
	--플레이어 일행(left, idle, idle)
	--꼬마공주 위치보다 우측에 용이 위치해 있을 때
	--플레이어 일행(right, idle, idle)
	--J백작(right, idle, idle)

		scene_util.set_direction(count_j, 'right', false)
	end)

	start_coroutine(function()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wing_fire_02')

		wait_for_sec(1.2)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wing_fire_02')
	end)
	out_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right', pivot_pos, 1)
	wp_util.move_async(pet, vector(out_pos.x, pet.Position.y, out_pos.z), 8, nil, { y_mode = 'flying' })


	--fw_dragon(left, idle, idle) [D]위치 도착 시, [E]위치(x=-120.4, y=10.8, z=-38.5)로 위치 변경
	character_util.set_position(pet, vector(-120.4, 10.8, -38.5), true)
	scene_util.set_direction(pet, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(pet, self, 'fly')
	character_util.set_active_shadow(pet, false)

	--캐릭터 회전 = 반시계 방향으로 140도
	character_util.spine_rotate(pet, 95, 0)

			nil, 'sleep_deep', { key = 'fw_tamagotchi_s2_7_7', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lt' })

	--J백작(right, sleep_deep, idle) : 앞으로의 선택이 곧 당신의 여정을 결정짓게 되겠지요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'right',
			nil, 'sleep_deep', { key = 'fw_tamagotchi_s2_7_8', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lt' })

	--J백작(right, sleep_deep, staff_idle) : 당신의 모험에 무운을 빕니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'right',
			'staff_idle', 'sleep_deep', { key = 'fw_tamagotchi_s2_7_9', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lt' })

	local star_piece = self.field_object.star_piece()

		pet.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
	}

	--J백작(left, sleep_deep, staff_idle) : 세상으로 나오느라 고생하셨습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'left',
			'staff_idle', 'sleep_deep',
			{ key = 'fw_tamagotchi_s2_7_10', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lb' })

	--J백작(left, sleep_deep, nod 1회 후 idle) : 지금부터는 제가 모시겠습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(count_j, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 1 }, 'sleep_deep',
			{ key = 'fw_tamagotchi_s2_7_11', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lb' })

	--불타는말(right, idle, happy) 1.5초 유지
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_horse_cast_01', 0.6)
	scene_util.play_wait_action(pet, self, 'right',

	--J백작(이동 방향, idle, walk) 속도4로 [A]위치로 이동 후, 카메라 그리드 밖에서 제거
	--불타는말(이동 방향, idle, walk) 속도4로 [A]위치로 이동 후, 카메라 그디르 밖에서 제거
	local out_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right', count_j.Position, 1.5)
	wp_util.move(pet, out_pos, 4, nil)
	wp_util.move_async(count_j, out_pos, 4, nil)

	character_util.set_position(pet, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_position(count_j, vector(999, 0, 999))

	self.controller.npc_placement_state = self.controller.npc_placement_phases.horse

	--플레이어 컨트롤 해제
	--서브퀘스트 완료
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('FireWorldTerminatorSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FireWorldTerminator @
		Comment = 터미네이터 서브 퀘스트 섹션 1 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type FireWorldTerminatorController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'fireworld_5'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		done = 999
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	--region Character
	self.get_character = {
		--터미네이터
		machine = function()
			return get_character('sub_terminator_war_machine')
		end
	}
	--endregion Character

	self.get_lava_switch = function()
		return get_field_object('sub_terminator_lava_switch')
	end

	--region Marker
	self.get_marker_pos = {
		center = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_terminator_center_pos_' .. number)
		end
	}
	--endregion Marker

	--region Sprite
	self.sprite = {
		sprite_info = {
			robot_thumb = 21657
		},
		sprite_table = {},
		sprite_table_origin_parent = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter, target, drop_type, skip_text)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}
	--endregion Sprite

	--region Fx
	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		change_cyborg_muin = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_terminator_charge')
		end,
		terminator_teleport = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_terminator_teleport')
		end,
		onefire = function()
			--return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cwp_knight_onefire')
		end,
	})

	self.fx_list = nil
	--endregion Fx

	--region Etc
	self.wait_pos = vector(999, 0, 999)

	self.in_grid = false

	self.default_machine_hit_box = nil

	-- 용암 분출구 이름
	self.lava_crater_name = 'sub_terminator_lava_crater_1'
	self.lava_name = 'sub_terminator_lava_1'
	self.is_active_flow = true

	-- 스타피스 이름
	self.star_piece_name = 'sub_terminator_star_piece_1'

	-- 서브 퀘스트 id
	self.sub_quest_id = 488

	self.follow_id = 72
	--endregion Etc
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.LavaFlowChangingEvent), 'on_lava_flow_changing_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self.default_machine_hit_box = self.get_character.machine().Hitbox

	self:start_npc_setting()

	local hand = self.sprite:create('robot_thumb_1', vector_util.get_x0z(self.get_character.machine().Position),
			self.sprite.sprite_info.robot_thumb, 1, true,
			nil, nil, true)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.get_lava_switch(), active_state_type.enabled)

	hand.Position = hand.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.2)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.LavaFlowChangingEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.get_lava_switch(), active_state_type.disabled)
	self:fx_dispose_all()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region Event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_character.machine()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.terminator_interact_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'sub_terminator_grid') then
		self.in_grid = true

		start_coroutine(self.hand_scene, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'sub_terminator_grid') then
		self.in_grid = false

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_character.machine())
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_lava_flow_changing_event(e)
	local lava_crater = get_field_object(self.lava_crater_name)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(lava_crater, e.Sender) then
		local lava = get_field_object(self.lava_name)
		local is_active = lava.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsActive

		if is_active ~= self.is_active_flow then
			self.is_active_flow = is_active

			start_coroutine(self.up_down_terminator_change, self)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--endregion Event

--region Scene
function local_class:up_down_terminator_change()
	if self.is_active_flow then
		self:up_chagne()
	else
		self:down_chagne()
	end
end

--올라갈때 변경 (따봉 손)
function local_class:up_chagne()
	local machine = self.get_character.machine()
	local hand = self.sprite.sprite_table['robot_thumb_1']

	--따봉 아저씨 비활성화
	field_object_util.set_active_state(machine, active_state_type.disabled)

	--따봉 손 활성화(보이는 곳으로 이동)
	hand.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(machine.Position)

	hand.Position = hand.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.2)

	start_coroutine(self.hand_scene, self)
end

--내려갈때 변경 (따봉 아저씨)
function local_class:down_chagne()
	local machine = self.get_character.machine()
	local hand = self.sprite.sprite_table['robot_thumb_1']

	--따봉 손 대사 제거
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_character.machine())

	--따봉 아저씨 활성화
	field_object_util.set_active_state(machine, active_state_type.enabled)

	--따봉 손 비활성화(안보이는 곳으로 이동)
	hand.Position = self.wait_pos
end

--용암 채원진 채 반복하는 씬 I'll be back
function local_class:hand_scene()
	local machine = self.get_character.machine()

	--활성화 되어 있지 않으면 실행하지 않는다.
	--그리드 안에 있지 않으면 실행하지 않는다.
	while self.is_active_flow and self.in_grid do
		--더미네이터: …….
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(machine, self, nil,
				nil, nil, { key = 'fw_sub_terminator_terminator_s1_1', skip = false })

		if not self.is_active_flow or not self.in_grid then
			return ;
		end

		--더미네이터: 아 월….
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(machine, self, nil,
				nil, nil, { key = 'fw_sub_terminator_terminator_s1_2', skip = false })

		if not self.is_active_flow or not self.in_grid then
			return ;
		end

		--더미네이터: 비….
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(machine, self, nil,
				nil, nil, { key = 'fw_sub_terminator_terminator_s1_3', skip = false })
	end
end

function local_class:terminator_interact_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local machine = self.get_character.machine()

	local machine_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(machine.Position)

	--이벤트 시작과 동시에 BGM 볼륨 0.6 으로 변경
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	machine.Hitbox = self.default_machine_hit_box

	--플레이어 (idle, walk) 상태로 1초에 걸쳐 위와 같이 정렬
	--파티원 있을 경우 리더 뒤쪽으로 차례로 정렬
	party_util.align_party(machine_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 'right', 1)

	--정렬 완료되면 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--플레이어 (left, idle, cross_arm) 상태에서 (question) 마크 출력
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self, 'left',
			'cross_arm', nil, 'question')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--더미네이터 중심에서 fx_dv_change_cyborg_muin 출력 (async 아님)
	local amb_charge_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_light_loop_03', loop = true, parent = machine })
	local fx_muin = self.fx.change_cyborg_muin():Instantiate(machine.Bounds.center + vector(0, -0.2, 0))

	--동시 출력
	--플레이어 (left, surprise, idle) 상태로 1회 normal_jump 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(leader, true)

	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 3.5크기로 줌인
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.5, 1)

	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 더미네이터 포커스 이동
	camera_util.move(machine_pos, 1)

	--플레이어 (notice) 이모티콘 출력
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'notice')

	--동시 출력 완료되면 다음 진행

	--더미네이터 (right, idle, idle) mix duration 1초로 전환
	scene_util.set_anim_async(machine, self, { name = 'idle', loop = false, mix_duration = 1 })

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--fx_dv_change_cyborg_muin 제거
	fx_muin:Dispose()
	fx_muin = nil

	--더미네이터 (right, idle, get): 시스템 정상화.
	--ㄴ 시스템 정상화. 대사가 나오는 타이밍에 해당 효과음 페이드 아웃으로 재생 종료 처리 부탁 드립니다. 믹스 값 0.3초
	amb_charge_sfx:FadeOut(0.3)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(machine)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(machine, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'fw_sub_terminator_terminator_s1_4')

	--동시 연출

	--더미네이터 (right, idle, walk4legs 정지 상태) mix duration 1초로 전환
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(machine, self, { name = 'walk4legs', loop = false, mix_duration = 1 })

	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 줌 아웃
	camera_util.resize_to_default_async(1)

	--위 연출 완료되면 순간이동 연출 진행

	--fx_terminator_teleport 더미네이터 위치에 출력
	local amb_charge_sfx_2 = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '02_light_loop_03', loop = true
	})
	self.fx.terminator_teleport():Instantiate(machine.Bounds.center)

	--동시 연출

	--더미네이터 0.2초에 걸쳐 알파값 100에서 0으로 전환
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(machine, 0, 0.2)

	--화면 shake 0.08세기로 0.5초간 출력
	camera_util.shake(0.08, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	--위 연출 모두 완료되면 다음으로 진행

	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 리더 포커스로 이동
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--플레이어 위치에 fx_dv_change_cyborg_muin 지속 출력
	local leader_pre_pos = leader.Position
	local leader_center_pos = leader.Bounds.center
	fx_muin = self.fx.change_cyborg_muin():Instantiate(leader_center_pos)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--플레이어 (파티) (right, scared, run)으로 5의 속도로 위의 상태로 직선 이동
	--도착하면 (left, scared, idle) 출력
	do
		local party_align_move_key = 'party_align'
		local pivot = self.get_marker_pos.center(1) + vector(0, 0, 3)
		local pos_table = {
			pivot,
			pivot + vector(1, 0, 0.5),
			pivot + vector(1.5, 0, 0),
			pivot + vector(1, 0, -0.5),
		}

		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			local member = user_party[i]
			local index = i + 1

			scene_util.set_emotion(member, self, 'scared')

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member, pos_table[index],
					5, nil, self, party_align_move_key, { run = true, last_direction = 'left' })
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, party_align_move_key)
	end

	--이동 완료되면 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--동시 연출
	--fx_dv_change_cyborg_muin 위치에 더미네이터 (right, idle, walk4legs) 상태로 알파값 0에서 100으로 0.2초에 걸쳐 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_cast_light_02')
	self.fx.terminator_teleport():Instantiate(leader_pre_pos)
	machine.Position = leader_pre_pos
	scene_util.set_direction(machine, 'right', false)

function local_class:start_npc_setting()
	local center_pos = self.get_marker_pos.center(1)

	local npc_data = {
		--터미네이터 (right, idle, get)
		{
			target = self.get_character.machine(),
			pos = center_pos + vector(-3, -1, 3),
			dir = 'right',
			emo = nil,
			anim = 'thumbsup',
			listener = true,
			hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(2, 2, 1)),
			is_not_active = true
		},
	}

	self:npc_setting(npc_data)
end

function local_class:npc_setting(npc_data)
	for _, target_data in pairs(npc_data) do
		local target = target_data.target
		local target_pos = target_data.pos
		local target_dir = target_data.dir
		local target_emo = target_data.emo
		local target_anim = target_data.anim
		local target_tint = target_data.tint
		local target_shake = target_data.shake
		local target_is_anim_loop = target_data.is_anim_loop
		local target_effect = target_data.effect
		local target_alpha = target_data.alpha
		local target_function = target_data.coroutine_function
		local target_listener = target_data.listener
		local target_is_not_active = target_data.is_not_active
		local target_oneline_key = target_data.oneline_key
		local target_crash_behaviour = target_data.crash_behaviour
		local target_hitbox = target_data.hitbox

		if target_is_not_active then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.disabled)
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.enabled)
		end

		if target_crash_behaviour then
			target.CrashBehaviour = target_crash_behaviour
		end

		target.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()

		character_util.set_position(target, target_pos)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)

		scene_util.set_direction(target, target_dir, false)

		if target_emo then
			scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, target_emo)
		end

		if target_oneline_key then
			target.Interactable.Talk = target_oneline_key
		end

		if target_listener then
			character_util.add_listener(target, self.controller)
		end

		if target_anim then
			scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = target_anim, loop = target_is_anim_loop, one_shot_sfx = false })
		end

		if target_shake then
			scene_util.shake(target, 0.03, 9999, false)
		end

		if target_tint then
			character_util.add_color(target, 'dark_tint', target_tint.color, target_tint.magnitude, 0)
		end

		if target_alpha then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(target, target_alpha, 0)
		end

		if target_effect then
			local fx = target_effect():Instantiate(target.Position)
			self.fx_list[target.Name] = fx
		end

		if target_hitbox then
			target.Hitbox = target_hitbox
		end

		if target_function then
			start_coroutine(function()
				target_function(target)
			end)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:fx_dispose_all()
	if self.fx_list then
		for _, target in pairs(self.fx_list) do
			if target then
				target:Dispose()
				target = nil
			end
		end

		self.fx_list = nil
	end
end
--endregion Setting

return local_class

local controller_base = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Base/QuestControllerBase')

---@class FireWorldVampireIdolController : QuestControllerBase
local local_class = newclass('FireWorldVampireIdolController', controller_base)

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.super:init(cs_controller)

	self.script_config = {
		HasPreSection = false,
		NormalSectionCount = 2,
		HasPostSection = true
	}

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version + 1

	-- character
	self.characters = {
		vampire_idol = function()
			return get_character('vampire_idol')
		end,
		princess = function()
			return get_character('princess')
		end,
		petal = function(number)
			return get_character('vi_petal_' .. number)
		end,
		female = function(number)
			return get_character('vi_female_' .. number)
		end,
		male = function()
			return get_character('vi_male')
		end,
		kid_boy = function()
			return get_character('vi_kid_boy')
		end,
		old_man = function()
			return get_character('vi_old_man')
		end,
		event_1_female = function()
			return get_character('vi_event_1_female')
		end,
		event_1_kid_boy = function()
			return get_character('vi_event_1_kid_boy')
		end,
		event_2_male = function()
			return get_character('vi_event_2_male')
		end,
		event_2_old_woman = function()
			return get_character('vi_event_2_oldwoman')
		end,
		event_3_male = function()
			return get_character('vi_event_3_male')
		end,
		event_3_kid_boy = function()
			return get_character('vi_event_3_kid_boy')
		end,
		event_3_female = function()
			return get_character('vi_event_3_female')
		end
	}

	-- event 저장용
	self.section_event = metatable_helper.inherit({
		data_storage = nil,
		custom_state_key = 's2_event_save',
		event_count = 3,
	}, {
		init_storage = function(this)
			local storage_create = require('utils/QuestDataStorage')
			this.data_storage = storage_create.create(self.cs_controller.QuestId)
		end,
		get_custom_state = function(this)
			local custom_state = this.data_storage:get_data(this.custom_state_key)

			return custom_state < 0 and 0 or custom_state
		end,
		clear_event = function(this, value)
			local custom_state = this:get_custom_state()

			custom_state = custom_state | (1 << (value - 1))
			this.data_storage:set_data_async(this.custom_state_key, custom_state)

			self:set_bgm_volume()
		end,
		check_clear_event = function(this, index)
			local custom_state = this:get_custom_state()

			return custom_state & (1 << (index - 1)) ~= 0
		end,
		get_clear_count = function(this)
			local custom_state = this:get_custom_state()
			local clear_count = 0

			for i = 0, this.event_count - 1 do
				if custom_state & (1 << i) ~= 0 then
					clear_count = clear_count + 1
				end
			end

			return clear_count
		end,
		--remove_custom_state = function(this)
		--	this.data_storage:remove_data_async(this.custom_state_key)
		--end,
		dispose = function(this)
			this.data_storage = nil
		end
	})

	-- 세실 bgm 정보
	self.bgm_info = {
		zone_name = 'vampire_idol_zone',
		bgm_name = 'ondemand/v2_10_futurecastle_part2/audio/music:bgm_idol_panorama_02',
		volume = 0,
		add_volume_value = 0.25,
		change_bgm = false,
		current_bgm_state = nil,
		current_stage_bgm_name = nil
	}

	self.is_stage_exit = false
end

function local_class:load_resource()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()

	self.is_stage_exit = true

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	self.section_event:dispose()
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.bgm_info.change_bgm and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.bgm_info.zone_name) then
		self:play_vampire_idol_bgm()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.bgm_info.change_bgm and type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), self.bgm_info.zone_name) then
		self:play_stage_bgm()

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion event

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	local petal_count = 5
	for i = 1, petal_count do
		local petal = self.characters.petal(i)
		character_util.set_sorting_layer(petal, 'Default', -1)
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
end

--- 세실 존 bgm 적용
function local_class:play_vampire_idol_bgm()
	-- 섹션 1에서는 적용되지 않음
	if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress == nil or
			self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress == 0 then
		return
	end

	-- 클리어 이후 볼륨 설정
	if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress ~= nil and self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.IsComplete then
		self.bgm_info.volume = 1
	end

	if self.bgm_info.volume == 0 then
		return
	end

	--TODO : 세실 컨트롤러 기능과 동일
	self.bgm_info.current_bgm_state = music_player.StageBgmState

	if music_player.StageBgmState == stage_bgm_state.event then
		self.bgm_info.current_stage_bgm_name = music_player.StageEventMusicName
	elseif music_player.StageBgmState == stage_bgm_state.theatre or
			music_player.StageBgmState == stage_bgm_state.fanfare then
		self.bgm_info.current_bgm_state = stage_bgm_state.field
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = self.bgm_info.bgm_name, state = 'event', volume = self.bgm_info.volume })

	self.bgm_info.change_bgm = true
end

--- 기존 bgm 원복
function local_class:play_stage_bgm()
	-- 섹션 1에서는 적용되지 않음
	if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress == nil or
			self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress == 0 or

	end)

function local_class:petal_anim_async(target, args, play_sfx, play_windchime_sfx)
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(target, 'Top Effects', 5)

	local anim_scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(args.scale, 1)
	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(target, args.name)
	local is_play_sfx = lua_helper.get_or_default(play_sfx, true)
	local is_play_windchime_sfx = lua_helper.get_or_default(play_windchime_sfx, false)

	if is_play_sfx and args.name == 'hide' and anim_scale < 10 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_windchime_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gather_bush_02', volume = 0.7 })
	elseif is_play_sfx and args.name == 'show' then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_cry_02')

		if is_play_windchime_sfx then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_windchime_01')
		end
	end

	scene_util.set_anim(target, self, args)

	if is_play_sfx and args.name == 'show' then
		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(anim_duration - 0.8, function(_)
			return not self.is_stage_exit
		end)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gather_bush_02', volume = 0.7 })

		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(0.8, function(_)
			return not self.is_stage_exit
		end)
	else
		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(anim_duration, function(_)
			return not self.is_stage_exit
		end)
	end

	character_util.set_sorting_layer(target, 'Default', -1)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('FireWorldVampireIdolPostSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = post @
		QuestName = FireWorldVampireIdol @

]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type FireWorldVampireIdolController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'fireworld_2'

	-- character
	self.characters = controller.characters

	-- marker
	self.markers = {
		vampire_idol_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('vi_vampire_idol_pos')
		end,
		petal_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('vi_s1_petal_pos_' .. number)
		end,
	}

	self.req_cnt = 0
	self.is_stage_exit = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	self:set_npc()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	local zone_bound = field:GetZone(self.controller.bgm_info.zone_name).Bounds

	if zone_bound:Intersects(user_party.Leader.Bounds) then
		start_coroutine(self.play_petal_routine, self)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	self.is_stage_exit = true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.controller.bgm_info.zone_name) then
		start_coroutine(self.play_petal_routine, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), self.controller.bgm_info.zone_name) then
		self.req_cnt = self.req_cnt + 1

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_npc()
	-- 세실 (down, sing, sing2) 인터랙트 불가능한 상태로, 위치에 대기
	local vampire_idol = self.characters.vampire_idol()

	character_util.set_position(vampire_idol, self.markers.vampire_idol_pos())
	character_util.set_direction(vampire_idol, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion(vampire_idol, self, 'sing2')
	scene_util.set_anim(vampire_idol, self, { name = 'sing', one_shot_sfx = false })
	vampire_idol.Interactable.Talk = 'fw_sub_vi_s2_67'

	local petal_count = 5

	for i = 1, petal_count do
		local petal = self.characters.petal(i)

		petal.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		character_util.set_position(petal, self.markers.petal_pos(i))
		character_util.set_direction(petal, 'down')
		field_object_util.set_active_state(petal, active_state_type.enabled)
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(petal, field_ui_type.character_stats)
		character_util.set_active_shadow(petal, false)
	end
end

function local_class:play_petal_routine()
	self.req_cnt = self.req_cnt + 1

	local req_cnt = self.req_cnt
	local petals = { self.characters.petal(1), self.characters.petal(2), self.characters.petal(3),
					 self.characters.petal(4), self.characters.petal(5) }

	local anim_routine = function(petal)
		self.controller:petal_anim_async(petal, { name = 'hide', loop = false }, false)

		if self.is_stage_exit then
			return
		end

		self.controller:petal_anim_async(petal, { name = 'show', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' }, false)

		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(2, function(_)
			return not self.is_stage_exit
		end)
	end

	while req_cnt == self.req_cnt and not self.is_stage_exit do
		start_coroutine(anim_routine, petals[1])

		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(1, function(_)
			return not self.is_stage_exit
		end)

		if self.is_stage_exit then
			return
		end

		start_coroutine(anim_routine, petals[4])

		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(1, function(_)
			return not self.is_stage_exit
		end)

		if self.is_stage_exit then
			return
		end

		start_coroutine(anim_routine, petals[3])

		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(1, function(_)
			return not self.is_stage_exit
		end)

		if self.is_stage_exit then
			return
		end

		start_coroutine(anim_routine, petals[5])

		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(1, function(_)
			return not self.is_stage_exit
		end)

		if self.is_stage_exit then
			return
		end

		start_coroutine(anim_routine, petals[2])

		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(1, function(_)
			return not self.is_stage_exit
		end)
	end
end

return local_class

		twinkle_fx = nil,

		item_ids = { 21672, 21673, 21674 },

			interact_desk = 3,

				this.kid_boy.Interactable.Talk = nil

			scene_util.set_direction(this.soul_male, 'down', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(this.soul_male, self, 'sleep_deep')
			scene_util.set_anim(this.soul_male, self, 'cast')
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(this.soul_male, 0.7, 0)
			character_util.force_update_spines(this.soul_male, 1)
		end,
		dispose_items = function(this)

				end

			this.kid_boy = nil

		soul_kid_boy = nil,

			none = 1,

			this.male = self.characters.event_2_male()
			this.old_woman = self.characters.event_2_old_woman()
			this.soul_kid_boy = self.characters.kid_boy()

				this.old_woman.Interactable.Talk = nil

			character_util.set_position(this.soul_kid_boy, self.markers.petal_pos(2))

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(this.soul_kid_boy, 0.7, 0)
			character_util.force_update_spines(this.soul_kid_boy, 1)
		end,
		dispose_petal = function(this)
			if this.petal ~= nil then

				this.petal = nil
			end

		dispose_group = function(this)

			field_object_util.set_active_state(this.old_woman, active_state_type.disabled)

			this:dispose_petal()

			this.male = nil
			this.old_woman = nil

		end

	-- 이벤트 그룹 3
	self.event_3_group = metatable_helper.inherit({
		event_number = 3,
		male = nil,
		female = nil,
		kid_boy = nil,
		soul_old_man = nil,
		desk = nil,
		zone_name = 'vi_event_3_group_zone',
		twinkle_fx = nil,
		item_id = 21675,
		cur_state = 0,
		petal = nil,
		state = {
			none = 1,
			zone_event = 2,
			interact_desk = 3,
			give_item = 4
		}
	}, {
		init_group = function(this)
			this.male = self.characters.event_3_male()
			this.female = self.characters.event_3_female()
			this.kid_boy = self.characters.event_3_kid_boy()
			this.soul_old_man = self.characters.old_man()
			this.desk = self.fo.group_3_desk()

			character_util.set_active_shadow(this.soul_old_man, false)
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(this.soul_old_man, field_ui_type.character_stats)

				this.cur_state = this.state.none

			end

			self.controller:set_event_3_clear()

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(this.soul_old_man, 0.7, 0)
			character_util.force_update_spines(this.soul_old_man, 1)
		end,
		dispose_petal = function(this)
			if this.petal ~= nil then
				load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs({ this.petal })

			end
		end,
		dispose_group = function(this)
			character_util.remove_relate_event(this.male, self.controller)

			if this.twinkle_fx ~= nil then
